verses.english_text: In the Name of Allah, most Beneficent, most Merciful.
Praise belongs to Allah (the worthy of praise), Who is sustainer of the worlds.
Most compassionate, Most Merciful.
Owner of the Day of Judgement.
(O Allah) We pray to You and seek help from You.
You keep us constant on the straight path.
On the path of those on whom you have bestowed your grace and not of those who have earned your wrath and gone astray.
Alif Laam Meem
. This is the book (of Allah) (which you know), there is no doubt (of any kind) in this, this is the guide for the people who fear Allah
. Who believe in the unseen, and pray steadfastly and spend (in the name of Allah) from whatever We have given them
And believe in whatever has been revealed to you (O Prophet) and on those before you and these are people who believe in the Day of Judgement
These are the people who have been guided by the Lord and these will get their desires
The people who disbelieve (O Prophet) make no difference for them whether you warn them or not they will not become believers.
Allah has sealed their hearts, their ears (and they will not become believers) and there is a veil upon their eyes and there is great torment for them.
Certain people who (orally) say that they believe in Allah and on the Day of Judgement but (in fact) they are non-believers.
They deceive Allah and the believers, but in fact they deceive themselves and they do not have any intelligence.
There was disease in their heart which Allah has (now) increased and since people were used to speaking lies hence there is difficulty and torment (on them).
And when it is said that: do not spread immorality on the earth, they say we are doing rectifications.
Beware, without doubt they are spreading immorality but do not understand.
And when they are told to become believers like others, they say shall we become believers like fools believe, beware they are fools but do not realize.
When they meet the believers, they say that they are the believers but when they meet with their evil ones in isolation, they say we are with you; we just make them (Muslims) fools.
Allah makes them and loosen their strings, so they get entangled in their disobedience.
These are the people who have purchased aberration over guidance, then neither did they benefit from the business, nor did they get guidance.

Their likeness is similar to a person who lit the fire (among the gathering) during the night when the fire lit the area around him, Allah took away their light and left them in utter darkness that they could not see anything.
They are deaf, dumb, and blind and could not avoid their aberration.

Or their likeness is to the night of rain where there is pit darkness, thundering and lightening and with the fear of death they have plugged their ears with their fingers, but Allah has encircled the unbelievers (that they could not escape).

Lightning may dazzle their eyes, when there was lightning, they started walking and when there was darkness, they were made numb, if Allah pleased, He could have taken their power of seeing and hearing, no doubt Allah has power on everything.
O people! Pray to your Lord who has created you and the people before you. (You) may become God-fearing.

(Allah) Who made earth your bedding and sky the ceiling and sent down the rain from Paradises then He grew fruits for your sustenance then do not make anyone partner to Allah, however you know it better.

If you are in any doubt over the wordings of what I revealed on My servant (Mohammad [SAW]) and if you are truthful then you write a similar Surah and apart from Allah whoever is your helper, call him also.
If you cannot do this, and you can never do this, then fear the fire which is fueled by men and the stones and is prepared for the infidels.

And who have become believers and have done good work (O Prophet) grant them glad tidings that there are gardens (of Paradises) and beneath there are rivers, when they will eat the fruits they will say that they have had these fruits earlier because they will get the similar kind of fruits and in Paradise and there will be neat and pure wives and they will stay there (in gardens) forever.

Undoubtedly Allah does not does not hesitate in describing a mosquito (and tinier than this) as an example, who are believers know that the example is just and is from their Lord, infidels say that what does Allah wants to describe with this example, Allah leaves many in misguidance and guides many with this example, but He leaves in misguidance to the wicked (only).
Those who break the covenant of Allah after confirmation and breach the order (teachings) of Allah and spread corruption on the earth (actually) these are people who are at loss.

(Oh) How can you deny the existence of Allah, whereas, when you were lifeless (in the wombs of your mothers) He gave you life and He will cause you to die (and again) He will bring you to life (again) on the Day of Judgement and you will be returned to Him.
It is He (Allah) Who created everything on earth for your benefit then He thought of (making) sky, so He created seven (strong) skies, and He (Allah) has perfect knowledge of everything.

And (O Prophet) remember the time when your Lord said that He wants to make a vicegerent on the earth so angels said (with awe) You will create one who will spread corruption and cause bloodshed on the earth whereas (if You want to make a vicegerent we are more deserving because) we praise and glorify You and prove your piousness, the Allah said there is no doubt whatever I know you do not know.
And to prove the veracity of Adam He taught him all the names then He presented (whose names were taught) to the angels and said if you are right then tell Me the names.
The angels expressed (their) inability and replied Glory to You, we do not know anything except whatever You have taught us and You are all knowing and identifier of the interests.

(At that time) Allah ordered Adam to tell the names of those people, when Adam told the names of those people to the angles then Allah addressed the angles and said have I not told you that I know the secrets of earth and the skies and whatever you declare and hide (all that) I know.
And (remember the time) when I asked angels to prostrate before Adam, everyone bowed down, but Iblis refused and was arrogant and became infidel.
And I told (to Adam), O Adam inhabit in Paradise with your wife and eat bountiful things you want but do not go near that tree (otherwise) you will cause harm to yourself.

Then Satan betrayed Adam and Havva and at last brought him out (of the comfort in which they were) and I told (O Adam and Havva) to go on earth and there will be enemy of one another and on the earth your dwelling place and stay (will be) until certain time (till Day of Judgement).
Then Adam learnt from his Lord some words (of apology) and Allah (with the blessings of those words) accepted the apology of Adam and Allah is undoubtedly and He is very compassionate and forgiver.

(And when) He (Adam) was ordered to descend down (it was also told to him that) if the guidance come to you from Me follow it (because) whoever will follow My guidance will have no fear (on the Day of Judgement) and will not grieve.
And remember this also that whoever becomes infidel and denies Our verses then he will go to Hell and will remain in Hell forever.
O Bani Israel (children of Jacob [Yaqoob]) remember My favours done earlier and fulfil your covenant with Me and I will also reward you and fear Me only.

Whatever has been revealed here complement that book (Torah) also which is with you and do not become first ones to deny and do not sell My verses cheaply (for worldly benefit) and continue to fear Me.
Do not mix right with wrong and do not hide the right which you know.
And pray regularly and give Zakat and those who bow down (in front of Me) you also bow down with them.
You preach righteousness (to others) but do not look at yourselves whereas you read the Book of Allah regularly and (yet) you do not understand this?
In the time of tragedy take refuge in prayer and have patience, however, prayer is difficult but not for the humble ones.
They know better that they will be presented in the Court of Lord and Verily will be returned to Him.
O Bani Israel! Remember Our favors bestowed upon you, and (also think) that We preferred you over the worlds.
And fear the day when nobody can give ransom nor intercession and replacement will be accepted, and no one can be helped (from outside).

And remember the time when we delivered you (your forefathers) from the clutches of Firaun who were greatly troubling you. (Firaun) was slaughtering your young ones and keeping your females (for their service), this was a tremendous trial by your Lord (of your patience).
(And also remember the time) When We parted the sea into pieces then We delivered you.

And drowned the people of Firaun in front of you and (also remember the time) when I promised Moosa the forty nights and after his departure you made a calf (for worshipping) whereas you were persecuting yourselves.
Even then We forgave you so that you would be thankful.
And remember the time when I gave the book (Torah) to Moosa and gave laws to differentiate between just and unjust so you can be guided.

And remember the time when Moosa told his people that you have done injustice by praying to the calf (as God), and now there is no other way than you repent to God and kill (the guilty among) yourself and that is better near your God; when you did this Allah accepted your repentance, undoubtedly, He is the most forgiver compassionate.
And also remember the time when you told Moosa that you will not believe in God until we see him face to face, and that the lightening took on you and you were just staring.
Then We gave you life after death so you can be thankful.
And We sent the cloud and sent Mann-va-Salwa saying to eat the good things provided to you and they did not do any harm, they harm themselves.

And remember the time when We told you to go to the village (Irja) and eat (and drink) whatever you want and enter from the gate prostrating and saying Hitta so We will forgive your sins and will increase the reward for those who do good things.
Whatever was told some mischievous people changed and started uttering other thing, then We send unto them the epidemic from sky because of their mischief.

And remember the time when Moosa asked for the water for his tribe, We asked Moosa to strike his strand on the stone and twelve rivers came out after he stroke and everyone identified their own pier and We allowed them to sustain and asked them refrain from corruption.

And also remember the time you told Moosa that you cannot withstand one food and asked him to pray to his Lord so He cucumber and wheat (or garlic) and lentil and onion in place of Mann-va-Salwa, Moosa told them you want to replace the superior food with the common food items then land in some city and whatever you desire is available, then they were disgraced and will become dependent and they return towards the wrath of God, this befall on them because they denied the signs of God, they killed prophets and because they disobeyed and rebelled.

Indeed, the apparent believers, Jews and Christians and Sabians whoever truly believe in God and the Day of Judgement and did good work, their rewards are with the God and on the Day of Judgement they will not have fear of any kind and their hearts will not grieve.

And remember the time when We took pledge from you for obeying Torah and We brought Mount Tur (Sinai) on your head and asked you to hold Torah tightly and remember whatever is mentioned in it so you fear Allah.
And then you deviated, had it not been Grace and Mercy of Allah you would have been great losers.
And you know those people who infringed the covenant of the Day of Sabbath. So, we told them you have violated and become apes with disgrace, and they became so.
So We set this incident as an example of punishment for those who witnessed it and for the generations to come and a lesson for the people who fear Allah.
And remember the time when Moosa told his tribe that Allah has ordained that you slaughter a heifer and they said are you joking, Moosa said I seek refuge in Allah that I be among the ignorant ones.

Then they said to him to ask Allah how that heifer should look like, Moosa said that Allah is saying that heifer should not be too old or too young but should be of middle age and you should obey what has been commanded.
They solicit Allah that He should tell us what the color should be, Moosa said Allah is saying that heifer should be of dark fawn color and should be pleasant to the people.
Then they said beseech Allah and He may tell us how the heifer should be because it has become ambiguous and if Allah is willing, we will find it.

Moosa said Allah has commanded that heifer should not be domesticated not should have been used for ploughing nor should have been used for irrigation, should be healthy, unicolor and spotless, they said not it has become clear, after all they slaughtered the heifer, however they were not going to do it.
When you killed a person there was a dispute and you started blaming each other and you were hiding but Allah wished to reveal it.
Then We told them to touch the piece of meat of the heifer on the dead body and Allah brings to life from the dead like this and shows His signs so you understand.

Hereafter your hearts become like rocks and even harder, for rivers gush out of some rocks, and some have cracks and water spurt out of them and some rocks fall down because of fear of Allah and whatever you are doing Allah is not oblivious to it.
O Muslims! You expect them to believe like you, among them is one group who listen and understand the Words of Allah but distort it in spite of the fact that they understand and know it.

When they meet those who are believers, they say we believe, and when some of them meet in private they say will you disclose to the believers what has been revealed to you so that they give you the reasoning and argue in front of Allah, do you not understand.
Don’t you understand this much that Allah knows all whatever they conceal or reveal.
There are illiterate among them who understand the Book of Allah for their selfish gains and that is their figment of imagination.
Woe unto them who write book and publicize it as the Book of Allah to earn some money, woe unto them that they wrote with their hands and woe unto them that they earn in this way.
And they say that hell fire cannot touch them for more than a few days, tell them have you taken any promise from Allah that he cannot break or they are blaming Allah without any thought.
Yes, who earned bad deeds and were surrounded by sins are the people of Hell and shall remain forever there.
And the people who are faithful and have done good deeds deserve Paradise and will remain forever there.

And remember the time We took the covenant from Bani Israel none but Allah, and behave with kindness with parents, relatives, orphans, and needy and talk softly with these people, worship and give charity, and all of you except a few turned back and you are the people who turn back.
And remember the time when we have taken a covenant from your elders not to shed blood and do not deport people from the city and they have agreed and you are aware about this.

Then you are the people who kill each other and unfairly assist a group to deport others from the city and it is interesting if they come as prisoners you release them by paying ransom though you were prohibited from deporting them, then do you believe part of the Book of Allah and reject some parts, and whoever among you will follow this will be punished and defamed and will return to the severest punishment on the Day of Judgement and Allah is not unaware of what you do.
These are the people who brought this world in lieu of the everlasting world, there won’t be any concession in their punishment nor any help will reach them.

This is proven that We gave Book to Moosa and later many messengers followed his footsteps and We gave many obvious miracles to the son of Maryam, Isa and helped him with Holy Spirit, have you become so immodest that whenever any messenger bring order from Allah which is against your wishes you puffed up and you negated some prophets and kill some.
They say their hearts are wrapped, no, but because of their infidelity they are cursed by Allah and few people become believers.

When the Book of Allah came to them which confirms the book which they already had and they were praying with their book for victory over infidels, when those signs came, which they knew, they refuted it, curse of Allah is on infidels.

Miserable is the cost for which they have sold their souls that Allah chooses the person to reveal upon him His Book and in the envy, they repudiated whatever Allah has sent, wrath upon wrath has befallen upon them, and there is humiliating punishment for the infidels.

And when they were told to believe what have been revealed they said we already believe on whatever have been revealed to us and do not believe what has been revealed after that although whatever have been revealed is truth and whatever they already have also confirms this, now you tell them if indeed they are believers why they have slayed earlier messengers.
Moosa have come with clear signs yet they worshipped the calf and did injustice to themselves.

And remember the time when we took covenant from you and brought Mount Tur (Sinai) on your heads saying hold firmly what have been sent to you and listen, they said we heard but would disobey, they drank to their hearts the love of calf, tell them your faith gives bad instructions, if you have faith.
O Prophet! Tell these people if they think if the house near Allah on the Day of Judgement is meant for them and not for others, then seek death if you are sincere.
But due to bad deeds which their hands have already sent, they will never seek death and Allah knows the wrong-doers very well.

And, O Prophet! You will find these people greedier for life and polytheists wish to live a thousand years, although if they get this long life, it cannot save them from wrath of Allah, and Allah sees well what they do.

O Prophet! Tell these people whoever is enemy of Gabriel should know that Gabriel had delivered by command of Allah the Quran on your heart and it confirm the books which have been revealed earlier and are accessible to them and there are glad tidings for the truthful.
Whoever is enemy of Allah, His angels, and His messengers and especially of Gabriel and Mikhail than Allah is Verily enemy of these infidels.
And, O Prophet! We have sent clear and explicit signs to you which nobody can deny but disobedient.
And their condition is such when then enter into covenant one party broke it and many are non-believers.
And when came the messenger of Allah and he confirmed their book too, one group of those People of Book threw behind the Book of Allah and they know nothing.

And they followed the words which during the time of Suleiman devils were used to recite, although Suleiman was not unbeliever but evils turned unbelievers and taught magic to the people and those things were revealed to two angels; Haroot and Maroot, in Babul, though they never taught anybody until they told them that we are the source of testing and do not become unbelievers by following this, yet they were used to learn tips to create dispute among husband and wife, but without the Will of Allah they could not have harmed anybody and they were used to learn such acts which were harmful and not of any use to them despite they knew that whoever will purchase these deeds will be unlucky on the Day of Judgement and its outcome is very wicked against which they have exchanged their lives, alas, they should have understood something.
And they become believers and abstain from magic, etc. then the reward from the Court of Allah would have been much better, only if they would have understood.
O believers, when you want the attention of the Prophet, don’t address him as “ra’na”, instead address him as “anzarna” and listen attentively and there are painful punishments for the infidels.

O Prophet! Who become unbelievers among People of Book and infidels do not want that revelation to be sent to you but they cannot do anything because Allah choses whoever He wants and Allah is so bountiful.
O Prophet! Whenever we abrogate any verse or make it forget, We substitute with similar or better one also, don’t you know Allah is all powerful.
Don’t you know that the Kingdom of earth and the sky is undeniably exclusively for Allah and except Allah you do not have any Patron or Helper.
O Believers! Will you put irrelevant questions to your Prophet as people used to ask Moosa and whoever accepted infidelity in lieu of faith Verily have gone astray.

O Believers! Some of the People of Book due to envy want you to revert to ignorance after accepting the faith and that’s too when they know the reality but you forgive them till Allah reveals His command, verily Allah is capable of everything.
Keep praying and give charity, whatever good you will send forth, you will see its reward with Allah, and whatever you do Allah is Verily watching it.
And Jews and Christians both say only they will go to Paradise, it is only their imagination, tell them if you are truthful then show your proof.
However, whoever prostrate before Allah and also did good work, there reward is with Allah for such people, and on the Day of Judgement they will not fear anything, nor shall they grieve.

And Jews say faith of Christians is not good and Christians say the same about Jews, this they say in spite they read the Book of Allah and infidels also say likewise, they fight among them and know nothing, on the Day of Judgement Allah will judge among them.

And what cruelty will more that people are stopped from going to Mosques and plan to destroy them, they should not enter the Mosques but fearfully, there is heavy punishment for such people on the Day of Judgement.
Turn to East or West, all directions go to Allah, verily Allah has all the scope and knows everything.
And Jews say that Allah has got a son, verily Allah is clear of all this, Allah owns everything on the earth and sky and everything obeys Him.
He is the primal origin of the earth and the sky and whenever He wants to do something He just commands and the thing comes into existence.

And a polytheist who does not know anything says why Allah does not speak to us or why does not any sign come to us? People before them have spoken likewise their hearts are identical and whoever has firm belief We have shown them our signs clearly.
O Prophet! We have sent you with truthful religion to give glad tiding and as warner and you will not be asked anything about the people of Hell.

O Prophet! Unless you follow the religion of Jews and Christians they will not be satisfied, O Prophet! Tell them guidance is Guidance of Allah, and after receiving the knowledge of Quran if you will follow the desires, remember nobody can save you from the wrath of Allah and no one will be your patron or helper.
Whom We have given Book they read it in a way it should be read, these people who believe and whoever deny are at loss.
O Bani-Israel remember the bounties We have bestowed upon you and given you significance over others.
And fear the day when no sacrifice will be accepted and no one can pay ransom and no one’s recommendation will be accepted and nor they can reach any help.

O Prophet! Remind Bani-Israel the time when Allah tried Ibrahim with certain commands few deeds and they succeeded in completing then Allah stated O Ibrahim We are going to make you Leader of the People, Ibrahim asked about his offspring He said Our positions do not go to tyrants.

O Prophet! Remind the time when We made Kaaba a place of reward and refuge and commanded Ibrahim to make this place for prayer and took covenant from Ibrahim and Ismail to keep this House clean for the people doing circumambulation, etikaf, bowing and prostrating

And O Prophet remind them the time when Ibrahim prayed, O my Lord make this city, city of refuge and peace and among its dwellers whoever believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement give them different fruits to eat, Allah said alright We will allow them the benefit for some days in this world then will make them helpless and pull them towards Hell and which is very unpleasant place.

And remind them of the time when Ibrahim and Ismail were elevating the foundation of Kaaba and were praying O my Lord accept our services verily only You listens to our prayers and know our intention.
O my Lord make us Your obedient and form a tribe from our children who are Your obedient, show us the rituals of Hajj and accept our repentance and verily only you accept the repentance.
O my Lord send your messenger from among them to read out your verses and your other Books and teach them wisdom and purify them, verily only You are predominant, and You devise the strategy.
And who is who will hate the way of Ibrahim and make himself fool and verily We selected him in this world, and he will be among the righteous people on the Day of Judgement.
When their Lord asked them to accept Islam, they said I accept the Islam of the Lord of the World.
Likewise, Ibrahim did will to children, and also did Yaqoob, and they said O my children Allah has chosen Islam for you and do not die but as Muslim.

O Jews, were you there, when death come to Yaqoob and he asked his children who you will worship after me, they said we will worship your Lord and the Lord of your father and forefathers Ibrahim, Ismail and Ishaq who is One and Only and we are His obedient.
O Jews! They have gone, they will face whatever they have earned, you will face whatever you will earn, you will not be questioned for their deeds.
They ask you to become Jew or Christian to be on the right path, tell them we are on the path of Ibrahim who avoided infidelity and was not among unbelievers.

O believers! Say you have faith on Allah and believe what has been sent to us and believe on whatever have been sent on Ibrahim, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqoob, and children of Yaqoob, and on the books revealed on Moosa and Isa, and we do not differentiate among messengers, and we are obedient to Allah.

Thus, if they become believers like you then they are on the right path, and if they have turned away, they are just opposing you, O Prophet! Your Allah is sufficient to save you from their mischief, and He listens to all knows all.
O believers! Tell them colour is only the colour of Allah and which colour will be better than the colour of Allah, and we worship Him only.
O Prophet! You ask them, are you fighting us for the Lord, whereas our Allah is the same as He is your Lord also, thus our deeds are for us and your deeds are for you and we are purely His slaves.

Are you saying that Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqoob, they were all Jews or Christians? O Prophet! Ask them, “Are you better aware or Allah? And who is more unjust than those who conceal and Allah is not unaware of your deeds.
These were the people who have gone, whatever they have earned is for them, and whatever you will earn will be for you, and you will not be questioned for their deeds.
Some fools will say that what is the reason for Muslims to change the Qibla for prostration, O Prophet! In reply tell them East or West belong to Allah and He guided whomever He pleases.

And We made you Middle Ummah with respect to Qibla so you be witness to people’s deeds and Prophet be witness to your deeds, first Qibla We made to test the people who follow Prophet and who turn their heels from him, however this Qibla is heavy on their hearts except for those who have been guided and Allah does not wish to reject your deeds, He is Very Kind and Merciful on the people.

O Prophet! Verily We observe your looking towards Paradise to change the Qibla, definitely We will ask you to turn to Qibla so that you become happy, so pray towards the Holy Mosque and O believers! Wherever you are, turn your face towards Kaaba and whoever was given the Book knows well that changing the Qibla is a just deed and is from their Lord and whatever people do Allah is not unaware of it.

They will not accept any argument you put forth for your Qibla and you also are going to accept their Qibla and even People of Book does not accept Qibla of each other, and after receiving the knowledge if you follow their desire, you will become disobedient.
Whomever We gave Book they recognize their Prophet as they recognize their sons and some of them conceal the truth openly.
O Prophet! The truth is from Allah, do not be among the people who doubt.
Everyone is turning to one side, O Muslims, forget the dispute and hasten towards the good deeds, wherever you are, Allah will bring you towards Him, and verily Allah is capable of everything.
O Prophet! Wherever you go, turn towards the Holy Mosque while praying and certainly the new Qibla is a truth from your Allah and Allah is not unaware of your deeds.

O Prophet! From wherever you go for prayer, turn towards the Sacred Mosque and O Muslims, wherever you are for prayer turn your face this way so people should not blame you but hypocrites will blame you, do not be afraid of wicked ones, fear Me only so the blessings reach you and you get guided.
Like We sent a messenger from among you who read out our verses to purify you, teach you stories of the Book and wisdom, and teach you the things which you did not know.
And Remember Me so that I remember you, and keep thanking Me, and do not be thankless.
O Believers! Have patience and ask for help through prayers and verily Allah is with those who have patience.
And people who are killed in the way of Allah don’t call them dead; they are alive but you don’t notice.
And verily, I will test you through fear, hunger, loss of goods and life and scarcity of fruits and give glad tidings who patiently persevere.
And when some difficulty befall they spontaneously say we are from Allah and unto Him we shall return.
Give glad tidings that Mercy and Blessings of Allah are on these people and they are people who have been guided.

Verily Mount Safa and Marwa are the signs of Allah and whoever performs Hajj or Umrah and there is no harm if they walk between them and whosoever performs the good deeds happily Allah also values and knows them.
Verily those who conceal Our explicit proofs and guidance which I have clearly revealed, whereas We have explained in the Book, so Allah curses them and those who curse also curse them.
Those who concealed but repent, I accepted their repentance, and I am Acceptor of repentance and Merciful.
Those who turned unbelievers and died in that condition, curse of Allah, Angels and of mankind on them.
They will always be cursed, and they won’t be given any concession or chance in their punishment.
And your Lord is only Allah and no other god Who is Most Kind and Most Merciful.

Verily creation of sky and the earth, changing of day night, people who take merchandise in ships on seas, the rain which comes from sky, soil coming to life after being dead, spreading of different animals, blowing of breeze, the clouds which are spread between earth and sky, these are clear symbols for the intelligent people.

Some people make a similar god and make partner of Allah, and love them as they should love Allah, people who are believers love Allah in a better way, and alas, wicked people could imagine what punishment they will experience, Allah is all powerful, and He gives very severe punishment.
What difficult time will be when leaders will get rid of their followers, and they will witness that their mutual relationship is broken.

And their followers will say if we return to the earth, we will also get rid of them like they have separated from us, Allah will show them their deeds and there will be only remorse, and how they will come out of Hell-Fire.
O People! consume the lawful and pure eatables, and do not follow the footsteps of the Devil, he is your sworn enemy.
He will openly invite you towards evil deeds and he wants that you blame Allah without knowledge.
When they are asked to follow the orders sent by Allah, they deny saying we will follow the tradition of our forefathers whereas their forefathers knew nothing, nor they were on the straight path.

And those who become unbelievers are similar to an animal; that they call to an animal who just listens to their call and understands nothing, such people are deaf, dumb and blind and understand nothing
O believers! Consume the pure things given to you and if you worship Allah, thank Him only.

He has prohibited meat of dead animals, blood and meat of pig and meat of those animals on whom somebody else’s name was uttered while slaughtering, however, whosoever is helpless and is not rebellious and do not transcend if they consume something from this, there is no harm for them, Allah is so Forgiving and Merciful.

Verily people who conceal the things revealed in the Book for small worldly gain they fill their bellies with fire and on the Day of Judgement Allah will not speak to them nor will forgive their sins and for them is painful punishment.
These are the people who exchanged straying with guidance and forgiveness with punishment then how they will bear Hell-Fire.
This is because Allah sent a Book with guidance and verily those people who chiefly oppose it reach far deep in ill fortune.

Good deeds are not only that people turn their face towards East or West for some time, but good deeds are those that they should believe in Allah, Day of Judgement, His Angels, Books and messengers, and in their love they should part with their wealth for their relatives, orphans, needy, migrants, and people who ask from them, for slaves, and pray regularly and give charity, should respect the covenants and if poverty, sorrow, and difficult time strike them, they should be steadfast, these are pious people.

O believers! If someone is killed then you can revenge life in exchange of a life; free-man for free-man, slave for slave, woman for women, but if heir of the killed wish to pardon the killer so he should also match their response and pay reasonable blood-money, this is a concession and kindness from your Lord but if someone exceeds the limit then there is grievous punishment for him.
O Wise one! There is life in revenge, so you desist from bloodshed.
O believers! You are commanded that when someone’s death approaches and he leaves behind wealth he should make reasonable will for parents and near relatives, it is duty for those who fear Allah.
Onus is on the person who have heard it and then changed it, he will bear the sin of the same, verily Allah knows all and listens.
Then if person is apprehensive of partiality on the part of testator but he arrives at a compromise with the heirs then there is no sin for it, verily Allah is All Forgiving and Most Kind.
O believers! Observe fasting, it has been made compulsory for you, similarly as it was also made compulsory for those before you, so you desist from sins.

Fasting are but for few days, but still, whosoever is sick or travelling, so count the days, or if it is very difficult to observe fast then giving a meal to one needy is compulsory, and whoever wishes to willingly give more is much better, and if you are clever then you must understand that fasting is good for you.

Fasting is for the month of Ramazan in which I revealed Quran which is a guide for the people, and therein are explicit signs of guidance, O believers, keep fast if you are staying in your permanent place, and if someone is sick or travelling, then those days should be counted, Allah wish to make things easy for you, and He do not want any hardship for you, and counting is for compensating it later, so praise Allah, Who has shown you the straight path and you become thankful.

O Prophet! If my people ask you about Me, tell them I am near to them and when they pray for anything I listen to their prayers and accept their prayers, so they should also obey Me and believe in Me so that they come on the straight path.

O Believers! You have been allowed to mingle with your wives on the nights of fasting, women are your garment and you are their garment, when Allah saw you are hurting yourself so He accepted your repentance and forgone your mistake, now you can cohabit with them and whatever is written for you, ask from Allah and consume until whiteness of the day become distinct from the blackness of the night at the dawn, then keep fasting until night and when you retreat in Mosques do not cohabit with women even during night and do not go even near them thus Allah have very clearly described His rulings so you save yourselves from disobedience.
Unlawfully do not take property of one another, do not indulge in corruption to gain unlawfully which does not belong to you, which you also know.

O Prophet! People ask you about different phases of moon, tell them it signify religious activities and time of Hajj, your entering in houses from the back door is not a good sign, but fear of Allah is the best deed and if you wish to enter the house enter from the main doors and continue fearing Allah so you get your wishes.
And the people who fight with you, you also fight with them in the way of Allah, and do not exceed, Allah does not like the people who exceed.

And you kill the unbelievers wherever you find them, and the people who exiled you from Makkah, you also deport them, and creating unrest is worse than bloodshed, until unbelievers do not fight you near Sacred Mosque, you also do not fight there, but if they fight you, you also kill them, this is the punishment of the unbelievers.
But if these people desist, verily Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
Go and fight them till the crime is uprooted, and only religion of Allah should remain, then if they desist, do not exceed, because excess is not good but only on the tyrants.

Sacred month is equal to sacred month, sacred things are equal to each other, if somebody acts aggressively on you, then you can retaliate in the same way, keep fearing Allah and know well that Allah is the companion of pious people.
And spend in the way of Allah, and do not cause your death, and do good deeds, and verily Allah likes the person doing good work.

Complete Hajj or Umrah only for Allah, if you are helpless, you may sacrifice as per your capacity and do not shave your head until sacrifice reaches its destination, and if someone is sick or have some disease of head, than fasting or giving charity or sacrifice are the replacement of the same, and if somebody is performing Umrah instead of Hajj than he should offer sacrifice as per his capacity and if one cannot offer sacrifice than fasting of 3 days should be observed during the Hajj period and 7 days of fasting should be observed, after returning home, command of these ten days are for those whose sons are not residing in the vicinity of Sacred Mosque, and keep fearing Allah and know that He gives grievous punishment.

Months of performing of Hajj is known, whosoever decide to perform Hajj then it is imperative on him from wearing of Ahram till the end of Hajj should not do intercourse, fight or commit any sin, Allah knows the good work very well and make provision and the best provision is piety, and O wise one keep fearing Me.

There is no harm if you seek the benefit of His Blessings during the Hajj period, when you leave Arafat then remember Allah near Mashar al-Haram as has been told to you, however earlier you were among strayed ones.
Then you also leave with others asking forgiveness from Allah, verily Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

When you complete the Hajj rites then remember Allah as you remember your forefathers, and even more, and there are some people who ask for benefits in this world only, then they would not have any share on the Day of Judgement.
And there are some people who say O Lord give us the benefits of this world and also reward on the Day of Judgement and save us from Hell-Fire.
These are people who will have their portion of what they have earned and Allah is quick in taking account.

And remember Allah for a few appointed days, then if someone hastens and leaves Mina after two days, there is no harm, and if he stays for three days there is no harm also, but this concession is for the pious people, and fear Allah and be sure you will all be called from your graves towards Allah.
O Prophet! There are certain people who talk sweetly, which looks nice in this world and they swear on Allah for your love, but they are quarrelsome and your enemies.
And when he became ruler, he started running here and there to spread disquiet and destroy agriculture and animal life, and Allah does not like perversity.
When it is said to fear Allah, the pride incites them to commit sin, so Hell is enough for them and it is very bad place.
And among them there are people who even sell themselves to please Allah, Allah is very Compassionate for such people.
O Believers! All of you together enter Islam completely and do not follow the footsteps of the Devil because he is your open enemy.
When clear proofs come to you, then why waver, understand clearly that Allah is predominant and a great planner.
Are they waiting for this only that Allah should come in the shadow of white clouds with angels of punishment and do settle all the things, however all matters return to Allah.
O Prophet! Ask Bani Israel how unambiguous signs were given to them, when somebody has received the blessings of Allah and distort it, so undoubtedly Allah gives the severest punishment.

Who has chosen the infidelity world looks beautiful to them, and they make fun of believers whereas on the Day of Judgement the status of pious ones will be much higher, and Allah gives abundant sustenance to whoever He pleases.

Earlier they were one community, then Allah sent messengers who gave glad tidings and warn them, revealed scriptures with truth, to arbitrate between people who differed, and alas, differing people were only those to whom scriptures were given, then they played mischief, so Allah with His Compassion showed the righteous path to the faithful in which they have disputed, and Allah guide to the right path whomsoever He pleases.

Do you think you will enter Paradise easily, whereas you have not faced the situation which people earlier time has faced, they were encircled with many difficulties like illness, hunger and poverty and they were jolted by earthquake in such a way that messengers and their followers said let us see when the help of Allah will arrive, look do not be disappointed, help of Allah is near.

O Prophet! They ask you what they should spend in the way of Allah, tell them whatever they spend from their rightful earnings is for their parents, relatives and orphans and wayfarer, whatever good work you do Allah knows it.

Warfare is made imperative on you, however you will dislike it, something you may like but it may not be good for you, and something you may not like but it may be good for you, and Allah knows all but you do not know.

O Prophet! They question you whether warfare during the sacred months are allowed, so tell them warfare is great sin in these months, creating hindrance in the way of Allah and denying Allah, and denying entry into Sacred Mosque, is greater sin near Allah, and persecution is much grievous sin than bloodshed, these unbelievers will keep fighting you till they can made you renegades from your religion, and if somebody renegades and dies as unbeliever, such people will not get any reward of their deeds and these are people destined for Hell-Fire and they will remain there forever.
Undoubtedly, people who believed and emigrated and fought in the way of Allah, these are people who are hopeful of the Blessings of Allah, and Allah is all Forgiving and Compassionate.

O Prophet! These people ask you about liquor and gambling, tell them there is great sin in both these acts, there may be some benefits but sins are greater in them, they ask you what they should spend in the way of Allah tell them, whatever remain with you after spending on your needs, like this Allah describes His commands clearly so you may ponder.

And in this world and the Hereafter they ask you about orphans, tell them setting their affairs right is better and is better if you mix their affairs with yours, eventually they are your brothers, Allah differentiate between perverts and well-wishers very well, and if He wanted, he could have put you in adversity, and verily Allah has great Wisdom.

And O believers! Do not marry unbelieving women unless they turn believers, unbelieving women may appear pleasant but faithful women are even better, and do not marry your women to unbelievers until they turn believers, however good unbelieving men may appear but believing men are Verily better, these unbelievers call you towards Hell by offering to marry, but Allah invites you towards Paradise and Forgiveness with His Benignity, and describes His Commands explicitly so the people get guided.

O Prophet! They ask you about menstruation, tell them it is discomfort therefore keep away from them during menstruation and do not go near them until they are purified, and when they become pure you can enter from where Allah has allowed you, verify Allah likes pure people and who ask for forgiveness.

Your wives are tilth for you, you can go there as you like, send good deeds ahead of you and keep fearing Allah and remember that one day you have to be present in front of Him and give them glad tidings for deliverance.
And do not make Allah an excuse for doing good work and fearing Allah and arbitrating between people and Allah knows all and hear all.
Swearing which unintentionally are uttered Allah will not hold you responsible, but Allah will Verily hold you responsible if you swear intentionally, and He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
People who swear not to go near their wives, they have got intervening time of 4 months to desist from their swearing and return to them, verily Allah is all Forgiving and Compassionate.
And if they have decided to give divorce so verily Allah listens and knows all.

The women who have been divorced should wait for three menstrual cycles before marrying again, and if they believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement then it is not permitted for them to hide whatever Allah has created in their wombs, and if their husbands wish for reconciliation, during this period then they are more entitled for it, rights of women and men are same on each other, although men are a degree above women, and Allah has the Great Wisdom.

Divorce can be give only twice, and third time either they can be stopped or will be finally sent with kindness, and it is not permitted for you to take from them whatever you have already given, unless both fear that they cannot keep within limits of Allah and then if you fear they will not be able to abide by the limits of Allah, in that case if a women give some gift to set herself free, then there is no sin on both, and do not exceed the boundaries set by Allah and whoever cross that boundaries of Allah are among the oppressors.

If a woman is given divorce third time then reconciliation is not possible without her getting married to another man, and if that man divorces her, then there is no sin in reconciliation, if they think they can keep the limits of Allah, and these are limits of Allah, which He explains for sensible persons very clearly.

When you divorce your wives and they reach their prescribed time, either hold them with your good behavior or bid them goodbye with liberality, and do not hold them back to torment or to do excesses, and if you do this you will be doing unjust to yourselves, and do not make mockery of commands of Allah, and remember the Blessings of Allah, He guides you through His Books and words of wisdom, keep fearing Allah and know very well that Allah necessarily know all.

And when you give divorce to your women and they complete their prescribed time, do not stop them from marrying again, and when they start living lawfully, Allah advises with His commands, and following this is refining and purification, and you do not know what Allah knows.

Women can breastfeed their child for two years and its imperative on the father to arrange the maintenance, food and clothing for her. Nobody is given hardship more than what they can tolerate, so neither mother nor the father of the child should suffer. (if father has died) likewise it is also required by from heirs of father of the child, then if with mutual understanding they wish to end the breastfeeding, then there is no sin on both, and if you want to breastfeed your child by someone else, which is also allowed provided you give whatever has been agreed, and keep fearing Allah and know that whatever you do Allah Verily sees it.

And whoever dies leaving behind wives, they should keep themselves waiting for four months and ten days, and after they attain that period, they can do whatever they want and there will be no blame on you, and Allah is aware of whatever you do.

And if you fear that somebody else might propose her, you can symbolically indicate to her or keep to your hearts, there is no harm in it, Allah knows that you will think of marrying her but do not marry secretly, there is no harm in speaking pleasantly and do not even think of marrying them before they complete the term, Allah Verily knows what is in your hearts, so keep fearing Allah and know that Allah is all Forgiving and Forbearing.

And if you give divorce before you have touched your wives and before dower is fixed, then there is no blame on you, however wealthy and poor people should do them favors according to their capacity, and it is a duty upon people who do good work.

And if you have fixed the dower of woman and divorce them before touching them in private then pay half of the dower, but if woman relinquish it, or their guardian who are empowered relinquish it, then ho harm, but if you give full dower which is very near to piousness and do not forget mutual liberality, and Allah is Verily watching your actions.
O Muslims! Guard your prayers regularly especially the middle prayer, and stand devoutly only for Allah.
Pray even if you are in a fearful situation or walking or riding, then when you become secure remember Allah as has been taught to you which you did not know.

Remember Allah, and who are dying and leaving behind their wives then they should make provision in their will for their maintenance and home stay for one year, thereafter if women leave on their own, you are not to be blamed, Allah is Predominant and Wise.
And women whose dower is fixed but are divorced without touching, provision should also be made for them, this is duty of the pious people.
Allah sent His communications like this so you may understand.

O Prophet! Did not you notice them when thousands escaped their homes fearing death, but, Allah commanded them to die and they died, then Allah brought them to life, He is very Compassionate to people but majority do not thank Him.
O Muslims, fight in the way of Allah and know that Allah hears and knows everything.
Is there anyone who can give loan to Allah so He multiplies your wealth, and Allah lessens straitness or amplifies your wealth, and unto Him everyone will return.

O Prophet! Have not you considered the heads of Bani-Israel tribe when they said to their messenger to appoint a king for them so they can fight in the way of Allah, he said you may not flee when you are asked to fight, they said we have left our abodes and children and have no excuse that we would not fight in the way of Allah, and when fighting was made compulsory all of them fled except a few, and Allah knows the oppressors very well.

And their messenger said to them: Allah has appointed Taloot as king over you, they said we have greater right to the kingship because he is not capable even monetarily Messenger said Allah has given him preference over you and he may not have wealth but Allah has given him knowledge and good physique and Allah may give His kingdom to whoever He pleases and Allah is all capable and knows all.

And their messenger told them as a sign that this kingdom is from Allah that a chest will come to you in which there is tranquility and relics which the children of Moosa and Haroon have left behind, and this chest will be carried by angels. And if you believe, verily there is a sign for you.

When Taloot left the city with his army he said to his companions you will find a river through which you will be tested, whoever will drink its water will not be on my side and whoever will not drink its water will be definitely on my side, however if you will drink a handful of water there is no harm, when they reached the river, everyone except a few drank its water, when Taloot with the believers crossed the river they said today we do not find strength to confront Jaloot and his army, but who were real believers instantly said that it is seen quite a few times when a small group has vanquished the large group with the help of Allah, and Allah is with those who have patience.
At last, when they went to confront the army of Jaloot they prayed, O Lord! Give us patience and make us steadfast in fighting and grant us the victory over the unbelievers.

Then they defeated the enemy with the command of Allah and Dawood killed Jaloot, and Allah granted him kingdom and wisdom and knowledge and taught him what He pleased, and if Allah would not have repelled a group through another group, there would have been disorder on the earth, but Allah is Gracious for all the people of the world.
O Prophet! These are the true verses of Allah which He revealed on you very clearly and Verily you are among the Prophets.

I have given eminence, to some over some messengers whom I have sent, with some of them Allah spoke, and some of them were exalted, and He gave Isa son of Maryam clear miracles and helped him through Sacred Spirit and if Allah pleased, those after them would not have fought among themselves after receiving the distinct miracles, but they were divided among them and some of them accepted the faith but some become infidels and if Allah pleased they would not have fought, but Allah does whatever He pleases.

O believers, whatever has been given to you spend in the way of Allah before the day come when here won’t be any trade and no one will help, nor any intercession will be accepted and only infidels are the oppressors.

Allah is the Lord, no one else is worthy of worship, he is Everliving, and the world exists because of Him, He does not doze off nor He sleeps, everything in the skies and on the earth belong to Him, and who is there who can intercede with Him without His permission, He know everything; whatever is in present and whatever has happened earlier, and nobody can comprehend anything from His knowledge except whatsoever He pleases, His Throne encompasses all the skies and all the earths, and the preservation of both the sky and the earth is on Him and He never feel fatigued, and He is Most Great and Most High.

There is no compulsion in the religion, Allah has distinguished guidance from straying, whoever has denied the false gods and believes in Allah only, they are holding the string tightly which will never break, and Allah hears and knows all.

And Allah is the Patron of those who have become believers, He bring them from darkness to the light of guidance, whoever is unbeliever, Devil is their patron, and He has pushed from light of guidance to the darkness, and these are dwellers of Hell and shall remain there forever.

O Prophet! Did you not considered him that he disputed about his Lord because I have given him kingdom, Ibrahim said my Allah is that who gives life and death, and while boasting he said that I also give life and death, Ibrahim said my Allah causes sun to rise from East, you bring the sun from West, on this he was astonished but did not become a believer, and Allah never guides the oppressors.

O Prophet! Did you considered the condition of a man who was crossing a village which was devastated and roofs have fallen down, he said how Allah will settle the village after such devastation, on this Allah make him dead for 100 years, then He brought him to life again and asked him how long you were lying down, he said one day or even less, He said no you were lying down here for 100 years, now look at your food which has not spoilt and your donkey whose bones are scattered, all this was done to show the example of My Power and look at the bones, I set them together and make skeleton and cover with flesh, when he it became clear to him, he said now I have complete believe that Allah has power over everything.

And O Prophet! Remember that time also when Ibrahim requested Me to show him how I bring alive from the dead, Allah said don’t you believe this, he said yes I do believe but I want to see it myself so that I am satisfied at heart, Allah said if it is so then bring 4 birds, slaughter them and keep pieces of their flesh on the hills and then call them and you will see them coming running towards you, and do understand that Allah is Predominant and has Wisdom.
Parable of spending in the name of Allah is like the parable of a seed which has seven ears and every ear has 100 seeds and Allah doubles it for some, Allah is of vast capacity and knows all.
People who spend in the way of Allah and do not showcase it or trouble them, their reward is with their Lord, they will have no fear on the Day of Judgement, nor will they be depressed.
Reply softly, leniency is much better than such charity, which hurts, Allah is Self-Sufficient and Wise.

O believers, do not make your charity worthless by showing it off and hurting the supplicant, do not be like the person who do the charity just for show off, and does not believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement, his parable is like a shining stone on which dust falls but when heavy rainfalls it get clears it, hypocrites will not get benefit of their charities, Allah never guide the infidels.

And those who spend with their hearts in the name of Allah, their parable is like a garden on the hillock, when heavy rain falls their yield becomes double, even if heavy rain does not fall only a drizzle will suffice, Allah is always aware about your deeds.

Does any of you would like that you have a garden of dates and grapes and there are rivers beneath it and also there are different types of fruits, and old age catches him and his children are small and weak, suddenly hot air blows which is full of fire and devastate the garden, Allah describes his commands clearly like this so you ponder over it.

O believers, spend in the way of Allah from your pure earning and whatever I have grown on earth for you, and do not even think of giving your bad earnings in the way of Allah, and if someone give, you will not take it except that your eyes are closed, and be aware that Allah is self-sufficient and Praiseworthy.
Satan makes you fear poverty and encourage you for niggardly whereas Allah gives you assurance of His Forgiveness and Abundance, Allah has vastness and knows all.
He grants wisdom to whom He pleases, and if someone gets wisdom from Him, as if he has received wealth of goodness, and nobody recognizes importance except those who know.
If you spend anything or make vow Allah Verily know, and no one will help the oppressors on the Day of Judgement.
You can give charity openly, but if you hide it is better for you, Allah will forgive your sins if you give charity this way, and whatever you do Allah knows it.

O Prophet! It is not incumbent on you to reach them to their destination, you have to just show the way, but Allah guide whoever He pleases, O people, whatever you will spend in good work is for your own benefit, and you do not do anything but to please Allah, whatever you will spend in good work, you will get back manifold in return, and your right will not be marginalized.

Charity is for those who need, and are confined in the way of Allah and cannot move, they do not ask for alms and people think they are rich, but if you see closely their face you will know, they do not cling on you for help and whatever you spend in good activity, Allah Verily know it.
People who spend during the day or night secretly or openly in the way of Allah, their reward is with their Allah, on the Day of Judgement they will not have any fear or grief.

People who survive on usury, they will stand dazed on the Day of Judgement, these are people whom Satan has cling on, this is because they think that matter of trading and usury is alike, whereas Allah has allowed trading and forbidden usury, then whoever received this Command and refrained, can retain whatever taken earlier, their matter is with Allah, and whoever continue usury even after receiving Command, those are dwellers of Hell and shall remain there forever.
Allah eradicates usury and promote charity and He does not like thankless and sinners.
People who believe and do good work and pray regularly and give charity, their reward is with their Lord, on the Day of Judgement they will neither fear nor grieve.
O you believers, fear your Lord, and if any interest remains, forgo it, if you are true believers.

And if you don’t do it then be ready to fight your Lord and His Prophet, if you have repented then that is your real wealth, do not cause unnecessary loss to anyone and nor any loss will be caused to you.
And if the debtor is in difficulty, give him time till his difficulty eases, and if you forgo the amount fully it is better for you.
And fear the day when you will be returned to the Lord, then whatever you have done will be rewarded in full and no one’s right will be trampled.

O believers, when you deal with each other in contracting debt, make a note of the same, and whoever write should write with fairness and should not refuse to write as Allah has made them literate, let him write who is taking loan should dictate clearly and continue to fear Allah and should not undermine the right of the loaner, and if the person taking loan is incapable or obtuse and illiterate, let the guardian should supervise with fairness, call for two witness, take two men as witness, but if there are no two men then one man and two women as witness, if out of two one woman forget second would remind her, witness should not refuse when they are called, do not be averse to writing whether amount is small or large with time frame, for Allah the contract is justifiable and strong for proof, and is very necessary that you may not have any doubt in future, but when you deal in cash there is no blame on you for not writing, and have witness for sale or purchase, and do not harm the writer or witness, and if you do this it is considered transgression, and fear your Lord, He teaches you and know everything.

If you have to give loan while travelling and could not find any writer then take something as deposit, if you know each other you can give loan without writing but person who has been trusted should return the debt to the loaner and fear your Lord, and do not hide testimony and whoever will hide testimony his heart will be sinner, Allah is fully aware of all your actions.

Whatever is in the skies and whatever is in the earth belongs to Allah, and whatever is in your hearts whether you declare or not, Allah will hold you accountable for it, then Allah will forgive whom he pleases, and will punish whom he pleases, and Allah has power over everything.

Prophet (Mohammad) believes, on whatever have been revealed on him, and all believers who have faith in Allah, His angels, His Books, and His Prophets, and they say they do not differentiate between the Prophets, and also say, O Lord, we heard and believed, and O Lord, we only need your Forgiveness and we have to return unto You.

Allah do not impose on anyone more than their ability, your good deeds are beneficial for you, and you will see the consequences for bad deeds, O Lord, do not punish us if we forget or commit mistake, O Lord do not burden us like you have burdened the earlier people, O Lord do not burden us more than what we cannot tolerate, and forgive our mistakes and sins, and have Mercy on us, You are our Lord, now help us against the infidels.
Alif Laam Meem
Allah is the Lord, no one else is worthy of worship, he is Ever-living, and the world exists because of Him.
O Prophet! He has revealed the truthful Book on you which confirms the existing books, and He has sent Taurait and Injeel for the guidance of the people.
And we sent the book to differentiate truth from falsehood, and verily there is serious punishment for those who do not believe the verses, Allah overpowers all and He is a revenger.
Verily, nothing is hidden from Allah neither on earth nor on sky.
It is He who carve your faces in the womb of your mother as He pleases, there is no god but Allah, He is Predominant and Wise.

It is He Who have revealed the Book and some of the verses are very decisive which are base of the Book, and some verses are metaphoric, and whose hearts are not straight, follow only these verses which are metaphoric to create mischief and interpret their own meaning, whereas except Allah and those who are firmly entrenched in knowledge ; nobody knows their meaning, they say we believe in all whatever has been revealed from the Lord, and only knowledgeable understand.
And they pray: O my Lord, do not deviate our hearts after You have guided us, and bestow upon us Mercy from your Court, there is no doubt that you are the Giver.
O my Lord, verily one day You will collect all the people, undoubtedly Allah does not renege on His promise.
Verily, people who turned unbelievers, nothing will save them, neither their wealth nor their children, they are the fuel of Hell-Fire.
They are like tribes of Firaun and people earlier than them, who denied Our verses, so Allah punished them because of their sins, Allah is strict in punishment.
O Prophet! Tell those who turn unbelievers, that very soon they will be defeated against the believers and will be assembled in Hell, what a bad place it is.

Verily, there is a big sign for you in two group which confronted each other, one group was fighting holy war, and another of the unbelievers, whom believers saw double in quantity, but Allah gave victory to the small group, and Allah strengthens with His help whom He pleases verily it is a lesson in this incident for those who can see.

In this world, love of beautiful things such as, wives and sons, large piles of gold and silver, superior breeds of horse and livestock and agricultural fields are made to seem good; these are few benefits of this world, but an everlasting living place is with Allah.

Tell them shall I tell you something better than these things, whoever followed piety, there are gardens of Paradise for them with the rivers flowing beneath, and they will remain forever there, and apart from this there are pure and clean spouses for them, and above all there is happiness of Allah, and Allah is watching these believers.
These people say, O my Lord we have accepted faith, forgive our sins, save us from the torment of Hell.
These are the people who are patient and speak truth, obey Allah, and spend in the way of Allah and seek repentance in early hours of morning.

Allah, has Himself bore witness that there is no god but Allah, and all angels and people with knowledge who are steadfast on justice bear the same witness, that He has Great Wisdom and there is no god but Him and He is Predominant and Knowing.
Religion near Allah is only Islam, and people of the book disputed it among them out of envy after knowing it, and whosoever deny the signs of Allah, should know that Allah is quick in reckoning.

O Prophet! If these people unnecessary argue with you, tell them you have submitted totally to Allah, and my followers have also done so, and ask the people of book and ignorant whether they have accepted the faith, if they have become believers they are on the right path, and if they turn away, then you were just to reach the message to them, and Allah know His servants.
Verily, who deny verses of Allah and unjustly slay messengers, and slay those who do justice, then give them good news of painful punishment.
These are the unlucky people whose all acts are futile in this world and the world hereafter, and no one will help them.

O Prophet! Did you not notice the condition of the people who are given part of the book; now they are being called towards the Book of Allah, so the justice is done among them through these books and some of them turned their face.

These are the people who turn back, because they say they have to stay only for a few days in Hell, and more than that the fire cannot touch them, with these forgeries they are defeated in their own religion.
In what condition will they be, when on the Day of Judgement, which is certain, they will be collected and everyone will be rewarded according to their deeds and no injustice will be done to them.

O Prophet! Pray: O Allah, You, are the Owner of all the worlds, You give kingdom to whoever You please and take away kingdom from whoever you please, and it is only You who give honour to whoever You please and disgrace to whoever You please, and all the goodness are in Your Hands, Verily, you have power over everything.

It is You who stretch the night into the day, and stretch the day into night, You bring life out of death, and, You bring death out of life, and it is You Who gives uncountable sustenance to whoever you please.

Believers should make believers only their patrons and not the unbelievers, and if someone will do this then he will not have anything to do with Allah, but if you want to guard yourself against them (then there is no issue), Allah makes you fearful from Himself only, you shall return to Allah.

O Prophet! Tell them whatever is in your hearts whether you conceal or reveal it, Allah knows all, and whatever is in skies and whatever is on the earth, Allah knows all, and Allah is extremely capable.

And remember that day, when, whoever has done any good or bad deeds will see it present there, and will say, I wish, there could have been long duration between me and my bad deeds, and Allah makes you fearful from Himself only, and Allah is very Generous on His servants.
O Prophet! Tell them if you love Allah then follow me, so Allah may also love you, and will forgive your sins, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O Prophet! Tell them to obey Allah and His messenger and if they rebel then they should know that Allah does not like infidels.
Verily, Allah has chosen Adam, Nooh, and descendants of Ibrahim, and descendants of Imran over the whole world.
Descendants of some from some, Allah know Allah hear everybody all and know everything.

O Prophet! Remember the time when the wife of Imran said, O my Lord, I want to free my child who is in my womb from worldly affairs, and want to devote him for your service, please accept my offering, Verily, You are hearing and knowing.

When the baby girl was born, she was amazed and said, O my Lord, I bore a girl, but girl is not like a boy, whereas Allah knew of the importance what she bore, I have named her Maryam and give my daughter and her offspring in your refuge against accursed Satan.

Her offering was Graciously accepted by her Lord, He made her grow in purity and beauty, and made Zakaria her guardian, whenever Zakaria visited her chamber of prayer he found some eatables kept beside her, and asks her, O Maryam, from where this came, Maryam replies that it is from Allah, indeed to whosoever Allah pleases gives uncountable sustenance.
Observing all this, Zakaria prayed that time to Allah and requested that O my Lord grant me from Yourself a pure offspring, Verily only you listen to the supplication.

Then angels called to him while Zakaria was praying in the room and told him that Allah is giving glad tiding to you of Yahya who will witness the Words of Allah, will be chief, pious and a messenger among the righteous ones.
He said how I can have the son when I have become old and my wife is barren, he said, Allah does what he pleases.

Zakaria said, O my Lord, give some sign for my satisfaction, He said, the sign is that you will be able to speak only in sign language for three days, and remember your Lord much, and glorify Him in the morning and the evening.
And remember the incident that the angel told Maryam, Allah has chosen you and has purified you and selected you from the females of the worlds.
O Maryam! obey your Lord and be among the people who bow down and prostrate.

O Prophet! This announcement is from the unseen news, which We sent you through revelation, you were not with them when they were dipping their pens in water to decide who will be guardian of Maryam, and you were not present with them.

When people were quarrelling among them, remember when angels told Maryam that Allah is giving glad tidings to you for a son, whose name will be Isa ibn Maryam, and he will be among the honourable in this world and The Hereafter and will be among the near ones.
And he shall speak to the people in the same tone, from the cradle as well as in old age, and will be among the pious ones.

On hearing this, Maryam said with astonishment, O my Lord! how can I bear the son when no man has even touched me, it was said, Allah does what He pleases, when He decides to do something, He just says Be it, and it becomes.
O Maryam, Allah will make him learn Heavenly books and wisdom, especially Taurait and Injeel.

And will make him a messenger for Bani Israel and he will tell them: I have come to you from your Lord and brought these signs for my prophethood, I will make a bird from clay and blow something on it and with the command of Allah it will fly, and with command of Allah will give sight to the blinds, and will cure people afflicted with leprosy, and will bring alive the dead, and will inform you, whatever you eat and hoard in your homes, if you are honest, these are signs for you.

And I verify Taurait which is already here; one of the reasons for my coming is that I will allow many things for you which are forbidden now, I have come from your Lord with signs, so you fear Allah and obey me.
Verily, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him because this is the straight path.
When Isa saw unbelieve in them, he asked who is with Allah, and will be my helper, his disciples said we are the adherents of Allah and have believe in you, O Isa be witness that we are the obedient.
Our Lord, we believe, in whatever you revealed and follow the messenger, then mention us as the witness of Your messengers.
And they planned against Isa and We dispelled their planning; Allah is the best planner.

And remember the time when Allah said O Isa, I will complete your period of stay on earth, and will cause you to ascend towards Me, and will keep you pure from these infidels, and I will empower your followers over the infidels until the Day of Judgement, then you all have to return to Me, and on that Day I will decide among you who were quarrelling.
Whoever turned unbeliever (Allah) will punish them severely in this world and The Hereafter and nobody will be their helper.
And Allah will reward you fully if you did good deeds, and Allah does not like the oppressors.
O Prophet! This We are describing to you are My signs and incidents full of wisdom.
Resemblance of Isa and Adam are the same to Allah, We created a body of clay and said Be, and it became.
Rightful things are from Allah, and don't be among the people who doubt.

Then after you have received the knowledge of Quran, if someone dispute with you, tell them we bring our sons and you bring your sons, we bring our women and you bring your women, we bring our souls and you bring your souls, then we together will earnestly invoke curse of Allah on the liars.
O Prophet! These are all truthful incidents, and except Allah there is no god, Allah is Predominant and having Wisdom.
And still if they turned their faces, then Allah does not like oppressors.

O Prophet! Tell these people of the book, come at an equitable position between us that do not worship anyone except Allah, and should not make anyone His partner and should not accept anybody as your Lord, but still if they turn away, say, be witness we are obedient to Allah.

O People of Book! Why do you dispute unnecessary and fight about Ibrahim, some call him Jew and some call him Christian, whereas Taurait and Injeel, which are their origin, these books were revealed after him, don't you understand this?
Ah! You are the same fools who disputed about some knowledge you received, now you are quarreling about the things which you do not know at all, and reality is known to Allah and you do not know.
Ibrahim was neither Jew or Christian, but he was purely on truth and obedience nor he was from the polytheists.
More important to Ibrahim is those who follow him, and this messenger and faithful, and Allah is the Guardian of faithful.
A group of the people of the book tried to distract you from the right path, however with their planning they do not distract you but themselves, also they do not understand.
O people of the book! Why do you deny verses of Allah whereas you can be the witness.
O people of the book! Why do you dispute the verses of Allah and conceal them whereas you know.
A group of people of book said, in the morning accept the Book which has been revealed on Muslims, and deny it in the evening, may be this way Muslims also renounce.

Do not believe anybody except those who follow your religion, O Prophet! Tell them guidance is only, Guidance of Allah, and never believe that Allah will give to anyone else the importance given to you, and can anyone argue about you before Allah, O Prophet, tell them, giving importance is in the Hands of Allah, and He gives to whoever He pleases, and He is Generous and Knowing.
He chooses with Mercy, anyone He pleases, and Allah is Mighty Graceful.

Among the people of book are some such that if you entrust heap of wealth they will return, and there are some with whom if you entrust even one coin they will not return until you strongly demand, and they think, they do not have any obligation towards Arabs, they tell lie about Allah and know they are lying.
And whoever oblige their covenant and practices piety, Verily Allah loves the pious people.

People who sell their promise made to Allah for small sum, these people do not have any share in The Hereafter, and Allah shall neither speak to them on the Day of Judgement nor will look them with Mercy, nor He will purify them of their sins, there is severest chastisement for them.

Most Verily, there are some, among people of the book, who read their own meaning from Taurait to show that it is part of the book but it is not part of the book, and they say whatever we are reading have been revealed from Allah, but it is not revealed by Allah, and knowingly falsely speaking against Allah and they know.

It is not appropriate for any mortal that he is given the book, wisdom and prophethood, and he say to people: be my followers instead of Allah, but his word would be that you follow Allah, you teach the book of Allah and also read.
He will never enjoin you to consider angels and prophets as Lord, how can he enjoin you towards infidelity after you became Muslims.
