Remember the time when the covenant was taken from the messengers that whatever book and wisdom We gave you, then a messenger will come and he will confirm your books, you also believe in him and help him; and Allah asked: do you agree? Apart from all other things, you also carried my covenant; all said: yes, we agree, He said then be a witness of one another and I am also a witness with you.
And after this whoever turn back on his covenant then he will be among the transgressors.
Are they seeking anything other than religion of Allah, when all the dwellers of earth and the sky, willingly or unwillingly, are bowing down before Him, and everyone have to return unto Him.

O Prophet! Tell them we believe in Allah and on whatever has been revealed on us and on Ibrahim, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqoob and children of Yaqoob and on Moosa, Isa and other messengers from their Lord, and we do not differentiate among them and we are His obedient.
And anyone who desire anything other than the religion of Allah shall not be accepted and he shall be in great loss in the Hereafter.

How will Allah guide such people who turned unbeliever after accepting faith, whereas they had accepted that he is truthful Prophet and they have also received clear miracles, Allah do not guide unjust.
Curses of Allah and His angels and all people are on such people.
They will always be in the curse, there won't be any remission in their punishment, nor they will be given any respite.
But except those people who repented and have corrected themselves because Allah is all Forgiving and very Merciful.
Those who turned unbeliever after accepting faith, and increased their infidelity, their repentance will never be accepted, and these are the worst strayed.

Who turned unbeliever and died in this condition only, so if somebody give gold in ransom which will fill the earth, it will not be accepted, these are the people who will get painful punishment, and nobody will be their helper.
O People! Unless you don’t give your favourite thing in charity, your status will not be elevated, and whatever you spend, Allah Verily knows it.

Before the revelation of Taurait and Injeel, Bani Israel was allowed to consume everything except those which Israel had forbidden on himself, O Prophet! Tell them if there is any truth in whatever they are saying, then bring Taurait and read in front of us.
Even after this if anybody fabricates a lie against Allah, these are people who are oppressors.
O Prophet! Tell them Allah has spoken Truth, now you follow the religion of Ibrahim, who was not among the pagans.
House which was first made for the prayers is this only which is in Bakkah, it is blessed and is a guide for the world.

There is clear sign in it such as the standing Place of Ibrahim, whoever enters in it shall be secure, if they have sufficient financial eligibility they should perform Hajj, and if anybody turns unbeliever, Allah is self-sufficient from the worlds.
O People of book why do you deny the verses, when Allah is the Witness of your deeds.
Tell to the people of book, why do they deter the people from the way of Allah, and try to find crookedness in it, when you are witness of its reality, and whatever you do Allah is not unaware of it.
O Believers, if you follow any group of the people of book, they will make you infidel again after your accepting Islam.
However, the verses of Allah are being read before you and His Prophet is also from among you, and whoever gets attached with Allah, so definitely He will guide you to the right path.
O Believers, fear Allah, the way He should be feared, and do not die in any other religion except Islam.

You all together keep holding rope of Allah tightly, and do not dispute among you, and remember the favour of Allah on your condition when you were enemies of one another, Allah put love in your hearts and with this blessing you become brothers, and you were standing on the brink of burning fire and were about to fall in it but Allah saved you, and Allah describe His commands like this so you come on the right path.
There should be a group among you, who should invite people towards good deeds and bar them from the bad deeds, and these are the people who will get their desires fulfilled in The Hereafter.
And do not be among the those who cause division among the people, and even after receiving clear signs their words and action are not the same, and strictest punishment is for these kinds of people.
Fear the day when some faces will be white and some faces will be black, people will ask the black faced people, Oh, you, you turned unbeliever, after believing, now you taste the punishment.
Whose faces will be white will be in Paradise due to the Mercy of Allah, and they will remain there forever.
O Prophet! These are verses which We recite for you clearly, and Allah does not desire to punish anybody of the worlds.
Whatever is in the skies and on the earth belongs to Allah, turn to Allah for all the Affairs.

How good a group you are, you have been created for the guidance of the people, you enjoin the people for good work and stops them from bad deeds, and believe in Allah, it would have been better for the people of book, if they also would have accepted the faith like this, there are only few faithful among them and most of them are transgressors.
O Muslims! They shall by no means can harm you but a little, and if they fight you, they will have to turn their backs on you and they will not get help from anywhere.

They have been identified with humiliation wherever they stay, only if they get refuge with the covenant of Allah or covenant of people, they will be under the wrath of Allah and will suffer with destitution, because they deny the verses of Allah and unjustly slay messengers, this because they were disobedient and committed excesses.
They are not all alike, but some people of the book are such that they are steadfast and recite verses of Allah during the night and they prostrate regularly.
They believe in Allah and on the Day of the Judgement, invite people for good deeds and bar them from bad deeds, and run towards the good deeds, these are the righteous people.
They won't be denied of their good deeds, and Allah is well aware of righteous people.
Verily, who opted for infidelity, they cannot be saved with their wealth or children, these people are dwellers of Hell and shall remain there forever.

In the few days of this world whatever they spend is like a breeze full of frost, which fell on their fields, and whoever has done injustice on themselves and destroyed it and then fell the frost, Allah has not oppressed them, but they have done injustice to themselves.

O Believers! Do not make anyone your confident other than believers, because these people will not fell short in inflicting more loss on you, they wish more strife and affliction for you, their enmity is obvious from their words, and they have more in their hearts, and if you are prudent, We have described our signs clearly for you.

O People! You befriend them but they do not befriend you, you believe on the whole book, when they meet you, they say they believe in the Book and when they are alone, they bite their fingers in rage, O Prophet, tell them to die in their rage, whatever is in your hearts, Allah knows it.

O Believers, they do not like even if you are benefited a little, but feel happy when any trouble befalls you, and if you show patience and safeguard yourself then they cannot deceive you, and Allah has power over their activities.
O Prophet! Recall the time when you left early in the morning, and when you were identifying the position of war for believers, and Allah is all-knowing and all-hearing.
At the time when two groups wanted to show laziness but were safe because Allah was their Guardian, and believers should depend on Him only.
Verily, Allah did help you in the Battle of Badr, in spite of you being weak, still Allah granted you the victory, so fear Allah, so you may become thankful.
O Prophet! You were telling the believers is it not enough for you that Allah has sent 3000 angels from sky to assist you.
Verily, if you remain patient and practice piety, and suddenly enemy confronts you, then Allah will send 5000 angels to help you who will be carrying the signs of bravery.
Allah did this help to please you, and for assurance of your hearts, help is always from Allah, Allah is Predominant and have Wisdom.
This help was to cut a group of infidels or denigrate them, so that they should return to their homes in disgrace.
O Prophet! You do not have any role whether I accept their repentance or punish them, because verily, they are oppressors.
Allah is the owner of everything whether in skies or on earth, He may forgive anybody or punish anybody, and Allah is most Gracious and Forgiving.
O Believers! Do not use usury to increase your wealth, and fear Allah so you are delivered.
Fear the fire of Hell which has been prepared for the infidels.
And obey Allah and His Prophet so that you may be shown Mercy.
And hasten towards Forgiveness of your Lord and Paradise which is as extensive as skies and the earth, and which has been made available for the pious people.
Whoever spend generously, whether in ease or in strait and control anger and forgive men, and Allah loves those who do favours.

Those are the people, if they commit any sin or cause damage to their souls, they remember Allah and seek forgiveness, and who else can give forgiveness except Allah, and they do not insist on their deeds.
These are the people whose reward is forgiveness and Paradise, beneath which there are flowing rivers in which they will dwell forever, and this is the best reward for good deeds.
There are examples in the past before you, now go and travel on the earth and see consequences of those who have denied.
This is a statement of truth for general people and admonition and guidance for the righteous people.
Beware! Do not be lazy, don’t feel dejected in distress, if you are the believer then your head will be held high.

(In Battle of Ohad) If a wound was inflicted on you, such wounds were also afflicted on your opponents (in Battle of Badr) also, and We alternate time among the people so Allah observe the believers separately, and some of you may get the rank of martyrs, and Allah does not befriend the oppressors.
And Allah wanted to segregate the believers and destroy the unbelievers.
Do you think you will all go to the Paradise? And Allah does not know who has fought in His way and who has remained steadfast.
You were desirous of death before going into battle, and now you have seen it and are seeing it yourselves also. (then why not are you going to the battlefield now).

And Mohammad [SAW] is only a Prophet, and there were many prophets before him, then if he dies or is killed, will you turn back (to infidelity)? No one can harm Allah if you turn back, and in near future Allah will reward you for your thankfulness.

And no one can die without command of Allah, and the time is fixed for every one’s death, and whoever desires for reward in this world, I will give here, and whoever desire for the reward in the Hereafter, I will give them there, and shortly We will reward the thankful.

And many messengers have passed with whom faithful have fought the enemies in such a way that they were not weakened by distress, neither they show cowardice, nor they disgraced before enemies, and Allah befriends who exercise restraint.
Their saying was only, O Lord, forgive our sins and increase our deeds in Your way, and keep us steadfast and give us the victory over infidels.
So, Allah rewarded them in this world and good reward for the Hereafter, and Allah loves the people of good deeds.
O Faithful, if you follow unbelievers, then you will be returned on your heels (to the infidelity) and only you will be in loss.
Allah is your Guardian and is better than all the helpers.

Soon, We will instill your fear in the hearts of the infidels because they made partner to Allah for whom Allah has not sent any sign, and they are destined for Hell which is very bad place for oppressors.

Certainly, Allah fulfilled his promise when you were slaying the infidels with His command in the Battle of Ohad until you reached your desire, later you showed your cowardice for war booty and disputed the instructions of the Prophet and disobeyed him, some of you are desirous of this world, and some desire the Hereafter (and sacrificed themselves over the Prophet), then He turned you from them, and Allah wanted to test you, then Allah forgave you, Allah is very Considerate and Gracious for the believers.

And remember the time when you were running up the hill and not looking back and Prophet was calling you from rear, due to this Allah gave you sorrow in exchange of sorrow, so you don't get depressed for whatever you have lost, and neither on affliction which befell on you, Allah is well aware of your deeds.

Later, Allah made to sleep peacefully a group and another one was deprived of sleep because they were worried about their lives only and have untruthful and ignorant thoughts, and they were saying, what control do we have over affairs of war, O Prophet, tell them that Control is only that of Allah, they concealed in their hearts which they do not tell you and they say, if it was in our hands we would not have been killed here, tell them, even if you stayed back in homes and if martyrdom was your fate you would have come to battlefield, Allah wishes to test thoughts of your hearts and wishes to clarify the truth of your conscience, and He know the thoughts of the hearts.
Verily, the day when two groups were fighting and some of them fled the scene because of their sins Satan strayed them, but Allah forgave them, and Allah is Forbearing and all Forgiving.

O believers, do not be like those who turned infidel, whose brethren died abroad, or were killed in war, they said, if they were with us, they would not have died or killed, Allah makes this cause of intense regret their hearts, Allah gives life and death, and He is well aware from your deeds.
If you are killed or died in the way of Allah, then Blessings and Forgiveness of Allah is better than the wealth which you collect.
If you die or get killed you will be raised to Allah only (from your graves).

It is a Blessing of Allah that they got a soft-hearted person like you, if you would have been rude and hard-hearted, they would have scattered long ago, now pardon them, and seek forgiveness for them, take their advice in your affairs, but if you decide on something, trust upon Allah only, Verily, Allah befriends those who trust on Him.
If Allah helps you then nobody can overpower you, and if Allah forsakes you then who is there who can stand for your help, and believers should have trust in Allah only.
Status of a messenger is not that he betrays, whoever betray, will have to present that thing on the Day of Judgement, they will get full reward for their deeds, and nobody's rights will be trampled.
Whoever is regular in adherence to please Allah, can he be compared with who is caught in the wrath of Allah, and whose place is hell, and that is the worst destination.
They are in varying grades in the sight of Allah, and Allah is seeing whatever they do.

Allah has favoured believers that he sent a Prophet from among them who recite the verses and purify them, and teaches him the Book and words of wisdom, whereas these people (before declaration of prophethood) were in total misguidance.

When affliction befallen you whereas you had befallen double the affliction on them, they said from where this affliction has come, O Prophet, tell them this is from you only (because you have disobeyed Prophet), Verily, Allah has power over everything.
And the day when two parties confronted each other, and that day the affliction befallen on you was from Allah (because of your mischief) so that he tests you.

And notice the hypocrites, hypocrites were told to fight in the way of Allah, or at least drive your enemy away, they said had we know how to fight then we would have accompanied you, that day they were nearer to infidelity rather than with faith, they were saying what was not in their hearts, and what they conceal, Allah knows all.

And these are the people who stayed in their homes and said about their brothers if they would have followed us, they would not have been killed, O Prophet, tell them if you are truthful then avert your death.
Those who were martyred in the way of Allah, don't consider them dead, but they are alive and get sustenance from their Lord.
They were overjoyed for the bounties they received from Allah and have good news for those who could not join them that they shall have no fear or grief.
They are rejoicing with promise of Grace and Blessings of their Lord, and He does not overlook the reward for the believers.
Who were wounded (in the Battle of Ohad) and were steadfast in obeying Allah and His Prophet and among them who were pious and did good work, there is great reward for them.

Those are people, when they were told that people have compiled large battalion for you so be afraid of them, upon hearing this, their faith increased and they said: Allah is sufficient for us, and Responsible.
These fighters came back with the blessings of Allah, and they did not face any trouble, they obeyed the order of Allah, Allah is very Gracious.
This Satan instill fear among his friends, so do not be afraid of him; if you are believer then fear Me (Only).

And do not grieve for those who hastens towards infidelity, because they cannot harm Allah at all, however Allah wants them to have no share in the Hereafter, and there is grievous punishment for them.
Those who have adopted infidelity instead of believing they cannot harm Allah, there is grievous punishment for them.
And those who disbelieve should never think that respite given is of any good to them, but time is given to them to add to their sins, in the end there is humiliating punishment for them.

Allah cannot leave you in this condition unless evil ones are separated with the pure ones and also do not wish to inform you about the unseen, but He chooses some from His messengers for this, hence, believe in Allah and Prophet, and if you will practice faith and piety there is grand reward for you.

Beware! People who show stinginess in whatever Allah has given them, should think that there is no benefit in stinginess, this is bad, very soon, on the Day of Judgement, in the wealth they practice stinginess will be put around their necks as shackles, and all the heritage of earth and skies belong to Allah and He is well aware of your deeds.

Allah heard them say that Allah is a pauper and we are very rich, We are writing their nonsense, and their act of slaying of messengers also, but on the Day of Judgement I will say: now as punishment, taste fire of Hell.
This is the reward for your deed which you have sent ahead, otherwise Allah never oppresses His servants.

And these people say: Allah has made covenant with us unless some messenger show us this miracle that his sacrifice is accepted by way of lightning from the sky, we will not believe him, O Prophet, tell them that many messengers brought clear signs and showed the miracles as demanded by you, if you are truthful then why did you slay them?
O Prophet! Still if they deny, do not get worried, before you many messengers have come with clear signs, scriptures and illuminated books, but still they rejected them.

Every soul shall taste the death, and you will get full reward for your deeds on the Day of Judgement, and successful will be the person who will be saved from Hell and will enter Paradise, and a few days' life in the world is only delusion.

O Believers! Verily, you will be tested with your lives and wealth, and you will have to hear the annoying talk from the people who were given the Book of Allah before you and also from infidels, and if you tolerate it will be an act of determination.

Remind the time when Allah had taken a covenant that you will explain the book of Allah properly and do not conceal anything of it, but they did not honour it and they cast it behind them, and got a small price in lieu of it, what a bad transaction it is.

Beware! The people who rejoice on what they have done and wish that they should be praised for whatever good work they have not done, don't think they are saved from punishment, there is painful punishment for them.
And the sky and the earth belong to Allah, and He has control over everything.
Undoubtedly, in the creation of earth and the skies, and in alternation of day and night are many signs for those who understand.

Those who remember Allah standing and sitting and lying on their sides and ponder over the creation of skies and the earth and spontaneously say: O Allah, You have not created anything which is useless, You are Pure, save us from the punishment of fire.
O my Lord, to whoever you make to enter the fire You have Verily disgraced, and no one helps the oppressors.
O our Lord! we heard a caller who was calling towards faith, saying: believe in your Lord, so we believed; O our Lord forgive our sins and ward off our faults, and may we die with the righteous ones.
O our Lord! Grant us what You have promised to your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Judgement and You never break Your promise.

So their Lord accepted their prayer, I do not waste anyone's work whether man or woman, you are from one another, who were deported from homeland and persecuted in My way, and were martyred in the battle against infidels, I will Verily cover their evil deeds, and will make them enter Gardens of Paradise, beneath them rivers are flowing, this is their reward with Allah, and there is always good reward with Allah.
Beware, you should not be deceived by infidels who roam from city to city.
This enjoyment is brief, and their ultimate destination is Hell and what a bad place this is.

But whoever practices piety of Allah, there are Gardens of Paradise beneath which are flowing rivers, and they will always remain there, this is hospitality from Allah, for pious people the Hereafter is better than this world.

And Verily, there are some among the people of book who have faith in Allah, and on the Book revealed to you, and on the books revealed on them and prostrate before Allah, and they do not take small price for the verses of Allah, there is reward for them with Allah, and certainly, Allah is quick in taking account.
O Believers! Be patient and teach others to be patient, and prepare (for the holy struggle), and fear Allah so that you may be successful.

O People! Fear the Lord Who created you all from one soul and created his mate from the same soul, then from those two created numerous men and women and scattered them in the world, and fear Allah, through Whom you demand from one another (your mutual benefit), and be afraid of negligence of relatives, Allah supervises all your deeds.
And give orphans their property, and do not exchange good with bad, and don't mix their property with yours, this is a very grave sin.

If you doubt that you would not do justice to orphan, then you can marry women of your choice two, three or four times, but if you fear you cannot do justice among them then contend with one only and with captive that your right hand possess, this is more proper and that you may not deviate from the right path.
Give women her dower happily, and if they themselves give up some portion out of their free will, then you can consume it.
And don't give the weak-minded your wealth, which Allah has made means of sustenance for you, but provide for them clothes and food and speak to them with kindness.

And test the orphans, when they reach the age of marriage and if you find in them ability of sound judgement, return their property to them, and do not consume in excess fearing they may get adult soon, and whoever is rich among you, desist from their property, and whoever is poor should take minimum, and when you return their property to them take witnesses in their presence, and Allah is self-sufficient in reckoning.

There is a part for men in the inheritance of property of parents and relatives, and for women also there is a part in the inheritance of property of parents and relatives, whether wealth is small or big, it is a duty.
And at the time of distribution if other relatives, orphans and poor come, also give them something as sustenance, and talk softly and appropriately to them.
Those people should be afraid and think how pity they would feel, if they leave behind weak children, they should fear Allah and talk to them softly.
People who unlawfully grab the property of orphans, they are filling their bellies with fire, and soon they will go to Hell.

O Believers! Allah directs you for your children that the boy shall have the equal of the portion of two girls, then if they are more than two girls then they will get two-third of the inheritance, if there is only one girl she will get half, and if children are there and parents are alive there is one-sixth share for each parent, if there are no children then mother will get one third share and if brother is there the mother will get one-sixth, after the payment of bequest he may have made and payment of debts if any, these are your parents and children but you did not know who is more beneficial for you, this is ordinance from Allah and Allah Verily have knowledge and wisdom.

Your share is half of her property if your wife dies and does not leave a child, and if she leaves behind a child then your share is one-fourth after payment of debt and any bequest she had made; if you do not have any child then there is one-fourth share for your wives and if you have any offspring, than there is one-eighth share for them, after payment of debt and bequest if you had made, if somebody dies leaving behind brother or sister as inheritor. (if deceased's parents are not alive and he has no children), then each will have one-sixth share, but if more than two then their share is one-third, after payment of debt or bequest the he had made, as long as it is not detrimental to their rights, then this order is from Allah and He is Knowing and Forbearing.

These limitations are set by Allah, and whoever will obey Allah and His Prophet, on the Day of Judgement Allah will send him to the Gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing and they will remain there forever and this is the biggest success.
And whoever disobeys Allah and the Prophet and crosses these limits, then Allah will send him to Hell and he shall remain there forever, and this is the most disgraceful punishment.
And if your women commit adultery then take four witnesses among you, and if all four confirm this then as punishment confine them in the house until they die or Allah makes some way for them.
And among them who commit fornication they should be beaten up, but if they repent and reform themselves, then leave them, Verily Allah accepts repentance and is Kind.
But repentance is accepted by Allah from those who do evil unknowingly and repent as soon as they realize, and Allah accept repentance of such people, and Allah is all knowing and Wise.

And repentance is not for those who did evil throughout their lives and when they reach the death bed, they say we repent, and likewise repentance is not for those also who died in infidelity and We have prepared painful punishment for them.

O Believers, this is not proper for you to become inheritor of a woman forcefully, just for the intention of taking some part of the dower from them do not stop them from marrying again, however if they commit indecency. (you may warn them), and continue good behavior with your wives, even if you do not like them for any reason, have patience, perhaps Allah may have kept betterment, in the things you may dislike.

And if you wish to replace a wife with another (after divorcing her), and even if you have given her much in dower, do not take anything back, would you like to take that back in exchange of slander and clear sin.
How you will take back when you have already consummated the marriage, and they have taken a firm covenant from you.
Do not marry the women whom your fathers had married (even illegally), now whatever has been done, it was shameful and a very abominable custom.

O Believers, following women are forbidden for you: your mothers (maternal and paternal grandmothers), daughters (granddaughters), sisters and your parental and maternal, nieces (brother's and sister's daughters), and the women who have breast fed you, and your 'milk sisters', and mothers of wives, your step-daughters under your guardianship born of your wives with whom you have cohabited, but you can marry the girls whose mother you have not cohabited with, and wives of your sons (daughters-in-law) who are from your own loins, and marrying with two sisters at a time, except what has already past, Verily Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

And married women are prohibited except those you get them as slaves in the battle against infidels, this is written command of Allah, other women are also allowed with purity and chastity you wish to marry them by paying dower and not with indecency and adultery, the women you have taken in temporary marriage, pay them the prescribed dower, and after completing the agreed period, if you wish to stay with them with mutual consent, there is no harm, Verily Allah is All-Knowing and All-Wise.

Among you who is unable to pay dower to the free believing women, then he can marry a believing slave-girl in your possession, and Allah know your thoughts, you are from one another, and marry the slave-girls with the permission of their masters and pay them dower, but marry only those who will remain steadfast with you, they should not be indulging in fornication openly or stealthily, after becoming your wife if she commit adultery then her punishment is half of the free woman, this is for those who fear falling for evil, but if you exercise restraint it is better for you, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
Allah wishes to explain His commands to you and make you tread the path of upright people and accept your repentance, and Allah is aware of everything and is Wise.
Allah desires to accept your repentance and people who follow lusty desires want to drive you far away from the right path.
Allah desires to mitigate your burden because humans have been created weak.

O Believers, do not unjustly grab the wealth of one another, but if you do trade with mutual consent where wealth of one another is involved then there is no harm, do not commit suicide by choking yourself because Allah is Merciful on your condition.
And whoever will cross the limit and unjustly commit excesses, very soon We will cast them in the fire of Hell and it is very easy for Allah.
If you do not commit the major sins out of prohibited acts, then We will forgive your smaller sins and will send you to the honourable place.

And among you Allah has given preference to one over another, but don’t wish because this preference is because of their deeds, men will get their share of what they earn, and women will get their share of what they earn, ask Allah for His Mercy, Verily, Allah is aware of everything.
And to every one We have appointed heirs of what parents and near relatives leave; and whoever has made covenant, give them their portion, Verily Allah is witness over all.

Men have control over women, Allah has preferred some over some others, and good women obey men since they spend their wealth over them, and like Allah has provided them safety, they also preserve everything, and if you doubt that they may go rebellious, admonish them, and then stop sleeping with them, and still if they don't reform then hit them (lightly that do not cause blood to come out and no limb should break), but if they obey, do not seek a way against them, Allah is High and Great.

And if you fear dispute between them, take one arbitrator from man's side and one arbitrator from woman's side so they make peace between them, and Allah will make best arrangement, and Allah is Knowing and Aware.

Worship Allah only and make no partner for Him, and be kind to your parents, relatives, orphans, destitute, immediate neighbours, unknown neighbours, those sitting beside you, aliens, slaves and slave-girls, and Allah does not like proud and boastfulness.
These are the people who are stingy and advise other about it, and conceal the wealth given by the Grace of Allah, and We have prepared disgraceful punishment for unbelievers.
And the people who spend their wealth just to show off and do not believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement, and whose companion is Satan how bad is he.
What harm would have happened If people who believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement have spent something in the way of Allah, and Allah knows them very well.
Allah does not cause injustice to anyone even of the size of a particle (on the contrast) He cause to doubles the good deeds of anyone and Himself reward abundantly.
What condition would that be when We will summon the witness of every group, and (O Mohammad) you will be summoned to witness over them.
That day, O Prophet, unbelievers who disobeyed the Prophet will desire they were levelled with earth, and alas, they will not be able to conceal anything from Allah.

O Believers, do not go near prayer in intoxication, so you should understand what you are saying, and not after intercourse until you perform bath, but if you are passing on the road (you can go), if you are sick or in travel and stool comes out or perform intercourse and could not find water, then get yourself clean with dust, then wipe your face and hands with dust and perform dry-ablution (taymoom), Verily Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.

O Prophet! Didn’t you notice those who were given a portion of the book of Allah, but those people started purchasing ignorance instead of guidance, they really want you also to stray from the right path.
And Verily Allah is well aware of your enemies, and Allah is enough for friendship and Allah is enough for support.

There are people in Jews who alter words from their places and say: we heard and disobeyed, you also listen but you will not be heard, this is because of language distortion and taunts, it would have been better if they would have said: we heard and obeyed and you also listen and do favour, but Allah has cursed them because of their infidelity, so very few of them will turn believers.

O People of Book! The Book which We have revealed (now) also confirms the book which you have, so believe in it before We distort the faces and turn them toward their backs, like We cursed the violators of Sabbath, shall do the same for them, and Allah's command shall be implemented.
Allah does not forgive the sin, that someone makes someone partner with Allah, except that He can forgive any sin, and whoever makes someone associate with Allah, has committed a great sin.
O Prophet, did you not notice that some people show off purity, whereas to whoever Allah gives purity whoever He pleases, and they shall not be wronged even as small as thread.
Look, how blatantly they are blaming Allah, and this is sufficient for their manifest sin.
Did you not notice that those who were given portions of the book have faith in Satan and idols and say infidels are better than the believers.
O Prophet, these are the people who have curse of Allah, you will see that no one will help them.
Do they have any share in the kingdom? That they do not want to give even a straw to them.
Or they are jealous of those whom Allah has given abundance with His Grace, and gave book, wisdom and kingdom to the family of Ibrahim.
Then some of them believed and some of them denied, and burning Hell is sufficient for these people.
Whoever deny Our verses, Verily, shortly We will enter them in Hell-fire, their skins will melt We will replace with new skins, so they taste the punishment, Allah is Predominant and Wise.

And those who believed and did good deeds, shortly We will make them enter such gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, they will remain there forever, and they shall have pure mates, and We will keep them in thick shadows.

O Believers, it is the command of Allah to return whatever has been kept with you for safe- keeping (to their owners), and when you judge among people, do it with justice, how good Allah admonishes you, Verily, Allah hears and sees all.

O Believers, obey Allah, obey the Prophet and obey those who are in authority among you, and if you quarrel on any subject and if you believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement, it is better for you to turn to Allah and His Prophet in the matter, and this is better for you than believing the result.

O Prophet, Did not you consider those people who think they believe the Book revealed on you and the books revealed before you, and they desire transgressors to be their judge, whereas they are asked to deny them, and Satan wants to astray them and wants to take them far away.
When they are called towards the command of Allah and His Prophet, you will see that hypocrites deny intensely.
What will happen that day when affliction will befall them due to their deeds, and they will come and swear before you that: we just wanted to do good work and create unity.
Allah is aware of what is in their hearts, then seclude from them and admonishes them, and speaks to them in effectual words regarding them.

And We did not send any Prophet but only for the people to obey him by the command of Allah, and when they were unjust to themselves; (by disobeying) if they would have come to you seeking forgiveness from Allah, and you also praying for them, then Verily, they would have found Allah very Merciful.
O Prophet, I Swear, they will not become true believer unless they make you arbitrator in their quarrelling, then they should also not feel bad what you decide; but should wholeheartedly accept it.

If We would have ordered them (like Bani Israel) to lay down your lives or leave your homes, only few would have followed it; it would have been in their interest if they would have followed the advice given to them and have been steadfast.
And We would also have given them great reward.
And would certainly have guided them to the straight path.
And whoever obeys Allah and His Prophet, they will be with those whom Allah has bestowed the favors; the prophets, truthful, martyrs and righteous, and how good are these friends.
This is the Grace of Allah and Allah is sufficient to know.
O Believers! Check your safety preparation properly (at the time of holy battle), then it is up to you whether you leave in companies or altogether.
There are some who will avoid (going to the battlefield), and if any affliction befalls you, they will say: it was Grace of Allah that we were not with the Muslims.

And if bounties of Allah come to you (overpowering your enemies) then they will behave in a way that they were never your friends, and will say: would that I had been with them I would have achieved more attainment.
Now it is required that people should fight in the way of Allah who buy the Hereafter in exchange of this world, if they are martyred or return victorious, shortly We will give them great reward.

O Believers, what has happened to you that you don't fight to rescue the weak and hapless women and children who are praying to Allah: rescue us from this city (Makkah) whose dwellers are oppressors, and give us from You a guardian; and give us from You a helper.
Believers fight in the way of Allah and infidels fight and die in the way of Satan, so (O believers) fight against the friends of Satan, because their strategy is very weak.

O Prophet! Didn’t you notice their condition who were advised to withhold their hands, pray and pay poor-rate (but they become restless), and when fighting was made obligatory, a group from them feared (from enemy) as if they are fearing Allah and even more, and saying: O Lord, why did you made fighting obligatory so soon, we wish you would have delayed it more, O Prophet, tell them capital of this world is few, and better place for the pious ones is the Hereafter, and you will not be wronged even as a thread.

Death will reach you, wherever you may be, even if you hide in the strong forts; if they get any benefit they say it is from Allah but if any tragedy befalls them they say it is because of you (Prophet), O Prophet, tell them it is all from Allah, what has befallen them, why don't they understand anything.

However. (truth is that) whatever benefits and success has reached you it is from Allah and if any tragedy befalls you it is because of you, and O Prophet! We made you messenger for the people, and Allah is sufficient as Witness.
Whoever obeyed Prophet has obeyed Allah, but if they turn away, We have not sent you to watch over their evil deeds.

In front you these people say that they are your obedient, but when they go from your presence, whatever you have told them, they decide against it during the night, however, Allah writes down whatever they decide by the night; you need not care what they do, depend on Allah, and Allah is Sufficient for protection.
Do they not even think in the Quran that had it not been from Allah they would have found many discrepancies in it.

When they get the news of peace or fear, they spread it, however they should have referred it to the Prophet or people of authority because they investigate it. (The Prophet or people in authority would have decided whether to spread or not); and were it not for the Grace of Allah, you would have all followed Satan except a few.

So, fight in the way of Allah and you are not responsible for anybody's deeds except yours, and motivate the believers (for fighting), and shortly Allah will restrain the might of the infidels, and might of Allah is greater, and His punishment is most severe.
Whoever will cause others to do good deeds will have some share of its reward, and whoever cause others to do bad deeds shall have some share of its punishment, and Allah is Guardian over everything.
And when somebody salutes you, you also salute in a better way, or in the same way, Verily Allah keeps the account of everything.
No one is worthy of worship except Allah, He will gather you on the Day of Judgement there is not an iota of doubt about it, and Who can be more Truthful than Allah, then what has happened to you.

What has happened to you, then, two groups have been created among the hypocrites, whereas We have turned them back (to unbelief) on the basis of their deeds; do you wish to guide them whom Allah has left them in misguidance; whereas to whoever Allah leave in misguidance, you cannot find a way to guide them.

However, to whom Allah leaves in misguidance. (nobody among) you cannot find a way to guide them, they want you also to become infidel like them, so you too become like them, now, unless they do not migrate in the way of Allah don't befriend them, now, if they turn away from this also, arrest them and kill wherever you find them, and do not make them your assistant or friend.

Except those who meet with the group with whom you already have a covenant, or they come to you with heavy heart and say they will neither fight you and their own people; Allah could have imposed them upon you if He wanted, He would have given them the power over you, therefore if they withdraw from you and do not fight you and offer you peace, then Allah has not given you any way over them.

Soon you will find some people who wished to be safe from you as well as from their tribe, but when they are called towards mischief, they get into it head on, now if they do not withdraw, nor did they propose peace to you and nor they desist from fighting, so seize them wherever you get and kill them, these are the people upon whom We have given you the domination.

It is not permitted for a believer to kill a believer, except by mistake, and whoever even if he kills a believer by mistake, he should release a believing slave and should pay blood-money to the next kin of the deceased, unless they remit it, but if (he is believing and) from your enemies, then release a Muslim slave, if he is (an infidel) and from the people who have made covenant with you, then blood-money should be paid and releasing a believer is obligatory, but he who cannot find a slave to release, then keep two months continuous fast as atonement, Allah is all Knowing and has Wisdom.
Whoever kills a believer intentionally, his punishment is Hell and he shall remain there forever, wrath of Allah is on him and curses and Allah has prepared painful punishment for him.

O Believers! When you go to fight in the name of Allah do not hasten and make investigation before killing, and if someone salutes you even just to show his belief, do not say: 'you are not a believer', are you just after materialistic benefits whereas there are lots of gains with Allah. (O believers) you were also like them, but Allah conferred Mercy on you, so check thoroughly; Verily Allah is aware of what you do.

Except disabled, who hide themselves in houses and those who fight in the way of Allah cannot on par, but people who strive with their life and wealth in the way of Allah, Allah has graded them highly over the people who sit in their houses, although Allah has promised good to all the believers (whether they participate in fighting or not), but warriors have much more share over those who sit in houses.
He will bestow grades, forgiveness and Mercy, and Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

Verily, when angels extract the soul of the people while they were oppressing themselves, they will ask in which state you were on earth, they will reply: we were weak and helpless on the earth; angels will say, was not the earth of Allah spacious so you could have migrated, so these are people whose place is Hell and it is evil place.
Except for the men, women and children who were so helpless that they were not having any strategy and could not find a way (to escape).
These are the people whom shortly Allah will forgive, and Allah is all Pardoning and Forgiving.

And who will migrate in the way of Allah will find the spacious place, and whoever leave his home for Allah and His Prophet but dies before reaching the destination, Allah will Verily reward him, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O Believers! When you are in travel, and fear attack from the infidel while praying, then shorten our prayer because infidels are your open enemies.

O Prophet! When you are with the believers on the battlefield, and fighting is in progress, make two group of the believers, one should be left for fighting, and other should pray behind you and keep the weapons with you, after you perform prostration of first rakat, then they should hasten in second rakat and should read it independently and should guard you from your behind, and other group who has not prayed may come and pray behind you and keep their weapons with them, infidels desire that you be careless with weapons and property and they will ambush you, however if it is raining or you are not well, you can keep your weapons on the ground but be alert, and Allah has already prepared the disgraceful punishment for the infidels.

And when you have finished praying remember Allah while standing, sitting, lying down, in all positions, and when you are secured from danger of the enemy then pray as earlier, because prayer has been made obligatory on the believers on fixed timing.

O believers, do not be slacked in pursuit of your enemies; if you have faced any hardship, then the same hardship has been faced by them also, but you have hope from Allah which they do not have, and He knows the intention of each and has Wisdom.
O Prophet! We have revealed the truthful Book to you to arbitrate among them with justice with the command of Allah; and do not side with the people who betray.
Pray for forgiveness from Allah for your people, Verily Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O Prophet, do not defend those who have betrayed their souls, Allah does not like who are criminal of betrayal.

They hide (their deeds) from the people but they cannot hide from Allah, however He is with them, when they make strategy at night which Allah does not like, Allah's Knowledge encompasses all their strategies.
Beware, in this life you have started fighting for them, but who will fight with Allah on their behalf on the Day of Judgement or who will be their advocate.
And whoever does evil and or oppresses his own soul and, in the Hereafter, seek repentance, so Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
Whoever commits sin, harms himself, Allah is Knowing and Wise.
And if somebody commit a mistake or a sin, then accuses another for it, he has committed upon himself slander and a manifest sin.

O Prophet! If Allah's Mercy was not on you then one of these groups would have tried to misguide you, however they are misguiding themselves, they cannot harm you in anyway, and it is Allah Who have revealed on you His Book and wisdom, He taught you the thing you didn’t knew, and great Mercy of Allah is upon you.

O Prophet! There is no good in their secrets, but if anybody gives alms and does good work or makes reconciliation among people and whoever does these works just for Allah's pleasure, We will give him great reward shortly.

Whoever transgresses with the Prophet, after manifesting the right path and tread the path other than the path of the believers so We will turn him to the same way, to wherever he will turn himself, and will make him enter Hell; and what an evil place it is.
Verily, He never forgives whoever makes anybody Allah's partner, apart from this He may forgive anybody, and whoever makes anybody Allah's partner has gone astray and fallen far apart.
Unbelievers worship women (deities) instead of Allah, in reality they invoke transgressor Satan.
He who has curses of Allah, who has said in the beginning. (O Allah!) I will take a share from your servants.

Then I Verily will misguide them, and will entangle them in big hopes and bid them to tear the ears of the animals, then will instruct them to alter the creation of Allah, and whoever will make Satan his guardian instead of Allah, he Verily is in manifest loss.
Satan promises them and makes them hope big, and his promises are just an illusion.
These are people whose abode is Hell and they cannot escape from there.

And those who believe and do good deeds, shortly We will cause them to enter gardens, beneath them the rivers will be flowing, and they will remain there forever, it is the righteous promise of Allah, and who is more truthful than Allah?
Neither your wish nor the desires of people of book will have any effect, whoever does bad deeds shall be requited with it, then you shall not find anybody your guardian and helper other than Allah.
And whoever will do the good deeds whether men or women and are believers also, these people will go to the Paradise unhindered, also not the least of unjust will be done onto them.

And who can be more religious than he who has submitted himself and bow down before Allah, who is pious also and tread the path of Ibrahim, who was used to walk aside from falsehood, and Allah took Ibrahim as friend.
Whatever is in the skies and on the earth belongs to Allah and He encompasses everything with His Power.

O Prophet! They ask you about marrying orphan girls, you tell them they are allowed you to marry them; the earlier order recited to you for not marrying was because you wanted to marry without paying the fixed dower to them, and Allah is ordaining you regarding weak children to be firm for the rights of the orphans, and rest assured that good work you do Allah Verily know it.

If any woman fear divorce due to excesses and negligence from her husband and if reconciliation is affected between them, there is no harm, and stinginess is present with every soul, if you will behave well and desist from excesses, Allah is aware of your deeds.

No matter how much you strive, but you cannot do justice among your wives, but don't incline towards one only, and don't leave others suspended, but if you reconcile and practice piety, then Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

And if both husband and wife wish to gets separated (by way of divorce), then Allah will provide abundance to them from His vast treasure and (make them independent of each other) He has vast capacity and has Wisdom.

Whatever is in skies and whatever is on the earth all belong to Allah, We granted the book to the people before you, and to you also, We enjoined that keep fearing (from disobeying) Allah, and if you disbelieve (you cannot harm Allah, and remember) whatever is in skies and whatever in on the earth all belong to Allah and Allah is Self-Sufficient, and Praise-Worthy.
Whatever is in skies and whatever is on the earth everything belongs to Allah, and Allah is enough for Guardianship.
O People, if Allah wishes He can eliminate all of you, and settle this world with new inhabitants, and He is capable of doing this.
Whoever wants the reward for his deeds only in this world (then he should know) Allah has the rewards of this world and the Hereafter both, and He listens and sees everyone.

O Believers, hold fast to justice, and testify truly for the sake of Allah, even if it is against you, your parents, relatives, rich or poor, Allah is more Compassionate for them, do not follow your evil desires, lest you deviate; and if you testify with break-and-twist or abstain fully then, Verily, Allah is well aware of what you do.

O Believers, believe in Allah, His Prophet and in the Book which He has been revealed on His Prophet, and the books revealed earlier, whoever will deny Allah, His angels, His books and His Prophets and the Day of Judgement, then he has strayed off and gone far away.

Verily, who believed and became infidel, again believed and once again became infidel, and they increased their infidelity, then Allah will not forgive them and nor will not guide them to the right path (also).
O Prophet! give glad tidings to the hypocrites that they Verily there is painful punishment for them.
Those who make infidels their guardian instead of believers and search for honor with them (they should know) Verily, Honor is entirely for Allah (only).

O Believer, however, Allah has ordained for you in His Book that when you hear that the verses are being denied and mocked at, do not mingle with the infidels so you also start pondering on something else and at that time you also become like them, undoubtedly, one day Allah will gather both hypocrites and unbelievers in Hell.

They (Hypocrites) await your situation that you get victory, or you get defeated, and if Allah give you victory, they say: were we not with you, and if infidels get some part, they tell them: did not we overwhelmed you and then did not we rescued you from believers. (O infidels) Allah will judge you on the Day of Judgement, and Allah will never let infidels dominate the believers.

Verily, hypocrite think they are deceiving Allah, whereas Allah negates their deception, they stand up in prayer carelessly and half-heartedly just to show the people, and very little they remember Allah.

They are suspended between believing and unbelieving, they are neither with Muslims nor with infidels, and O Prophet! To whoever Allah leaves in misguidance, you cannot find any way for their guidance.
O Believers, do not make unbelievers your guardian instead of believers, do you wish to offer clear proof against you to Allah.
There is no doubt that hypocrites will be in the lowest stage of Hell (and O Prophet); you will not find anybody there who will be helping them.

But those who repented from hypocrisy, amended their way and hold fast to Allah, and followed religion just for Allah, these people will be in Paradise with the believers, and shortly Allah will bestow great rewards upon the believers.
What would Allah gain by punishing you if you show gratitude and faith in Him? Allah is Appreciative (of the grateful), and All-Knowing.
Allah does not like public speaking of evil language, except for those who have been wronged. (he can describe), Allah hears to everyone and know everybody.
Whether you do good work openly or conceal it, or if you forgive some wrong, Allah is Forgiving and Powerful.

Verily, those who deny Allah, His Prophets, and wish to create divide between Allah and His Prophets and say that we believe in some Prophets while deny some and wish to create a new path (between infidelity and faith).
These are the infidels in reality and We have prepared a very disgraceful punishment for them.
And those who believe in Allah and His Prophets, and do not differentiate between them, Allah will reward them very shortly, and Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.

O Prophet! Do not worry about demands of the people of book, who tell you to bring a book from sky on them, because they had demanded much more than this from Moosa, hence, they said show us the Allah manifestly, then because of their mischief, lightning destroyed them, then in spite of receiving clear argument about monotheism they worshipped heifer, but still We pardoned them and gave Moosa the clear domination.

And due to covenant with them We raised Mount Tur (Sinai) over them, and directed them to enter the city while prostrating, and We also directed them not to exceed the rules of Sabbath, We took very strong covenant from them.

Then, because they broke the covenant, deny the commands of Allah, unjustly killing the messengers and their saying that their hearts are covered (whereas it was not the case), and due to their infidelity Allah sealed their hearts, they will not accept faith, except a few.
And due to their disbelief and they uttered grave charges against Maryam;

And their saying that they killed Jesus Christ son of Maryam, whereas they neither killed him nor crucified him, but We changed another person into Isa's face, Verily they are in doubt and they aware are not, they just follow a conjecture; and Verily they did not kill him.
Rather, He raised him towards Himself, and He is Mighty strategist.

And (when Isa will descend after reappearance of Imam Mahdi - Aj.) from the people of the book there will not be anybody who will not believe in him before he dies, and Isa will testify on the Day of Judgement.
So, because of iniquity of Jews, We made unlawful to them clean and pure things which were earlier lawful for them, and for their hindering many from the path of Allah;
Practicing usury in spite of prohibition, unjustly grabbing the wealth of people, and for the people who adopted infidelity, We have kept prepared painful punishment for them.

But, O Prophet, those among them who are well-grounded in religious knowledge, and the believers who have faith on all the Books; whether revealed on you or sent earlier and does pray regularly and give poor-rate and have faith on Allah and the Day of Judgement, We will shortly reward them grandly.

O Prophet, We revealed to you, the way We revealed to Nooh and messengers after him, and the way We revealed to Ibrahim, Ismail, Ishaq, and Children of Yaqoob, Isa, Ayyub, Yunus, Haroon and Suleiman; and to Dawood We gave Zaboor.
And, We sent many Prophets, whose story We have described to you, and We sent many Prophets whose situation We did not described to you, and Allah directly spoke with Moosa.

And We sent messengers as giver of glad tidings and as warner (from the punishment of Allah), so after arrival of messengers, no argument shall remain for them against Allah, and Allah is Predominant and Wise. (infidels may believe it or not).
But whatever has been revealed, itself bears testimony that Allah revealed it with His Knowledge, and angels also testify this, although, Allah, Himself is enough for the testimony.
Verily, those who adopted infidelity and stopped people from the way of Allah have gone astray and have gone far away.
Verily, those who adopted infidelity and did oppression so Allah neither will Forgive them nor they will get any kind of guidance;
Except that Allah will show way to Hell and they will remain in it forever, and this is very easy for Allah.

O People, the Prophet has come from Allah to you with truth, so believe and this is better for you and if you will deny. (then know) that whatever is in the skies and on the earth everything belongs to Allah and He is Knowing and Wise.

O People of Book, do not transgress in religion, and do not say anything about Allah but truth, and Christ, Isa son of Maryam was just a messenger (he was neither God nor His son), Allah sent a Word to Maryam by which she became pregnant, and was an spirit from Allah, so believe in Allah and his messengers, and desist from believing on Trinity, and strive for your benefit, Allah is the only Lord, and he is pure from having a son (why does He need it), whatever is in the skies and on earth everything belongs to Allah, and He is sufficient for Advocacy and Guardianship.

Neither Isa can deny being servant of Allah, nor His close angels, whoever will deny him to be the servant of Allah and will boast so shortly Allah will call them to Him (and will reward or punish them).

Whoever accepts faith and did good work they will be given full reward, even more by the Grace of Allah, and whoever will deny and boast, so He will give painful punishment; and they shall not find for themselves besides Allah any guardian or helper.
O People, there is not any doubt that manifest proof (truthful religion) has come to you, and We have revealed the bright light.
Then those who believe and keep attached with it, shortly Allah will reach to them His Grace and Mercy and will guide them to the path which reaches Him.

O Prophet, they ask for your edict regarding 'kalalah', tell them: Allah has ordained Himself to that if any person dies who does not have any children (neither parents are alive) and has a sister, so she will get half of what he leaves behind (and if sister dies), and she does not have any children (nor parents are alive) so his inheritor will be this brother only, and if there are two sisters then they shall get two-third from what he leaves, and if anybody's inheritors are brother and sister both, then man shall have double of woman's share, Allah described His Commands clearly to you, lest you go astray, and Allah is aware of everything.

O Believers, fulfil your covenants, lawful for you are all grazing four-footed livestock, except those who have been read out to you, but when you are wearing Ahram, do not think hunting is permitted, Verily Allah commands whatever He pleases.

O Believers, beware, do not disrespect the signs of Allah nor the sacred months, and do not disrespect sacrificial animals, and nor the animals who have been garlanded, and who intend for pilgrimage to the Sacred House and are desirous of His pleasure and Grace, and after you remove Ahram then hunt and beware, do not oppress just because someone hindered you from visiting Sacred Mosque, in goodness and piety be helpful to one other, and do not help each other for committing sins, keep fearing Allah because His punishment is intense.

O People. (forbidden for you are) dead animals, blood, flesh of swine, and animal on which any name other than Allah was invoked while slaughtering, and animal killed by strangling, who died of injury, who is smitten by horn, and partly eaten by wild animals, but was slaughtered before dying, and are slaughtered after offering to idols, and that you divide by arrows, that is impiety, O believers, now that infidels are grievous because of your believing, but do not fear them, fear Me only; this day I have completed your religion, and have fulfilled My Mercy and have chosen Islam as religion for you; if somebody is forced by hunger and is not inclined towards sin (and eat something), then Verily Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

O Prophet, people ask you what are things that are allowed, tell them pure things have been allowed to you, and you have taught the hunting animals tamed and you taught them some of tricks which Allah has taught you, so you can eat of what these hunting-animals catch for you and pronounce the name of Allah on it, and keep fearing Allah because there is not any doubt that Allah is swift in taking the account.

This day all the pure things have been allowed to you, and food from people of book is also allowed and your food is allowed for them; and free and chaste women of believers and their free and chaste women who were given book before you, are allowed for you provided you pay them dower purely, and not as payment for fornication, whether openly or in friendly way, and whoever deny the faith, all his deeds will Verily go waste and (even) in the Hereafter he will be in loss.

O Believers, when you prepare for prayer wash your faces, and your hands from elbow, and wipe your head and feet up to ankle, and if you are unclean then take obligatory bath, and if you are sick and or travelling, or have used toilet, or have cohabited with women, and could you not find water then perform dry-ablution, wipe your face and hands with soil, Allah does not desire to put you in any difficulty, but He wants to purify you and fulfil His Mercy, so that you become thankful.

And remember the favors Allah has done to you and that covenants you have made with Him, when you said: you heard the commands of Allah and obeyed and keep fearing Allah because there is not an iota of doubt that Allah knows all the secrets.

O Believers, be the people who are steadfast and give true testimony to please Allah, due to enmity of any tribe do not cause to act unjustly, then do justice in all circumstances, it is near to piousness, and fear Allah because Allah is aware of whatever you do.
Who accepted faith and performed good deeds, Allah has promised them forgiveness and reward (in the Hereafter).
Who adopted infidelity and deny Our verses, they are all Hellish.

O believers, remember the favors of Allah, when people of a tribe tried to stretch their hands towards you but Allah withheld their hands from you, and keep fearing Allah, and believers should rely on Allah only.

There is no doubt that Allah has taken covenant from Bani Israel and have appointed 12 chieftains among them, and Allah told Bani Israel: Verily, I am with you, if you pray regularly and give poor-rate and believe on My messengers and keep helping them, and give loan (to the needy) and I will distance you from the sins, and cause you to reach to the Gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, even after this whoever will deny then he Verily has gone astray.

Then We cursed them because they broke the covenants and We hardened their hearts, because they changed the meaning of Our verses to their own meaning, and they forgot much from what were advised to them, O Prophet, except a few from them, and you shall be discovering their betrayal one by one, but you forgive them, because Allah pleases with those who do favors.

And people who say they are Christians, we took covenant from them also, but they forgot a large section what was advised to them, then (as a punishment) We created hatred among them till the Day of Judgement, and Allah will shortly tell them what they were doing.

O People of Book, Our Prophet has already come to you, to reveal to you many things clearly which you conceal and withheld many things, Bright Light has come to you from Allah, and to you has come the Book which describe the things clearly;

Those who are steadfast for the pleasure of Allah, through this they are guided towards deliverance, and from His command take them out of utter darkness and bring them into light and guides them to the right path.

People who are of the view that Messiah, son of Maryam is God, have become infidels, O Prophet, ask them if Allah wish to kill Messiah son of Maryam, his mother and destroy everybody on earth, then who is there who can deter Allah, it is the Kingdom of Allah whatever is in the skies and on the earth, and between them, and whatever He pleases He creates, and Allah has power over everything.

And Jews and Christians say they are sons of God and His beloved, O Prophet say: if it is so then why does He give you punishment for your sins? But you are also one of His creatures, Allah will forgive whom He pleases and will punish whom He pleases, and everything in the skies and on the earth and between them is His Kingdom, and to Him is eventual return.

O People of book, now that Prophet has come after a period of suspension lest you say: no one came to you to give good news and to warn; now Prophet has come to give you glad tidings and to warn, Allah has power over everything.

O Prophet, remind them of the time when Moosa said to his tribe: O my people remember the favors of Allah, and he made many messengers and kings from among you, and gave you all that He had not given to anybody in the world.
O My people, go to the Holy Land where Allah has written governance for you, and do not show your back to the enemy, because you will only bear the loss of it.
They said: O Moosa, there live very strong people, unless they do not leave from there, we will not set our foot over there, if they leave by themselves then we will enter.

But two persons who were fearful of Allah and had Allah's Mercy on them said: just attack and enter the gate, as soon as you enter the gate, they will all flee and victory will be yours, and if you are believers then you should rely only on Allah.
They said: O Moosa! we shall not enter there until they leave, yes you go with your Lord and you both fight and we are sitting here.
Then Moosa pleaded: O Allah! You know better that I do not have control on anyone except my brother and myself, make a separation between us and these disobedient (we cannot be together).
Said Allah: (as punishment) they will not get governance for 40 years and during this period they shall be wandering in the forest (of Egypt), hence, do not grieve for these transgressors.

O Prophet! relate them the story of Adam's two sons (Qabeel and Habeel – Cain and Abel) when they submitted their offerings in the court of Allah, so the offering of one (Habeel) was accepted and other's (Qabeel's) offering was not accepted, with jealousy he (Qabeel) said I will Verily kill you, he replied (O brother) what can we do, Allah accepts offering from pious ones only.
If you desire to kill me you will stretch your hand towards me, but I will not stretch my hands towards you with intention to kill, because Verily, I fear Allah who is Lord of the worlds.
I want you to bear your sins as well as my sins and you become Hellish, and this is punishment for the oppressors.
Then his soul incited him to kill his brother and at last he killed him, and he became one of the losers.

(When he became worried about the dead body) Allah sent a crow who started scraping the ground to show Qabeel how to hide dead body of his brother; seeing this he uttered: Woe unto me I am so helpless that I can’t even follow this crow to hide dead body of my brother, he was very remorseful for his act.

Due to this We made it obligatory on Bani Israel that no one should be killed except if he has killed somebody or cause destruction in the nation, if he does so he has killed entire mankind, and if one saves somebody it’s as if he has saved the entire mankind, Our messengers came to them with the manifest miracles, even after this, certainly many of them continue excesses.

Those who wage a war against Allah and His Prophet (and do not obey them), and wander in the land to create mischief, they should be killed or hanged as punishment or their limbs should be severed from opposite direction or they should be exiled, this disgrace is in this world and in the Hereafter there is a huge punishment for them;
But those who repented, before you overpowered them, their sins will be forgiven, and be understand that Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O Believers keep fearing Allah, and always be in pursuit for His nearness, and strive vigorously (and strenuously) in the name of Allah, so that you are successful.

Undeniably, people who have adopted infidelity, if they have all the treasure of earth and more similar like it, and they wish to give as ransom to save themselves on the Day of Judgement, it shall not be accepted, and there is painful punishment for them.
And they would try to flee from the fire of Hell, but they cannot leave from there, and their punishment is everlasting.
Punishment of stealing whether by man or woman, is to cut the hand ;this is their punishment from Allah, and Allah is Great and Wise.
But whoever repents after committing wrongdoings and corrects his ways, then Allah also Verily accepts the repentance, because Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O Man! Don't you know whatever is in the skies and on the earth is exclusively the kingdom of Allah, He punishes whom He pleases, He forgives whom He pleases, and Allah has power over everything.

O Prophet! Don't be sad for those who leap towards infidelity, some of them say openly that they believe but they are unbelievers from heart, and some other who are Jews listens to the lies, interestingly to inform the unbelievers who have not yet come to you, these people knowingly distort meanings of Taurait from their places and say to the people it is written in Taurait, and if this is told by Mohammad (SAW) too, believe it, and if he does not tell you than be cautious, if Allah intends to punish somebody then you have no control for him with Allah, for these are the people for whom Allah has no intention that He purify their hearts, but for them is disgrace in this world and in the Hereafter they will have severe punishment.

These unlucky people listen to the lies interestingly and devour on forbidden things, so O Prophet, when they come to you with any matter, it is up to you whether to decide between them or keep away from it, these people can never harm you, but if you arbitrate, decide with justice, because Allah loves those who do justice.
When they have Taurait and commands of Allah are mentioned in it then why do they come to you for judgement, and then they turn away from it, fact is that they are not the faithful.

Verily, I sent Taurait, there is light in it for the guidance of people, and according to this obedient servants of Allah (messengers of Bani Israel) gave decision to the Jews, and people of Allah and Jewish priests, who had its knowledge and were made its custodian of it, also gave decision according to it, thus O Muslims, do not be scared of the people but fear only Me, and do not take small price of this world for My verses; and whoever do not give judgement according to the Book of Allah; is infidel.

And We have commanded in Taurait for Jews that life in lieu of life, eye in lieu of eye, ear in lieu of ear, tooth in lieu of tooth, and wound in lieu of similar wound; and if the oppressed forgoes the oppressor, it will be the expiation for his sins, and those are oppressors who do not judge in accordance with the Book of Allah.

And I made Isa, son of Maryam tread the path of earlier messengers; he verified the book Taurat, which was already existing with them, and I gave him the Injeel, which had guidance and light (faith), and verifying earlier existing book of Taurait, and in it was the guidance and counsel for the pious people.
And people of Injeel should have judged by whatever Allah has revealed in it, and whoever does not follow the Book of Allah is transgressor.

And, O Prophet, I also have given you the truthful Book that verifies the books which are already existing and it also protects them, and you also instruct accordingly what has been revealed to you; and do not shrink of whatever has come from Allah and do not follow their ill desires, and We sent different laws and methods for different people, if Allah had pleased He could have sent only one law for all of you, but with different laws He wanted to test to you in whatever has been given to you, step towards the virtuous deeds, and be sure all of you have to return to Him only, there, He will tell you in which you differed;

O Prophet, I repeat you make judgement according to what has been revealed to you, and do not follow their low-desires but save yourself from it, may it not be so that they deviate you from whatever has been revealed to you by Allah, thereafter if they turn back from your order then know it is the will of Allah that He afflict them in distress due to their sins, and certainly many are transgressors.
Do they desire that you judge them like the period of ignorance, whereas for those who believe; nobody's judgement can be better the judgement of Allah for them.

O Believers! Do not befriend with Jews and Christians because they are mutual friends (and they oppose you) and remember whoever among you took them as friend then Verily, he will become one of them, and Verily Allah does not guide the oppressors.

And, O Prophet! who have illness (of hypocrisy) you will see they hasten to meet them and tell you the reason that they are scare of them lest affliction may befall because of turn of events; so, very soon, Allah will show victory of Muslims, or some other sign from Him, then they will regret, on what they hid in their hearts.

And the believers (when the hypocrite will be exposed), will say: are these the same people who swear hard and tell us: Verily, we were with you, all their deeds are wasted, and they are in utter loss.

O Believers! (there is no worry) if any of you revert from your faith, very soon, Allah will bring a nation, He shall love them and they shall love Allah, who will be lowly with the believers and will fight with infidels in the way of Allah, and will not mind the reproaches of the reproachers, this is Grace of Allah, He gives to whom he pleases; Allah is Magnanimous and Knowing.
O Believers! Your master and guardian are only these: Allah, His Prophet and those believers who pray regularly and give poor-rate while they bow down.
Whoever made Allah, His Prophet and these believers their guardian then he has entered into the Party of Allah, Party of Allah is always predominant.

O Believers, and to whom the books (Taurait and Injeel) have been given before you, and those who make mockery of your religion, do not make them and the infidels your guardians, and if you are believer then fear Allah only.
And their mischief has come to the point that when you call them for prayer, they make fun of it, this is because they don't understand anything.

O Prophet! Ask the people of the book which fault do you find with us except that we believe in Allah, and in the Book which has been revealed upon us, and also the books which were sent earlier, and that many of you are wicked.

O Prophet! Tell them: shall I tell you which is worst fault is considered by Allah, who has been cursed by Allah, on whom is the wrath of Allah, and those whose entity has been distorted and made monkeys and swine, and who worshipped Satan (instead of Allah); thus, these are the more erring and have strayed from the right path and have gone far away.
And when they come to you, they say they believe, but they came with infidelity and they also left with it, and whatever they concealed (hypocrisy), Allah knows very well.
O Prophet! You will see many hastening towards sins and transgression, devouring the forbidden, and Verily it is very evil what they do.
Why don't people of Allah and religious scholars stop the people from lying and devouring forbidden which they continue, Verily it is very evil.
