And Jews say Allah's hand is tied, their hands shall be tied and rebuke of Allah is on them (why would Allah's hand tied); whereas Allah's both hands are spread out and He spends how he pleases; the Book which has been revealed on you will increase their begrudge and jealousy, and will drag them towards disobedience and transgression, and I have put enmity and malice among them till the Day of Judgement, and when they flare up the fire of fight, Allah puts it out; and they roam the earth to spread mischief, and Allah does not like mischief makers.
And if people of book would have obtained faith and feared me, then Verily, I would have forgone their sins, had bestowed blisses, and caused them to enter in restful Gardens.

If they would have followed what was written in Taurait and Injeel, revealed to them by Allah; then Verily sustenance would have come from the above, and from beneath their feet, and would have consumed peacefully, among them some are reasonable, but most of them, whatever they do, do evil.

O Prophet! Deliver the order of Allah to the people which has already been revealed to you, and if you didn't do it that will mean you have not delivered any of His messages, and do not be afraid, Allah will protect you from mischief of the people, Allah will never allow to reach tribe of infidels to their destination.

O Prophet! Tell people of book that unless you will not practice the orders mentioned in Taurait and Injeel which have been sent to you from your Lord, your religion is nothing, and O Prophet, their bitterness and envy because of the Book revealed from your Lord will increase transgression and infidelity; so do not feel sorry for the group of infidels.

There is no doubt, whether Muslim or Jew whoever is steadfast and wise whether Christian and whoever believe on Allah and the Day of Judgement and perform good deeds, they will not have any fear nor will these people have any grief.
We have taken a covenant from Bani Israel and sent many messengers to them, in spite of this, when any messenger orders which was against their desires, they denied some and slayed some.

And they thought there won't be any harm for them, as if they became blind and deaf from the truth. (but despite this, when they repented) Allah accepted their repentance, but again most of them became blind and deaf, and Allah is seeing what they are doing.

Whoever is of the belief that Isa son of Maryam is god, they are all infidel, whereas Maseeh himself has said: O Bani Israel, worship the Allah, Who is yours and our Lord, because remember whoever makes the partner to God, Allah have forbidden Paradise on him, and his place is Hell, and none will help oppressors.

Who believe that Allah is third in Trinity, Verily, they have become infidel, remember, except one Allah, there is no god, if they don't desist from talking nonsense about Allah, and those who remained infidel they will Verily face punishment.
So, why don't they repent in the Court of Allah, and seek forgiveness for their sins, whereas Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

Maseeh, son of Maryam is just a messenger, and many messengers have passed before him, his mother was also a true servant of Allah, like others they were also used to consume food, O Prophet, ponder over, how I explain Our orders to them clearly, and see where they are wandering, O Prophet, tell them: instead of Allah you worship such things which neither can benefit you nor can cause harm, see how they are straying.
O Prophet! You tell them, instead of All Powerful Allah you are worshipping such a thing which neither can benefit you nor harm you, and Allah Hears and Knows everything.

O Prophet! Tell people of book do not commit unnecessary excesses in your religion, and do not follow their low-desires who had gone astray and have misguided many, and went far away from the right path.
Who were infidels in Bani Israel were cursed by Dawood and Isa son of Maryam, curses befall them because they disobeyed and exceeded their limits.
And they did not withhold themselves from any of their evil deeds, but in spite of advice they were stubborn, and how evil these people were doing.

O Prophet! You will notice that these Jews befriend many infidels, whatever they have accumulated for themselves how evil it is that Allah is enraged with them in this world, and in the Hereafter, they will be in everlasting punishment.
If they had faith upon Allah, His Prophet and on whatever was revealed to them, then never would they have befriended them, but most of them are immoral.

O Prophet! You will find among these Jews and polytheists most hostile to the believers; (among non-Muslims) you will find friendliest persons who call themselves Christians, because among them there are many are abstinent and worshippers, and also that they do not boast.

And you see suddenly tears roll out of their eyes when these people hear Quran which is revealed on Our Prophet, because they realized the truth and say: Our Lord we believed, write us among those who have supported the prophets.
How should we not believe on truth which came to us; when we aspire that our Lord will cause us to enter (Paradise) with the people who perform good deeds.
So Allah granted them green Gardens beneath that rivers are flowing, on the basis of their belief and they will live there forever, and this is the reward for the people who perform good deeds.
These are the Hellish people who adopted infidelity and denied our verses.
O Believers! The pure things which are made lawful by Allah, do not make them unlawful for you, and do not exceed the limit, Allah does not like transgressors.
And consume happily whatever is lawful, clean and pure things Allah has given you; and keep fearing the Lord on which you believe.

Allah will not hold you responsible for your loose oaths, but will certainly hold you responsible for your serious swearing, and penalty for the same is to feed ten poor persons of the food you normally eat, or give them clothes or set a slave free; and if anybody cannot do this then he should fast for three days - this is penalty for your swearing, when you swear, fulfil it, Allah explains His orders clearly so that you become thankful.
O Believers, Liquor, gambling, idols, dice, these are all impure and Satan works, save yourself from it so you get prosperity.
Satan wants to create enmity among you through liquor and gambling; and keep you off from prayer and remembrance of Allah, so will you then desist?
Obey Allah and obey the Prophet and desist from disobeying, still if you turn-back then know that Our Prophet had come just to deliver the clear message.

And those who believed and did good work there is no harm what they have already consumed; and if they guard (against evil) and believed and did good work, then they guarded (against evil) and believed, again they guarded (against evil) and performed good deeds, Allah likes the people who do good work.

O Believers! Allah Verily will test you through hunting to which your hands and spears can reach, because Allah wishes to observe, who fears him in secret, and if still he will transgress then there is painful punishment for him.

O Believers! Do not kill by hunting while on pilgrimage wearing Ahram, but if you did intentionally, you will have to give compensation of the same of the same kind of animal (which you have killed by hunting) as the two wise men among you will judge, compensation animal shall be brought to Kaaba for sacrifice, or in its equivalent food should be given to the poor or in its lieu fast should be kept, this is because he may taste punishment for his sins which he has committed, and Allah has forgone it, and whoever repeat the act, Allah will punish him; Allah is a Great Avenger.

For you and your head of the caravan hunting in the sea and consuming it has been allowed for you, but hunting on the ground is forbidden while you are in Ahram, and keep fearing Allah to whom you have to return.

Allah has made Kaaba, His Sacred House, sacred months, sacrifice, and animals who are garlanded for sacrifice, are designated reasons to establish peace, this is because you should know that Allah is aware of everything - whether in skies or on earth; and Verily Allah knows all things.
Know that Allah gives the severest punishment and also that He is Great Forgiver and Merciful.
Nothing is imperative on Our Prophet except to deliver the message, and Allah knows everything that you do openly and what you do secretly.
O Prophet! Say: Impure and pure cannot be the same; even if the quantity of impure you may like, and O men of understanding, keep fearing Allah so you become successful.

O Believers! Do not question Prophet for things that if you will come to know you may not like it, but if you will question at the time of revelation of Quran, you will be told about it. (and the questions you had already asked), Allah has forgone, and Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.
Earlier people also questioned similarly (to the messengers of their time). (when they could not endure), they became unbelievers.

Allah has not fixed any rule such as Bahirah (slit ear she-camel), nor Saibah (bull), nor wasaila (twins), nor Haam (old bull), but infidels fabricate lies against Allah, and most of them do not understand.

When they are called towards the Book revealed by Allah; and towards the Prophet, they say we have seen our forefathers like this and that is sufficient for us, whereas their forefathers neither knew anything nor they got guidance.
O Believers! Guard yourself when you are on the right path, their misguidance cannot harm you, you have all to return to Allah, there Allah will reveal to you their deeds.

O Believers! When someone is near his death then for preparing the Will two just witnesses are necessary, if you are travelling and distress of death befall you then two witness (may be non-believers also) are necessary, and if you doubt, than hold them until after prayer, and they should swear on Allah that they will not take a price in exchange of testimony (from anyone), even if one may be our relative, we will testify in the name of Allah and shall not conceal, and if we do, then Verily we are the sinners.

Then if it became known that they are guilty of lying then take another two witnesses from among whose right is given, and who is nearer to deceased will stand in their denial, then these new witnesses will swear on Allah that their testimony is truer than the earlier witnesses and have not lied even equal to a hair, and if we did are Verily among the oppressors.

It is more reasonable to testify correctly, and/or should fear that their testimony may not be rejected by other witnesses, keep fearing Allah and listen to Him, He does not guide the nation of transgressors.
Remember the time, when Allah will gather the Messengers and ask: what answer did you get for your preaching, they will say, what can we say, You know the unseen.

When Allah will say: O son of Maryam remember My favours to you and your mother, and confirmed you through Holy Spirit; you spoke to people from cradle; in the same way as you did in old age, when I taught you writing and words of wisdom, and Taurait and Injeel and when you made bird from clay then blows something on it and it became live bird with My order, and you healed the blind and lepers; and you brought to life the dead from the graves with My order, and when you went to Bani Israel, with miracles and We saved you from them, some infidel said it is manifest magic.
And when I caused divine inspiration to the disciples (of Isa) to believe in Me and My Prophets, they said: we believed and be our witness that we are Your obedient.

And remember the time when disciples asked Isa, O son of Maryam are you capable that a tray of food to come for us from the sky, Isa said if you are truthful than fear Allah (do not ask anything to test Him).
They said: we just wanted to taste it as a blessing and eat something from it so our hearts are totally satisfied and we assure you whatever you told us was the truth, and we are witness upon it.

Then Isa son of Maryam requested O Allah, my Lord, send us a table-spread of food for us from sky so that this day becomes a solemn festival for the first of us and to the last of us; and may a great sign be therein for us, and give us sustenance and you are the Best Giver of sustenance.

Allah said: Verily, I will send the table-spread of food but if anybody denies it then I will give such a severe punishment which I shall not give (such severe punishment) to anyone else in My Kingdom.

Visualize the time when Allah will say: O son of Maryam, did you said: consider me and my mother as Gods instead of Allah; Isa will say: Glory be to Allah, it was not my capacity to utter any word, which I had no right to speak, and had I said, you would be knowing, because you know what is in my heart but I do not know what is in Your Secret, without any doubt you are aware of the unseen.

I have not said anything more than what you had ordered me, worship Allah who is our Lord and Lord of you all, and up till I was there I took care of them, and when you lifted me; then You were their guardian, and You are witness to everything, and if you punish them, you are the Owner.
(O Allah), whether You punish them or forgive them they are your servants; Great Wisdom you have.

Allah said: this is the day when truth will benefit truthful, there will be green Garden beneath which rivers will be flowing, and they will live everlasting life there, Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Allah, and this is the biggest success.
Whatever is in the skies and on the earth everything is Kingdom of Allah, and He is Competent of Everything.
All praises are due to Allah, who has created many skies and earths, and made different darkness and light, and yet the infidels try to compare Allah with others.
This is Allah, who created you from clay, and fixed a time for your death, and the time of Day of Judgement is fixed by Him, yet you doubt.
He is the Lord in the skies and on earth, He is aware of what is obvious, and what is concealed, and He is aware of what you do.
What a strange condition of theirs, when any verse comes to them from the verses of Allah, they turn their face away.
Therefore, when truth came to them, they indeed rejected it, so these people who are mocking at, will soon know of its reality.

Don't you see, I have destroyed many generations who were given such a power which so far, I have not given you, and sent downpour over them from the skies, and made rivers beneath them (their abodes); but then on account of their sins I destroyed them, and after them I created another generation.
O Prophet, even if I would have sent a Book written on paper and had they touched it, yet infidels (would have not believed and) would have said it is manifest magic.
And they say why don't an angel comes to him, if I had sent an angel, matter would have been settled; and they would not have got any respite.
Had I sent an angel as Prophet then I would have made him male only, and would have made him wear same cloth, as male wears cloth.
O Prophet! Do not be disheartened, messengers prior to you were also mocked at, the same punishment had encompassed them which they had mocking at.
O Prophet! Ask them to travel on earth, so they should see how evil was the consequence of those who denied (the messengers).

O Prophet! Just ask them whom does it belong; all whatever is in the skies and whatever is on earth, tell them it all belongs to Allah, He has considered Mercy upon himself as imperative, you will all be made to gathered on the Day of Judgement there is no doubt about it, whoever has harmed themselves will not believe.
However, they do not understand, whatever lives in the night and in the day, everything belongs to Allah, and He Hears (to everybody), and Knows (everything).

O Prophet, tell them: Shall I take anyone else as guardian leaving Allah, who is Creator of the skies and the earth, and He gives livelihood to everyone, and nobody gives livelihood to Him. (also) you tell them that Allah has ordained me, and I am the first Muslim and that you should not be of the polytheists.
O Prophet! You tell them if I disobey my Lord, Verily I fear the day of severe punishment.
And that day, from whose head the punishment is averted, then Allah has been Merciful to him and this is manifest success.
And if you are afflicted from Allah, then know Verily only Allah can repel it, and if any benefit reaches you then nobody can stop Him, because Allah has Power over Everything.
He is dominant on His servant, He is Aware and Wise.

O Prophet! Ask them which is biggest testimony; say: Allah is Witness between you and me; this Quran has been revealed to me so that I may give you news and warn you; and do you bear witness that along with Allah there are other gods; O Prophet, tell them you do not testify this; and tell them there is only one Allah, and I deny the things to whom you make partner with Allah.
To those whom We gave the book, they recognize the Prophet as they recognize their children, but whoever have put themselves in loss, they cannot become believers.
Who will be more tyrant than who falsely slander on Allah or deny His verses, and tyrants will never be saved.
And remember the day when I will gather all those polytheists, then I will ask them where are those; who they considered partner with Allah.
Then none of their mischief will remain; instead they will say: we swear on Allah who is our Lord, we had made none His partner.
O Prophet! Just see how they are lying with themselves, and whatever slander they did; have now vanished.

And some of them hear you but We have cast a veil over their hearts and ears so they could not understand, even if they would have seen the divine miracles also, yet they will not believe; after disputing with you when infidels go away, they say it is nothing, but stories of earlier people.
And they stop (others) from listening and do not listen themselves also; and they only destruct themselves while they do not understand.

O Prophet! You will see them when they will be brought on the brink of Hell, they will say: alas, we if would have been sent back and we would not deny the verses of Allah and we would be among the believers.

(But their desire will not be fulfilled) But whatever they have concealed before, has become manifest to them, if they are sent back yet they will do everything which are prohibited, and Verily, they are liars.
And infidels also say that everything is worldly life only (and Day of Judgement is a myth), and we will not be raised again (after our death).

And O Prophet! you will see when Allah will question them, is it not truth? They will reply, by our Lord, it is all truth, then He will say: since in the world you denied it, now taste the punishment.

Whoever denies the presence before Allah on the Day of Judgement is in great loss, till suddenly it will come on their head, they will say, alas, we neglected it, and they will be carrying a burden of sins on their back, how bad is this burden which they will carry.
And this world's life is nothing but play and amusement, and it is obvious that abode of the Hereafter is for the pious ones which is much better than this, don't you know that much also.
We know you are grieved by their talk; they deny you not; but (in fact) these tyrants deny the verses of Allah.

And many messengers were denied before you, and they were patient on the denial and persecution till Our help reached them, and there is no one who can change the words of Allah, and incidents of messengers already have reached you.

Their turning away is hard on you, but if you can make a tunnel in the ground or put a ladder on sky to show them some miracle; if Allah pleases, He could have gathered all on the right path (but He tests people); but don't you be among the ignorant.
Those only follow you who hear you, and the dead will be raised again (on the Day of Judgement) and will be returned unto Him.
And they say why does no miracle come on messenger from his Lord, tell them, Allah is capable of revealing miracles, but many of them do not know the prudent measures of Allah.
Four-legged animals who live on earth and two-legged animals who fly in the sky also have communities like you, nothing we have omitted from the Book, then all of them will be brought to their Lord.

And whoever denied Our Verses they have gone into the darkness (of infidelity) and they have become deaf and dumb, Allah may leave in misguidance to whom He pleases and He may guide to whom He pleases.
O Prophet! Ask them, do you think if the wrath of Allah and the Day of Judgement come to you and if you are truthful, will you call somebody other than Allah?
Not anybody else, but you will call Him only, and then for the purpose you have called him, if He pleases, He will repel that then you will forget the gods whom you used to partner with Allah.
O Prophet! I sent many messengers to Ummah which have gone prior to you, but when they disobeyed, I encompassed them in difficulty and hardship so they may implore tearfully in Our Court.
So when Our punishment came on their head; why did they not implore us tearfully? but their hearts have hardened and Satan has decorated their acts for them.
When they forgot who admonished them, then We opened the doors of worldly things so much so when they were happily enjoying the rewards, then suddenly We seized on them, and they became hopeless.
Then the roots of the unjust people were cut off, all praise to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

O Prophet! ask them, if Allah takes away your hearing and eyesight and seals your hearts; then except Allah, which other Lord who can give you these bounties again; O Prophet see how clearly We explain Our arguments, yet they turn away their faces.
O Prophet! Ask them do you think that if punishment of Allah befalls suddenly or openly, so will others also be destroyed unjustly? (never)

And we send messengers just to give glad tidings to (the good doers) and warn (bad doers), then whoever accepted faith and did good deeds will neither have any fear on the Day of Judgement nor will they grieve.
And whoever denies our verses, torment will engulf them because they were wicked.

O Prophet say: I don't say to you I have treasures of Allah, nor I do know the unseen, neither I tell you that I am an angel, I am only bound by what is revealed to me; ask them, can both blind and seeing persons be the same? Do you not reflect?

Through this Quran warn them who fear (in their hearts) that they will be brought before Allah after their death, and (they think) none to be their guardian and intercessor, so that they become pious.

And O Prophet, drive them not away (from your gatherings), who pray morning and evening to seek pleasure of Allah; you are not answerable for their reckoning, and they are not answerable for your reckoning, do not drive them away that you become among unjust.
Likewise, We tested some people with some, so that they say: these are people among us who have Mercy of Allah on them, and does He not know His grateful servants.

And whoever believed our verses and come to you, give salutation (to them) and tell them: Allah has made Mercy imperative upon Himself, Verily, who commit a wrong in ignorance but repent and reform himself, then Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
We explain our verses clearly so that the path of sinners becomes obvious for everyone (and no one should tread on that).

O Prophet say: leaving Allah, I have been forbidden from worshipping gods, whom you worship, also tell: I will not follow your low desires otherwise I will be among the misguided, and will not remain among the guided ones.

O Prophet say: I am following the clear argument of Allah and you have denied it, and (in punishment) you try to hasten; which I don't have with me, governance is that of Allah only; and He states the truth and He is Best among who give judgements.
And tell them in which (in punishment) you try to hasten, if I had it with me; so that would certainly have been decided between you and me, and Allah is well aware of the tyrants.

And none else knows the keys of unseen except Allah, only He knows whatever is on earth and in the sea, and no leaf falls but He Verily knows, and no grain in the darkness of earth, neither any moist or dry thing, but that is mentioned in the Divine Book.

He is the Lord who take your soul at night, and know what you did during the day, when He raises you up at day, so an appointed term of life (which He knows) is completed, then at last you have to return unto Him, then He will inform you about your deeds.

He is Predominant on his servants, and he sends keepers (angels) on you, so much so that if someone's death nears so My angel picks him up and they not shrink their responsibility in following My orders.
Then these people were called back to their truthful Master, be aware that governance is of His only, and He is swiftest in taking account.

O Prophet! Ask them who gives you freedom from the utter darkness of the land and the sea, who you beseech and implore Him with tears and also quietly, and say that we will be thankful if He releases us from these difficulties?
Say you: Allah gives you freedom from difficulties and distress, yet you make others partner with Allah.

O Prophet say: It is He who is Predominant on you, if He pleases, He can send punishment from over your head and from beneath your feet; or caused one group to fight with other group, and make to you taste the fight of others, just ponder how We explain our verses in different way so that you could understand.
And your tribe denied this (Quran) which is a truth, O Prophet, tell them you are not any keeper on them.
There is a term fixed for every prophecy to complete, you will know shortly.

And when you see people are absurdly arguing about Our verses, then leave from there, lest they start some other argument, if Satan has caused you to forget this; do not sit (again) with them when you remember.
Pious ones have no responsibility for accounting of these people, but they should remind them so they may become pious too.

And whoever considers religion a play and amusement, they are deceiving themselves, leave such people, and keep advising them through Quran lest someone is afflicted with distress and then they will not find any guardian or intercessor other than Allah, and if they give ransom of the whole world in exchange of their sins, it shall not be accepted; who are afflicted with sins due to their deeds, they will be given hot and boiling water for drinking and they will face painful punishment because they practice infidelity.

O Prophet ask them, shall we implore the gods, leaving Allah, who can neither benefit nor harm us; and after Allah has guided us, shall we return back on our heels towards infidelity like the person who is misguided by Satan and fell down perplexed in forest; and he has friends who call him towards the right path, saying: come to us; (O Prophet) tell them: Guidance comes from Allah only; and we have been commanded that we be obedient servants of the Lord of the worlds.
And we have also been ordained to keep up prayers and fears Him only; and it is He that you will all be made to gather before Him.

It is He, who have created skies and earth correctly; and on any day when He says: Be, it becomes; His Word is truth, when trumpet will be blown, on that day it will be exclusive Kingdom of Him, and He is the Knower of obvious and unseen, and He is Wise and Aware.
(O Prophet, remember the time) When Ibrahim told his father Azar, you consider idols as god, I see you and your tribe in manifest misguidance.
Likewise, I showed him My Kingdom of skies and earth; so that he be among those who are confident.
When the darkness of night fell and he saw a star and suddenly he said, is it my god? So when it set, he said, I love not those that sets.
When he saw the shining moon, he said, is it my god, so when it set, he said, if my Lord had not guided me, I would Verily have been among those who are astray.
Then, when he saw the burning Sun, he said, is it my god, this is bigger, so when it also set, then he said: O my nation, I am away from the things you make partners with Allah; (they can't be god).
I have avoided falsehood and I have turned wholly towards Who have created skies and the earth and I am not among the polytheist.

And people of his nation started arguing, then Ibrahim said: do you argue with me for Allah who Verily have guided me, and I do not fear the idols whom you make partners with Allah, however my Lord can do whatever He pleases, Predominant is my Lord because He have Knowledge; yet you don't heed to the advice.

And why should I fear those whom you make partner with Allah; while you don't fear the matter that He has not sent any authority to you by which you set partners with Allah; then among two of us who has more right to security; say, if you know.
Whosoever believed and he did not contaminate his faith with falsehood; peace is for them only, and Verily, they have been guided.
And these were Our arguments which We gave to Ibrahim against his nation; We will raise in degree to whoever We please, Verily your Lord is Wise and Knowing.

We gave to Ibrahim; Ishaq and Yaqoob and We guided them all, and before them We guided Nooh; and his descendants (of Ibrahim): Dawood and Suleiman and Ayub and Yusuf and Moosa and Haroon; and We give such reward to the do-gooders.
And Zakariya and Yahya and Isa and Ilyas. (guided them all); these are all among good servants.
And Ismail and Al-Yasha and Yunus and Lut (guided them all) and exalted them over all the worlds.
Not only to them, but We selected many from their forefathers and their children and brothers and guided them to the right path.
See, this the guidance of Allah, He guides to whoever He pleases, if they were polytheist all their deeds would have gone waste.
These were the messengers whom We gave books, perfect intellect and prophethood, even if people do not believe it, We have appointed a nation who will never deny it.

(Prophets of earlier time) were the people whom Allah has guided, so you also follow their guidance. (O Prophet) tell them you do not want any reward for this prophethood, this is nothing but advice for the whole world.

And Jews did not value Allah the way they should have done, because in their absurd talk they said that Allah has not revealed anything on a human being. (O Prophet) ask them: who had revealed the book which Moosa brought; which was a light and total guidance for them, you divided to which and converted into pieces of paper, among that which conform with you, you make it into public and, you conceal which is against you; however you were taught through this book which neither you nor your forefathers knew. (O Prophet) say: Allah had revealed it and then leave them so they play in their own loose discussion.

Quran is the book which I revealed with Blessings, and it confirms the already existing book, and We have revealed it so that you warn the people who have faith in the Hereafter living in Mother City and its vicinity, and they believe in it and in prayers they are bound.

Who can be more unjust that who falsely say that he has received revelation, whereas no revelation was sent to him, or the person claim that he will also reveal a similar Quran as Allah has revealed, O Prophet have you seen, how the unjust will be in difficulties of death and angels will tell them to give up their lives and today you shall be recompenses with disgraceful punishment because you falsely blame Allah and you showed pride while listening His verses.

And at last you have come alone to Me, as I have created you at first, and you left all behind wealth and children that I had given you, and I don't see your intercessor whom you considered My partner, now your mutual ties between you have broken and they have vanished.

It is Allah who cracks kernels and seeds and makes them into trees, and He brings forth the living from the dead, and brings forth the dead from living ones, He is your Lord, then where you are going away.
He causes the dawn to break and created the night for rest and Sun and the Moon for accounting, these are the established rules of Predominant and Wise Allah.
This is the Lord, Who created stars for your benefit, so that you find the ways in the darkness of forests and the seas, and We have explained our signs in detail; for those who are acquainted.
And it is Allah who has created you all from one person, then kept you (in father's back), and reared you (in womb of mother); and for the wise ones We have explained our signs in detail.

And it is He Who is Able and Powerful, Who sent rain from skies, and We bring forth buds, and created green stems, then brought bunch of seeds from them; date-palm and its spathes (come) clusters of dates hanging low and near, and created gardens of dates and grapes and olives and pomegranates, which were similar to one another but different in taste and when they give yields and ripen, ponder over them; Verily there are many signs (of Allah) for the believers.

And they make Jins partners of Allah whereas they are also creatures of Allah, and they fabricated sons and daughters for Allah. (whereas) Allah is Exalted and Pure from all these things; which they ascribe about Him.
He is the Creator of skies and earth, how can He have a son neither He does have any wife, He has created everything and knows everything.
(O People!) This Allah is your Lord, and there is no lord except Him, He is the Creator of everything, so worship Him and He is Guardian of everything.
Eyes cannot see Him neither in this world nor in the Hereafter (but) He sees to all eyes very well; He has grasp over all visions and Knower of all things.
Thing to advise you has come to you, now you take benefit from it or if he becomes blind then he will harm himself. (and the Prophet tells them) you are not their keeper.
And We describe our verses differently. (in order to complete the argument), so they should say you have recited the Quran, and We make clear the Quran for those who know.
Follow that Whatever has been revealed to you from your Lord, there is no god but Allah, and renounce the polytheists.
And if Allah pleased, they would not have practiced polytheism, and We have not made you their keeper and neither you are responsible for them.

And revile not to those whom polytheists consider their god lest in the enmity they may revile unknowingly for Allah, and We have made pleasing to every community their deeds, later everyone has to return to the Lord only, and He Verily will inform them, about their deeds.

And they swore strongly in the name of Allah that if they receive a miracle they will Verily believe, O Prophet, tell them that miracle is with Allah only; and what should you know that Verily, they will not believe even after receiving a miracle.
And We have turned their hearts and eyes and like they have not believed at first on Quran so We have left them in rebellion that they wander.

And O Prophet! Fact is that if We would have sent angels and made dead talk to them and would have brought all unseen things (Paradise, Hell, etc.) in front of them in groups, yet they would not have accepted faith unless Allah pleases, and most of them do not know.

(O Prophet, as the infidels are your enemy), similarly, We made enemy of all prophets to Satan from among men and jinn, to test them; they deceive each other with whispering of their sweet-talk, and if your Lord pleased they could not have done all this, so leave them in their slanders.
(This whispering was for) Who do not believe in the Hereafter their hearts may inclined towards them and they be pleased with it, so the slander which they are doing, they also indulge in it.

Do you want that shall I search an arbitrator other than Allah, whereas it is Allah who has sent the obvious book, and to whom We have sent the Book they Verily know that this (Quran) has been sent truthfully from your Lord; so you don't be among those who doubt.
And the word of Allah is completed with truth and just, no one can change the word of Allah, and He listens and Knows.
O Prophet, there are many people in the world if you follow them, they will misguide you from the path of Allah, they just follow their assumptions, they just do the guesswork.
(What do you know) Allah knows them well who have astray from His path, and He also knows those who have been guided.
If you believe His verses then eat that only on which Allah's name was pronounced at the time of slaughter.

And what has happened to you, you do not eat from on which Allah's name was pronounced, however, and you have been explained on what is forbidden for you, but if you are helpless (then you can eat), and many people misguide others who follow their low-desires, and your Lord know who transgress from truth.
O People, leave obvious and secret sins both, whoever commits sin, shortly they will be recompensed for their deeds.

And on do not eat the animal slaughtered without the name of Allah, because it is Verily misconduct; and Satans create evil-suggestion in the hearts of their well-wishers, that they should contend with you unnecessarily, and if you obey them, then Verily you are also polytheist.

And the person who was earlier dead and We brought him to live and created a light for him through which he walks among the people, can be like the person who is struck in utter darkness and cannot come out of there. (as faith is decorated for believers) likewise the deeds of the unbelievers have been decorated for them.
(And like in Makkah) In every settlement We placed wicked ones as Chief of their tribes, that they may plot therein, and these people who plot, harm themselves only but they don't understand.

(To verify Prophet) When any sign comes down, they say: we will not believe unless the same thing is given to us that has been given to the Prophet, and Allah knows well where to keep His prophethood, and those who are sinners will shortly get the punishment for their plotting, and with Allah there is painful and disgraceful punishment for them.

To whoever Allah pleases to show the right path, Allah expands his breast and fills it with wealth of Islam, and to whoever He pleases to leave in misguidance, He causes difficulty (for him) and makes his breast strait, as if accepting faith (for him) is like climbing the sky, Allah imposes evil on those who do not believe on Him.
O Prophet tell them, Islam is a straight path made by your Lord, We have explained our verses in detail for those who wish to take lessons.
They shall have a house of peace and tranquility for them with their Lord; Allah will be their Guardian in reward of their deeds, which they have done in the world.

O Prophet remind them of the day when Allah will gather them all and will say: O Assembly of Jinn, you have misguided many people and increased your party, and among men who were their friends will say: O my Lord, we benefitted mutually and now came to those time when You had decided to punish us, Allah will say: Hell is the abode for all of you and you shall remain there forever, but to whoever Allah may please may deliver, Verily, your Lord is Wise and Knower.
Likewise, because of their deeds We shall make some unjust guardian over some other unjust.

(Then We will ask them) O assembly of jinn and men, didn't the prophets among you came who recited Our verses and warn you about this day (Day of Judgement), they will reply: (Verily they did come), and we are testifying against our own selves, worldly life of some days kept deceiving them and they testified against themselves, they Verily were all infidels.
(And reason for sending the prophets was) Because your Lord does not destroy the people of the towns with force and coercion, while they are in negligence.
There are ranks for everybody according to their deeds, and your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
Your Lord is selflessly Merciful, if He pleases He will destroy all of you and make your heirs to anyone He may please, like He created you from the children of others.
What promise is made to you will Verily come one day and you cannot make Allah helpless (in bringing it).
(O Prophet) say: O my nation, you do whatever you want, I am doing my work, then shortly you will come to know that the house of the Hereafter is for whom, and the unjust will never be successful.

In farming and four-footed animals created by Allah they set apart portions; and according to their thinking say this portion belongs to Allah and this portion for our partners, but the share of their partners reached not to Allah, but the portion of the Lord reaches their partners, and what an evil judgement they make.

And thus their partners presented to unbelievers slaying of children as good deed, to throw them in ever-destruction, and distort the religion for them, if Allah had pleased they would not have done this, O Prophet, therefore leave them and in that which they slander.

And according to their whims they say: these four-footed animals and farming are untouchable, no one can eat it without our order, and some of the animals are forbidden for riding and loading, and on some of animal they do not mention Allah's Name. (and they did attribute falsely to Allah), this is all slander and accusation on Allah, and Allah will shortly punish them for their false accusations.

And infidels also say: that the calf which is in the wombs of slaughtered cattle who we had set free in the name of idols, comes out alive then it is lawful for our males and unlawful for our females, and if it comes out dead, then portion is for everyone; Allah will reward them for making such description; He is Wise and Knowing.

Verily, who killed their children foolishly and unknowingly; the sustenance which was given to them by Allah; they considered forbidden for themselves by falsely blaming Allah, they are in severe loss and have gone astray from the right path; and they were not to get guidance.

It is Allah who created many gardens which have different kind of trees, some are creepers (like grapes); and some are on ground and some dates trees, and farming whose fruits are of different tastes, and olive and pomegranate, some are similar and some are unique; ripen when they get, consume their yields, the day you do harvesting separate the share of Allah (give poor-rate), and do not spend wastefully, because Allah does not like those who spend wastefully.

And among four-footed animals some are big ones to carry load and some are grounded (small ones); and do consume the sustenance given by Allah, and follow not footsteps of Satan, he is your open enemy.

Allah has created eight types of pairs, two from the sheep and two from the goat, O Prophet, ask them: 'whether Allah has forbidden two males, or two females or their young-ones which are in the wombs of two females, inform me if you are truthful'.

And two of camels (male and female) and two of heifer (male and female), O Prophet ask them, whether Allah has forbidden their males or females or their calves which are in the wombs of two females? Were you present when Allah commanded this? Then who can be more unjust who slander on Allah, so they misguide people without understanding; and Allah never causes unjust to reach their destination.

O Prophet, say: What has been revealed to me (Quran) I do not find any eatables unlawful to consume in it, except dead (animal), blood and flesh of swine, Verily these are impure, or on slaughtered animals on which somebody else's name was taken in disobedience (of Allah), then if anybody consume this in helplessness and is not disobedient and transgressor, then your Lord is all Forgiving and Merciful.

And We have forbidden for Jews all the animals who have claws; and fats of heifer and goats, except the fat which is on their back, or on intestine or what mixed with bones, this We had given them punishment for their transgression, and there is not any doubt that We are the truthful.
O Prophet, if they deny you, tell them although Your Lord is vast Merciful but punishment to the sinners cannot be warded off.

Shortly, polytheists will say, if Allah pleased, neither we nor our forefathers would have been polytheists; and neither we would have caused upon ourselves anything as unlawful, and those who have passed before them kept denying (prophets) and they tasted Our punishment, O Prophet! say: do you have any argument, if yes, take out and show me, but you only follow your whims; and your talk is only speculation.
O Prophet! Say: (Now you do not have any argument), argument which can take you to Allah, is exclusive for Allah, if He pleased, He would have guided you all.

O Prophet! Say: Present your witnesses and they should testify that whatever things you say unlawful, Allah has made them unlawful, and (in case) even if they testify, O Prophet, you don't testify with them; and do not follow their low-desires who deny our verses and do not believe on the Hereafter, and make others partner with their Lord.

Say: Come I will read and recite for you that thing which Allah have made unlawful; and that make not anything partner with Allah; and show kindness to parents, and out of fear of poverty do not kill your child (because) it is We, who provide sustenance to you; and go not near evil whether openly or secretly, and do not kill anybody whose killing has been made unlawful by Allah; except in punishment; these are the thing which Allah has commanded so you understand.

And do not go near the property of an orphan, only if it is beneficial for him, until he reaches his youth, and do the measure and weight justly, We do not give discomfort to anyone more than what he can bear; let anything happen but speak justly, even if it is against your kin, and fulfill the covenant of Allah, these are the things which Allah has enjoined you that you take lesson.

And be mindful that this is My straight path, tread on this path and follow no other paths because it will divert your attention and make you go astray, these are the things which Allah have enjoined so that you become pious.

Then to complete Blessings We bestowed the book (Taurait) upon Moosa and in it described everything, and it was total guidance and Mercy for the people so that people should believe that they will be presented before their Lord.
And this Book (Quran) which We have revealed now, is full of Blessings, you should follow it and keep fearing your Lord so you are shown Mercy.
(O Polytheists, We sent this book because) you may not say that earlier books were revealed for two groups (Jews and Christians), and we were unaware to read it.

Or may say: if the book was revealed to us, we would have been better followers of the straight path, now (see) the bright argument and book and Mercy had come to you from your Lord, now who will be more unjust who will deny the verses of Allah and turn their face from it, who turn their face away from our verses, We will shortly punish them for turning their face away.

(O Prophet), Are they waiting that the angels should come to them or your Lord Himself (shall come to you), or some signs of your Lord should come, however, the day when signs will come and till that day whosoever would not had believed, or the believers didn't do any good work after believing, now their faith would not benefit them, so now (O Prophet) tell them, you wait and I am also waiting.

(O Prophet), you have nothing to do with them who caused division in the faith and made sects; their case is with Allah only, then whatever they were doing in the world (good or bad) will be told to them.

(Look at his Mercy), Whoever will do a good deed, Allah will give tenfold reward for it, but whoever will do a bad deed then Allah will punish him for that much only, and nothing unjust will be done to him.
(O Prophet), say to them: My Allah has guided me to a straight path, e. g. towards a strong religion, religion of Ibrahim, who used to walk avoiding falsehood and was not among the polytheists.
(O Prophet), You (tell to these people): my prayer, my worship, my life, my death, everything is only for Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
He does not have any partner, this is what I have been commanded, and I am the first believer.

O Prophet, ask them, should I search for any other god leaving Allah Who is the Master of everything, whoever commits a sin his blame is on him only, and nobody else will bear the burden of others’ sins, then all of you will be presented before your Lord, then He will tell you all the things in which you disputed.

And that is He who made you His vicegerent on the earth; and among you We raised the degree of some (prophets) over some (prophets), that We may test you with our Blessings, undoubtedly your Lord is quick in punishment, and also there is no doubt that He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
Alif Laam Meem Sa’ad.

(O Prophet), This book of Allah has been revealed to you so that you warn (people from wrath of Allah) and cause the advice for the believers; and because of this you should not feel straitness of heart.
(O People), follow whatever has been revealed to you from your Lord, and except Him do not follow other (false) guardians (gods), you people only accept advice a little.
(You do not know), there are many settlements which We have destroyed, Our punishment reached (at a time) when they were fast asleep at night or they were taking a siesta during the day.
So, when our punishment befell them, they could not say anything except, Verily, we were unjust.
Then We will Verily question those for each and every thing, to whom we had sent prophets, We will also question prophets.
And with deep thinking We will ask them reality and will repeat every particle of it, and We were not absent.
It is a truthful thing of weighing the deeds on that day, then whose good deeds will be heavy he will be successful.
And whose scale of deeds will be light then Verily they had harmed themselves by disobeying Our verses.
(And O children of Adam) We established and gave you power on the earth and provided stuff for livelihood, but you thank very less.

There is no doubt that We created you (your father Adam) and made faces for you then We told the angels to prostrate before Adam, so they all prostrated except Iblis, he was not among those who prostrated.

Allah said: When We have ordered you to prostrate, then what prevented you from prostrating. (Iblis) said: I am better than him, You created me of fire (subtle element) and created him of clay (dirty element).
Allah said: (you behaved proudly) get down from here (from Paradise), because you have no right to be proud of, get out from here, you are among the humiliated ones.
He said: give me the respite until the day when all the people will be raised again.
(Allah) said: you are given respite.
Said he: Since You have disrupted my path, also I will sit on the straight path (to misguide them).

And I shall target the children of Adam; and will come to them (to cause them to go astray); from their front, from their rear, from their right and from their left; many among them will not be Your thankful.
Allah said: get away from here with contempt and reproach, whoever will follow you; Hell will I fill with you all.
And told Adam: O Adam you dwell with your wife in Paradise and may eat from wherever you want, but beware go not near that tree otherwise you will be among the unjust.

Then Satan caused whisper to both so the things of their body may become exposed which were covered by the Heavenly clothes, he said to them: your Lord has prevented to consume the fruits of that tree that you may not become angels or may not live forever.
And swore before them both that he is their well-wisher.

So with deception he made them inclined to eat it (from that tree); so as soon as both of them tasted it (fruit from that tree), their Heavenly clothes fell down and their private parts were exposed, they both started to cover themselves with leaves of Heaven, then their Lord called out to told them: did not I told you not to go near that tree and that Satan is your open enemy?
Then both started pleading: O our Lord we have harmed ourselves, and if You will not forgive us and will not show Mercy then we will only be at loss.
Command came: you all (Adam, Eve and Satan) get down from the Paradise, you are enemy of one another, and until a term of time your stay and means of livelihood is there.
Said Allah: you will live life on earth and there shall you die, and you shall be given life again and extracted from there.

O children of Adam! We sent clothing for you, to hide your private parts; and clothing of adornment; and clothing of piety, and this is the best among all the clothing, and this clothing is the power and sign of Allah so that people get advice and lessons.

O children of Adam! Beware, let Satan not misguide you, like he had misguided your parents and became a caused to expel them from Heaven, he pulled down their clothing to expose their private parts; he and his clan see you but you cannot see them, I made Satan the friend of those who do not believe.

And when they commit any bad deed, they say we found our forefathers practicing these traditions and Allah has also commanded this; (O Prophet) you tell them clearly Allah never commands for any bad deed; do you say against Allah those things which you do not know.

(O Prophet) say: My Lord has commanded for justice. (and He has also said) turn your face straight (towards direction of prayer) and be sincere in your prayer and supplicate with him; as He has created you (in the beginning), you will be brought to life again.
He has guided one group, and another group adopted misguidance - they took Satan as their guardian instead of Allah, and yet they think they are on the right path.
O children of Adam! At the time of prayer dress up nicely; and eat and drink, and be not wasteful spender, Allah does not like wasteful spenders.

O Prophet! ask them, who has prohibited things of adornment, and good provision, which have been created by Allah for His servants? You tell them that these good provisions are purely for them on the Day of Judgement who were believers in the life of this world, in this way we explain Our verses for the sensible persons.

O Prophet tell them My Lord has prohibited immorality whether openly or secretly; and from all sins and from unjust excesses and that you make anybody partner with Allah on which no argument has come; and that you be slanderous on Allah without understanding.
And there is a fixed time for every nation, when their time comes; it cannot be postponed or preponed, even for a second.

O Children of Adam! When Our prophets from among you come to you and describe Our commands, obey them, because whoever will guard against sins and perform good deeds (on the Day of Judgement) these people will not have any fear nor they will grieve.
And whoever will deny our verses and will show pride, these are Hellish people, and they shall remain forever in it.

Who can be more unjust that who deny the verses of Allah and slander on Allah, these are the people who gets their share (sustenance) what had been written for them, until our angel will reach to extract their soul, and ask them where are those, whom you were used to call instead of Allah, they will reply: they are all gone away and they will testify against themselves that Verily we were unbelievers.

(Then Allah) will tell them: those from jinns and men who have gone away before you; go and get mingled with them and go to Hell; when one group will enter, it will curse the other group, when all groups will reach inside (Hell) then the previous group will curse their previous group and say: O Lord, they have misguided us, so double their punishment, Allah will say: punishment is double for all of you, but you do not know.
And among them first group will address the previous group and say: now you do not have any preference over us, you also taste the punishment for your deeds.

Verily, who denied Our verses and displayed haughtiness, for them neither gates of skies will open nor they can enter Paradise, so much so until camel pass through the eye of the needle, and We give such punishments to the guilty.
And for them will be a mattress of fire and (also) a sheet of fire to cover them, and We give punishment to unjust like this.
And those who believed, and performed good deeds, so We do not burden anybody more than his capacity, these are the people of Paradise and shall remain in Paradise forever.

And We will remove whatever of ill-feeling will be in their hearts, and there will flow rivers beneath their palaces, and they will be saying: thanks be to Allah who made us reach us to our destination, and if Allah has not guided, we could not have reached here, Verily the prophets of our Lord brought the truthful religion; and that they will be informed loudly that this is that Paradise, to which you have been made heirs and owners, in reward to your deeds.

And people of Paradise will call out to people of Hell and say: whatever was promised by our Lord, we have received all, did you also received all, what was promised by your Lord? People of Hell will reply: yes, we got it. Then a crier will cry out: curses of Allah on unjust who had hindered people from the path of Allah.
And unnecessary they wanted to distort it and they had denied the Day of Judgement.

There is a partition between Paradise and Hell and on (that) Elevated Place (Araaf) there will be some people and who will identify them with the writing on their foreheads, and they will call salutations to the people of Paradise, and those who will be on an elevated place, they have not entered Paradise but they Verily have desire for it.
And when they will suddenly see people of Hell, they will say: O my Lord, do not make us companion of wrongdoers.
And the people of the Elevated Place, by identifying Hellish people by blackness of the faces, will say: now neither your group is of any use to you nor your pride which you used to do in the world.

Are they the same people for them you used to swear that Allah will not show Mercy to them, look these are the same people, who have been told: Enter Paradise, there is no fear for you nor you will grieve.

And people of Hell (with coyness) say to the people of Paradise: pour some water on us or give us some from what Allah has granted to you; people of Paradise will reply: Allah has completely forbidden the food and water of the Paradise for the infidels.

Who had made their religion a play and the life of world has deceived them, so today (Day of Judgement) We will intentionally forget them, the way they had forgotten that they will be presented today, and used to deny Our verses.
Although, We had sent Book to them and described it in detail with knowledge, and it is guidance and mercy for the believers.

Are they only waiting for the result (Day of Judgement), although when time and day will come, they will immediately say that Verily all prophets of Allah had brought just truth, so now someone is there for our intercession who will intercede for us, or could we be sent back to the world where we will do other deeds, other than what we earlier did; Verily, they greatly harmed themselves, and which they have forged has gone away.

Verily, your Lord is Allah Who created the skies and the earth in six days; and He is firmly established on the Throne, He throws day as veil over the night, as if night is intensely searching for the day, and He created Sun, Moon and stars, they are all obedient of Allah's order, look, Kingdom and Creation is exclusive for Him only; He is blessed and Lord of the worlds.
(O People) Supplicate with your Lord by imploring with tears in secret; He Verily does not like those who exceed the limit.
And do not do mischief after reform on earth; and supplicate with hope while fearing Allah, because Mercy of Allah is near to those who do good deeds.

This is He who sends glad tiding winds before His Mercy; until when they blow with loaded clouds; We drives it to a dead land; then We sends rain; then We bring out on the earth all types of fruits, similarly We will raise the dead on the Day of Judgement, so you get advice and lesson.
And good land, sprouts out good vegetation by the command of Allah; and the bad land, gives out bad yield, like this We describe Our verses in diversified manner for those, who are thankful.
Verily, We sent Nooh to his nation and he told them: O my nation, worship Allah, and you do not have any other Lord, and I warn you of the big day of punishment.
So some chiefs of his tribe said: we Verily see you in manifest misguidance.
Nooh said: O my nation, I do not have any misguidance, but I am a prophet from the Lord.
And I am reaching to you the message from my Lord, and I am desirous of welfare for you, and the things which I know from Allah, you do not know.
And, do you wonder that command of Allah has come to you through a male from among you to warn you from the punishment of your Lord so you become pious and so that Mercy may be shown to you.
Even then the people denied him, then We delivered him and those who were on ark, and drowned all others whoever have rejected Our verses, and Verily they were all blind.
And We sent his brother Hud to the nation of Aad, also he told them: O my People! worship Allah, there is no god except Him, don't you fear Him?
So some of the chiefs of their tribe who were infidels said: we Verily see you in stupidity; and we definitely consider you a liar.
Hud said: I did not say any stupid words, rather I am a prophet of Lords of the worlds.
I bring to you the messages, from your Lord and I am your true advisor.

And, do you wonder that command of Allah has come to you through a male from among you to warn you from punishment; and remember the time when He made you vicegerent after Nooh; and did increase your creation extensively; so do remember bounties of Allah so you become successful.
They said: have you come to us so that we worship Allah only, and leave them whom our forefathers have worshipped? So if you are truthful, bring Him to us from Whom you warn us.

Hud replied: punishment and wrath had already come to you from your Lord, do you dispute with me because of some names (of presumed idols), which your forefathers have (unnecessarily) created, whereas Allah has not sent any argument for them, so you just wait (for punishment of Allah), and I am also waiting.
Finally, We delivered those who were with him and uprooted them who denied our verses; and that also they would not have accepted faith.

And We sent his brother Saleh towards nation of Samood (as a prophet), so he said: O my nation, worship Allah, there is not any other Lord of yours except Him; Verily manifest and bright signs have come to you from your Lord; this Allah's she-camel is a miracle for you, so set her free to graze anywhere she wants, and do not give harm her otherwise you will be afflicted with painful punishment.

And remember the time, when We made you successor after the nation of Aad; and settled you on the land on which you construct huge palaces on the soft and plain land; and make houses by carving out the mountains, then do remember the benefits of Allah, and do not cause mischief on the land.
So the leaders of that nation asked those who were poor believers, do you know that Saleh is in fact the true prophet of his Lord? They replied we already have believed on whatever he preaches.
Then those who were haughty (on their worldly wealth) said: we do not accept him on whom you believe.

After all they cut the legs of she-camel, and they showed haughtiness against the command of their Lord, and (shamelessly) said: if you are truthful prophet, then bring us your Lord with Whom you had warned us.
Then the earthquake overtook them, and they sat down in their homes while their heads were on their knees.

Then Saleh left them and told them: O my nation, alas, I conveyed the messages from Allah to you, and wanted your welfare; and had explained the good and bad to you; but you did not even consider him a friend, who was desirous of welfare for you.
And We sent Lut (as a messenger) and he told his nation, it is a concern, that you commit such an act which nobody has not committed before you in the kingdom of Allah so far.
You turn to men leaving women for your carnal desires (whereas it is not necessary); but you are vulgar, who waste (sperm).
On this, the nation did not have any reply, that they started discussing to expel them from their settlement because these are the people who think they are pure.
Then We delivered him and his family, except his wife because she was among those who would stay back.
The We sent rain of specific stones on them, now see what will be the outcome of the sinners.

We sent his brother Shoaib towards Madyan, so he said: worship Allah, there is no god except Him, argument from your Lord has come to you, now do the measure and weight properly and do not sell short-weight, and do not make mischief on the land after reform, this is better for you, if you are going to be believers.

Beware, do not sit on the roads to frighten and threaten the believers; and desist from diverting them from the path of Allah; and seeking crookedness in it, and remember, you were few, We multiplied your number; and do look what happens to the mischief makers.
And one group among you believed on the message brought by me and another group did not believed, then wait, Allah will decide between us; and He is Best Decider.

And the arrogant people of the nation said: O Shoaib, we will drive you and whoever have believed with you, out of our settlement or else you return to our religion; they replied: even if we do not like;

It will be a great blame on Allah that we return to your religion, when He had delivered us from that religion; and we have no right that we come on your religion until Allah Himself does not wishes, knowledge of our Lord is predominant on everything, and we trust on Him only; O Allah decide between us and our nation with truth; you are the Best decider.
Then the infidels of their nation said: if you will obey Shoaib, then you will be counted among the people who are losers.
Resultant, an earthquake overtook them, and they sat down in their homes while their heads were on their knees.
Whoever denied Shoaib they were destroyed in such a way as if they have never lived there, whoever denied Shoaib were among losers.
Then Shoaib turned away from them and said; O nation, I had delivered the messages of my Lord and also advised you, now how I should concern on their condition.
And whenever We sent a prophet in any village, we Verily made their people suffer if they disobey, so may they implore with humility in Our Court.

Then We gave them goodness in place of evil, and they multiplied; and said: this affliction and ease had come to our elders also, then suddenly We seized them, and also they could not have understood.
And if the people of the village believed and guard themselves against evil, then We open the doors of Blessings of skies and the earth, but if they deny then We seize them, in their own deeds only.
Does the people of village feel secure from punishment of Allah coming to them at night, when they are asleep?
Or they are sure that Our punishment will befall during the day when they will be busy in play.
Are they secure from the planning of Allah; whereas those who feel secure from Allah's planning; those are at a loss.

Does not the people who inherit earlier people of the earth get guidance from them; that if We pleased We would have afflicted them with punishment due to their sins, and have sealed their hearts, then they could not have heard anything.

These settlements of which we are giving you the news, where Our prophets came with miracles, now they would not believe because they have denied earlier, like this we sealed the hearts of unbelievers.
We did not find most of them who would adhere to the covenants; and found most of them are transgressors, and (they) are not obedient.
Then after them We sent Moosa with Our miracles to Firaun and his people, so they also did unjust, now see the result of the mischief makers.
And Moosa told Firaun: I am a Prophet of the Lord of the worlds.
It is imperative for me not to speak anything about Allah except the truth; I have come to you with the miracles from your Lord, so send Bani Israel with me.
He said if you have come with miracles, then show it; if you are truthful.
So Moosa threw his staff, and suddenly it became a manifest snake.
Then he pulled out his hand and people saw it was shiny and bright.
Chiefs of Firaun said he is a sensible magician;
Who wants to drive you away from your land, now what is your opinion?
They said withhold him and his brother, and send collectors into cities;
So they may bring from their expert magicians.
Magicians came to Firaun, and they said: if we prevail upon him what reward will we get?
Firaun said, Verily you shall be close to me in my court.
They said: Moosa, will you throw down your staff or shall we begin our work.
Moosa said: you begin your work, so they threw the ropes and they cast magic on their eyes and frightened them, then they demonstrated great magic.
Then We indicated to Moosa to throw his staff also, and it will swallow all their magic snakes.
Result was that truth got established, and their affairs were nullified.
They were all defeated and they returned with humiliation.
And magicians all went down in prostration.
They said: we believe on Lord of the worlds;
Means, on the Lord of Moosa and Haroon.
Firaun said: how you accepted faith before my permission, this is your deceit which you are spreading in the city, that you can take the people out of city, so shortly you will know its result.
I will cut your hand and feet from opposite directions, and then will I crucify you all.
They replied: Anyway, we have to return to the court of our Lord.
And you are angry with us that we believed in the signs of our Lord, O Lord, pour out upon us patience and let us die as Muslims.

And a group of Firaun said, will you leave Moosa and his people like this to cause mischief in the land that they may forsake you and your gods; he said: shortly I will slay their sons and keep alive their women; and I have power and dominance over them.
Moosa told his people to seek help from Allah and have patience, land belongs to Allah and He makes it to whoever He pleases, and anyway the result is for the pious ones.

They (people of Moosa) said, we have been persecuted before your arrival; and also after you came; Moosa replied: shortly your Lord will destroy your enemy, and will make you inherit him on this land, then He will see how you behave.
And then We afflicted Firaun in famine, and also in shortage of fruits, so that they may take lesson.

Thereafter, when any good came to them they said it is our right, and if any evil came, they say: it is ill-luck of Moosa and his companions, beware, their ill-luck was already written only from Allah, but most of them do not know.
And the people said: O Moosa you may bring any number of signs for magic; we are not going to believe you.
Then We sent on them flood, locust, lice, frogs, and blood as clear signs, but they denied, and Verily they were sinful people.

And when punishment befell them they said: O Moosa, pray to your Lord what He has promised, if He will remove punishment from us, then we will certainly believe in you, and will also send Bani Israel with you.
And when We removed punishment for a period of time, then again they became among the people who break their covenant.
Then We took revenge on them and drowned them in the sea, and they had denied our verses and they were negligent of them.

And We caused to make heirs on the land of East and West to the deprived ones and gave Blessing to them, and like this We completed Our saying on Bani Israel because they showed patience, and destroyed whatever Firaun and his people were planning; and demolished their tall buildings.

And we took Bani Israel across the river; and they reached to such people who were sitting around their idols, these people said to Moosa: also make for us a god, like of theirs, he replied: you are totally ignorant.
Their system is going to be destroyed and their deeds are invalid.
What, shall I seek for you, another god except Allah? when He has made you excel over the worlds.
And When We delivered you from people of Firaun, who subjected you to severe torment, they killed your sons and kept your women for service, in this there was your tough trial from your Lord.

And We promised for thirty nights to Moosa and completed with additional ten days, so the promise of his Lord became the promise of forty days, and he told his brother Haroon to be his deputy and continue reforms, and beware follow not the path of mischief makers.

So thereafter when Moosa came to complete his covenant, so his Lord spoke to him, he said O my Lord show your glimpse, He said: you can never see Me, look at that Mountain, if it remains at its place, then you can see me; when His manifestation fell on the mountain, it turned into particles and Moosa fell unconscious; when he came to consciousness, he said: O Lord, you are clean and pure and I repent in Your court, and I am first to believe.
He said: O Moosa! We selected you for our prophethood and to address you, now take this book and be among thankful servants of Allah.

And in Tablets of Taurait we ordained all parts of advice and did mentioned details of everything, so hold them firmly and adopt good things written in it; and very soon We will show you the houses of transgressors.

And shortly We will make them turn away from our verses who roam on the land haughtily, and if they see every sign, they will not believe in it, their condition is such that if they will see the path of guidance, they will not adapt to it, but if they see any path of misguidance, they immediately adapt to it, this is because they have denied our signs and were negligent of them.
And whoever denied our verses and meeting of the Hereafter, their deeds are a waste, and they will be given the reward as per their deeds.

After Moosa went (to Mount Tur [Sinai]) his people made an idol of calf by melting their gold ornaments and in which was a sound also, did not the people see that it could neither talk nor show the way, they considered it to be god, and they Verily were unjust.

And when they felt remorse and they saw that they have are diverted from the path, then they said: if our Lord will not show mercy on us and will not forgive us, then we shall certainly be of the losers.

And when Moosa returned to his people, he said with anger and wrath you have done very bad in my absence; you did haste in receiving the command of Allah, and threw down the tablets and dragged his brother by his head; Haroon said: O brother, these people did weaken me, and they were about to kill me, what would I have done, don't give a chance to enemies for taunts on me, and do not consider me with the unjust.
Moosa said: O Lord! forgive me and my brother, and enter us into Your Mercy that You are the Best among who show mercy.

Verily, whoever adopted (idol of) calf, wrath of Allah will shortly befall on them, there is humiliation for them in this world also; and like this that We give punishment to those who falsely accuse.
And those who did evil deeds, then repented and believed; then after repentance your Lord is Great Forgiver and Merciful.
When Moosa's anger calmed down he picked up the tablets, and in it there were things of guidance and mercy for the people who fear their Lord.

And for his appointment with Me Moosa chose 70 men of his people, then when a jerk of earthquake took them, he said: O Lord if You wanted You could have destroyed them earlier and myself too, what! now would You destroy us because of these fools, so this is how you tested us, you leave in misguidance to whoever you please and guide to whoever you please, You are our Master, forgive us and show mercy on us, You are Great Forgiver.

And do write for us good in this world and the Hereafter, we turn to You only; said He: my punishment, it will reach to those to whoever I please, and My Mercy has spread over everything and I will shortly write it for who have fear of Allah, pays poor-rate, and are believers of our signs.

And those who follow messenger, the Prophet who (in this world) neither read nor wrote; whose mention is found in Taurait and Injeel, that he orders for good and stop you from the evil, and makes lawful for you the pure things, and makes unlawful the bad things, and removes the burden and restriction of difficult orders, so whoever believed in him, respected him and helped him, and followed the light which came with him; Verily those are the people who will prosper.

O Prophet! Say: I have been sent towards you as a representative and Prophet of Allah, Who is the Owner of the earth and the skies, there is no god but He; only He gives life and causes death, hence, have belief on Allah and His ummi Prophet who believe on communications of Allah, so that you may be guided.
And there is also a party within the people of Moosa who guide with truth, and who are truthful and just in the affairs.

And We divided Bani Israel's twelve children of Yaqoob into twelve tribes; and revealed to Moosa: when they ask for water, strike the staff on the ground and twelve springs will start flowing and every group identified their own places of water, and We sent clouds to give shade on their heads; and sent them favors such as Mann-va-Salwa so that they eat Our pure sustenance; and with their opposition they did no injustice to Us, whereas they did injustice to their own souls.

And remember the time when We told them to enter that village and eat whatever you want, and while you enter say 'hitta' and prostrate, so that We forgive your mistakes, and shortly We will also increase the reward of those who do good deeds.
But the unjust (among them) started uttering something else, other than what was spoken to them, so We sent upon them punishment from sky because they were disobeying.

And ask them about the village which was on the seashore, and whose residents exceeded the limit on Sabbath, that their fish used to come on surface on the day of Sabbath, but next day they don't come, so they used trickery, and like this We tried them, that they were doing disobedience.

And when one party among them told reformers why do you preach such a people whom Allah will destroy or send severe punishment on them, they said: they want to be free from blame before their Lord so these people also may fear Allah.
And when they forgot the reminders then We saved the reformers, and encircled those who were unjust in severest punishment because of their disobedience.
When despite prohibition they rebelled a second time, then in disgrace We ordained them to become apes.

And remember the time when your Lord has openly announced that until the Day of Judgement evil governors will be imposed on them who will give them worst trouble; and your Lord is He Who gives quick punishment also, and is very Forgiving and Merciful also.

And We divided Bani-Israel in different tribes, some of them were righteous but others were that of the opposite, and We tested them with comfort and difficulties so they may come on the (right) path.
