Later a posterity came into existence who inherited the book, but took all the wealth of the world and said shortly they will be forgiven, and when they got the wealth again, they took it again, so were not the covenant of the book taken from them. Beware! do not say anything about Allah but truth, and they too have read the book; and the Hereafter is the best for the pious people; and don’t you understand this.
And those who adhere to the book and establish prayer, so We do not waste the reward of good character and righteous people.

And remind the time when We raised the mountain like a canopy and hung over them and they thought it was going to fall over them, so We said: hold Taurait firmly and remember whatever is written in it, you may guard yourself against evil and become pious.

And when your Lord took out children of Adam from their loins - their descendants, and made them witness concerning themselves only and asked: am I not your Lord? Everyone said: yes, we testify it; We took this covenant lest they should say on the Day of Judgement that we were unaware of this covenant.
Or say: our ancestors were polytheist, and we are their children, so would You destroy us because of deeds of those who were unjust?
And like this we describe our verses in detail so you may come back.
And give them the news of the person to whom We gave our verses, but he totally separated from it, so Satan caught hold of him and he became among misguided people.

And if We pleased We would have elevated him because of the verses but he himself leaned towards the ground, and he followed his low-desires, now his example is like a dog that he gives out his tongue if you attack him, and (if you) leave him (still) he gives out his tongue, this is the example of people who denied our verses, so now you narrate these incidents, so they might ponder.
How evil is the example of the people who deny our verses, and those people are being unjust on their souls.
To whoever Allah guides is the guided ones, and to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance then they are from those who are in loss.

And as if We have created a large number of men and jinns for Hell, that they have hearts but they don't understand, they have eyes but they don't look, they have ears but they don't hear, these are like four-footed animals and even more misguided than them, and actually these are people who are negligent.
And all good names are for Allah so do call Him with those names, and leave them out who violate the sanctity of His names, shortly they will be given reward for their deeds.
And those are from Our Creation only who guide with truth and do justice with truth.
And whosoever denied our verses, We will shortly wrap them in such a way that they will not even understand.
And We are giving them respite, because Our scheming is very stable.
Did not they notice that their companion messenger does not have any lunacy, he only clearly warns you from the punishment of Allah.
And didn't they think about the kingdom of earth and sky and all the creations of Allah, and that if their end nears, so on what announcement they will believe, after this.
To whoever Allah leaves in misguidance, no one can guide him, and He leaves them in rebellion so they may blindly wander on.

O Prophet! they ask you about the Day of Judgement that when will it be established, so tell them its knowledge is with Allah, He will reveal it at an appointed time, this Day of Judgement is to be very difficult for both, earth and the skies, and it will come suddenly to you, these people ask you about it as if you are totally in know; say: its knowledge is with Allah, but most of the people even do not know this.

Say: I do not control any benefit or evil over my own soul, only Allah wills; if I knew the evil, I would have done lots of good, and no evil could have reached me, I am only to give glad tidings to the believers and to warn them of the punishment of Allah.

He is Allah who has created all of you from one soul, then created its pair from it so they get rest from it, then husband cohabited with wife so light pregnancy was created which she carries everywhere and when pregnancy became heavy and when birth time near, then both prayed to their Lord: we will be among thankful if You give us a righteous child.
And when We gave righteous child, then made partners with Allah in whatever He gave, whereas Allah is much above and superior than (his purported) partners.
These people make them partners with Allah, who cannot create anything and also themselves are creatures.
And they do not have the ability to help themselves nor they can help anybody else.
If you invite them for guidance they will not come along, whether you invite them or be silent, it is one and the same for them.
Those whom you call upon instead of Allah are all servants like you, call upon them, and if you are truthful in your thinking they should respond to your calls.

Do they have feet with which they walk, hands with which they attack, eyes with which they look, and ears with which they hear, which they can use; say: you call upon your partners and do whatever plotting you want, and do not give Me any respite (will see what you can do).
Verily, my Lord and Master is Allah, who revealed the Book, and He is Master of and heir of good servants.
And you call upon whom except Allah, they neither can help you nor can they be useful to themselves.
And if you invite them for guidance then they will not be able to hear, and if you look at them it will seem they are looking at you, whereas they are not even able to see.
You follow the way of forgiving and order for good, and keep away from the ignorant.
And if any wrong thought is created from Satan then seek refuge in Allah, and He is Who Hears and Knows everything.
Even if any wrong thought wants to touch the pious people, they remember Allah and look at the facts.
And the brethren of Satan, polytheists, are pulling them towards misguidance, and do not show any laziness in it.

And if you do not bring a sign to them they say why don't you select any (sign); say: I follow only whatever is revealed to me from my Lord, this Quran from your Lord is proof of guidance and has the status of Mercy for the believers.
(O People) When Quran is recited then listen to it attentively, so the Mercy be shown to you.
And implore our Lord within your heart silently (and) fearfully, and not with high tone but with low tone, remember him in the morning and the evening, and don't be among the negligent ones.
Verily,those who are near to your Lord and don't transgress from His worship, and glorify Him and prostrate before Him only.
O Prophet! They ask you about the spoils of war; say: spoils of war are all for Allah and Prophet, so fear Allah and reform among yourselves, and obey Allah and His Prophet, if you believe in Him.

And believers are in fact those when Allah is mentioned in front of them; fear of Allah is created in their hearts, and if His verses are recited their belief increases, and they trust upon Allah only.
They establish prayer and also spend (without seeking any favor) from the subsistence given by Us.
These are in fact believers, for whom there are ranks and forgiveness and an honorable sustenance.
As your Lord took you from your house with truth, whereas a group of believers disliked it.
These people are arguing with you, in spite of the truth being obvious to them in this regard, as if they are being sent towards death and they are looking with regret.

And remember the time when Allah was taking covenant with you that out of two one group is for your, and you had wished it may not be that of powerful one; and Allah pleases to prove His words through truth and wants to cut off series of the infidels.
So that truth may be proved and falsehood is destroyed, even if the guilty dislike it.
When you were beseeching the Lord, He heard your beseeching that We are helping you with one thousand angels who are coming one after another.
And it was just a glad tiding so that your hearts are satisfied, and aid is only from Allah, only Allah is possessor of honor and has wisdom.

When Allah caused you to sleep which was restful for you, and was sending water from sky to purify you, and to take you away from uncleanness of Satan; and to cause satisfaction to your hearts and make you steadfast.

When your Lord revealed to angels: I am with you, so make the feet of the believers steady; I will shortly cast fear in the hearts of infidels; you therefore attack necks of infidels, and cut-off every part of their fingers.
This is because they opposed Allah and His Prophet, and whoever will oppose Allah and his Prophet, Allah will cause severe punishment for it.
This is the punishment of the world - taste it, and later there is punishment of Hell also for infidels.
O Believers! When you meet the infidels in the battlefield, never show them your back.

And today whoever will show their back (to infidels) will deserve the wrath of Allah and his place will be Hell, which is the worst outcome, except for those who retreat due to the planning of war or to take refuge with some other group.

So, you have not killed those infidels, but Allah has killed them, and O Prophet, you have not thrown the pebbles, but Allah thrown the pebbles, that He may show abundant favors on the believers, because He hears everyone and knows the condition of everyone.
This and that is indeed favor, and Allah is the weakener of the plotting of the infidels.

And you wanted victory, so the victory has come, and if you desist from war than there is good in it for you, and if you will repeat it than We are also returning; how large your group may be, but it is not going to benefit you, and Allah is always with the believers.
O Believers! Obey Allah and the Prophet and do not desert him, when you are also hearing.
And do not be like those who say: we heard although (in fact) they are not hearing.
Worst people near Allah walking on the earth are deaf and dumb who do not use wisdom.
And if Allah would have seen any good in them the Verily, He would cause them to hear, but if He would cause them to hear they would turn their faces and would have avoided.

O Believers! Answer to the calls of Allah and Prophet when they invite you towards the matter in which there is life for you, and remember, Allah comes in between man and his heart, and you will all be made to be presented before Him.
And avoid that mischief, which is not exclusive to the unjust only; and remember Allah is the owner of the strongest punishment.

O Muslims, remember the time when in Makkah you were weak and few in number, and were always fearful that they will take you away, then Allah shielded you and verified you with His help, gave you pure sustenance so you may thank.
O Believers! Do not be disloyal, towards Allah and Prophet and your trust; when you know.
And know that your children and your wealth is a test, and Allah is He, with whom lies the great reward.

O Believers! If you will guard against evil, then He will grant you, ability to differentiate between truth and falsehood, and will cover up your shortcomings, will forgive your sins, He is of mighty Grace.
And O Prophet! remember the time, when infidels were plotting to confine you or exile you or kill you; along with their plotting, Allah was also planning, and He is best among planners.
And their condition is such that when Our verses are recited, they say: we heard and we also can say the same if we want, and this is nothing but tales of the earlier people.
And remember the time when they said: O Allah, if this truth is from you then rain stones on us from sky or send on us painful punishment.
Although, O Prophet, Allah will not send punishment until you are in their midst, and Allah will not punish them if they repent and seek forgiveness.

And what are in them that Allah will not punish them, whereas they stop people from entering Sacred Mosque and are not its trustee also, its guardians are only pious people but most of them are even unaware from this.
And their prayer in the Sacred Mosque is nothing but clapping and whistles, so now taste the punishment because of your infidelity.

Those who adopted infidelity they spend their wealth to desist people from the path of Allah, so they will spend and it will become a matter of regret for them, also they will be defeated in the end; and those who adopted infidelity they will be taken towards Hell.

So, Allah would separate impure ones from the pure ones; and then impure ones will be put one upon another and they will become one pile, and they will all together be put in Hell, these are the people who will be deprived and in loss.
O Prophet! Tell the infidels if they will desist from infidelity, their past sins will be forgiven, but if they turned their back, then tradition of the earlier people have also passed by.
And you fight with infidels until the mischief is uprooted, and whole religion remains for Allah only, but if they desist, the Allah sees their deeds.
And if they revert again, then remember Allah is your Master and Guardian, and He is the Best Master and Guardian and Helper.

And know that whatever benefit you get, one-fifth of it is for Allah, Prophet, and his near ones of Prophet, orphans, poor and travelers who are in distress; if your faith is on Allah and that help which We had sent on Our servant on the day to decide between truth and falsehood, when two parties were quarreling among them, and Allah has power over everything.

At the time you were nearer side of valley in battlefield, and those people were far away in battlefront, and caravan was on a slope from you, if you would have earlier left for fighting that you Verily would have done to the contrary, but Allah wanted to decide about the happenings, that whoever is killed might be killed by clear proof and whoever would live might live by clear proof, and Allah hear all and know the condition of hearts.

When Allah made them appear less in your eyes, if He would have shown you more in number in your eyes, then you might have become lazy and would have disputed among yourselves, but Allah saved you from this dispute; because He is aware about secrets of your hearts.

And at the time of battle, Allah made enemies appear less in your eyes, and made you appear less in their eyes, so that matter might be decided which was bound to happen, and all the matters are to return to Allah.
And O Believers! whenever you may face any group, then face it with steadiness, and remember Allah in abundance, may be in this way you become successful.
And obey Allah and his Prophet and do not dispute among yourself lest you become weak and your strength is affected, and have patience, Allah is with those who have patience.
And be not like those who comes out from their houses with pride to show the people; and continue stopping people from the path of Allah, Allah has encompassed their deeds.

And remember the time when Satan decorated their deeds for them, and said today no one can overpower you and I am your helper, and when both groups came face to face, he fled and said: I am free from you; and I am seeing that what you do not see, and I fear Allah, and He is severe punisher.
When hypocrites who had deviation in their hearts were saying: their religion have deceived them, however those who believe on Allah, Allah is Predominant on everything and has great Wisdom.
Wish you could see, when angels were taking their souls, they were smiting on their face and back (and saying) now taste (the punishment of) Hell.
This is because the reward for your earlier deeds is this only, and Allah will not be unjust to His servants.
That condition was of people of Firaun and people earlier than them that they denied verses of Allah; so, Allah seized them of their sins, and Allah is Strong and giver of severe punishment.
This is because Allah does not change the favor shown on any people until they create the change themselves.

As were the consequences of people of Firaun, and people earlier than them, they denied verses of the Lord, then We destroyed them on account of their sins, and drowned the people of Firaun, and all of them were unjust.
Worst people walking on the earth are those who adopted infidelity and now they will not believe.
Those who made covenant with you and they break their covenant every time, and they do not fear Allah.
And in war if they come into your possession, then exile them and their supporters, so they may take lessons.
And if you fear treachery of covenant and betrayal from the people of any tribe then throw their covenants towards them, Allah does not like the people who betray.
And infidels should not feel that they have gone ahead; they can never humble the Muslims.

And to face them collect your possible strength and arrange line of horses, and with that frighten the enemies of Allah, your enemy, and to those (enemy) whom you do not know but Allah know them; and whatever you will spend in the way of Allah will be fully compensated and no unjust will be done to you.
And if they incline towards peace then you too bend, and trust in Allah, He Hears all and Know (everything).
And if they wish to deceive you then Allah is enough for you, He verified you, through His help and through the believers.

And he has created love in their hearts, even if you had spent the entire world, you could not have created such mutual love, but Allah has created this love, and He is Predominant over everything and has Wisdom.
And O Prophet! For you enough is Allah and those believers who follow you.

O Prophet! Prepare the believers for war, even if you might get twenty persons who have patience, then they will dominate two hundred, and if they will be (one) hundred they will dominate (one) thousand infidels, because infidels are not sensible people.

Now Allah has lightened your burden, He saw that there is weakness among you (people), so if you are one hundred and have patience, you will dominate over two hundred, and if you will be one thousand then you will dominate over two thousand by the command of Allah, and Allah is with those who have patience.

No prophet is allowed to take prisoner until he faces difficulties of fighting on the earth; you people wish only for the wealth of this world whereas Allah wishes for the Hereafter (for you) and only He is having Honor and Wisdom.
Had it not been the previous decision of Allah; so, because of the ransom you have taken, His punishment would have reached you.
So now you can consume whatever war-booty you have got since it is lawful and pure, and adopt to the piety of Allah, and Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.

O Prophet! Say to the captives of your hand: If Allah will see goodness in your hearts, then whatever wealth has been taken from you, Allah will bestow upon you seventy-fold goodness and will forgive you, because He is very forgiving and Merciful.
And now if they wish to betray you, so before this they have betrayed Allah; thereafter Allah granted power over them (to you), Allah Knows everything and has Wisdom.

Verily, those who believe and they migrated and they fought with their life and wealth in the way of Allah, and those who sheltered and helped, these are all friends of each other, and those who believed but did not migrate, you are free from their guardianship unless they migrate; and if they seek your help in religious matters, then it is imperative on you to help them; except against those people, between you and them there is a treaty; and Allah sees your deeds well.
These unbelievers are helpers of one another, and if you will not help the believers; then there shall be in the land persecution and great mischief.
And those who are believers, migrated, fought in the way of Allah, sheltered, and helped, actually they are the real believers, and for them is forgiveness and honorable sustenance.

And those who believed later and migrated and fought alongside you, they are from among you, and they are near ones of the Book of Allah, and have more priority and nearness over one another; Verily Allah is the Best Knower of everything.
O Muslims! Whatever covenants and treaties you had entered with the polytheists, Allah and His Prophet are declaring their disassociation with them.
So, O Infidels! You can roam around freely on the earth for four months, and remember you cannot save yourself from Allah, and Allah will disgrace infidels.

It is a general announcement on the day of Great Hajj that Allah and His Prophet are disassociated from the polytheists, but if you repent it will be better for you, and if you will deviate then remember you cannot humble Allah, and O Prophet, give good news of painful punishment to the infidels.

Except for those people with whom, O Muslims, you have made covenant, and they have not shown any sloth, and have not helped each other against you, so instead of four months, complete your covenant until end of the term, that Allah likes those, who adapt to piousness.

So, when the sacred months passed by, kill infidels wherever you find them, and take them captive and sit on every road and stop them, but if they repent and establish prayers and give poor rate; then leave their way, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.

And if polytheists seek protection from you, give them, so that they listen to the Book of Allah and then reach them to their place of refuge, this concession is because these ignorant people are not aware of truth.

How can the covenants of treaty-breaker unbelievers may remain good with Allah and His Prophet, but if you have taken a covenant from anyone near Sacred Mosque, and if they remain on it, you also remain on your covenant, and Allah likes those who are pious, and guards themselves against sins.

How can be any concession given to them that if they will overpower you, they will neither have any consideration for your neighborhood, and nearness and nor they will honor any covenant; they are just pleasing you with their talk otherwise their hearts are Verily denying; and most of them are transgressors and treaty-breakers.
They have taken a small benefit in exchange of the verses of Allah, now they are hindering people from the way of Allah, they are doing very evil work.
They do not respect the nearness, word and treaty of any believer, these are those who just exceed.
Even then, if they repent, establish prayer, and give poor-rate, then they are your brethren in religion, and We describe our verses in detail for the knowledgeable persons.

And if they break their oaths after treaty and use taunts in the religion, then fight openly with leaders of infidelity, there is not any trust in their oaths, they might desist from their deeds in this way.

Will not you fight with the people, who had broken their covenant and treaty, and they have also decided to expel the Prophet, and they attacked you first, are you afraid from them; then Allah is more deserving that you create His fear (in your hearts); if you are believer.
Fight with them, Allah will punish them through your hands and will disgrace them, and will give you victory over them, and will comfort hearts of the believers.
And will calm the anger of their hearts, and Allah accepts repentance of whom He pleases; and He has Knowledge and Wisdom.

And do you think you will be left like this, whereas Allah has not observed yet that who among you are the strugglers in the way of Allah, and they have not befriended anybody leaving Allah and His Prophet and the believers; and Allah is well aware of your deeds.

This is not the job of polytheists that they would populate the mosques of Allah, whereas they themselves are witness of infidelity of their own souls, their deeds are a waste, and they will abide in Hell forever.

Mosques of Allah are populated by those who believe in Allah and on the Day of Judgement; and who established prayer and gave poor-rate, and did not fear anybody except Allah, these are the people who will be counted among the guided ones.

Do you make giver of water to pilgrims, and population of Sacred Mosque equal in status with those who have faith on Allah and on the Day of Judgement, and struggle hard in the way of Allah; no, Allah does not consider them both equal, and Allah never guides the unjust people.
Verily who believed and migrated and struggled hard with their life and wealth in the way of Allah; they have great status near Allah, and in fact they are successful.
Allah is giving glad tidings of Mercy, approval, and gardens to them; where there will be perpetual pleasures for them.
They will always remain in those gardens because there is great reward with Allah.
O believers! Do not befriend your father, grandfather and brothers if they like infidelity against faith, and who will keep them befriended, these people will be counted among the unjust.

O Prophet! Say: If your fathers, children, brothers, spouses, your relatives, the wealth which you have collected, and loss in business you fear, and houses you like; are more important in your eyes than Allah, His Prophet and struggling hard in the way of Allah, then wait till the command of Allah comes, and Allah does not guide the people who are unjust.

Verily, Allah helped you on a lot number of places; and on the day of (battle of) Hunain when you were feeling pride on your numbers, but it didn't benefit you, and earth even with all its spaciousness became strait for you, then you showed your back and fled.

Then after this, Allah sent down his tranquility on His Prophet and on believers, and send the armies which you did not see, and sent punishment on those who adopted infidelity, and this is the reward and result for infidels.
After that, Allah will accept the repentance of whoever he pleases, He is all Forgiving and Merciful.

O Believers! Polytheists are totally impure, so beware, they should not enter the Sacred Mosque after this year, and if you fear poverty, then Allah will shortly enrich you with his Grace and Mercy, He has Knowledge and Wisdom.

And struggle hard against those who do not have faith, on Allah and on the Day of Judgement, and whatever have been made unlawful by Allah and His Prophet do not consider it unlawful, and in spite of being people of Book they do not follow the truthful religion; and with their own hands they agree to pay ‘jizya’ to you with disgrace.

And Jews say that Uzair is son of Allah and Christians say Maseeh is son of Allah, these are their verbal talks, this is similar to the talk which infidels used to say, may Allah slay them all, where are they heading?

They have adopted their monks and Rabbis as their Lord, leaving Allah and Maseeh son of Maryam, whereas they were ordained to worship one and only Allah, there is no Lord except Allah, He is Alone and Self-Sufficient; and He is clean and pure from thinking of the polytheists.
They wish to extinguish the Light of Allah from their mouth by blowing, and Allah will not consent until He perfect his Light, no matter how much the infidels dislike it.
This is that Allah who sent His Prophet with guidance and truthful religion, to make His religion dominate over all religions, no matter how much the infidels dislike it.

O Believers! Many monks and rabbis illegitimately eat up the wealth of many persons, and they stop people from the way of Allah, and those who hoard gold and silver and do not spend in the way of Allah, O Prophet, give them the good news of painful punishment.

The day when that gold and silver melted in hellfire and they will be branded on their foreheads and on their waists with it, that this is the treasure which you used to hoard, now taste your treasures and hoardings.

Verily, numbers of months near Allah in His Book are twelve, from the day he has created skies and the earth, among them four months are sacred, this is the straight and strong religion, so beware do not be unjust to yourselves in these months, and fight the polytheists in same way as they fight with you; and remember Allah is only with pious people.

Transposition of sacred months is a kind of addition in unbelief, through which infidels are misguided, one year they make it lawful and another year they make it unlawful, so it becomes equal to what Allah has made unlawful; and also Allah's unlawful is made lawful; and their worst doings have been decorated for their eyes, and Allah does not guide the unbelieving people.

O Believers! What has happened to you, when you were told to come out and fight in the way of Allah, you glued to the ground, are you satisfied with this worldly life in exchange of the Hereafter; then remember, in the Hereafter, provision of this worldly life is very little compared to actual reality of this world.

If you will not come out in the way of Allah, then Allah will grip you in painful punishment, and will bring other people in your place, and you cannot harm Him in any way, He has Power over everything.

If you will not help the Prophet, Allah have helped him when infidels expelled him, he left with one person and both were in a cave, he was saying to his friend: grieve not Allah is with us, then Allah bestowed tranquility upon his Prophet from Himself; and aided him with the armies which you could not see, and Allah made lowest the words of infidels, and words of Allah in fact are the highest, He is all Dominant and all Wise.
O Muslims! Whether you are light or heavy, come out of your homes and fight in the way of Allah with your life and property, this is better for you; if you know anything.

O Prophet! If there is a short advantage or easy journey, they would Verily follow you, but long journey becomes difficult for them, and shortly they will swear on Allah and say that if we had been able, we would Verily have come with you, they are destroying their souls, and Allah knows well that they are lying.
O Prophet! Allah acquitted you, why did you allow them to stay back, without verifying who is truthful and who is a liar.
Those who believe in Allah and the Day of Judgement, they will never seek permission in opposition to fight in the way of Allah with their lives and wealth, Allah knows the pious people very well.
This permission may be sought by those who have no belief in Allah and the Day of Judgement, there is doubt in their hearts, and they are struck in their doubt.

If they had intended to go, they would have made arrangements, but only Allah did not like their going, that's why Allah has weakened their thoughts, and now they were told to keep sitting with those who are sitting.

Even if they had gone, they would have increased your fear, and they would be searching the dissention among you, and among you are the people who would have listened to them, and Allah knows well to the unjust.
Verily, earlier also they have tried to create mischief and wanted to disturb your affairs; until the truth came and command of Allah became manifest, whereas people were disliking it.
And there are people who say: give us permission and do not put us in mischief, then know: they have already fallen into mischief, and Hell has encircled infidels from every side.
Their condition is such; that they feel bad if any good comes to you, but if any difficulty comes towards you they say: we had already arranged our affairs, and returned happily.
Say: Only those matters reach to us which have been written for us by Allah, He is our Master, and the believers trust in Him only.

Say: In whatever matter you are waiting for us, of the two one is good, we are (also) awaiting this in your matter, that Allah Himself or through us will afflict you with punishment, so now await the punishment, we are also awaiting with you.
Say: Whether you spend willingly or spend unwillingly, your action is not going to be accepted, because you are a people who are transgressors.
And non-acceptance of their alms is just because they have denied Allah and His Prophet, and they perform prayer with weariness and laziness, and spend (wealth) in the way of Allah, with distaste.
Their wealth and children should not surprise you, this is the will of Allah to punish them through these in their life of this world and they will die as unbelievers.
And they swear that they are from among you, but they are not from you; they are cowards.
If they will find refuge place, cave or any hiding place, they will hurriedly run towards it.
And they are also from those who blame regarding alms, that they will agree if they are given something; and will disagree if they are not given something.

Although, We wish they had agreed on whatever was given by Allah and His Prophet and would have said: we are satisfied by what has been given to us by Allah; shortly, He and His Prophet will give us from their Mercy and Grace; and we only desire Allah.

Charity and alms are for poor, needy, and for those who administer the funds, to incline the hearts, for freeing captives, and who are in debt, for destitute travelers in the way of Allah, this the ordained by Allah, and Allah Know well and have Wisdom.

Among them are also people who trouble the Prophet and say he is only (all) ear, say: it is better he is ear and have believe on Allah, and verify the believers, and is Mercy for those who have faith; and whoever will hurt the Prophet, there is painful punishment for him.
They swear on Allah that they might please you, whereas Allah and His Prophet are more deserving that if they were believers in fact they should have pleased them with their deeds.
Do they not know that there is Hellfire for those who oppose Allah and His Prophet, and have to abide in it forever? And this is great disgrace.

Hypocrites fear that a chapter (of Quran) may be revealed and Muslims may know what is in their hearts, so say: you may make fun of it, but for what you are afraid, Allah will Verily make it manifest.
And if you will question them, they will say that they were just talking and joking, so say: was it with regard to Allah, His verses and His Prophet that you are mocked at.
So do not feel sorry now, you have adopted infidelity after faith, if we forgive one party of yours, but will Verily punish the second party, because they are guilty.

Hypocrite men and women, they are all from one another, they all enjoin evil, and prohibit from good, and stop their hands from spending in the way of Allah, they have forgotten Allah and Allah has also overlooked them; that hypocrites are the real transgressors.
And Allah has promised hypocrite men and women for the fire of Hell, where they will abide forever, that is enough for them and it is the everlasting punishment for them.

Your example is like your earlier people who were more powerful than you and also wealthier and they had more children than you, they benefitted well from their share, and you also took advantage of your fate, like your earlier ones have benefitted; and like this you indulge in useless things, as they have indulged, although, they are the people whose deeds have gone waste in this world and the Hereafter, and (they) are the same people who are in loss.

Did not they get the news that before them the settlements of people of Nooh, Aad, Samoud, Ibrahim and companions of Madyan were overthrown before them, to whom messengers had brought the manifest signs but they denied them; Allah does not persecute anybody, they are persecuting their souls themselves.

Believing men and women are friends and helpers of each other, that they enjoin for good to each other, and prohibit from evil, establish prayer and give poor rate, and obey Allah and His Prophet, these are the people on whom Allah will shortly bestow His Mercy; and He is Predominant on everything and has Wisdom also.

Allah has promised believing men and women for gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing, they are going to abide in it forever, there are pure and beautiful mansions in the garden of everlasting bliss, and the Will of Allah is the biggest thing, and this is a great success.
O Prophet! fight with infidels and hypocrites and be stern with them, their destination is Hell, which is a very evil place.

They swear on Allah in their talk that they did not say this, whereas they uttered words of infidel, and became infidel after adopting Islam, and wished for, which they could not get, and their anger is on this that Allah and His Prophet with their Grace and Mercy have enriched Muslims, anyhow if they still repent is better for them, and if they turn their face; then He will give painful punishment to them in this world and the Hereafter, and on the earth no one will be their guardian and helper.
There are those among them who made covenant with Allah, if He will give us with His Grace and Mercy, then they will give charity in the way of Allah, and will be among the good servants.
Later, when Allah bestowed upon them with His Grace and Mercy, then they became stingy, and went aside and turned back.
So their stinginess caused hypocrisy in their hearts, until the day when they will meet Allah because they opposed their covenant with Allah and lied.
Do they not know that Allah is aware of secrets of their hearts and also their whispering, and He knows all unseen.

Those who make fun of those who participate in charity with abundance and blame on those poor who do not have anything except their hard work, and mock at them, Allah will also make their fun; and with Him is very painful punishment.

Whether you seek forgiveness for them or not, if forgiveness is sought seventy times even then Allah will not forgive them, because they have denied Allah and His Prophet, and Allah does not guide the transgressing people.

Whoever stayed back from Tabook War were pleased on staying behind Prophet of Allah; and they felt offensive in fighting in the way of Allah with their life and wealth, and they say: do not go in summer, O Prophet say: Fire of Hell is much hotter than this, if they might understand something.
Now laugh less and cry more, this is punishment for them.

Thereafter, if Allah takes you back from the field to a group of them and they seek your permission to go and fight, then say: you can never come with me and cannot fight any enemy, earlier you chose to stay back, so now sit with those who stayed back.

Beware! If anyone from them dies do not say prayer on the dead body, and do not stand on the grave also, because they denied Allah and His Prophet, and they were transgressors when they left this world.
And their wealth and children should not look good to you, Allah wish to punish them in this world through them, and wish them they may die in disbelief.

And when any chapter is revealed that believe on Allah and fight alongside His Prophet, so those with wealth and influence among them will seek your permission and say: leave us behind with those who will sit.
They are pleased that they are with those who stayed back, their hearts are sealed, now they will not understand anything.
But O Prophet! Those believers who fought in the way of Allah with their life and wealth. (all) good things are for them, they will prosper and are successful.
Allah has arranged those gardens for them beneath which are flowing rivers, and they will forever abide in it, and this is the biggest success.

And with the excuse villagers will also come to you, that they should be given permission to stay at home, they also stayed back who falsely stated regarding Allah and His Prophet, shortly there will be painful punishment on infidels among them.

Those who are weak or sick or do not have anything to spend in the way of Allah, there is no harm in their sitting back, provided they are sincere for Allah and His Prophet; that there is no blame for good character people, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.

And there is also no blame on them who come to you saying: provide us also on any ride, and you said, we do not have arrangement for any rides, and they return from you with tears in their eyes; and they were sad that they don't have anything, to spend in the way of Allah.
Blame is on those who are rich and still seek your permission, and want to be among people who stayed back, and Allah has sealed their hearts, now they are not going to know anything.

These breaching people will give you different excuses upon your return; so say: do not give your excuses, we are not going to verify them, Allah has informed us of your condition; He is Verily seeing your deeds, and Prophet is also seeing; after this you will be returned in the court of present and unseen, Who will inform you about your deeds.
Shortly they will swear on Allah upon your return that you forsake them, you get aside from them, they are statue of evil, their place is Hell which is right punishment for them.
They swear before you to please you, even if you pleased with them but Allah will never be pleased with the transgressing people.

These villagers are very hard in infidelity and hypocrisy, and they are not worthy of knowing the limits and commands revealed by Allah in His Book on the Prophet, and Allah is all Knowing and having Wisdom.
Among these Arabs are those who consider hypocrisy as loss, and wait for different calamities on you, there is big calamity for them, and Allah is all Hearing and Knowing.

Among the Arabs are those who believe on Allah and the Hereafter, and consider their spending a mean for nearness to Allah and blessings of Prophet, Verily, this is the means for nearness for them, shortly, He will enter them into His Mercy; and He is Forgiving and Merciful.

And among the migrants (Mahajirs) and helpers (Ansars) who went ahead and who followed them, Allah is pleased with all of them, and they are pleased with Allah, and Allah has provided them gardens beneath them rivers are flowing, and they will abide in it forever, and this the biggest success.

And around you are hypocrites among villagers, and among the people of Madina who are experts in hypocrisy and you do not know their transgression, but Allah knows well, shortly we will befall them with double punishment, thereafter they will be returned to the greater punishment.
And other people who admitted to their sins that they have mixed good and bad deeds, shortly Allah will accept their repentance, and He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O Prophet! Accept the alms (Poor rate) out of their property, so that they are purified, and pray for them, because your prayer will sooth their hearts, and Allah Hears all and Knows everything.
Do they not know that only Allah accepts repentance of His servants, and takes the alms and poor rate, and He is the Acceptor and He is Kind.

O Prophet Say: You do your deeds, Allah, His Prophet and the believers see your deeds; and shortly you will be returned to Allah, who knows the unseen and the seen, and He will inform you what you did.
And some of them are left on the hope of command of Allah; whether Allah will punish them or accept their repentance, He Knows and is having Wisdom.

Those who built Zarar Mosque to weaken Islam and to give strength to infidelity and create disunion among Muslims, and prepare shelter for those who fought Allah and His Prophet, they are also hypocrites, and they swear that they built it for good, although Allah is testifying that they are liars.

Beware, never you stand in this mosque, but the mosque which was built on the day one is based on piety and is worthy that you pray in it; and among them are men who like purity; Allah loves pure people.

Who built his foundation on fear of Allah and pleasure of Allah is better, or he is better who built his foundation on a hollowed bank which will take the whole house and fall in Hell; and Allah do not guide the unjust people.

And the foundation of their mansions will always be a matter of doubt in their hearts, but that their hearts may break into pieces, and death comes to them, and Allah is all Knower and is master of Wisdom.

Verily Allah has purchased from the believers, their life and property in exchange of Paradise; and they fight in the way of Allah and slay the enemies, and themselves also get slain, and this truthful promise is mentioned all places in Taurait, Injeel and Quran, and who else will be to honour the covenant like Allah; now rejoice on the business which you have done with Allah, that this is the biggest achievement.

These are the people who repent, perform worship and praise Allah, travel in the way of Allah, bow down, do prostrations, order good deeds, stop people from evil, and preserve the limits of Allah, and O Prophet! give them glad tidings of Paradise.
It does not befit the status of the Prophet and the believers to seek forgiveness for polytheists, even if they are their relatives, when it has become obvious that they are companions of Hell.

Ibrahim seeking forgiveness for father was because his promise to him and for the favour what he did to him (Ibrahim), but when it became clear that he is enemy of Allah, he disassociated himself from him; and Ibrahim was very beseeching and forbearing.
And after guiding a people, Allah does not declare them misguided, unless they are informed what things they have to guard against; Verily, Allah knows everything.
Kingdom of skies and the earth is for Allah only, and He the giver of life and death, except Him you do not have any guardian or helper.

Verily Allah showed His Mercy on Prophet and those Mohajirs and Ansars; who helped Prophet in distress, when a party was feeling crookedness in their hearts, then Allah accepted their repentance, and He was pitiful and merciful on them.

Allah showed His Mercy on those three, who were left behind, when land with all its vastness became strait and they were about to die and they understood that except Allah no one can shelter them, then Allah turned towards them so they may repent, and Allah is great acceptor of repentance and is very Kind.
O Believers! Fear Allah and be with those who are the truthful.

Dwellers of Madina and villagers of vicinity have no right to get separated from Prophet, or that they may hold their souls dear over his soul, because he does not feel thirsty, tired or hunger in the way of Allah, nor does he do anything that may enrages the infidels, nor he takes anything from the enemy, but instead he writes their good deeds, and Allah does not waste reward of any doers of good.
They do not do any small or big spending in the way of Allah, nor they traverse any valley so that it may be written for them; and Allah may reward them with the best of what they have done.

It is not imperative for believers that they all leave for war at a time; so why don't one group from every party take the flag of the religion and when they return to their people they may warn them about the punishment of Allah, so they may become cautious.
O Believers! struggle hard with the infidels around you so that they feel your intensity and power, and remember, Allah is only with the pious people.

And when any chapter (of Quran) is revealed some of them taunt, 'whose faith might have increased among you'? So remember, definitely their faith increases, who are believers, and they also get happy.
And those who are sick at heart, their sickness increases with (revelation of) chapter (of Quran), and they die as unbelievers.
Do they not realize that they are inflicted with calamity one-two times every year, even then neither they do repent nor they learn.
And when any chapter (of Quran) is revealed, they glance at each other; that is anybody seeing them? And then they return, so Allah also turns their hearts; these people are not going to understand.
Verily, to you came the Prophets who were from among you, and every difficulty of yours troubles him, and he is always ambitious regarding your guidance, and have compassion and mercy for believers.
Even after this if they turn faces, then say: Allah is enough for me and there is no god except Him; I rely on Him, and He is the Lord of Supreme Throne.
Alif Laam Raa, these verses are from the Book, full of wisdom.

Is this strange for the people that We revealed to a man from among them, who warn the people from punishment and give glad tidings to the believers that for them is high rank in the Court of Lord, but these infidels say that he is an open magician.

Verily, your Lord is that who have created the earth and the skies in six days, after that he established Throne and His Power, He is the planner of all affairs, there is no one who can do intercession without His permission, He is your Lord, worship Him, and are not the senses coming to you.

Like this you all have to return, this is true promise of Allah, He began all Creations, and will take them back, so He may reward justly to the believers and good doers, and who have become unbelievers, there is boiling water as drink for them, and there is painful punishment for their infidelity.

This is Allah who made Sun radiant and Moon luminous, then fixed phases for moon, so that you can count the years and find other calculations, this is all Allah has created with truth; He describes for knowledgeable persons His verses in details.
Verily in the onset and departure of day and night and whatever Allah has created in the skies and on the earth, there are signs for the pious people.
Verily those who do not desire for Our Meeting, and are pleased and content on the life of this world, and those who are negligent of Our verses;
these are all those who have place is Hell; on account of their deeds.
Verily those who believed and did good deeds, on the basis of their faith Allah will guide them to a destination where rivers are flowing beneath the gardens of favours.
There they will say: Allah is purest and Self-Sufficient, their gift will be salutations, and their final words will be: all praises are for the Lord of the worlds.

If Allah would have done haste in evil, like you wish haste for good, so uptil now their term would have been decided, We leave them in rebellion to those who do not desire for Our meeting; so that they keep on stumbling in this way.

When a person gets into any loss; then he calls on me while standing and sitting, and from every side, and when We avert his loss, he passes by as if he has never called upon Us when he was in trouble; Verily, the deeds of those who do excess We made them to look fair-seeming in their own eyes.
Verily We have destroyed the Ummah of before you when they became unjust and they would not believe on the signs brought by the Prophets, like this we punish the guilty nations.
Then We made you their successor on the earth to see how you act.

Those who do not desire for Our meeting, when Our verses are recited in front of them, they say: bring another Quran or change this, then you tell them: I do not have any right to change it; I follow only the commands which are revealed towards me; I fear for the punishment of a Mighty Day if I disobey my Lord.
(O Prophet) say: If Allah had wished I would not have recited in front of you, I would not have informed you, earlier I have stayed among you for a period; don't you then understand this much also.
Who is much more unjust than the one who blames Allah or denies His verses, He is not going to deliver the guilty.

Those who worship others than Allah, who neither can harm them nor they can benefit them, these people say they will be our intercessor before Allah, so say; are you telling Allah such a thing which He does not know in the skies and in earth; He is pure, and much higher than their polytheism.
All people are one Ummah by nature, then they separated; if it was not the decision of your Lord; then in the matter you disagree; the matter would certainly have been decided.
These people say why does not any sign of Allah is revealed on them, say: authority of the unseen is with Allah only, then await, I am also with those who await.

And after the difficulty when We made them taste Mercy, then immediately they started wickedness in Our verses, so say: Allah is much swift in strategy than you, and Our representatives are watching your strategies.

And this is that Allah who make you roam on earth and the sea, until you were on the ship, and they sail on them in pure breeze, and all the passengers became happy, and suddenly a strong air blew surge on them from all sides, and they thought that they have been encircled from all sides, then they started praying with pure heart, that if they are delivered from this difficulty they will be among the thankful.

When He delivered them, then they started unjust on the land, O People, your unjust would be against yourselves, the fun of life is of few days, later you all will be returned towards Us only, then We will tell what you were doing in the world.

Life of this world is like rain which We send down from the sky, then the vegetation comes out of the ground which men and animals eat, when the ground became lush green and becomes garnished, so the owners thought now they have an authority over it; then suddenly Our command came on day or night time, and We rendered it like totally harvested field; as if nothing was there in it yesterday, We described Our verses in this way, for the people who reflect.
Allah is inviting everyone to the house of peace and guides to whoever He pleases.

Whoever did the good deeds, reward for them is good and more also, and neither their faces will have blackness nor they will be disgraced, these are the people of Paradise and shall forever abide in it.

Whoever have earned evil, for them there is similar evil in their reward, and their faces will also have blackness of their evil, and there won't be anybody to protect them from the punishment of the Lord; blackness will be as if the veil of black night has covered their faces, they are Hellish people and shall abide forever in it.

The day when We will gather everybody, then the polytheists will be told: that they and their partners should stand apart, then We will cause separation between them, and their partners will say that you have not worshipped us.
Now Allah is enough as Witness between you and us, that we were unaware of your worship.
At that time everyone will test their past deeds, and they will all be returned to the Court of Allah, the Truthful Master; and whatever blame they were making shall vanish away from them.

O Prophet! Ask them: Who gives sustenance to you from the skies and the earth? And who controls hearing and seeing? And who brings out living from the dead; and who brings out dead from the living? And Who plans all the affairs? They will all say: Allah, say: then why don't you fear Him?
That Allah is your Truthful Lord, after truth there is nothing but disgrace, so where are you being taken?
Like this the punishment of Allah is proved (appropriate) for the unjust, because they are not going to believe.

You ask them: Is there anyone in your partners who can begin the creation (and cause them to die), and then bring them to life again? Then tell them that it is Allah, Who begins the Creation (and causes them to die) and it is He who returns them to life again, so in which direction are you going?

Say: Is there anyone among your partners who can guide to truth; say: it is only Allah guide to truth; and who guide to truth, Verily he should be followed or those who are unable to guide, and instead he should be guided himself, so what has happened to you and how are you judging.
Their majority only follow their speculations, whereas in the way of truth, speculation cannot be of any benefit, Verily Allah is well aware of their deeds.

And this Quran is not such that it can be forged by anybody except Allah, but is a verification and explanation of its previous books, there is no doubt in it that it has been revealed by the Lord of the worlds.
Do these people say that the Prophet has forged it, say: you can also bring even one chapter like this? And may call anybody except Allah for your help; if you are truthful in your slander.

In fact they have denied the thing of which they do not have even full knowledge, and its interpretation also has not come to them, like this people before them also had denied, now see what will happen to the unjust.
There are some who believe and some do not believe, and your Lord know the unjust people very well.
And if they deny you then say: for me is my deeds and for you are your deeds, you are free from my deeds and I am free from your deeds.
And among them some people are those who looks like as if they are hearing, but do you want to make the deaf hear, when they do not understand.
There are some who are looking at you, so can you guide the blind, who cannot see anything?
Allah does not do unjust to people even of the size of a particle; they are unjust to themselves.

The day Allah will be congregating them (they will feel) as if they have lived in the world for an hour, and they will be knowing one another, Verily those who denied Our meeting remained in loss and could not be guided.
Whatever we have promised them, We show it to you; or before that We cause you to leave this world, in any way they will have to come back to Our Court, thereafter Allah is witness to their deeds.
And for every Ummah is one prophet, when prophet comes then judgements are made among them with just, and no unjust will be done unto them.
They say if you are truthful then when the promise of punishment will be completed?
Say: I am not master of any benefit or loss to my soul, unless Allah wills; for every Ummah there is a fixed term, that can neither be postponed or preponed.
Say: If the punishment comes on the night or day time, then what you will do? Then for what, these guilty are making haste.
So when the punishment will come on you then will you believe, now that you were asking for haste in the punishment.
After that the unjust will be told: taste the everlasting (punishment), will you get anything else except the reward for your deeds?
These people ask you (whatever you say) is it true? Then say: by my Lord it is true, and you can never fail Allah.

And whoever did unjust in the world, on the Day of Judgement if he gets all the treasures of the earth, he will give as ransom, and still they will manifest regret, but they will be dealt with justly, and no unjust will be done unto them.
Remember! All the treasures of earth and the skies, are for Allah only, be aware that the promise of Allah is truth, whereas most of the people are unaware.
That is Allah Who gives life and causes death, and to Whom you all will be taken back.
O Mankind! There already has come from your Lord the Advice (Quran) to you; wherein is remedy for ailments (hypocrisy and polytheism) of hearts; guidance; and mercy for the believers.
O Prophet! Say; This Quran is the fruit of Grace and Mercy of Allah, so they should be happy that this is much better than what they gather.
Say: Allah has sent down sustenance for you, and you are making lawful and forbidden in it, have Allah given you permission for this; or do you slander?
And those who falsely slander Allah, what do they think about the Day of Judgement? Verily Allah is Graceful on people; but most of them are not thankful.

And O Prophet! You be in any state, and recite any part of Quran, and O People, whatever you do, We are witness to all of you whenever you do any deed; and none of the atom of the skies and the earth is away from your Allah; and there is no such biggest or tiniest thing, which We have not included in this manifest Book.
Be aware Verily 'Auliya' Allah will not have any fear nor will they grieve.
These are the people who believed and fear Allah.
Both, this world and the Hereafter are the places of glad tidings for them, and there cannot be any change in the words of Allah, and this is in fact great achievement.
O Prophet! Don't grieve by their talks, all Honour is for Allah, He hears to all and knows everything.

Be aware, all the creations of the skies and the earth for Allah only; and those who call on His (the presumed) partners besides Allah, and they do not even follow them, they follow only their thoughts, and they are living life only on conjectures.
This Allah is that who created night so you can get rest; and made day a source of light, and also there are signs in it, for those people who would listen.

These people say that Allah has created His son whereas he is Self-Sufficient, and the entire universe of the skies and the earth is His, even you do not have any argument of your talk, do you blame Allah which you do not know.
O Prophet say: Those who falsely blame Allah can never be successful.
There is a little rest in this world and then to Us shall be their return, then We will make them taste the severe punishment because of their infidelity.

And tell them the tale of Nooh, that he told his people if my stay and verses of Allah are difficult for you, then my trust is on Allah, you also make perfect your intention and call unto your partners; and none of your action should remain hidden on you, then do whatever you want and do not give Me any kind of respite.
But if you will deviate, I do not want any reward from you, my reward is with Allah only, and I have been ordained that I should be among His obedient.

The (his) people denied him so We delivered Nooh and his companions on the ship and made them heirs on the earth, and drowned those who denied our verses, now see, who are warned, what will be their result.

Thereafter, We sent many messengers to their people, and they brought to them manifest signs, but because of their earlier denial they could not believe him, and like this We seal the hearts of the unjust.
Then after those messengers, We sent Moosa and Haroon with Our signs towards Firaun and his people, so they also denied and they were all also guilty.
So when Moosa came to them from Us with the truth, then they said it is manifest magic.
Moosa replied: After the advent of truth to you, you are calling it magic, so all this is magic for you? Whereas magicians are never successful.

Those people said: you have brought the message to deviate us from the path of our forefathers, and that you two might take over the governance and power in the land, and certainly we are not going to accept your talk.
And Firaun said: present to me all the clever and expert magicians.
When all the magicians gathered; Moosa said: you may throw whatever you want to throw.
When they threw the ropes, Moosa said: whatever you have brought it is magic and Allah will make it useless; and Allah never allows the corrupt to succeed.
And Allah proves the truth, with His words; whether guilty ones may not like it.

Still they did not believe in Moosa, except some offspring of his people, due to fear of Firaun that he may not afflict them in any trying; Verily he was very high in the land, and undoubtedly he was among those who commit excesses.
And Moosa told to his people that if you really believe on Allah; than trust in Him only, and in reality be His obedient.
So they said: Verily we trust upon Allah; (and they prayed) O Lord, do not make us centre of persecution of unjust.
And with your Mercy, protect us from persecution of infidels.
And We revealed to Moosa and his brother, make houses for your people in Egypt, and make your houses into centre of worship; establish prayer, and give glad tidings to those who believe.

And Moosa said: O Lord, You have bestowed on Firaun and his companions the riches of this world, O Lord, they will cause people to go astray from Your path, O Lord, destroy their wealth, harden their hearts; those people shall not believe, until they will see the painful punishment with their eyes.
Said Allah: We accepted the prayer of you both, now continue to stay on the straight path, and do not follow the ignorant.

When we made Bani Israel cross through the river; then Firaun and his army followed them unjustly and aggressively, when they were caught by drowning in the river, then he called out; I believe on One Lord Who has no partner, on Whom Bani Israel have believed, and I am among obedient.
A sound came: now that you had disobeyed before, your counting had done among mischief-makers.
So, today I am saving your body, that you become a sign for the people after you; however, many people remain negligent from our signs.

And We bestowed the best destination on Bani Israel, and gave them pure sustenance, so they did not differ between them, then Taurait came to them, now Allah will decide their differences on the Day of Judgement (in which they differ in this world).
If you doubt what We have revealed, so ask the earlier people who have been reading Taurait and Injeel; Verily truth has come from your Lord, so now you don't be among those who doubt.
And do not be among those who denied the verses of Allah, like this you will be counted among those who are in loss.
Verily against whom the words of punishment of Allah are proven, they will not believe.
Though even if all the signs may come to them; unless they don't see the painful punishment with their eyes (they will not believe).

Then there is no township (whose people) believe and their believing benefitted them, except people of Yunus, when they believed so We averted the disgraceful punishment from their worldly life, and allowed them to live peacefully for a period.
If Allah pleased all the dwellers of the earth would have believed; so would you force the people to believe.
And it is not possible for any soul to believe without permission of Allah, and he makes the uncleanness imperative on those who do not use their wisdom.
O Prophet, say: Just ponder in the skies and the earth; and remember any signs and warnings do not work for them, who do not wish to believe.
Now are they waiting for the bad days which have passed by on earlier people, then say: you wait, I am also awaiting with you.
After this, We deliver prophets and the believers, and upon Us it is imperative that We deliver the believers.

O Prophet, say: If you doubt my religion; then I cannot worship, whom you worship besides Allah, I only worship that Allah who will cause you to die, and I have been commanded to be among the believers.
You keep your face totally towards religion; keep aside from unjust, and never ever get counted among the party of polytheists.
And do not call out to anyone except Allah; who can neither benefit you nor can cause you any loss, otherwise if you will do this you will be counted among the unjust.

And if Allah may afflict you with any harm, then no one can save you, except Him; and if He intends any good to you, then there is no one who can repel His Mercy; and to whom among His servants He wishes He bestows good, He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O Prophet say: Truth has come to you from your Lord; now who will get guidance will only be good for himself, and whoever goes astray will only be his loss, and it is not your responsibility.
You should follow only whatever is revealed to you, and be patient unless Allah makes judgement, and He is the best among deciders.
Alif Laam Ra, this is the book whose verses are set clear; and has been described in detail from One, who is knowledgeable and wise.
Do not worship anyone except Allah, I am from Him to give glad tidings and warn you.

And seek repentance from your Lord and be attentive towards Him, He will greatly benefit you in appointed term; and give every doer of favour His favour; and I am fearful for you; from the punishment of the Great Day.
Return of all of you is towards Allah only, and He has Power over everything.

Be aware, these people are folding their hearts twice; that they may hide from the Prophet, then take note, Allah knows their apparent and hidden even when they wrap up in their clothes, and He knows secrets of all hearts.

And there is no creature on the earth whose sustenance is not on Allah, He knows the place where to give, and He knows their places and their destination (where they will be buried), and everything is secured in the manifest Book.

And that is He, Who created Skies and the earth in six days, and His Throne was over the water; so He tests you that who does the best deeds than others among you? And (O Prophet) if you may say: you will be raised again after your death, then these infidels will say it is only a manifest magic.

And if We delay their punishment for a certain period, then they will taunt: what has stopped the punishment? Be aware, the day when punishment will come, then it is not going to be averted, and that punishment will beset them from every side; of which they were making fun of.
And if We bestow Mercy on men and then takes it back from him, he becomes disappointed and ungrateful.
And after difficulty if he tastes the favour and comfort, then he says now our difficulties have gone and he becomes happy and starts boasting.
Except for those who believed, and have performed good deeds, there is forgiveness and great reward for them.

Then do you leave some part of Our revelation because you feel straitness in your heart that these people will say why the treasure was not sent on them or why no angel had come to them; so you are only the warner of the punishment of Allah, and Allah is responsible for everything and He oversees.

Do they say the Quran has been forged by man; then (O Prophet) say: you also forge ten chapters like this and bring if you are truthful in your talk; and you may call out to anybody for your help except Allah.
Then if they do not accept your offer, then know whatever has been revealed is the knowledge of Allah, and there is no god except Him, so now are you going to become Muslim?
Whoever wishes for the elegance of life of this world, We will reward them fully for their deeds here only, and We will not make any reduction.
And these are the people for whom there is nothing but Hell in the Hereafter, and whatever they have in the world has gone waste, and whatever they have been doing was worthless.

If the person is having explicit argument from his Lord; and also have witness to back him, and before that Book of Moosa is also testifying it, which was guide and mercy for the people; will he blame? Verily believers trust on this only, and there is Hell for those who deny it, so beware, do not have doubt on this Quran, this is truth from Allah, whereas most of them do not believe on this.

And who will be more unjust than who slander on Allah, these are the people who will be presented before Allah; and all the witnesses will testify that they were lying against Allah; then be aware that curses of Allah are on the unjust.
Who hinder from the path of Allah and try to create crookedness in it, these are the people who do not believe in the Hereafter and deny it.

These people cannot frustrate Allah on the earth, and neither do they have any protector or helper other than Allah; and their punishment will be doubled, they neither could hear the just talk on the earth nor they could see it.
These are the people who have put their souls in the loss; and whom they invented, have also disappeared.
Verily, they are going to bear a great loss in the Hereafter.
Verily, whoever believed and did good deeds and implored in the Court of his Lord, they are the people of Paradise, and will forever dwell in it.
The example of unbeliever and believer is like: who are blind and deaf, and who are seeing and hearing, are they equal if they are compared? Then where is your consciousness?
And We sent Nooh to his people with the message; that I am a warner for you from open punishment of Allah.
And that beware you, do not worship anyone except Allah, and that I have the fear of a painful punishment for you.

So elders of their people who adopted infidelity said, we have considered you a mortal like us; and we see your followers are simple and subjugated persons from among us, and we do not see your superiority over us; and we consider you a liar.
He replied, O People, what do you think, if I am having an argument from my Lord; and He bestows mercy on me which you could not see, so, can I impose this on you in spite of your dislike?

O People! I do not want any wealth from you, my reward is with Allah, and I cannot separate the believers also because they are going to meet their Lord, although I consider you a people who are ignorant.
O People! If I will drive them away, then who will be my helper from Allah, don't you have senses.

And I am not telling you that I have all the treasures of Allah, and neither I claim to know the unseen, nor I say, I am an angel, nor I say that Allah will not give good to them who are lower in your eyes, and only Allah knows their hearts well; if I will say this, I will be among the unjust.
They said O Nooh, you quarreled with us and you quarreled much, so now bring the thing what you have promised, if you are truthful in your promise.
Nooh said: If Allah pleases, He will bring it and you cannot frustrate Him.
And even if I wish to advise you, my advice will not work for you, if Allah wishes to leave you in misguidance, and that is your Lord and to whom you have to return.
Do they say, He has forged, then say: if I have forged, its guilt is on me, and I am free and clear of your crimes.
It was revealed to Nooh, none from your people will believe now except for those who have already believed; so do not grieve on their deeds.
Make an ark in front of Our Eyes under the guidance of Our revelation, and do not talk to Us regarding unjust people, they are all going to be drowned.

When Nooh was making the ark, whenever any party from his people passed from there they used to ridicule him, Nooh said: if you are ridiculing us today then tomorrow likewise we will ridicule you also.
Then shortly you will come to know that on whom punishment comes he becomes disgraced, and then punishment will be lasting one.

So much so when Our command came and water started gushing out from the oven ; We told Nooh to take two of every kind, a pair, and also take your family, except those against whom destruction has been decided, and also take the believers with you; and believers were a few.
Nooh said: now all of you board the ark, it will sail with the Name of Allah and it will also be anchoring, and Verily my Lord is all Forgiving and Merciful.
And Ark was sailing carrying them in the waves like mountain, Nooh called out to his son who was on a separate place: O my son, board the Ark with us and do not be among the infidels.

He (Nooh's son) said I will take shelter on mountain, which will save me from water, Nooh said: today nobody can be saved from the command of Allah, except on whom Allah shows His Mercy; then a wave came in between (and separated both of) them; and he became among the drowning ones.

And the command of Allah came that earth may swallow the water and sky may stop its water, then water receded and mission was completed, Ark rested on the Mountain of Judi, and came the sound that destruction is for the unjust nation.
And Nooh cried out O my Lord, my son is from me, and Your promise truth, and You are the best decider.

Came the reply: Nooh he is not from your family, his conduct is unrighteous; so do not ask from Me of which you do not have any knowledge, I give you counsel lest you may not be counted among ignorant.
Nooh said, O Allah, I seek your refuge from seeking something of which I do not have any knowledge, and if You will not forgive me and do not show Mercy, then I will be among the losers.

Said (Allah): Nooh, with peace and mercy from Us get down from the Ark, and blessings are on your people, and there are some nations whom We will give rest first, and then painful punishment will afflict them.
O Prophet! These are news of the unseen, which We reveal to you; whose knowledge neither you had nor your people; so now have patience, outcome is in the hands of pious people.
And We sent to the people of Aad, his brother Hood, he said O People, worship Allah, there is no god except Him, you people are only slanderers.
O my people! I do not ask you any price for this, my reward is with Him, Who have created me, so do you not then understand.

And O my people! Pray for forgiveness from your Lord, then repent in His Court then He will send heavy downpour from the sky, and will increase in your strength, and don't turn away from Him like guilty.
Those people said: You have not brought any proof, and we are not going to desert our gods on your saying and neither we are going to believe you.
We are only saying that one of our gods has made you insane, Hood said: Verily, I take Allah as witness and you also be my witness that I am free from your act of believing others except Allah.
So you plan against me and do not give me any respite.
Because I trust in Allah only who is my Lord and also your Lord; and the forelock of every walking creature on the earth is in His hand; and there is no doubt that only His path is right path.

Even then if you are turning your face; with that command I was sent to you; I have delivered to you that command, and (if you would not believe then) my Lord will bring another nation in your place; and you cannot harm Him in anyway, and my Lord is guardian over everything.
And when Our command came; then We delivered Hood and those who have believed with him, with Our Mercy and saved them from punishment.
These conditions are of the nation of Aad who denied the verses of their Lord and disobeyed messengers, and they followed the rebellious enemies of Allah.
And curses are on them in this world, and it will also be with them in the Hereafter, see, Aad's nation denied their Lord, and there is reprimand, for Hood's nation of Aad.

And We sent towards nation of Samood; his brother Saleh (as a prophet), so he said to his people: O my people, worship Allah only, there is no god except Him, He has created you from dust of earth and settled you in it, so ask for forgiveness from Him, and pray for repentance in His court, Verily my Allah is very near and listens and accept prayers.

They said: O Saleh! Before this we had expectations from you, now you deter us from worshipping of that, to whom our forefathers have worshipped, you call us to the religion which have put us in such a doubt, that we are astonished.

Saleh replied: O my people just see that I am on clear proof, from my Lord, He has bestowed upon me Mercy (prophethood) from His Court, even now if I disobey Him, then who will help me to save from His punishment, then you cannot increase anything except my loss.

O my people, this is the she-camel sent by Allah as a sign for my prophethood, set her free and let her graze anywhere in the land of Allah, and do not trouble her, otherwise, punishment will afflict you immediately.
Even then they killed her, Saleh said: now enjoy for three days in your homes (then you will be ruined), this is the promise which is never falsified.
Then, when Our command (punishment) came, so We delivered Saleh and those people who had believed with Our mercy and saved from disgrace of that day, undoubtedly your Lord is greatly Predominant.
Then the unjust became afflicted with a very mighty blast and were lying upside down in their homes.
As if they never lived there, so look, people of Samood disobeyed their Lord; listen properly, people of Samood are the rebuked people.
And angels who were sent by Us brought glad tidings to Ibrahim; they gave salutations and Ibrahim replied to their salutations, then immediately Ibrahim brought roasted meat of a calf.

And when he (Ibrahim) saw that they were not touching it; he became distrustful and started fearing from inside; they said: fear not, we have been deputed towards the people of Lut. (for their punishment).
And Ibrahim's wife (Sarah) was standing there, he laughed on hearing this news, then We gave her good news of Ishaq, and after Ishaq, of Yaqoob.
