She said: now will I deliver a child? I am old and my husband is also old, and this is very surprising news.
Angels said: you are wondering about the power of Allah? O people of the house (of prophet) may Allah's Blessings and Mercy be upon you, undoubtedly, He is worthy of Praise and He is Great.
When Ibrahim's fear had gone and he received the good news (of the child), then he started pleading with regard to the people of Lut with Us.
Verily Ibrahim was very tolerant and soft hearted, and he was always turning towards Allah.
O Ibrahim! Do not insist in this matter, the command of your Lord has certainly come, and undoubtedly such punishment is coming on them which cannot be averted.
When our angels came to Lut as young boys, with their thoughts he became sad and straiten at heart, and he said today's day is very hard and troublesome.

(Upon hearing the news of young boys) His people came running to him, before this also they were doing evil works, Lut said: O my people, there are my daughters (marry them), they are pure and allowed for you; don't disgrace me, about my guests, don't you have any sensible person among you?
They said: you know we do not have any requirement of your girls, and whatever we want, you know better.
Lut said: I wish I had strength to confront you or I could have taken refuge in a strong fort.

Angels said: O Lut, don't be afraid, we have been sent from your Lord, they can never reach you, after the passage of part of the night take your boys and wealth and leave from here; (and while going) do not turn your back to see, but your wife, who will Verily be afflicted with the same punishment which will befell on those people, and morning is for the promise (for their punishment), is not morning near?
When Our Command (punishment) came then We turned the surface of the earth of (that) town to its bottom and continuously rained on them stones of baked clay.
The signs of your Lord were engraved on them (stones), and that town is not far away from the unjust (infidels of Makkah).

And We sent to the people of Madyan, his brother Shoaib (as a messenger), he said to his people: O my people, worship Allah, there is no god except Him, and do not shorten the weight and measures, I am seeing you in prosperity, and I fear for the day of punishment which will encircle everybody.
O my people, keep measures and scales full; and do not give people their things less (in weight or measure), and do not create mischief in the land.
If you are true believers, then what remains with Allah is much better for you; and I am not any of your guardians.

They said: O Shoaib, does your prayer command that we should leave off whom our forefathers had worshipped, or we cannot spend our wealth as we want, and that you only have remained tolerant and sensible?

Shoaib said: O my people, I have clear proof from my Lord and He has given me sustenance, and I do not want to do the same in opposition to you from which I am preventing you; I only desire your correction; until possible and I do not want anything else, and nobody can verify me except Allah, I have trusted Him, and turns to Him only.

O my people, your opposition to me, may not make you guilty so that there may befall you affliction like of what befell the people of Nooh; or the people of Hood; or the people of Saleh; and people of Lut is not far away from you, you may take lesson from them.
And ask for forgiveness from your Lord only, then repent in His Court, Verily my Lord is very Kind and Loving.

Those people were saying: O Shoaib, whatever you say, much of it we don't understand, and certainly we consider you very weak among us, if your clan was not there we would already had stoned you, and you cannot dominate us.
O my people, you have more pressure of my clan than Allah? And you have put Allah behind you, Verily my Lord has encircled all over your deeds.

And O my people, you do whatever you want and I am doing mine, shortly you will come to know on whom punishment will befall, which will disgrace him and make clear who is liar, you also await, I am waiting with you.

And when Our command (of punishment) came, then with Our Grace We saved Shoaib and those who have belief with him; and those who were unjust were affected with a mighty blast, and they were lying upside down in their homes.
As if they have never dwelt here; be aware; for the nation of Madyan is also the same destruction as the nation of Samood was destroyed.
Verily, I sent Moosa with Our signs and clear proofs;
To Firaun and his chiefs, but they followed Firaun and did not listen to Moosa, however, the order of Firaun was not wise.
On the Day of Judgement, he will walk ahead of his people, and will lead them all to Hell, and how bad is that place.
And curses are behind them (in this world) which will follow them on the Day of Judgement also, and what a bad reward they got.
These are the conditions of some towns which We are describing to you, out of those some are still settled and some of them have been destroyed.

And We did not do any injustice to them, but they were unjust unto themselves, and when the command (of punishment) of your Lord came then those gods were of no use, whom they used to call instead of Allah; and neither those gods helped them, except destroying them. (they were punished because they worshipped false gods).
And (O Prophet), when your Lord grips people of towns because of their transgression; His grip is like this, Verily His grip is very painful and strong.

Undoubtedly, there is a sign in it for the person, who fears the punishment of the Hereafter, this will be the day when all the people (of the world) will be gathered; and this will be the day when everybody will be presented in Our Court.
And We are just delaying it until an appointed term.
When that day will come, then nobody will be able to speak without the command of Allah, and some of them will be unlucky and some will be lucky.
Those who are unlucky will be in Hell and there will be crying and wailing in it for them;
They will always remain there; as long as skies and the earth will be there, Verily, whatever your Lord pleases, He certainly does.
And whoever is lucky will be in Paradise, and they will always abide there, as long as skies and the earth will be there; but if your Lord pleases otherwise; this is His never-ending Gift.
Those who worship others except Allah, so you should not be in doubt, these people worship as their forefathers had worshipped, and We will give them their full share without any deficiency.

And We gave Moosa the book of Taurait, but they disputed that, and had your Lord not definitely decided earlier (to delay punishment), then matter had been decided between them, and these people (infidels of Makkah) are also in disquieting doubt about it (Quran).
And there is not an iota of doubt that your Lord will Verily (and suitably) reward them for their (whatever) deeds, because He is fully aware of their doings.
and (O Prophet), whatever you have been commanded for show perseverance in it, and those who have repented with you, they should not exceed, because Allah is Verily watching all their deeds.

And (O believers), whoever were unjust on themselves (by disobeying Allah), do not get inclined towards them, otherwise the fire of Hell will touch you also, and you have no Guardian except Allah; no one even can help you.
O Prophet! establish prayer in both part of the day and after passage of some part of night, because good acts Verily drive away evils, and it is an advice and lesson for those who remember Us.
And (O Prophet), be patient because Allah does not waste the good deeds.

Those who have passed by before you, why some of them were not sensible, who could have deterred people from spreading corruption. (there were such people, but very few), and those were they whom We saved (from punishment), and those who had disobeyed, they were enjoying plenty from what We have given them; and those were guilty people.
And your Lord was never such (unjust) that He will destroy the towns of which people have acted well.
And if your Lord please He could have made all people one Ummah, but Allah never uses coercion, that (because of this) they would always differ among them.
Only if your Lord shows Mercy, and He has created them for that, and because of this your Lord's definite command is completed, We will certainly fill the Hell, with the jinn and men.

And (O Prophet), We relate to you all the tales of previous messengers, to strengthen your heart; and in these tales have come the truth (Quran) for you and exhortations and reminders for the believers.
And (O Prophet), those who do not believe, say to them: you do your deeds and I am doing my deeds;
And you also wait (for result) and I am awaiting.

And all the knowledge of the unseen of skies and the earth is exclusive to Allah, and every work eventually returns to Him only, so worship Him and put your trust in Him, and whatever you do, Allah is not unaware of it.
Alif Laam Ra, these are the verses of explicit book.
We have revealed this book in Arabic language, so that you may understand.
(O Prophet), We relate you a very good tale by revealing Quran to you, however earlier you were totally unaware of it.
And remember that time, when Yusuf said to his father: O father, I saw (in dream) eleven stars, sun and the moon, I saw that they are all prostrating before me.
Yaqoob said: O (my) son, do not repeat your dream to your brothers; (or else) they will make deceitful plans for you, there is no doubt that Satan is open enemy of men.

And it will happen (as you have seen), your Lord will choose you and will teach you interpretation of dreams, and as He has completed his blessings before you on your forefathers, Ibrahim and Ishaq, similarly on you and children of Yaqoob He will complete His blessings, certainly your Lord is knowledgeable and wise.
(O Prophet), Certainly for those who ask there are signs of your prophethood, in the tale of Yusuf and his brothers.
(Yusuf's brothers) said: in spite of our majority; Yusuf and his brother (Benjamin) are more beloved to our father; there is no doubt that our father is in clear error.
(They said) Either kill Yusuf of throw him in some land, then attention of your father will turn towards you, then you will become righteous people.
One of them (Lavi) said: do not kill Yusuf, if you want to do this, then throw him in some blind well, some traveler may take him (with them).
They all said: O Father, what it is that you do not trust us with regards to Yusuf whereas we are his well-wishers.
Tomorrow, you send him with us so he might eat something and play and we will guard him.
(Yaqoob) said: It really saddens me that you take him (away); and I fear you become unaware of him and a wolf may tear and devour on him.
We are a big party, even then if wolf will devour him, then certainly we will be among the big losers.

When they took Yusuf with them, they decided to throw him in a blind well (and they did it), then We revealed to Yusuf: Do not get frightened; certainly, you will inform them about their (bad) deeds, and they wouldn't know.
They returned crying to their father at night.
And said: O Father, we went for a race and had left Yusuf to guard our goods, and in between a wolf came and devoured him, and however we may be truthful, but you will not believe us.

And they also brought shirt of Yusuf, with false blood on it; Yaqoob said: wolf has not devoured on him but you have forged the thing from your heart for your defense, then I have way of patience and thanks on what you describe, and I seek help from Allah only.

There comes a caravan and they sent their watercarrier to fetch water, he let down the bucket (in the well) and Yusuf sat in it, when he pulled it up he shouted wow there is a boy (in it), and they concealed Yusuf as a valuable investment, and Allah knew whatever they were doing.
When brothers of Yusuf became aware, they came forth and said: Yusuf is their slave, and they sold him for a few coins as they were already frustrated with Yusuf.

(They took Yusuf and reached Egypt and sold him for a hefty price) And of the people of Egypt who brought him and gifted him to his wife (Zulekha), and told her to keep him honorably, he might benefit us, or we might take him as son; and like this We made him powerful in Egypt, and that We teach him interpretation of dreams, and like this Allah is Predominant and Powerful but many of them do not know (Him).
And when Yusuf reached his youth We gave him command (prophethood) and knowledge, and We reward the good doers like this.

And the lady (Zulekha) in whose home Yusuf was living; wanted to get her illegitimate desire fulfilled from him and she closed all the doors, and lustily said: come forward, Yusuf said: Allah forbid, your husband is my master and he has kept me well, Verily the unjust never prosper.

And Zulekha had decided on her evil intention; had he not seen the argument of his Lord, he would also have inclined. (We saved him) that We keep away evil and indecency from him, Verily he was from Our sincere servants.

And both hastened towards the door, Zulekha (grabbed and) tore his shirt from behind; and both found Zulekha's husband standing on the door, she spontaneously said (to her husband) who has bad intention for your wife, his penalty is nothing but imprisonment or infliction of painful punishment.

Yusuf said: she herself had desired for me, and a person (an infant) from among household of Zulekha testified: 'if his shirt is torn from front than she (Zulekha) is truthful and he (Yusuf) is a liar;
And if his shirt is torn from behind then she (Zulekha) is liar and he (Yusuf) is truthful'.
When he saw his shirt torn from behind, he said to his wife: this is your guile, and no doubt that your guiles are big (and amazing).
He said (to Yusuf): turn away from this, and said to his wife: seek forgiveness because you are in error for all this.

And ladies of the city (of Egypt) started discussing that wife of Aziz (mighty one of Egypt - 'Aziz-e-Misr') is desirous of (illicit) relationship with her slave, Verily slave have entangled her in love. (but) we see her in clear error.

When Zulekha heard their taunts, she called them and arranged a banquet for them, and gave each of them a knife (and an orange and said: when he comes in front of you, cut and give him a piece of orange), and said to Yusuf: pass by in front of them, when ladies saw, they found him very handsome, and they all cut their hands, and said: by god he is not human but he is a noble angel.

Then Zulekha told the ladies: this is that because of whom you accused me, yes, Verily I wanted to get my desire from him, but he saved himself, but whatever order I am giving he did not comply, then Verily he will be imprisoned and will be in state of ignominy.

(On hearing all this Yusuf implored in My Court): O my Lord! I will prefer imprisonment over the demand of these ladies; if You will not deflect their deception from me, then (I fear) I may incline towards them; and be counted among the ignorant.
So his Lord heard him, and deflected the deception of the ladies from him, there is no doubt that He Hears and Knows.
Then in spite of witnessing the signs, they thought to imprison him for some time.

And along with Yusuf two other young men entered the prison. (After some days), one of them said I saw a dream that I am squeezing grapes to make wine, the second one said; I saw myself carrying bread on my head in a dream, which birds are devouring. (Yusuf) tell us its interpretation; we consider you from the good ones.

Yusuf said: before any food comes to you (in prison), I will interpret it that what food you will be getting, this (interpretation of dreams) is among other things which my Lord has taught me; I have left them behind who do not believe in Allah, and they also deny the Hereafter.

I follow the religion of my forefathers Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqoob, it is not appropriate for me to consider anybody partner with Allah, this is also one of the kindnesses of Allah - on us and on all people, but many of them do not thank also.
O my prison friends, just think who can be stronger, many gods or One God?

Alas! You are worshipping the names except Allah, who have been forged by your forefathers, Allah has not sent any proof for them, governance is just for Allah only, He has commanded that do not worship anybody except Him, this is the righteous religion, but many of the people do not know.

O my both friends of the prison. (now listen to interpretation): one of you (who saw grapes) will be the bartender of his master; another (who carried bread on his head) will be hanged, and birds will eat from his head; this is the matter of what you were asking which has already been decided.

And Yusuf said to the one who would be free, that to speak to his master regarding him (that he is imprisoned without any crime), and Satan made him forget to mention to his master, so Yusuf remained imprisoned for a few years.

During that period king saw a dream that there are seven healthy cows which are being eaten by seven lean cows, and he saw seven green ears (of grain) and later saw seven dried ears (of grain); he said: O chiefs of my court, if you can do the interpretation of dreams, then interpret my this dream.
They said, this is a confused dream and we do not know the interpretation of confused dreams.
Who was released recently (bartender) after a period he remembered (Yusuf) and said: let me go to prison, I will tell you (bring) its interpretation.

(At last he went to prison and said): O Yusuf, O truthful. (tell us the interpretation of this dream) that seven lean cows are eating to seven healthy cows, and seven ears (of grain) are there and seven dry ears (of grain) are there, so that I return (and describe) so they also know it (and your value also).
Yusuf said: (this is its interpretation) You will do farming for seven years continuously and whatever you reap save that with ears (do not break them), and do consume some of it.
Thereafter, there will come seven difficult years of drought, and you will consume whatever you have saved in (previous) seven years, except some which you will save for (further) sowing.
And after that one year will come when there will be good rain. (when there will be more grapes) and people will squeeze them for wine.

On hearing this interpretation, the king ordered to present Yusuf to him; when the messenger came to Yusuf (again), Yusuf said: you go to your master and ask him whether he knew something about the ladies who had cut their hands. (did I desired for them or they desired for me), no doubt that my Lord was well aware of their guile.

So, the king (gathered those ladies) and asked: when you wanted to get your desire fulfilled by Yusuf, what had happened? They all said: God forbid we did not see any evil intention from Yusuf, then (Zulekha) wife of Aziz (Aziz-e-Misr) said: now that the matter has come into light; fact is that I wanted to get my desire fulfilled from him; but Verily he is truthful.

(Messenger narrated this incident to Yusuf in prison, so Yusuf said: by this I just wanted) That king should know that I did not betray his trust in the absence of Aziz; and Allah never lets the guile of the people succeed.
And I do not consider my soul free from need, because soul always incite towards evil, but on whom my Lord shows Mercy, there is no doubt that my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.

King ordered to bring Yusuf to him so I will appoint him for my works, then, when he spoke to Yusuf (he realized value of Yusuf) and he ordered that from today you will hold a high and reliable position in my administration.
Yusuf said: appoint me on your treasures of land, because I am trustworthy and know its affairs also. (Yusuf was appointed as the imperial treasury officer).
And like this We empowered Yusuf in Egypt that he may live wherever he wants; We bestow Our Grace on whoever We please, and We do not waste the reward of the good doers.
Whosoever believed and continued their good deeds, for them reward of the Hereafter is much better than this.
(Since there was drought in Kanaan also) When (step) brothers of Yusuf came to Egypt to purchase grain, he recognized them, but they could not recognize him.

When Yusuf arranged grain for them (and they wanted to leave), he told them: next time when you come bring your stepbrother to me (whom you have left home), didn't you see that I am good in giving full measure, and also a good host.
Then if you will not bring him to me then you will not get any grain, and neither can you come near to me.
They said: We will request our father as soon as we reach there, and we will Verily do this work.
Yusuf said: keep their money in their bags, so when they will go back to their families, they will recognize it and they might come back again.

When they returned to their father, they said: O father, we have been prohibited from getting the grain again, so (next time) send our brother Benjamin (with us), so that we can bring the grain (again), and we will fully protect him.
Yaqoob said: Shall I trust you for him, like I have trusted you before for his brother (Yusuf)? (Anyway) Allah is his best protector, and He shows Mercy more than anybody else.

When they opened their luggage and they found their money was returned as it was. (they went to their father and said), O father, what else we want, our money has been returned to us; and we have also brought grain for our families. (now send Benjamin with us) we will protect him and will bring one load of camel more and what we brought this time was less, and his presence will make this easier.

Yaqoob said: Unless you will not make covenant in the name of Allah that you will bring him back without any harm, but only if you are surrounded in trouble yourself; I will not send him with you, then they made covenant that whatever they are saying Allah is witness to it.

And Yaqoob said to his sons: do not enter all together from one door, but enter (separately) from different doors, because I cannot avert the trouble which may befall on you from Allah; command is from Allah only and I have reposed my trust in Him; and all those who trust should trust in Him.

And when all the brothers entered (in Egypt) as per direction of their father, but Yaqoob could not avert the command of Allah which was to come, but there was a desire in his heart which he fulfilled in this way; because Verily We have given knowledge to him, but many of them does not know even this.
And when they reached Yusuf, he made his real brother sit beside him, and slyly told him: I am your brother; therefore, do not be sad about what they do.

When Yusuf asked to make their travel arrangement (grain, etc.). (on Yusuf's instruction) they hid a water bowl in the sack of his brother (Benjamin); then a crier challenged them: O people of caravan Verily you are thieves.
(On hearing this), they turned towards them and asked: what have you lost?
They said: we are not finding a bowl of the king, and I am responsible that whoever will bring that bowl I will give him a camel-load (of grain) as reward.
Then they said: By Allah we did not come to your land to create mischief, we are not thieves.
Then those servants asked if your lies are proved, what will be the punishment of the liar?
They (fearlessly) said, from whoever's sack the bowl is found, he will himself be the reward of that (he will be taken into slavery), we punish the unjust (thieves) in our land like this.

Yusuf, before searching his (real) brother's sack, he searched other brothers' sacks, and in the end, he took out bowl from his (real) brother's luggage, to withhold his brother We taught the planning to Yusuf; otherwise as per king's laws, he could not have withheld him, but only if Allah wills; (thus Benjamin was withheld) We raise the rank of whosoever we please; there is also all-knowing one above all the knowledgeable of the world.

They said: if he stole. (there is no surprise), before him his brother (Yusuf) had stolen, Yusuf concealed it in his heart (and did not reply) and did not disclose it to them, but he said that you are in an evil condition as what you describe for your brother.

They said: O Aziz (mighty one of Egypt - 'Aziz-e-Misr') his father is very old and love him very much; so retain one of us instead (as slave, and let him go); because we consider you as great doer of good deeds.
Yusuf said: Allah forbid, how can we withheld someone else other than from whose sack the bowl was found, if we do this we will be considered unjust.

When they were disappointed by Yusuf, they stepped aside for discussion privately among them; eldest among them said: O brothers, don't you know that our father has taken covenant in the name of Allah from us, and before this what mistake you have done about Yusuf, unless my father does not allow or Allah command Himself, I won't leave this land, and Allah is best to command.
You return to father and inform him that your son stole, and the covenant we had to bring him back, but we were not the guardian of the unseen.
You may ask the people of the land in which we were, and also from the people of caravan with which we travelled that we Verily are truthful.

(When they went back and described) Yaqoob said: (he did not steal) but you forged it with your heart, so I have patience and thanks Allah, I hope Allah will cause to reach to me all my sons, Verily He is knowing and Wise.
And Yaqoob turned his face from them and said weeping: Alas! Yusuf, and cried so much that his eyes turned white with sadness; and he was a great suppresser of the grief.
His sons said: You always remember Yusuf so much that you may fall sick or you might die.
Yaqoob said: (I do not say anything to you), I complain of uneasiness and sadness to my Allah, and whatever I know from Allah, you do not know.
O my sons! Go (to Egypt again) and find and bring Yusuf and his brother, and do not be hopeless from the mercy of Allah, because nobody becomes hopeless from the mercy of Allah except infidels.

When they went to Yusuf again (third time) they said: O mighty one (of Egypt - 'Aziz-e-Misr') we and our families are facing difficulties due to drought, and we have brought some money, ask them to give us full grain, and not only in exchange of money, but as charity and alms also, Verily Allah reward those who do charity.
(Now Yusuf could not control and said) You know what you have done to Yusuf and his brother when you were ignorant.

(They were surprised on hearing this and) said: are you our brother Yusuf? (Said Yusuf) Yes, I am Yusuf and this is my brother, Verily Allah bestowed Mercy on me and Verily whoever fears Him and has patience (on difficulties), so Allah never waste the reward of such people.
They said certainly Allah gave you superiority over us and Verily, we were completely at fault.
Yusuf said: Now from today there is no blame on you, Allah may forgive you, Allah is Merciful than anyone else.
Take my shirt and go and put it on the face of (our) father so he will be able to see, and come (back) to me with all your family members.
As soon as the caravan started from Egypt, then their father (Yaqoob) said, if you don’t consider me weak (from mind), I can feel the smell of Yusuf.
They said: By Allah, you are still in the same old error.

Then came the giver of good news, and put the shirt on his face, and Yaqoob immediately regained his eyesight; then Yaqoob told his sons: did not I was saying whatever matter I know from Allah, you don't know.
They said: O father, pray for our forgiveness (in the Court of Allah), we are totally at fault.
Yaqoob said: very soon I will pray to Allah for your forgiveness, undoubtedly, He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
When those people (Yaqoob and his clan reached and Yusuf came out to receive them) reach to Yusuf, he made them sit beside him and said: if Allah pleases, now enter peacefully in Egypt.

Finally he made them sit on the throne, and they all fell in prostration before him in his honor, he said, O father, this is the interpretation (of my dream) which my Lord has made it come true; Verily He did do favor to me, when He delivered me from prison, in spite of Satan created mischief between me and my brothers, He brought you people from village (to me in the town); Verily my Lord plans well for whatever He pleases to do; indeed, He is Knowing and Wise.

(Later Yusuf prayed) O my Lord, You also granted me kingdom, you also taught me interpretation of dreams, O Creator of skies and the earth, You are my Master and my Guardian in the world and in the Hereafter; let me die as a Muslim and count me with the righteous ones.
(O Prophet), this tale is from the unseen, which we sent to you as revelation (and you come to know), when Yusuf's brothers were discussing among themselves and planning (to kill him).
You were not present there, and how much you may say, but most of the people are not going to believe.
However, you do not ask for any reward (for propagation of prophethood); and this (Quran) is admonition for the entire world.
And there are many signs in the skies and the earth which they pass by (day and night), but they turn their face from it.
And such is the condition of most of the people that they don't believe in Allah but they make out His partners.
Are they satisfied that punishment of Allah befalls on them and become cover over them; or suddenly the Day of Judgment comes on them without any notice.

O Prophet say: my way is to call (the people) towards Allah, I and my followers (both) are on strong arguments, and Allah is pure and purer (from all defect and deficiency) and I am not from polytheists.

(O Prophet), before you also We have sent some village dweller men (as messengers), on whom We sent revelations; so didn't these people who walk on the land ponder that what happened to those who had passed by; and those who guarded themselves (from sins), reward of the Hereafter for them is comparatively better (than this world), don't they understand?

(Earlier messengers propagated so much) that when they were disappointed (because people didn't believe them) and they understood that they have been denied, Our help reached them; and We delivered whosoever We pleased; and Our punishment cannot be averted from the sinners.

Undoubtedly, in their tales there are lesson (and advice) for the knowledgeable people, this (Quran) is not any narrative which can be forged, rather it confirms the earlier books, and it describes everything and for believers it is guidance and mercy.
Alif Laam Meem Ra, these are the perfect verses of the Book which your Lord has revealed to you, but most of the people do not believe.

That is Allah which have raised the skies without any pillar which you see; He is firmly established on Throne; and He made sun and the moon to obey Him, that they rotate for fixed period, He regulates all affairs of the world and describes His verses with details so that you may believe that (one day) you will be presented before your Lord.

He is Allah who spread the earth and established mountains on it, and made rivers to flow, and made pairs of fruits, and covers the day with the veil of night, and signs are found in it for the people who ponder.

And different pieces of land which are adjacent to each other; and gardens of grapes are there and farming and date trees, some of them have two branches and some of them have single branch; and all of them are irrigated with one water; and We give preference to some fruits over some fruits for eating; and in it signs are also found for the wise people.

If you wonder (on anything), then you should wonder, on saying of infidels that 'after mingling with dust how we will come to life again', these are the people who disbelieved in Allah, and there will be shackles in their necks (on the Day of Judgement), these are the Hellish people and shall abide in it forever.

And (O Prophet) they ask you for hastening on the evil before good; however, many punishments had earlier befallen earlier (on many people), and Verily your Lord is very Forgiving, in spite of people's injustice, and undoubtedly your Lord is giver of severe punishment also.
And these infidels say why does not any sign come to them; then say: you are only a warner; and there is a guide for every nation.
And Allah knows what is in the womb of a woman, and what things continue to decrease or continue to increase in her womb, and before Him everything is with a fixed measure.
He knows the hidden and the obvious, and He is the Great and Most High.
Anyone among you who calls upon Him silently or loudly, and who has hidden himself in the darkness of night, and is walking in daylight, everything is the same for Him. (He hears all and sees all).

(You may be in any condition), there are forces angels are appointed as guardians to protect him from front and from the back by His command; and He does not change condition of a people unless they themselves change; and when Allah decides to punish somebody then nobody can avert it and neither they do have any guardian except Him.
It is Allah who shows lightnings and creates water-laden heavy clouds as warning and luring.

Thundering repeats His praise, and angels continue praising Him with His fear, and when He sends lightning, it strikes to whoever He pleases; and they talk for Allah with crookedness; whereas He has strong power and has mighty strength.

Calling is call to Allah only; and those people who call to others except Allah, nothing will be accepted from them; it is like the person who stretches his palm towards water that it may reach his mouth, but it will never reach, and prayers of infidels are always in misguidance.
All of the beings of skies and the earth are prostrating for Allah either willingly or unwillingly, and morning and evening their shadows are also prostrating.

{Prostrate, Non-Obligatory} O Prophet, ask: who is the Lord of skies and the earth? And inform them, that is only Allah, and say: to whom you adopt leaving Allah, they are neither beneficial nor harmful even for themselves, and ask (them): can blind and seeing-one be alike; or can light and darkness be equal; or whom they consider partner of Allah have they created a similar world, and (Our) creation have become doubtful (for them), say: only Allah has created everything; He is the One and Predominant over all.

He rains water from the sky, then watercourses flow according to their measure; and it created waves in deluge and foam was formed, and foam formed from the metal which was melted in fire to make ornaments and other things; like this Allah describes the just and the unjust; foam dries and vanish away, and whatever is beneficial for mankind remains on the land; and likewise Allah describes the examples.

Those who accept the words of Allah, there is good for them, those who do not accept His words, if they get all the treasures of the world, and they get similarly more, and they give everything as ransom; but their reckoning will be the worst, and their place is Hell, and it is a very evil place.
Can the person who knows whatever has been revealed to you from the Lord is the truth, be like him who is blind? (Never, but) Only wise-ones would understand.
Those who honor the covenant with Allah, they never break the covenant.
Those who maintain such relations which have been commanded by Allah and are fearful of Him and fear the severe reckoning.

And those who had patience for the Will of Allah and established prayer; and (in the way of Allah) spends openly and secretly from the sustenance given by Us; and repels evil with good; abode of the Hereafter is for them only.

These are the everlasting gardens, in which they will enter, and along with them from among their forefathers, ancestors, spouses and children the good servants (of Allah) will enter; and angels will be at their service from every door.
They will say: salutations to you that you had patience, now abode of the Hereafter is your best destination.
And those who break covenant, and breaks the relation from those, with whom they were commanded to maintain the relation, and create mischief in the land, for them there is curses and evil abode.

Allah amplifies or straitens the sustenance for whom as He pleases; these people are happy on the life of this world; whereas in comparison to the Hereafter life of this world is a temporary enjoyment, and that's it.
And infidels say why do not signs of their choice come to them, O Prophet say: to whoever Allah wills leave him in misguidance; and He guides those who turn to Him.
These are the people who believed, and their hearts get satisfied with the remembrance of Allah, and be aware that satisfaction is with remembrance of Allah only.
Those who believed and did good works, for them is the best place (Paradise) and best return.

Likewise, We sent you among a people where many a people have passed, so that you recite the things which We sent you through revelation, however, they will deny the Merciful, you say: He is my Lord and there is no god except Him, I rely on him and to Him is our return.

If there is such Quran which can move mountains from their place, or can be travelled on the land, or dead can be talked with. (this is that Quran), however, all the affairs are for Allah, does it not became clear to the believers; that if Allah pleased He would have guided all the people; and on these infidels troubles of some kind or other will continue to befall them because of their deeds; or troubles shall befell on their region; until the time of promise of Allah comes, because Allah never does against His promise.
O Prophet! Before you, many prophets were mocked at, We gave small respite to the infidels, and thereafter took them in Our grip, so what a severe punishment it was.

That is He Who watches the deeds of every soul; and they have forged partners for Him, then say: tell the names of His partners, you are informing Him about His partners, about whom He does not have any news in the whole land, these are only the words. (whereas) fact is that their planning has been decorated for them, and they have been barred from guidance, and to whom Allah does not guide, nobody can guide him.
There is punishment for them in the life of this world also, and punishment of the Hereafter is even more severe, and then there is no one to save (them) from Allah.

The Paradise, which the pious people have been promised, will be like this, that beneath which rivers will be flowing, and its fruits will be permanent; and shadow will be everlasting; such is the end of the pious ones, and the end of the infidels is Hell.

And to whom We gave the book they are happy with its revelation, and there are some groups which deny some part of it, so say: I have been ordained to worship Allah, and not to make anybody His partner, and to Him I invite (you), and to Him is the return of everybody.
And thus We revealed the Quran as command in Arabic language, and after receiving knowledge if you will follow their desires; so there will not be any guardian and defender against Allah.

Before you, We have sent many messengers and given wives and children to them, and it is not possible for any messenger that without command of Allah he can bring any sign, and for every period and term there is decree (from Allah).
And whatever Allah pleases He erases or maintains, that the real Book is with Him only.

And O Prophet, whether We show you Our promise of punishment of infidels, or may cause death to you; your mission is only to deliver the command (of Allah), and their accounting is Our responsibility.
Didn't they see how We reduce the land from all directions (with victory of Islam), and only Allah gives the command, no one can avert His command, and He is swift in taking account.

And those who were before them Verily did they plan, but reward for their planning is with Allah, He is aware of the deeds of every soul, shortly infidels will also know that good of the Hereafter is for whom.
And (O Prophet), infidels say that you are not a Prophet, so say: Allah and the person who has knowledge of the Book is sufficient for witness between me and you.

Alif Laam Ra. (O Prophet) this Quran is the Book which We have revealed to you so that with the command of Allah you bring the people out of darkness of infidelity to the light of believing; guide them to the path of that Who is Predominant and worthy of Praise.
Allah is that who is the owner of whatever is in the skies and on the earth (means everything), but alas! there is severe punishment for the infidels.
Those infidels who prefer life of this world over the Hereafter, and hinder people from the path of Allah, and wants to create crookedness in it, these are the people who are in utter misguidance.

And We did not send any prophet to the people but who spoke their language, so that he may explain Our commands to them, Allah leaves in misguidance to whoever He pleases, and guides to whoever He pleases; and He is Predominant over everybody and Wise.

And We sent Moosa with Our signs. (and ordained him) to bring his people from darkness (of infidelity) to the light (of believing); and remind them of those days (wherein Allah's sent down His blessings), there is no doubt that there are many signs (of Allah) in it for those who are patient and are thankful.

And remind them the time when Moosa said to his people: remembers the favors of Allah, when He delivered you from the people of Firaun who subjected you to severe torture, he was slaying your sons but spared your women (for his service), and in it there was great trial (of your patience) from your Lord.
And (remember) when your Lord told you: If you are grateful, Verily, I will increase My favors, and if you will be ungrateful then certainly My punishment is severe.
And Moosa told his people: if you and all the people of the earth will be ungrateful to Allah. (even then) He is Self-Sufficient and Praiseworthy.

Didn't the news of the earlier people reach you. (as) people of Nooh, Aad and Samood. (and other) who came after them, nobody knows them except Allah, messengers came to them with miracles; but these people thrust their hands into their mouth and said: you say you have been sent by Allah but we do not believe; and we are in deep doubt, towards the religion you invite us.

Their prophets said: you are doubting Allah who has created the skies and the earth, and also he calls you towards Himself so that He forgive your sins, and allow you to remain in the world till an appointed time, they said: you are a mortal like us, you want us to leave the gods whom our forefathers had worshipped, if you are truthful than bring and show us any open and explicit miracle.

Their prophets said in their reply: there is no doubt that we are mortals like you, but among his servants Allah shows His Grace to whoever He pleases (and bestows prophethood); and we do not have authority to bring any miracle except the command of Allah, and all the believers should rely on Allah.

And what is in it that we should not believe because certainly He has shown us the way (of deliverance), and whatever persecution we have tolerated from you (we were patient on it), and in future also we shall be patient; and those who trust, should trust upon Allah only.

And who adopted infidelity they said to prophets (of their time) we will Verily expel you from our land, until you come back to our religion, their Lord revealed to them (don't be afraid) We will certainly destroy the transgressors;
And after them, Verily, We will settle you in this land; this promise is for him who is afraid to stands (to give account to Us); and who fears from (Our) punishment.
And prophets prayed to us for their victory, and every hostile and transgressor was disappointed;
And immediately after that there is Hell and in it they will be given water mixed with pus and blood to drink.

And sip by sip he will have to drink it; and he will not be able to swallow it down his throat easily; and he will see death coming from everywhere, but he will not be able to die, and immediately thereafter the punishment will become severe.

And those who have denied their Lord, their example is such, that their deeds are like a heap of ash, and on one stormy day a strong wind will blow it away, and whatever they did in the world nothing will be in their control; and this is utter misguidance.
Didn't you notice that Allah has created the skies and the earth prudently, and if He pleases He can destroy everything and settle new creation;
And this is not difficult for Allah.

And they will all come out in front of Allah on the Day of Judgement, the weak will say to those who were arrogant in the world: we had walked along with you so now can you avert some part of punishment of Allah from us, they will reply: we wish Allah would have guided us, so we also would have guided you, whether we are patient or restless, it is same for us, because we cannot escape from punishment of Allah.

When their end fate will be decided (they will blame Satan), so Satan will say: Allah has promised to you was truth (which is completed), and I have also promised you but I have breached my promise, and I had no authority on you, but only I invited you towards bad deeds and you obeyed me, so don't blame me now, blame on your soul, today neither I can help you nor you can help me; and before also I hate you that you made me partner with Allah; Verily there is painful punishment for those who are disobedient.

And those who believed and did good deeds, they will enter in to the gardens of Paradise beneath which rivers will be flowing and with the command of their Lord they will forever abide in it, and gift of their meeting will be salutation.
(O Prophet), didn't you see that Allah has likened goodly saying with goodly tree, whose root is strong, and its branches are reaching sky.
With the command of Allah this tree bears fruits at all times, and Allah describes examples for the people so they may take advice and learn.
And the example of evil sayings is with the evil tree (whose root is weak) which is on the ground and it should be uprooted because it does not have stability.
Those who believed on sure talk, Allah will certainly make them stand firm in this world as well as in the Hereafter, and Allah leaves transgressors in misguidance, and Allah do whatever He pleases.
(O Prophet), didn't you ponder on their condition who were ungrateful on Our favours and they pushed their people in the pit of destruction;
And they all went to Hell, and what an evil place it is.
And they have made similar gods; so that they deviate people from His path, say: enjoy (for a few days) eventually you have to return to Hell.

(O Prophet), tell My servants who believed: to keep up prayer, and spend from the sustenance given by Us. (in the way of Allah, whether) openly or secretly; before the establishment of the Day of Judgement where trading, friendship or love - nothing will be of any use.

That is the only Allah Who has created skies and the earth, and rained water from the sky and (through different trees) created fruits for your sustenance; and made ships subservient for you, that they sail on water from His command, and gave you authority over the rivers.
And made the sun and moon subservient to you that they always circulate; and also gave night and the day under your control.
And whatever you asked from Him, He gave you, you cannot count the favors of Allah even if you wish to, Verily mankind is unjust and ungrateful.
And (remember the time) when Ibrahim prayed: O Lord, make this city (Makkah) a place of peace, and save me and my children that we may not worship idols.
O my Lord, Verily these idols have misguided many, and whoever follow me is from me and who disobey me. (then) you are all forgiving and Merciful.

O my Lord, I have settled leaving some of my family near your Holy Home in a deserted field, that O my Lord, they may make up prayer regularly, You make some people's hearts inclined towards them. (so they may also come and settle here), and bestow upon them different fruits so they may be grateful to You.
O my Lord, You are well aware of whatever we conceal and whatever we show, neither anything in skies nor on earth is hidden from Allah.
Thanks to Allah, who increased me by giving me two sons; Ishaq and Yaqoob, there is no doubt that Allah Hears the prayers.
O my Lord, make me and my children obligated in prayer and O my Lord accept our supplication.
O my Lord, on the day of accounting forgive me, my parents and all the believers.
Never think that Allah is oblivious to deeds of infidels; (punishment did not befall just because), Allah have given them respite till on the day when their eyes will freeze.
They will be running holding their heads; and their eyes will not return to them (they will be fixedly staring), and their hearts will be gasping void.

And (O Prophet), warn the people of the day, when punishment will befall them, then they will implore O my Lord give us some more respite, we will definitely respond upon your call and will follow the prophet; (they will get the reply); are not you the same people who used to swear that there is no downfall for you;
Are not you those people who were unjust unto yourselves (by disobeying Allah), and you also stayed in their homes, whereas you had known how We dealt with them, and We told (you) examples also.
And the people continued their plotting; however, their plotting was watched by Allah, so strong were their plotting that the mountain will move from their place.
Never think that Allah will ever promise against his prophet; Verily Allah is strong avenger.
The day when the earth will be changed with another earth and likewise skies (will also be changed with new skies); and everyone will stand in their places before One (and only) Conqueror Allah.
And on that day, you will see that sinners will be tied up in chains.
Their garments will be made of pitch, and fire will cover their face from every side.
Allah will reward everyone (whether good or bad), Verily Allah is very swift in taking account.

This (Quran) is a kind of information, so the people may be warned (from punishment of Allah) from it, so they should trust that Allah is the only Lord; so those who are wise should take advice from it (and also lesson).
Alif Laam Ra, these are (few) verses of the book (of Allah) and Quran.
(A Day will come when) most of those who are infidels will think, we wish we would have been Muslims.
(O Prophet) leave them as they are; that they may eat and enjoy (life of the world for a few days) and let their desires keep them busy in play.
Shortly they will know its result, we have not destroyed any town but its term appointed was already written.
No nation can go ahead or go back before its appointed time.
(O Prophet, these infidels) say: O you on whom the Quran has been revealed, you are insane.
And if you are truthful in your saying, why don't you bring angels in front?
We send angels openly for judgement with the punishment, and if the angels come (to them) then they will not get any respite.
Certainly, We revealed Quran, and We are its Guardian.
(O Prophet) before you also we sent many prophets for earlier nations.
No prophet came to them, but they mocked at them.
(As if) we put the misguidance, in the hearts of sinners.
These infidels will not believe Quran, and this has been method of earlier people also.
And if open even one gate of the sky and they ascend to it;
Yet they will say our eyes may have been distracted (hypnotized), and we have been magicked upon.
And only We created constellations in sky and for the watchers, decorated it (with stars).
And safeguarded them from the passing of every accursed Satan.
But if any Satan hear them slyly, then flame of a shooting star drives them away.
And spread the earth and fixed it with the anchors of Mountains and grew on it all the appropriate things.
And in it created all things for life, and (for animals also) to whom you do not give sustenance.
We have got innumerable treasures of everything, and We send from it in ascertainable quantity.
And we sent winds which fill clouds with water, then We rained down the water from the sky, then We gave you that water to drink, and you had not stored it.
And there is no doubt that We give life and We give death, and then We are the Heir.
And We have known the people who have gone by and We also know the people who will come.
And undoubtedly your Lord is that who will bring them to life (from the graves on the Day of Judgement), and He knows and is Wise.
Verily, We created man from waste clay, which gives tinkling sound (upon drying).
And We created jinn earlier than man, from smokeless fire.
And (O Prophet) remember the time when your Lord told the angels that from kneaded clay when it will make tinkling sound I am going to create a man.
And when will I complete it from all sides and breathe in him My Spirit; then all of you fall down before him in prostration.
So all the angels fell down in prostration (before him).
Except Iblis, he refused to be among those who prostrated.
(On this Allah) said: O Iblis what has happened to you that you were not among those who prostrated?
He said: I am not such a lowly that I will prostrate before a man whom you have created from waste mud which makes a tinkling sound.
(Allah) said: get out from the Paradise, Verily you are accursed.
And Verily curses shall be on you, till the day of reward.
(Iblis) said: give me the respite till the day (when You raise the people again).
Allah replied: you have been given respite.
Till the day of Appointed Time.
(Iblis) said: O my Lord, you have separated me from the path; I will also decorate the materials (of bad deeds) for your servants, and shall misguide them.
Except your pure servants.
Allah said: this is the straight path which reaches Me.
You shall not have any control over my pure servants, but those who will be misguided shall follow you.
And for all of them the final promise is Hell.
Which have seven gates and separate groups shall enter from them.
And Verily pious ones shall be amidst the gardens and rivers of Paradise.
They will be commanded to enter into it with peace and security.
Whatever sadness will be in their hearts, we shall remove all; they will be sitting on the couches, face to face with each other like brothers.
None of the trouble will touch them, and they shall never be expelled from it.
O Prophet! Inform my servants that I am very Forgiving and Merciful.
But remember at the same time Verily my punishment is also very painful.
Inform them about the guests of Ibrahim.
When they came they gave a salutation, Ibrahim replied and said: I am apprehensive of you.
They said: do not be apprehensive of us; we consider you a learned one, and we are giving you glad tiding of a son to you.
Now you are giving good news (of a son), when the old age has reached me, so of what then you give me good news.
They said: we have given you correct good news, so do not be hopeless (in the Court of Allah).
Ibrahim said: who else can be hopeless from the Mercy of Allah except the misguided ones.
Then Ibrahim said: O angels on what mission you are?
They said: We have been sent towards misguided people (with punishment).
For the family of Lut – that we will save them all.
Except for his wife, whom we have targeted, and she will Verily stay back (with those who will be in punishment).
When the angels came to the family of Lut.
Lut said: you look strangers to me.
Angels said: rather we have come to you with (punishment) for which your people were in doubt.
And we have come to you with the definite command of punishment, and we are truthful.
So when night remain a little take your children and move and you walk in their rear, and nobody should turn their back and see; and go to (the place) for which you have been commanded.
And We informed Lut about Our definite command that by the dawn their roots will be cut.
And (upon hearing news of the guests) people of the city came to them celebrating.
Lut said: they are my guests; and do not defame me by troubling them.
Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.
Why? had not we forbidden you from any guest?
Lut said: if you want to do anything, daughters of my people are there (marry them).
(O Prophet), by your soul, these people (people of Lut) were intoxicated in their madness
However, before sunrise Lut left and a mighty blast took them away.
Then We turned the surface of the earth of (that) town to its bottom and continuously rained stones of baked clay on them.
There is no doubt that for the people who understand the talk, there are many signs of Authority in it.
And that (town which was punished) is the pathway for people to traverse on it.
There is not any doubt that for believers there is a big sign (of authority of Allah) in it.
And people of Aika i.e. woods (people of Shoaib), were transgressors like people of Lut.
So We required from them also (for their disobedience), and these two towns are still existing on the main passageway.
(And likewise) dwellers of Hijr (people of Saleh) also denied prophets.
We gave them Our signs; but in spite of that they continued in their turning away from them.
And diligently they carved the mountains and made their homes.
(But) at last near the dawn a mighty blast took them away.
And whatever planning they were doing for their security was of no use to them.
And We created skies and the earth and whatever is in between (them) with truth, and the Day of Judgement will Verily come; so you (O Prophet) overlook fault of infidels with gracious forgiveness.
Certainly, your Lord is a great Creator and Knower.
Verily, We have given you oft-repeated seven verses and Great Quran.

And We have made some infidels happy (with the wealth of the world), don't even see them, and nor even feel sorry for them (on their infidelity), and meet politely with believers (even if they are poor).
Say: I am an explicit warner. (from the punishment of Allah).
(O Prophet, We will punish infidels as); Like We punished the dividers.
Who divided the Quran in parts.
(O Prophet) By your Lord, We will definitely question them.
For what they were doing.
Whatever you have been commanded, explain clearly, and turn your face away from the infidels.
We are enough, for those who scoff (at you).
Those who make partners with Allah, they will understand shortly.
We are aware that you feel straitness in your chest because of their talk.
So celebrate the praise of your Lord and be among those who prostrate in His Court.
And until death reaches you, continue to worship your Lord.
Command of Allah has come, so do not ask for haste unnecessarily, Allah is Pure and Exalted and free from their polytheism.
Among His servants He sends revelation with His command on whosoever He pleases so that they should warn the people that there is no god except Me, so therefore fear Me only.
That is He Who has created skies and the earth with truth, He is Exalted from those partners which they make for Him.
He created humans with sperm; then suddenly he becomes a manifest opponent.
He also created cattle, their skin (and wool) is for you, which is goods for winter, and there are other benefits also, and you eat some of them.
Because of them there is brilliance in your life, when you take them home at dusk after grazing, and when you take them for grazing in the morning.
And to the cities you could not had reach without difficulty, these cattle carry your loads there; most Verily your Lord is most Compassionate and Merciful.
And He created, horses, mules and donkeys, that you may ride on them, and as use of show; and creates other things also which you do not know.
Guidance to the straight path is on Allah only; but some of the paths are crooked, and if Allah pleased, He might have reached you all to the destination.
That is He, Who rained water from the sky which you drink, and trees (pastures) become fresh in which you graze your cattle.
From this water He grows for you farming, olive and dates and all types of fruits; there is not any doubt that in it is a great sign (of Power of Allah), for those who ponder.
He made night and day, sun and moon subservient to you; and stars are also by His command obey you, there is not any doubt that in it are many signs (of Power of Allah) for those who ponder.
And different colorful things which have been created for your benefit; undoubtedly there is great sign (of Power of Allah) for those who wish to get advice and lessons.

And that is Allah who made the rivers and the seas subservient to you, so you may consume fresh meat of fish, and you get ornaments from it which you wear; and you see ships which rip through water and traverse on sea; and made them subservient to you so you go in search of His bounty (business); and that you be thankful.
And that is He, Who fixed heavy mountains on the earth so that it may not move from its place (and you are unable to stand on it); and created rivers and ways that you may reach your destinations.
And created many signs (on the ways); and by the stars many people find their ways.
Can such Creator be equaled with those who cannot create anything; can't you understand even this?
You cannot count the Blessings of Allah, even if you wish; Verily He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
Whatever you do openly or secretly, Allah knows everything.
And those who call others for their needs, leaving Allah, they cannot create anything.
And they themselves are lifeless, even they do not know when they will be raised again.
Your Lord is One only, and who do not believe on the Day of Judgement; denial is from their hearts, and they are arrogant.
Whatever they do secretly and whatever they do openly, Allah knows it Verily, and He does not like those who are arrogant.
And when they are told what is that your Lord has revealed; they say: it is (nothing but) only the tales of earlier ones.
(Let them say); On the Day of Judgement, they will carry the load of their sins and the load of sins of those whom they have misguided without knowledge; look, what a bad load they are carrying.

Verily, those who were before them also plotted, so (command of) Allah uprooted the foundation of their mansions and roof fell upon them, and they did not realize from which side the punishment had come.

Thereafter, on the Day of Judgement Allah will disgrace them; and will say: (now say) where are they, to whom you made My partner, and regarding whom you fought with the believers, and on that day who have been given knowledge will say: today, disgrace and evil, all is for the infidels.

They are those people, when angels extract their soul, so those who were unjust to themselves, seems ready for obedience, will say: we were not doing any evil, then angels will reply: whatever you did, Allah is well aware of it.
Now enter the gate of Hell and shall remain there forever, what an evil place it is for those who are arrogant.

And when the pious people are asked what have your Lord revealed, they say: everything better than the best, those who did good deeds; there is good for them in this world and in the Hereafter (also) their abode is better, and what an excellent abode is that for the pious ones;

They will reach without hesitation in the evergreen gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, for whatever thing they will desire will be presented (to them), like this Allah will bestow the reward upon the pious ones.

When angels come to take the souls of those who are pure (from infidelity); they spontaneously give salutation and say: in reward for your good deeds that you had been doing in the world. (without hesitation) enter Paradise.

(O Prophet), are they waiting that angels come to them to extract their souls, or punishment of your Lord comes to them, people of earlier times also had talked like this; Allah had not been unjust to them, but they were unjust to themselves (because of their infidelity).
And whatever they were doing, they got an evil reward for that; and that (punishment) gripped them from every side, of which they were making fun.

And polytheists say: if Allah pleased, we would not have worshipping anything except Him, nor our forefathers; nor would we have forbidden anything without His permission; those who have gone by. (had also) done such talk; (so let them say); prophets' responsibility is only to deliver His commands clearly, and nothing else.

And We Verily sent a prophet for each nation; so that they tell them to worship Allah and desist from (worshipping) idols; to some of them Allah guided and some of them remained in misguidance, so you travel in the land and see (for yourself) what was the end of those who denied (prophets of Allah).
(It is no use) if you desire to bring them to the right path, because Allah will never guide the person whom He has left in misguidance, and nobody will help him also.

These infidels by all swearing on Allah say: those who die, Allah will not raise them again. (O Prophet) say: Verily Allah will do this; it is imperative on Him to complete his promise, but most of the people do not know this.
In the matter they were quarreling that will be explained before them, so the infidels should know that they were liars.
When We intend to create something, Our saying is that only, We say to it, Be, and that becomes spontaneously.

And those who tolerated persecution and migrated in the way of Allah; shortly We shall bestow upon them best place in the world; and reward of the Hereafter is Verily much greater; wish they were aware of this reality;
These are the people who were patient and trust their Lord.
And (O Prophet), before you we sent men as prophets to whom We revealed, so say: If you do not know, ask them who know.
We sent prophets with the miracles and books, and to you also We revealed the Book, so that you explain the commands which have been sent for them, perhaps they may ponder over it.
Are those who do plotting have become satisfied (from punishment) Allah may cause the earth to swallow them, or punishment comes to them and they do not understand.
Or they are confident that He will not catch them while they are walking, they cannot humble Allah.
Or they are confident that Allah will not catch them slowly? Your Lord is Compassionate and All-Merciful.

Did they see something among the creations of Allah, whose shadow sometimes turns left and sometimes turns right as if they fell in prostration before Allah and they are expressing their obedience towards Him.

Whatever is in the skies and on the earth and all the animals on the earth, all of them are prostrating before Allah, and angels (are already doing), and they do not transgress from the command of Allah.
And they fear their Lord, and obey immediately whatever is commanded by Him, Who is much more exalted than them.
{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} And Allah ordained that do not make two Lords, Lord is only that’s Allah; then fear Me only.
And whatever is in the skies and on the earth, everything is His, and exclusive obedience is always imperative for Him, then do you fear anybody other than Allah?
And whatever good you have is all from Allah, and if any evil touches you, you implore before Him.
Then, when He wards off trouble from you, then some of you make His partners.
They become ungrateful for the favors granted by Us; they will enjoy for some days in the world, then shortly you will know.

From sustenance given by Us, they make a part for idols also, and their reality they do not know; for the slander you did, by Allah you shall most certainly be questioned for it on the Day of Judgement.
And these people make daughters for Allah, Praise be to Allah, He is clean and pure from it; and for themselves (son) what they desire.
And when they are given the good news of a girl being born to them, then with sadness their faces turn black, as if they have swallowed a sip of poison.
Upon hearing the good news (of a female child) he hides his face from the people; (and thinks) whether to let her live with disgrace or bury her alive; Verily they are taking bad decisions.
Evil talk is more suitable for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, and for Allah are loftiest qualities (such as Oneness and Lordship); and He is Predominant and Wise.

And if Allah will seize them on their disobedience, then He will not leave any mortal on the earth, but He have given all of them, respite until an appointed time; when their appointed time will come then it will neither move forward or backward even for a second.

And they attribute to Allah what they abhor (themselves); and their tongues also lie for them that there is good for them in the Hereafter, whereas Verily Hell is for them, and prior to all they will be thrown in it.
By Allah before you, We sent prophets to the different peoples, so Satan decorated their affairs for them, and today also he is their guardian, and for them is great painful punishment.
And We revealed the Book to you so that you explain their problems in which they dispute; and this Book is entirely guidance and mercy for the believers.
And Allah sent down water from the sky and through which He relived the dead earth, undoubtedly for those who hear there is a great sign in it.
And there is no doubt that in four-footed animals there is a lesson for you; that in their belly from between dung and blood We give you milk to drink which is tasteful for drinkers.
And we give you dates and grapes (to drink juices), of which sometimes make wine and sometime use it for business, and certainly in it also there is great sign (of Power of Allah) for wise people.
And (O Prophet), your Lord indicated to honeybee to make hives on mountains and trees and heighted houses.

Then suck the essence from all flowers and travel with the obedience of your Lord; there comes out a drink (honey) of different colors from the bellies of bees, in it there is healing for people (from illness); there is no doubt that in this there is a great sign (of Power of Allah) for the people who ponder.

And Allah created you and He will cause you to die; and some of them are brought back to the worst part of their lives (very old age); that in spite of having much knowledge, you will not know anything, certainly Allah is all knowing and Powerful.

And it is Allah, Who has given preference (to some of you) over others in sustenance (and wealth), however who have been given more sustenance do not give to those who are their subordinates (workers and slaves, etc.); whereas, everyone has a part in that sustenance, so do they deny the favor of Allah.

And Allah made your wives of your nature from among you, and He made your sons and grandsons from your wives, and gave you pure sustenance to consume, so do they totally believe in falsehood, and deny the favor of Allah?
And except Allah they worship those which are neither capable to give any sustenance to them in skies and the earth nor can acquire such capacity.
Do not create examples for Allah, indeed Allah knows everything which you do not know.

Allah describes an example: that one slave who is property of another, and does not have any authority, and another person whom We have given from Our Court good sustenance, and he spends from in (in the way of Allah), openly and secretly, can these two be equal. (never), Praise be to Allah, but most of them do not even know this.

And Allah describes another example of two men: a slave who is dumb and is incapable of doing anything, and he is a burden on his master that wherever he sends him, he does not bring any good; does this slave and a person who advises justice to the people and is himself on right path can (these two) be equal? (Never).

And all the unseen of the skies and the earth is exclusive for Allah only, and happening on the Day of Judgement is like blinking and even sooner than that, indeed Allah is Predominant over everything.
And Allah brought you out of the wombs of your mothers, when you were unaware, and gave you ears, eyes and heart, so that you be grateful.
Didn't you ponder over the birds, who fly under the skies encircle in air, and Allah prevents them (from falling), Verily in this also there are many signs for those who believe.

And Allah made home your place (to stay), and he provided for you hides of cattle from which you make tents; that you carry while you travel, and He made wool and fur and hair and other useful things which you can use until appointed time.

And Allah made shades of his creations for your rest, He made for you caves in the mountains for you to retreat, He made garments to save you from heat (and cold), and gave you coats of mails to protect you from weapons' attack; like this Allah completes His favours that you may become obedient.
Even after this if they turn their face (from you), then your responsibility is just to deliver (the commands) clearly.
These people know the favors of Allah, still (knowingly) they deny and most of them are ungrateful.
And that day We will raise every Ummah from their graves and will make their prophets their witness, then the infidels will not be allowed to speak, nor their excuse will be heard.
And those who had spearheaded mischief in the world, when they will see the punishment, so neither their punishment will be lessened, nor they will be given respite.

And those who made partners of Allah, when they will see those partners (on the Day of Judgement) will say: O our Lord, these are our partners whom we called upon in the time of difficulties instead of You, but they will retort that you are great liars.
And that day they will all fell down and prostrate before Allah and the slandering which they did in the world will become useless and shall vanish.
Those who adopted infidelity and prohibited people from the way of Allah, and in reward of the mischief they spread, their punishment shall be increased.

And (remember the day) when We will raise up in every people a witness from among them to testify against themselves, and (O Prophet), will make you witness against them, We revealed the Book on you and described everything in it, and for Muslims, this is guidance, mercy and glad tidings.

Indeed, Allah ordains for doing justice, and for doing good and being generous towards the relatives; and prohibits from evil and indecency and transgression; and admonishes you that you may get the advised.

And when you enter into covenants, then complete the covenant with Allah and do not break the oaths after taking them, whereas you had made Allah surety for you; and whatever you do, Allah Verily knows.

You do not be like those females (in breaking oaths) who spun the yarn then breaks it into pieces, do you make your covenant with means of deceit that one group get more benefit than other group; Allah is testing you through this, and He will Verily make this clear on the Day of Judgement in which you had differed.

And if Allah pleases, He would have made you all one nation; but He leaves in misguidance to whoever He pleases, and to whosoever He pleases He guides, and whatever you had been doing in the world, certainly you will be questioned about it.

And do not make your oaths basis for your mutual mischief, that after your foot is stable, foot of Islam is weaken; and (then on the Day of Judgement); and in reward of you desisting people from the way of Lord, you will taste the punishment, and for you will be the severe punishment.
And do not take a small amount in exchange for the covenant of Allah, and if you know then understand that whatever is with Allah is much better that what you have.

And whatever you have (one day) will be over, and the reward of Allah is everlasting, and those who are patient in the world; on the Day of Judgement, We will bestow upon them the best reward for what they did in the world.
Whoever will do good work, whether men or women, will also be believers; We will make their lives pure in this world, and will reward them better than the best for good work they did.
And when you recite the Quran, seek refuge from Allah, from the cursed Satan (from his evil whispering).
There is no doubt he cannot control those who are believers and rely on Allah.
His control is only on those who befriends him and those who indulge in polytheism.
And (O Prophet), when We change a verse with another verse then what We reveal (We know its prudence well), but these people say you are a forger, but most of them know nothing about it.

And (O Prophet) make it clear to them that this (Quran) has been revealed to you by Sacred Spirit from your Lord with truth; so those who have believed should be steadfast, and for the Muslims it is entirely guidance and glad tidings.

And (O Prophet) in reality We know that these infidels say some man teaches you Quran; (whereas it is totally wrong), to the person they refer to is a non-Arab, while this (Quran) is clearly in Arabic language.
Indeed, those who do not believe the signs of Allah, He does not guide them and there is also painful punishment for them.
Indeed, those who falsely blame do not believe in Allah, and they are liars also.

And who will adopt infidelity after believing; except that he is compelled for it but his heart is content; and have space for infidelity in his chest, there is wrath of Allah on him and grievous punishment for him.
This is because of those people who preferred worldly life over the Hereafter, and Allah never guides transgressing nations.
These are those, whose hearts, eyes and ears have been stamped with infidelity, and they are in reality negligent of truth.
And these people are among the losers in the Hereafter.
Verily your Lord, those who were persecuted and later they migrated, and fought (in the way of Allah), and were patient, there is no doubt that your Lord is Oft Forgiving and Merciful.
And on that day when every mortal will be quarrelling for himself, and every person will get full reward for whatever he has done, and no unjust will be done to them.

Allah has described the example of a village, where people were very comfortable and sustenance were in abundance for them and came to them (from everywhere), then they showed ungratefulness towards the favors so because of their deeds Allah made the hunger and fear like cloth to cover them with it from all sides.
And a prophet came from among them, and they denied him, then punishment (of Allah) overtook them, and they were unjust.
And Allah have given you some pure and lawful sustenance, you may consume them, and if you claim to worship Allah then be grateful to Him.

Allah has made unlawful for you dead (animal), blood, flesh of swine and that animals on whom (at the time of slaughter) somebody else's name except Allah was taken; but if someone is helpless (from hunger) but is neither rebellious or exceeds the limit, if he consumes it (in bare minimum required quantity) then Allah is Oft-Forgiving and Merciful.

If anything comes on your tongue that it is lawful or unlawful but do not say it (without understanding) lest because of that you may falsely blame Allah, there is no doubt that who falsely blame on Allah can never succeed.
There is little benefit in the world but painful punishment (in the Hereafter) for them.
And on Jews We made unlawful the things which We have already explained to you, We did no injustice to them but they were unjust to themselves.
Then those who committed sins unknowingly but repent (wholeheartedly) and amended themselves; so (O Prophet), indeed your Lord after this is all Forgiving and Merciful.
There is not any doubt that Ibrahim was (comprehensive) leader, obedient of Allah, and (always) treading aside from the falsehood, and he was not among the polytheists.
