Grateful for His favors, Allah chose them and have guided them to His straight path.
And We bestowed upon them the good, and in the Hereafter also they will be among the good ones.
(O Prophet), then we revealed on you that you follow the way of Ibrahim; he used to walk aside from the path of falsehood and was not among the polytheists.

(O Prophet), respect for the day of Sabbath was for those (Jews and Christians) who disputed in it, nothing else, and your Lord will decide between them on the Day of Judgement in which they were disputing.

(O Prophet), Invite people to your Lord through wisdom and good talk and exhortation, and debate with them in the best manner; indeed, those who went astray from the path of Allah, your Lord know them well; and those who were guided He know them well also.
If your opponents are being hard with you then you also be hard with them in the same way, but if you will be patient, then it will be better for those who keep patience.
And O Prophet, be patient; and you cannot be patient without the help of Allah; and don't feel sad on the plotting of the opponents and do not straiten your heart on it.
Indeed, Allah is the companion of those who are pious and do good works.

Glory be to Him who made his servant travel from Sacred Mosque to Aqsa Mosque during the night; around which We have made available every blessing; to show him the Our signs (of Power), indeed He is all Hearing and Seeing.
We gave the book (Taurait) to Moosa and appointed him leader of Bani Israel; do not make anybody your benefactor except Me.
(And ordained that) O children of the people whom I made them board the Ark of Nooh; indeed, Nooh was a grateful servant.
And We had told Bani Israel in the book (Taurait) that you will create the mischief on the earth twice and will do great transgression.

When the time of first mischief came, We imposed upon you some of Our servants (Bakht al-Nasr and his army), who were very hard fighters, they broke into your houses (and carried out bloodshed) and promise of Allah (of punishment) was accomplished.
Then again, We made you prevail over them and changed your days; and helped you with wealth and sons and made you a great group.

If you do good work, then you do the good work for yourselves; and if you do evil work, then it will also be for yourselves; and when the time of second promise came; then We made another nation overpower you that they may damage your faces (so you cannot be recognized), and they broke into the mosque (Bait al-Maghdas) again as previous time, and that they may destroyed completely whatever they find.

(Even now if you live peacefully) it may be that your Lord may have mercy on you, but if you will create mischief again, then We too will take on you again, and We have made ready Hell a prison for the infidels.
Indeed, Quran guides to the path, which is the straightest path, and give glad tidings to the believers who do good works, for them is the great reward existing.
And this is also, that there is painful punishment for those, who do not believe on the Day of Judgment.
And human (after getting irritated) asks for evil for himself in such a way as if he is asking for good, and human is a haste maker.

Two of our signs are the night and the day, then We made dim light, as sign of the night (moon); and made illumination as sign of day (sun), so you may search the grace (sustenance) of your Lord, and you may count the years and do accounting; and We have explained everything with details.
And We cling human's deeds on his neck and will keep it before them on the Day of Judgement, and they will see it, as an open book in front of them.
And (We will tell him) read your deeds, today you yourself is sufficient for your accounting.

And whoever comes on the straight path, comes for his own benefit, and if somebody went astray, then he harms himself only, and nobody will carry the burden (of sins) of others; and We punish no one unless we send the prophet (to complete the need).
And when We wish to destroy any town; We give command to the wealthy people, and when they start disobeying; then that town becomes deserving of punishment, and We destroy them completely.
And how many generations We destroyed after Nooh, and (O Prophet), your Lord is sufficient to know and see the sins of His servants (and there is no need for any witness).
And whoever is desirous of this world We give him what he wishes soon, but then We have assigned Hell for them, and they will enter into it with disgrace and disrespect.
And whoever is desirous of the Hereafter and endeavor also for it and is a believer also, so these are the people whose endeavor will be accepted.
(O Prophet) Your Lord helps them and those with His forgiveness; and the forgiveness of your Lord is not restricted for anyone (it is open for all).
(O Prophet) Look, how We have made some of them to excel others; and the grades of the Hereafter are much more than here, and preferences of there are also much greater.
And see, do not make anybody partner of Allah; or else you will be sitting in destitution and disgrace.

And your Lord has ordained that do not worship anyone else except Him, and be good to your parents, and if both or anyone reached the old age with you, then do not even say even 'Ogh' to them (in reply), and do not reprimand them. (and whatever you have to say) say with respect.
And in front of them be submissive and show humbleness, and pray: O my Lord, how they nourished me when I was small, likewise You also show Mercy on them.
Allah knows whatever is in your hearts, if you have become really good, the He is the forgiver of those who repent.
And give their dues to the relatives and needy foreigners; and beware do not be wasteful spender.
Because wasteful spender are brothers of Satan, and Satan is very ungrateful to his Lord.
And when you are awaiting the Grace and Mercy of your Lord in hope and (by force) have to turn your face from poor; then make them understand politely.
Do not close your hand tightly to your neck (do not give anything) or open them completely (give everything) so you have to sit down blamed.
To whoever Allah pleases increases his sustenance, and to whoever He pleases keep straitens (his sustenance); and indeed, He is Knowing and takes care of his servants.
Do not kill your child for fear of poverty, because We give sustenance to you all, indeed killing of child is a grave crime.
And do not go near the adultery, because indeed it is great indecency and an evil habit.

And do not kill a soul whose killing Allah have forbidden; except in just manner (according to Islamic law of retaliation); and who is killed unlawfully We have given authority (of retaliation) to his heir but he should not exceed (in taking revenge of murder); anyway, he will be aided.

And do not go near the wealth of an orphan until he attains the puberty but only for his benefit and complete the covenants because on the Day of Judgement Verily you shall be questioned about covenants.
And if you have to give something in measure, then measure properly. (and if it is to be given in weight) then weigh properly, this is the best way of transaction, and its result is also good.
Of which you have no knowledge, do not pursue it, because (on the Day of Judgement) Allah will certainly question about (your) ear, eye and heart.
And don't walk haughtily on the earth, because neither you can ever break the earth, nor you can be tall as mountains.
(O Prophet) among the talks which is evil, is hateful near your Lord.
This is from Wisdom of your Lord what has been sent to you as revelation, and do not make another lord with Allah, lest be thrown into Hell with reproach and disgrace.
What! Your Lord chose sons for you, and created for Himself daughters from angels, indeed you are saying harsh words.
And We have explained in different ways in this Quran so that they may understand, but only their hate increased.
(O Prophet) say to these people: if there would have been more gods as they say, till now their gods would certainly be able to find a way to the Master of Throne.
Allah is most High, exalted, and pure, then what vulgar these people talk about Him.

And whoever is in the seven skies and on the earth, they all glorify Him; and there is nothing in the world which do not glorify His Praise, but you do not understand their glorification, indeed He is very Forbearing and Forgiving.
And when you recite Quran, We create a thick veil between you and those who have no belief on the Day of Judgement.
And We cover up their hearts so they can't understand the Quran, and We make their ears hard (so they can't hear), and when you talk alone about your Lord in Quran, they turn back and run away.
We know what they hear when they hear you talk, and when they converse privately among them, they say: you are following a person affected by magic.
Just see what examples they have made for you, and like this they have gone astray, and they are not finding any way.
They say when we will become dust and bone then will we be raised again as new creatures?
Say: become stone or iron.

Or anything else which you think is stronger, so these people will shortly ask you, who will raise us again? Tell them: That Lord who created you for the first time, on this they will shake their heads at you, and say: when? Say: it will shortly happen.
On the day when Allah will call you (through Israfil), then with His Praise you will obey Him (and will come out of graves), and you will think you stayed there for a short while.
And (O Prophet), say to my (true) servants that when they talk to infidels, talk decently, because Satan creates dissensions among them, indeed Satan is the manifest enemy of man.
Your Lord is aware of your conditions, if He pleases, He will grant Mercy on you, if He pleases, He will punish you, and (O Prophet), We have not sent you as their responsible (for their affairs).
And whoever is in the skies and on the earth, your Lord knows (all of them) well, and indeed We gave excellence to some prophets over other prophets, and it is We, who have given Zaboor to Dawood.
(O Prophet), You say to those people: to whom you consider lord, call upon them in your difficult time and see that they neither they can repel your trouble nor change it.

And to whom these polytheists consider lord and worship them, they themselves are seeking the ways for access to their lord, those who have more nearness to Him and expect (His) Mercy and fears Him; indeed, punishment of your Lord is something which is to be feared about.
And there is no town, but We will destroy it before the Day of Judgement or will send severe punishment on it; and this has (already) been written in the Divine Book.

We refrain from sending miracles because of the denial of earlier peoples; We bestowed she-camel to the people of Samood, which was a sign of (Our Power), but they persecuted her, and We send miracles only as a warning (to the people).

(O Prophet), remember when We told you that We have prevented people from all sides (from you); and the dream We showed you was for the trial (of faith) of such people, likewise the tree which is cursed in Quran and We warn people in different ways, but it only increases their inordinate transgression.
And when We asked angels to prostrate before Adam; everyone prostrated except Iblis and said: do I prostrate in front to whom you have created with dust?
(Iblis) said: see this is he, whom you have excelled over me; if you give me respite till the Day of Judgement; I will most Verily cut the roots of his progeny except a few.
Said Allah: Go (be gone), whoever will follow you, place of all of you is Hell, this is your full recompense.

And to whoever you can get control with your smooth talk, attack them with your riders and infantry, and have a share in their wealth and children, and make (false) promise to them; and the promise of Satan is nothing but deception.
And you cannot have control over My (true) servants, and your Lord is sufficient as disposer of affairs.
Your Lord is that who runs the ships for you in the seas, that you may search for His Blessings and Mercy (sustenance), indeed He is very Kind to you.

And when you faced trouble in the sea, they went missing to whom you worshipped, but He, and when He delivered you from the trouble and reached you on the land, again you turned your face from Him, and human is very ungrateful.

Have you become content that He will not sink you in the earth after taking you there (like Qaroon) or will not rain on you the stones (like nation of Lut), and at that time you will not find any protector.

Have you become content that Allah will not take you to the sea again then will send a strong breeze which will break your ship into pieces; then because of your infidelity He will drown you, then you will not find anyone who will help you against Us.

Indeed, We gave honor to the children of Adam and they roamed on the land and the sea (with animals and ships), and gave them good things to eat; and We appropriately excelled them appropriately over Our many creations.

And remember the day when We will call the people with their leaders, and they will read their deeds (happily) whose record book (of deeds) will be given in their right hand, and they will not be persecuted even like a single hair.
The man who (knowingly) lived like a blind in the world, he will be blind in the Hereafter also, and he will go far away from the path (of deliverance).

Indeed, they wish to deviate you from the conversation which We sent to you through revelation, so that you say something other than this (Quran) which may not be true, and if that would have happened, they would have considered you as friend.
And if it was not that we kept you steadfast, you would have somehow inclined towards them.
Then We would have made you taste in life as well as in death double the punishment, and you would not have found any helper against Us.

And these people want you to be disheartened from the land (of Makkah) and they want to expel you (towards Syria), and if they would have done it; they themselves could not have stayed there, except for a few days.
And before you, We have sent the prophets; they also had followed the same course, and you cannot find any change in the course set by Us.

Keep up the prayer from the decline of sun until the darkness of night. (Zohr, Asr, Maghrib & Isha); and morning prayer (also); because morning prayer is testified upon (by angels of night and day both).
And during the night time keep up late night prayer; this addition is your excellence, soon (on the Day of Judgement) your Lord may reach you to the highly praiseworthy position.
Say: O my Lord! Make my entry with goodliness (in Madina) and make my departure with goodliness (from Makkah), and bestow upon me from Your Court a power which will be my helper.
Say: Truth has come and falsehood has vanished; indeed, falsehood was destined to vanish.
And what We reveal in the Quran which is healing and mercy for the believers; and nothing adds up for disobedience but the loss.
And when We bestowed favor on humans (instead) he turned his face away from Us and becomes remote, and is disappointed if any trouble touches him.
(O Prophet) Say: everyone is doing the deeds in his own way, but your Lord knows who is best on the straight path.
(O Prophet), these people ask you about the soul, tell them that soul is a command of my Lord, and you have been given a little knowledge.
And (O Prophet), if We please, We will take back this (Quran) which We revealed to you, then you will not find any helper against Us.
But this is only great Mercy of your Lord (that He has not taken it back), indeed His grace and Mercy is on you.
And (O Prophet) say: if all the men and jinn of the world gather on this, to bring a similar Quran. (it is impossible) they could not bring a similar one (Quran), and some of them may help others.
And We explain examples differently for the people (to make them understand), but still, most of them do not stop being ungrateful.
And they (infidels of Makkah) say: we will not believe on you unless you do not flow a fountain for us from the earth.
Or you should have a garden of dates and grapes; in the middle of it you cause rivers to flow and show us.
Or break the sky into pieces on us, or bring angels of Allah in front of us (to prove your words).

Or you should have a house of gold or you ascend to the sky and we will not be convinced of your ascension unless you send to us a book (from there) and we read it; (O Prophet) say: Praises to my Lord, what I am except a human and a prophet (of Allah)?
And after the arrival of guidance nothing is stopping them from believing except, their saying that Allah has sent a human as a prophet.
(O Prophet) Say: If angels had settled and walked peacefully on the earth, We would have sent to them an angel as a prophet.
(O Prophet), say: indeed, Allah is enough between you and me as a witness, there is no doubt that He is Aware of conditions of His servants; and He Sees.

And to whoever Allah guides, only he is the guided one, and to whoever He leave in misguidance, then (remember) you will not find any guardian other than Him; and on the Day of Judgement, We will raise them upside down, blind, dumb and deaf (from their graves), their abode will be Hellfire, and if it will ever (begin to) extinguish; We will flare it up again.
This is their punishment because of their denial of our verses; and their saying that: after our death when we will become bones and decayed particles, will we be raised as new creation?

Do they not ponder that Allah who has created the skies and the earth is also have power to create similar humans again, and without any doubt We have fixed the term for them (their death), even then these unjust continue to deny this.
(O Prophet) Say: Even if you had treasures of my Lord's Mercy, you would have kept it locked for fear of spending it, and man is very strait hearted.
And We gave nine manifest miracles to Moosa, so (O Prophet) ask Bani Israel, when Moosa came to them, Firaun said: O Moosa, I think somebody has cast magic on you and made you mad.
Said Moosa: you Verily know that all these miracles have been sent by the Lord of the skies and the earth, these are things for pondering; O Firaun, I believe your misfortune has begun.
Then Firaun decided to extern Bani Israel from the land (of Egypt), so We drowned Firaun and the people who were with him.
Thereafter We told Bani Israel to live peacefully in this land; and when the promise of the Hereafter will come, We will bring you all together.
And (O Prophet), We revealed it (Quran) with truth, and it (Quran) was revealed with truth (too), and We have made you who gives glad tidings (of Paradise) and a warner (of punishment).
We revealed Quran on you in parts, so you may recite it before the people as per requirement, and We revealed it slowly, slowly.
Say: whether you believe on it or not, indeed those who were given the knowledge (of Heavenly Books) before this; when it was recited, they used to fell down on their faces in prostration.
{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} And they say: Glory be to Allah; indeed, the promise of our Lord was to be completed.
And these people fall on their faces in prostration and weep and this Quran increases their humbleness.

{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} (O Prophet), say: either you call Him Allah or Merciful (Raheem), all His (all) names are Beautiful, and don't recite your prayer very loudly, and neither recite your prayer with complete silence, but adopt a medium tone.

And say: all praises are due to Allah only, He neither has a child, nor does He have any partner in (His) Kingdom of the world, and He does not have any weakness that He should have a guardian; and continue to proclaim His Greatness in best manner.
All praises are worthy for Allah only Who revealed the Book (Quran) on His servant (Mohammad [SAW]); and did not keep any crookedness in it.
(But kept it) straight so that He may warn of severe punishment from Him (to the infidels), and to give glad tidings of best reward to believers who perform the good deeds.
They shall forever abide in it (with serenity).
And those who believe that Allah has a son, warn them (about the punishment).
And they have no knowledge of it, nor do their forefathers had any knowledge; (these are) strong words which they utter; they do not utter (anything) except lie.
So (O Prophet), perhaps you may kill yourself with grief following after them, if they do not believe this.
Whatever is on the earth We made it its adornment, so that We test people that who is best among them based on their deeds.
Then one day whatever is on it (will destroy) and We will make it chattel plains
(O Prophet), do you think the companions of the Cave and the Inscription were a wonder among Our signs?
That suddenly some youth came in the cave and prayed: O my Lord, grant us Mercy from Your Court and bestow upon us success in our affairs.
Then We covered their ears with a veil in the cave for many years. (put them to sleep)
Then We woke them up to see that between the two groups who is more aware of their period of stay.
(O Prophet), We describe their condition with truth, and they were a few youths who believed in their truthful Lord, and We increased their guidance.

And We strengthened their hearts (with patience and liberty), so they stood up and said: our Lord is master of the skies and the earth, and we will never worship any god except Him; if we do this then it would be irrational.
(Alas!) these are people of our nation who have made other gods beside Him, then why they do not present a manifest sign for them; and who can be more unjust than who falsely blame Allah?
(They said among themselves) Since you have deviated from the gods they worshipped. (let’s go) take refuge in the cave and your Lord will expand His Mercy on you and will make things easy for you.

(At last they settled in the cave) When sun rises you will see that it inclines towards right side of their cave, and when it set, it tilts towards their left; and they are staying in spacious place in the cave; this is one sign out of (Many) signs of Allah, and to whomsoever Allah guides, only he is the guided one, and to whomsoever He misguides then you can never find a guardian for him.

You will think that they are awake, but they are deep asleep, and sometimes We make them turn on their right side and sometimes on their left side, and their dog lay on threshold outstretching his front legs; (their condition is such) that if you will look at them (peek into their cave) you will run back and your heart will be filled with fright.

And (as We put them to sleep) likewise We raised them (woke them up) that they may question each other, and one speaker among them said: for how long you stayed (here). (another one) said: one day or even less than that. (thereafter they) said: your Lord knows for how long you have stayed, now send one of us to the city with some coins so he goes and see which is the best food (available), and bring some provision for you, he should go discreetly, that no one should come to know about you.
Indeed if they come to know about you, they will either stone you or take you back towards their religion, and if this happens then you can never get the deliverance.

And in this way We made them know their condition so they should see that promise of Allah is true, and that there is no doubt in the Day of Judgement. (after getting their news) they disputed among themselves; some of them said that an edifice should be erected on the cave in their remembrance, their Lord knows of their condition well, and those who prevailed over others said: we will make a mosque on it.

Shortly these people will say they are three and their dog is fourth, and some will say they are five and their dog is sixth, they speculate in the unseen, and some people will say they are seven and eighth is their dog. (O Prophet) say: their number is only known to my Lord, few people are aware of their (actual) number, so (O Prophet) do not argue with them regarding Companions of the Cave except a superficial talk, and do not enquire from these people about them (Companions of the Cave).
And do not say for any work that you will do it tomorrow.
But say it with if Allah pleases; in case you forget, then remember your Lord (say Allah Willing), and say: I hope my Lord will guide me to that whichever is nearer to the reality.
And Companions of the Cave stayed in their cave for 309 years.

(O Prophet, if they do not believe say): Allah knows well their period of stay, knowledge of the unseen of the skies and the earth is exclusive for Allah only, how clear He sees and how clear He hears; there is no guardian for them except Him, and He does not associate anybody in His commands.
And (O Prophet), recite the Book which has been sent to you through revelation, no one can alter its content, and except Him you will not find shelter anywhere.

And (O Prophet), you also be patient along with those who remember Allah early morning and at dusk and desire His pleasure, and do not turn your sight from them that you (also) desire beauty of world's life; and whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, he follows his worldly desires, his act is to commit manifest excesses.

And (O Prophet) say: the truth has been revealed to you from your Lord, whoever wish may believe and whoever wish may not believe, We have prepared the fire for the unjust whose walls will encircle them; and if they will cry for help, they will be given (boiling) water which will be like molten copper that will scald their mouths; what an evil water is this and what an evil place is this (Hell).
Indeed, those who believed and performed good deeds; We never waste the reward of those who do good deeds.

These are the people for whom there are evergreen gardens in Paradise, wherein rivers will be flowing beneath their mansions where they will adorn the bright gold bracelets and they will be given fine and thick silk robes of green colour; and they will be reclining on couches with cushions, and what a good reward it is, and what a good place it is (Paradise).
(O Prophet), tell them the examples of two persons, to one of them We have given two gardens of grapes, We have surrounded them with palm trees, and also there is farming between the gardens.
And both gardens yielded a good crop of fruits, and there was no shortage, and We have also flown rivers between those two gardens.
And when he got the yield, he said to whom he was talking, I have more wealth than you and my group is also larger than you.
(While talking this) he entered into the garden, however his condition was such that he was being unjust upon him and said: I do not think this garden can ever perish.
And I do not even think that the Day of Judgement will ever happen, and if ever I will be returned to Lord then indeed He will give me much better place than this.
His companion who was talking to him said: Do you deny your Lord who created you by dust and took you out from sperm then made you a perfect man.
(But we say), that Allah is my Lord, and I do not make anybody His partner.

And when you entered the garden why didn't you say: it is all as Allah pleased (nothing is mine), because without the help of Allah no one has any power, even if you consider me inferior to you in wealth and children.
So, shortly my Lord will give me a garden which will be better than your garden, and will send a pestilence from sky which will make your garden a chattel plain.
Or will decrease the water level which you will not be able to find it.

(So the punishment came), and the fruits (of his garden) became affected by a pestilence, then he regretfully rubbed his hands on the wealth which he had spent on preparation of his garden, and condition of the garden was such, that it had fallen upside down on its branches, and he said, alas! would that I had not made any partner with Allah.
And except Allah there was not any group which would have helped him (against Allah), neither he could take revenge.
And it was proved here that guardianship is only for Allah; who is truthful, and He is best in requiting and is better in giving the end result.

And (O Prophet), describe to them examples of the world also, its condition is like water which We rain down from the sky which will be absorbed by earth's vegetation, then in the end it will become particles which will be blown by the wind, and Allah has Power over everything.
And (O Prophet), wealth and children are adornments of life of the world, and good deeds are much better with your Lord in regards to hopes and rewards.
(Fear that day) when We will move the mountains and you will see the earth as an open ground, and We will gather them all and will not leave even a single one.

And (they all) will be presented in different queues before your Lord. (then We will remind them) as We created you earlier, at last you had to come to Us; and you thought that for your re-creation We will not appoint a time.

And the book (of deeds of people) will be kept before them, then you will see that sinners will become fearful to look at whatever would be written therein; Oh our misfortune! which book is this, no smaller or greater sins have been omitted from writing in it, whatever they have done in the world they shall find written in it; and your Lord is not unjust on anyone.

And remember the time when We commanded to angels to prostrate before Adam, so except Iblis everyone prostrated; he (Iblis) was from jinn who ran away from the command of his Lord, so (O people) do you make him and his children your friend; whereas they are your enemies, but unjust befriended him instead of Allah; this swap is worst for the unjust.

I did not called upon them (as witness) when I was creating the skies and the earth, and I did not called them (as witness) when I was creating them; I was not like that who would make helpers to those who go astray.
(And fear that day) when Allah will say: call upon those whom you considered My partner; they will call them, but they will not listen to them any; and We will make a strong curtain between them.
Upon seeing the fire the guilty ones will understand that they will be thrown into it, and they shall not find a way to avoid it.
And for their understanding We have described the parables in different ways, but human is more quarrelling than other creations.
And when guidance has come to them, only tradition of their earlier people is preventing them from believing and from seeking forgiveness from their Lord; or punishment should come in front of them?

And We send prophets only to give glad tidings (of deliverance) and warn (from punishment), and infidels quarrel on false things with the intention to uproot the truth, and they make fun of those verses of Ours in which We have warn them (of punishment).

And who can be more unjust than who is reminded of verses of his Lord but he turns away, and he has forgotten his earlier deeds, as if We have curtained their hearts so that they don't understand, and made their ears hard of hearing (that they don't listen), and if you will call them to the right path but they are never going to get the guidance.

And (O Prophet), your Lord is all forgiving and Merciful; and if because of their deeds Allah will catch hold of them, then He will send punishment on them immediately, but for them a term is fixed, and from that they will not get shelter anywhere except Allah.
The settlements which you see with your eyes, we destroyed them, when their people transgressed, and We had fixed the term for their destruction.

And (O Prophet), remember the tale when Moosa (went to meet Khizr) said to his young assistant (Yosh'e) that I will not stop unless I reach the junction where two rivers meet; I will walk for years (until I do not meet him).
When they reached the junction of the rivers, he left their (barbeque) fish, it made its way and swam away.
When they walked some distance Moosa asked his young assistant to give his breakfast to him (and said), we have met with fatigue on our today's journey.
(Yosh'e) said: did you see that when we halted near the stone, I left the fish there, and Satan made me to forget and I could not tell this to you, in a strange way it made its way in the river.
Moosa said: That was the place we were looking for, then both of them returned back to that place (retracing their own footsteps, where they had left the fish).
Both of them found one from among Our servants (Khizr) upon whom We granted Mercy and taught him a part of Our Exclusive Knowledge.
Moosa said to him: I have come with the purpose to accompany you, so that you can teach me some from the knowledge of guidance which you have been taught by Allah.
I will teach you, but you may not have patience with me.
And how you can be patient on the things which are not in your knowledge.
If Allah pleases, you will find me patient and I will not oppose any of your orders.
That servant (Khizr) said: if you want to accompany me, do not question me about anything, until I do not begin the talk myself.
So they began to walk together until they reached a ship in which that servant (of Mine) made a hole in it, you made a hole in it to drown the people, this is a strange act.
That servant of Allah said: did not I tell you, you cannot not be patient with me.
Moosa said: whatever has happened has happened, do not rebuke me on my negligence and do not be so strict in this matter.

Then they both went ahead until they met a boy, then that servant of Allah killed him, Moosa said: did you kill an innocent person, and that's too without any revenge for a blood, indeed your act was strange.
(Khizr) said: didn't I tell you that you can never have patience while accompanying me.
Moosa said: (okay) now if I ask you anything then do not allow me to accompany you, Verily you have reached a level of excuses from me.

At last both of them went ahead and reached near the people of (a) village, he asked for some food but they refused to host both of them, then both of them saw a wall in that village which was about to fall which he (Khizr) straightened. (on this) Moosa said: if you wanted you could have taken the wage for this.
(Khizr) said: Now separation between us, on the things you didn't have patience, I am telling their reality.

That ship (in which I made a hole) belonged to few poor (people) who used to toil on it for their sustenance in the river; I wished to make it faulty because an unjust king was in his pursuit who used to seize the ships by force (and take it in his possession).
And about that boy, both his parents are believers, and I thought (that he will grow up and) entangle them in infidelity and transgression.
So I desired that their Lord will give them a such a son in return who will be pure, and better in nearness to them.

And about that wall, it belonged two orphan boys and there was a treasure of them buried beneath it, and their father was a righteous person, so Allah pleased that both boys reach their youth then with the grace of your Lord they will dug out that treasure, and whatever I did was not out of my free will (but I did it with the command of Allah), this is the reality of those incidents on which you did not had patience.
(O Prophet) they ask you about Zulqarnain, you say in reply to them: I am telling you some of his tales.
(Allah says) We gave him power on the earth, and We gave him stuff of everything.
He utilized this stuff.

So while walking he reached the place of sunset, it appeared to him that it was setting in a stream of black mud, and near that stream he also found a nation there, We said to him: O Zulqarnain. (you have a choice) whether to punish them or behave nicely with them.
Zulqarnain said: Verily I will punish him who will do transgression, then at last they will all be returned before their Lord (on the Day of Judgement) and He will give them the worst punishment.
There is best reward for those who adopted faith and did good deeds, and shortly We will ask him to follow our commands which will be easier for him.
And then he took another way.
He walked (further) that he reached the place where the sun rises, so it appeared to him that it is rising upon them and We have not made any curtains in front of the sun.
And it was like this, and whatever was with Zulqarnain We were totally aware of it.
Then he took another way.
Until he reached between the walls, he found people living on this side of the walls who could not understand any talk.

Those people said (somehow): O Zulqarnain, on that side of the trench lives Gog and Magog who create mischief in the land, if you permit us, we will provide some expenses for you so that you make some hurdle between us and them.
Said (Zulqarnain), the power of provision of expenses which my Lord has given me is much better than your contribution; you only help me with (man) power, I will make a barrier between you and them.

Now bring to me iron sheets. (and they brought and a big wall was made) so the wall was levelled between the two mountains; he said light the fire and flare it, so when it (iron wall) became red, he said now bring me copper, melt and pour over this wall.
So neither Gog and Magog can scale it, nor can they pierce it.
Zulqarnain said (on seeing the wall): this blessing of my Lord and when the promise of my Lord (Day of Judgement) will come; He will make it level with the ground, and promise of my Lord is truth.
On that day We let them on their condition, and by clashing one over another they will become like waves of the river, and when the trumpet will blow then We will gather them all together.
And on that day We will present Hell explicitly in front of the infidels.
Whose eyes were behind the veils and also they do not want to hear anything.
And those who did not believe, do they think We have left them to make My servants as their guardians? So listen We have prepared Hell to host the infidels.
(O Prophet) tell them: shall I tell you about those who are the losers as per their deeds.
Those are the people whose endeavours of the world have gone waste, and they are thinking that Verily they are doing good deeds.

These are the people who denied the verses of their Lord and His meeting (of the Day of Judgement); so all their deeds have gone waste; and therefore we will not even set a balance for them on the Day of Judgement.
(And straight away will throw them in Hell), this Hell is reward for their deeds that they adopted infidelity and mocked at My verses and My prophets.
Indeed, who believed and did good works they will be hosted in the gardens of Paradise.
They will abide in it forever and would never like to leave it.
(O Prophet, tell these people), if for writing the words of my Lord the sea becomes ink, then before the words of my Lord finishes, the sea shall be over, even if you bring another sea to help it.

(O Prophet) say: I am also a human (in appearance) like you, only difference that my origin is different and revelation came to me that your Lord is only One; so whoever is desirous of appearing before his Lord should do good deeds, and do not make anybody partner in His worshipping.
Kaaf Ya Ha Ain Saad.
This is the tale of the Mercy of your Lord which He did on His servant Zakaria.
When Zakaria called his Lord in low voice.
And said: O my Lord my bones have become weak, and my head is flared up, with old age, and O my Lord I was never deprived after praying to You.
And I fear for my heirs that (they might destroy the religion) and my wife is a barren, so give to me an heir (child) from Your Court.
Who would inherit mine and Yaqoob's generation and O my Lord, with whom You are pleased.
(Allah said) O Zakaria, We give you glad tidings of a son whose name shall be Yahya; and We have not created anybody before this with a similar name.
Zakaria said: O my Lord, how will a son be born out of me? Condition is such that my wife is barren and I myself have reached an extreme old age.
Allah said: it will happen, your Lord is saying that it is easy for Me, before this you were created when you were nothing.
Zakaria said: O my Lord! give some sign for me; the command arrived : your sign is that for three nights (and days) you will not be able to speak to the people.
Then Zakaria came out from his place of worship to go to his people, and he said to them in sign language: glorify Him morning and evening (continuously).
(Yahya was born and he was commanded), O Yahya! Hold the book (Taurait) tightly and granted him prophethood when he was a child.
And granted him soft-heartedness and purity and he was himself pious.
He was kind to his parents and was not disobedient and transgressor.
And salutations are on him (from Our side) when he was born and when he will die and when he will be raised again.
(And O Prophet), Also described in the book about Maryam when she separated from her people and went to her Eastern place.
Then she drew a curtain before them, then We sent Our Spirit to her, and he went in front of her as a well-made human.
She was frightened to see him and said: if you are pious then I seek refuge in Allah from you (get away from me).
Gabriel said: I am just a messenger of your Lord to give you a pure son.
How can I bear a son when no human has ever touched me and neither I am evil-doer.

It will happen, your Lord has said that this is easy for me (giving a son without a husband); so that We make him Our sign for the people, and (a source of) Our Mercy, and this has already been decided.
Then she conceived on her own, and she withdrew herself from the people, and went to a remote house.
(When the time for childbirth neared), labor-pain brought her to a dried palm tree, she said: I wish I would have died before this; and I would have been a forgotten thing.
Then Gabriel called out from below, do not grieve, see that your Lord has made to flow for you a fountain beneath you.
And shake the branch of the palm tree towards you, so it will drop fresh and ripe dates.

Then eat, and drink water from the fountain and cool your eyes with your son, then if you see any man, say (with a hint): I have promised a fast in the name of Allah and I cannot not speak to anyone today.
Then Maryam came to her nation carrying the boy in her lap. (upon seeing her) they said: O Maryam! You have done an evil thing.
O Sister of Haroon, neither your father was not a bad man nor your mother was an evil-doer (what is this you have done).
Then Maryam pointed towards the boy (ask him, whatever you want to ask), how can we speak to a child in the lap?
(Upon this the child spoke with the command of Allah) Verily I am servant of Allah, and He has given me the book (Injeel) and made me a Prophet.
And He made me blessed wherever I may be, and till I am alive I have been emphasized to establish prayer, and give charity.
And made me obedient to my mother, and (thank Allah) He has not made me a transgressor and disobedient.
And salutation is on me (from Allah) on the day when I was born, the day when I will die and the day when I will be raised to life again.
This is the true tale of the son of Maryam, Isa, in which these people doubt (unnecessarily).
It is not befitting for Allah to make anybody His son, He is pure and purest, and when He decides to do something, he just says: Be, and it becomes.
And there is not any doubt that Allah is my Lord and your Lord also, so all of you worship Him, this is the straight path (of Oneness).
Then different groups disputed among themselves, and woe unto them who adopted infidelity, and they will have to face a Great Day (Day of Judgement).
When they will come in My Presence then they shall well listen and see, but these unjust are in manifest misguidance today.
(And O Prophet), Warn them of the day of intense regret when definite judgement will be made, and now they are in the state of negligence and are not believing.
There is not any doubt that one day We will inherit earth and whatever is on it. (and everything will be decimated) and everyone will be returned to Us.
And (O Prophet), mention Ibrahim in the Quran who was indeed a very truthful prophet.
When he said to his (step) father: O father! why do you worship this which neither can hear nor can see, nor it can be of any use to you.
O my father! Verily that knowledge has come to me which you do not have; so follow me, I will show you the right path.
O my father! Do not worship Satan, Satan is a disobedient servant of Allah.
O my father! I fear that punishment of the Beneficent may befell on you and you become companion of Satan.
(Azar) Said: O Ibrahim, don't you believe in my gods? If you will not desist from these things, then remember I will stone you; and get away from me forever.
Ibrahim said: accept my salutation, still I will pray for your forgiveness from my Lord because He is very gracious to me.
And I am leaving you and those whom you make partner with Allah, and I shall worship my Lord only, I hope that I will not be deprived of worshipping.
When Ibrahim left those people who worshipped others leaving Allah, then We gave him Ishaq and Yaqoob (as sons), and made each of them prophet.
And We bestowed upon them part of Our mercy; and appointed for them highest mention of truthfulness.
And mention Moosa in the Book that he was Our humble servant, was sent as a prophet.
And We called him from the right side of Mount Tur (Sinai); and called him near to Us to converse with him.
And with Our special Mercy gave him his brother Haroon, a prophet.
(And O Prophet), mention Ismail in the Book, indeed he was truthful in his promise, and he was sent as a prophet.
And he used to urge his family for establishing up prayer and giving poor-rate, and he was a favourite in the Court of his Lord.
(O Prophet), also mention Idris in the Book, indeed he was a truthful prophet.
And We raised him, and reached him to a very lofty place (Paradise).

These prophets upon whom Allah bestowed His Mercy are the children of Adam, and from the generation of those, to whom We had made to embark on the Ark of Nooh, and are the children of Ibrahim and Yaqoob; and are from the people to whom We have guided and chosen, when verses of (Allah) the Beneficent are recited in front of them, they fall down in prostration while crying.

{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} Thereafter, some wicked people became their heirs, who neglected prayer; and became the followers of their desires; shortly they will meet their misguidance (they will face punishment of their misguidance).
But whose repentance is accepted and they did the good deeds; these people shall enter the Paradise; no unjust will be done to them.
And they shall abide in ever-green gardens for which Beneficent Allah has promised to His servants in the unseen, and Verily His promise is going to come to the fore.
They will not listen to anything vulgar there but only salutations (of peace), their sustenance shall be ready morning and evening whenever they want.
This is that Paradise and from among Our servants who would be pious, We will make them inherit this.

(O Prophet, said Gabriel), we do not descend without the command of your Lord, whatever is in our front and rear, and whatever is in between them. (i.e. everything) belongs to Him; and your Lord is not forgetful.
He is Lord of skies and the earth and whatever is in between them, so you worship Him, and be steadfast in worshipping Him; do you know anybody with a similar name?
And some humans are amazed and say that when I die, soon I will be raised alive again from the grave?
So, does not he remember that when We created him before this when he was nothing?
(O Prophet) by your Lord, We will gather them together with Satans; then We will present them around Hell on their knees.
Then We will separate those persons from among every group, who were most disobedient to the Beneficent (Allah).
Then Verily We are aware who deserves more to be thrown in Hell.
And there is no one among you who shall not pass over it (because the Bridge of Siraat is set upon that); this is an unavoidable promise of your Lord.
Then We will deliver the pious ones, and shall throw the disobedient ones in it on their knees.
And when our manifest verses are recited before them so those who adopt infidelity ask the believers: whose rank is better between us, and whose assembly is best.
Although, We have destroyed many parties before them, who were much better in equipment and showcasing.

(O Prophet), say: if a person is in misguidance, then the Beneficent (Allah) gives him respite; until he will see with his own eyes the thing which is promised for him - either punishment or the Hour (Day of Judgement), then they will realize who is worst in the rank, and who is weaker in forces.
And those who are on the right path, Allah increases their guidance, and good deeds which remain, are better than the way of reward, and are also better with regards to the consequences.
(O Prophet), did you notice the man who denied Our verses and said: I will Verily get wealth and children (even if the Day of Judgement is established).
Has he come to know the unseen, or made any covenant with the Beneficent Allah?
Never. We are writing what he says and increasing his punishment more.
And whatever he is saying We will inherit all, and he shall come to Us alone.
And they have made others their god instead of Allah so that they become the cause of their honor.
Never! (But) instead these gods will deny their worshipping and will become their opponent.
(O Prophet), did not you see the thing, that We have left Satan on the infidels so that he misguides them.
Make no haste against them (for punishment); We are just counting the days for their punishment.
The day when Beneficent Allah will gather the pious people before Him like guests.
And (We) will drive away the sinners towards Hell like thirsty (animals).
On that day these people will not be able to intercede, except the person who have made covenant with the Beneficent Allah.
And these people (Jews) say that Beneficent (Allah) has made a son (to Uzair).
(O Prophet), say: You have said such a strong thing (by your forging).
It is near that skies may burst and earth may crack, and mountains may fall down in pieces.
Because of the thing that they have made a son to the Beneficent (Allah).
Whereas, it is not in any way appropriate for the Beneficent (Allah) that He (take) somebody as son.
Everything of the skies and the earth come before the Beneficent (Allah) as servant only.
Verily, He has encompassed them all in His knowledge, and He has well counted them all.
And they all will present themselves before Him individually on the Day of Judgement.
Verily, those who believe and did good deeds, shortly the Beneficent (Allah) will make their love imperative on people.
Verily, We have made this Quran easy in your language, so that you give glad tidings (of Paradise) to the pious people, and warn the contentious people (of Arab from punishment of Allah).
And before them how many parties We have destroyed; do you see any of them or hear even any whisper of them.
O Ta’ha.
(O Prophet), We have not revealed the Quran for your distress.
But it is advice for those who are fearful.
This has been revealed from Him Who has created earth and high skies.
The Beneficent (Allah) is firmly on the Throne with all attention.
Whatever is on the skies, and whatever is on earth, and whatever is in between them, and whatever is beneath the earth, everything is His.
If you call upon Him (loudly or slowly), He knows the secrets, and more hidden things.
Allah is that (Lord), and there is no god except Him; all beautiful names are His.
(O Prophet), did the news of Moosa reach you?
That when he saw the fire from afar, and said to his family (you wait here) I have seen the strange fire; let me go and bring a flame of it to you; or may find some way there.
When he reached near the fire came the sound: O Moosa!
I am your Lord, take off your footwear, because right now you are in the chattel plain of Sacred Valley, Tuwa.
And I have chosen you (to be Our messenger); listen to Our revelation attentively.
Indeed, I am that Allah and there is no god except Me, worship Me and establish prayer to remember Me.
Verily, the Day of Judgement is going to come, and necessarily I will keep it hidden, that every person might be rewarded as he would strive.
So let it not be that a person who does not believe in it and follows his psychological desires, and he may deviate you from this, and you may be destroyed.
What is in your right hand, O Moosa?
(Moosa) said: this is my staff, I recline on it, and with it I break leaves (of trees), for my sheep and I have other uses for it also.
(Allah) Said: O Moosa, throw it on the ground.
Moosa threw it down and it turned into a serpent and started moving.
(Moosa got frightened, Allah) said: pick it up, do not fear, We will restore it to its earlier state.
Press your hands under your arms, then you will see that without any illness your hand will come out white and shining, this is the second miracle.
So that We show you Our bigger signs.
Now you go to Firaun, he has transgressed the limits.
Moosa said: O my Lord! broaden my chest for me.
And make my task easy for me.
And untangle the knots of my tongue.
so that people may understand my words properly.
and make a minister from among my family.
Haroon, my brother.
strengthen my back through him.
And make him a partner in my task.
That we both would Glorify You too much.
And that we may remember You in abundance.
That You are seeing our condition.
(Allah) said: O Moosa! All your requests are granted.
And We had already bestowed favour to you once.
And We inspired your mother which is being told to you through revelation.

Saying: put him (Moosa) into a chest and then cast it in the river, then river will push it ashore, there Moosa's enemy and my enemy (Firaun) will pick him up, and We had put a shadow of Our love on you. (whoever will see will love you); so that under Our guardianship you might be brought up.

Then your sister went there and said: if you want I can introduce to you a midwife who will take good care of this child; in this way we returned you to your mother that her eyes remain cool; that she does not grieve on your separation (then) you killed a person (and you were very depressed), then We delivered you from depression, and We tried you severely, then you lived for some years among the people of Madyan; then you reached an age (and became capable for prophethood), O Moosa.
And I have chosen you for Our prophethood.
Go, you and your brother with My miracles; and be not lazy in remembering Me.
Both of you go to Firaun he has become severe transgressor.
Go and talk to him softly, so he may take guidance or be fearful.
(They) both said: O our Lord, we fear that he may exceed his limits upon us and he may become more transgressing.
(Allah) Said: fear not, I am with you, and I hear and see everything.

You both go to him and say: we are the messengers of your Lord, send Bani Israel with us and do not persecute them and we have come with the miracle of your Lord; and whoever will follow the right path, peace is for him.
It has been revealed on us from Lord that Verily (Allah's) punishment is for him, who deny His communication and turn his face away (from His commands).
Firaun asked: after all who is your Lord, O Moosa?
Moosa said: our Lord is He who gave everything its proper form and then guided them (to their goals).
Firaun asked: tell us about the condition of earlier generations.
Said Moosa: knowledge of all these things is with my Lord written in a Book (i.e. Laoh-e-Mahfooz), He neither forgets nor errs.
That is He, Who spread the earth and made ways in it for you, and He rained water from the sky, then (says Allah): from that water made different vegetations.
That you also eat and let your cattle also graze, indeed there are many signs in it for those who understand.
We created you from it (dust) and will return you to it (dust), and (on the Day of Judgement) We will raise you once again from it (dust).
And verily We showed all Our signs to Firaun, but still he denied and did not believe.
Said Firaun: O Moosa you have come to us; so that you may drive us away (from Egypt), on the strength of your magic?
So we are also presenting the same magic to you, then make an appointment between us and you; that neither we break it, nor you; and meeting place should be an open ground.
(Moosa) said: your appointment (for confronting) is the day of elegance (Festivity) and let all the people be gathered together before noon.
Then Firaun returned to his place and started concerting his plans, then he came back (for confronting).
Moosa said (to Firaun): you perish, do not falsely blame on Allah, otherwise you will be decimated by the punishment; and indeed (remember) he who slanders (on Allah) never attains (his desire).
On this they quarreled and started whispering.
And they said: indeed, they both are magicians, and they want to expel you from your land through their magic, and want to destroy your well-established religion.
So collect all your planning and come in battle-line, whoever will overpower (the other) today, he shall be successful.
(At last magicians said) O Moosa, will you throw; or shall we be the first (in throwing magic)?
Moosa said: you throw first (when they threw), with effect of their magic it appeared to Moosa that their sticks are moving.
Moosa felt some fear in his heart.
(Allah said to Moosa), fear not, indeed you will have the upper hand.

And throw down whatever (staff) is in your right hand, it will swallow their tricks, because the tricks they have shown are the tricks of magician, and magician cannot be successful wherever he will go.
(So staff of Moosa swallowed everything), all the magicians fell in prostration and said: we (now) believe in the Lord of Haroon and Moosa.

Firaun said to them: you believed before I gave permission to you? Verily he is your chief who has taught the magic to you; indeed, I will cut you hand and leg from opposite sides and will Verily crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, then you will come to see that who is more severe and more lasting between us in punishment.

Magicians said: we cannot prefer you over the explicit and bright miracles which have come to us, and over Him, Who created us; you may do whatever you wish because you can only govern the (little) life of this world.
And we believe on our Lord that He may forgive all our sins and (especially) sins of our magic on which you compelled us, and Allah is The Best and He is Everlasting.
Indeed whoever comes before his Lord as a sinner, Verily there is Hell for him, in which neither he shall die nor he shall live.
And whoever will come to him as a believer, and has done good deeds, these are the people who shall have high ranks.
They will forever abide in evergreen-gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing; and this is the reward for those who kept themselves purified (from the sins).
And We revealed to Moosa that: take My servants out of (Egypt) during night time, touch the river with staff and make a dry path in it for them; and you will not have any fear of chase or drowning.
Firaun chased them with his army, then water of the river completely overwhelmed and covered them.
And Firaun led his people astray and destroyed them and did not guide them.
O Bani Israel! We delivered from the claws of your enemy, and made an appointment with you for the right side of Mount Tur (Sinai), and sent upon you Mann-va-Salwa.

Eat (and drink) out of pure sustenance We have given to you; and don't create any mischief in it, otherwise Our wrath will befall upon you, and remember, on whoever my wrath befell he is indeed misguided (i.e. perished).
And whoever will repent and believe and will do good deeds and be steadfast, then We will Verily forgive him.
(And when Moosa went ahead with seventy people, We said): what made you hurry from your people! O Moosa?
(Moosa) said: they were walking close to me; and O my Lord! I hastened (towards you), so that You be pleased with me.
And We tested your people in your absence, and Samri led them astray.

Then Moosa returned regretfully and wrathfully towards his people and said: O my people! did not your Lord make a good promise to you (to give Taurait); did the time seem lengthy to you; and you wanted the wrath of your Lord befall on you; and you did exactly opposite of your promise.

And they said we have not broken our promise on our own, but instead we were laden with the jewelry of the people (when we had fled from Firaun), on his advice (Samri) we threw them in fire; then Samri also threw (in fire) likewise;
Then he (Samri) made an idol of calf (from this jewelry), its sound was also like a calf, on this some people said this is your lord and Lord of Moosa, but he forgot.
They did not think this much that the calf cannot reply to their talk and neither it is capable of any harm nor any benefit to them.
Haroon has said earlier to them that O my people, you are being tested by this; and indeed your Lord is the Beneficent Allah, so you follow me and obey my order.
They said: unless Moosa returns to us, we will not stop worshipping this.
Moosa said (to Haroon): what prevented you from following me (i.e. killing them) when you saw that they were misguided?
Did you disobey my orders?

Haroon said: O son of my mother! do not catch my beard nor my head, I feared only one thing that you might not say on your return that I caused division among Bani Israel and didn't respect your words.
Then he asked Samri: what is your condition?

He replied: I saw the thing which others could not see. (when Gabriel was going on his horse) I picked a handful of dust from beneath the feet of Gabriel (his horse) (and threw it in the mouth of the idol, and he started talking), then my soul commanded me this.

Moosa said: get away! your punishment in this world is that you would say: 'do not touch me' (or else I will get fever); and Verily (in the Hereafter also) there is promise for punishment for you, which you cannot oppose, and look at your lord on whose worship you persist, indeed we will bring it to ashes by burning, then we will scatter it in rivers.
Your god is only Allah, there is no truthful god except He, His knowledge is encompassing over everything.
(O Prophet!) And like this We relate the tales which have gone by; and from Our Court We bestowed upon you the Quran.
Whoever will turn his face away from it, he shall certainly bear the burden of his own bad deeds on the Day of Judgement.
They will forever remain in this condition, and what a bad burden it is which they will be carrying on the Day of Judgement.
The day when the trumpet shall be blown, We will gather the guilty together with their eyes turned blue (in blind condition); and present them before Us.
They will talk softly among themselves that we stayed a maximum period of ten days (in the world or the grave).
Whatever they will say that day, We know well; and clever among them will say you stayed there (maximum) just for a day.
(O Prophet), People ask you that what will happen to the mountains (on the Day of Judgement), so you tell them: Allah will make them small particles and scatter them.
And He will make the earth a barren land.
And (O man), you shall not see any crookedness or any twist in it.

That day everyone will run towards the sound of the Caller (Israfil) in a straight queue - and there will not be any crookedness in it, that day all the sounds will be silenced before Him, the Beneficent; and there won't be any sound except whispering (commotion).
On that day nobody's intercession will be of any use; except for those to whom Allah has allowed and whose words Allah is pleased with.
He knows whatever is before them and whatever is behind them, He knows everything, and they cannot dominate Him with their knowledge.
The faces of all will be humbled before Ever-Living, Everlasting Lord; and he who bears the burden of oppression will be unsuccessful.
And whoever did good deeds and was also a believer; he shall not have fear for any unjust or any loss.
And We sent Quran in Arabic language and described in it the different types of punishments so that these people become pious, or it creates a reminder in their minds.

Allah is truthful and most-High, the real Master (of the two worlds). (O Prophet!) do not haste in reciting the Quran before the revelation is completed on you; and pray: O my Lord! increase my knowledge.
And We have taken covenant from Adam before (that not to go near that tree), but Adam forgot it, and We did not find in him stability and independence.
And when We said to the angels to prostrate before Adam, then everyone prostrated but Iblis refused.
Then We told Adam: O Adam! indeed he is your enemy and enemy of your wife see that he may not become the cause for you to leave Paradise, and you fall in affliction (of the world).
Indeed, there is ease for you here (in Paradise) that you will neither remain hungry nor will be unclothed.
And neither you shall be thirsty here nor will you feel the heat of the sun.
So Satan whispered in his heart and said: O Adam! shall I guide you to the tree of everlasting life and to the kingdom which will never decline.
So, they both ate from the tree, then their private parts became manifest, and they began to hide them with garden leaves, and Adam disobeyed his Lord so he went away from the way of comfort.
Then his Lord chose him and accepted his repentance and guided him.

Allah said: both of you have to descend from Paradise, all of you are enemy to another, when My guidance reaches you, then you follow it; whoever will follow My guidance can never go astray and nor fall in trouble.
And whoever turns away his face from My remembrance, his life will be spent in severe straitness, and We will raise him on the Day of Judgement, blind.
He will say: O my Lord! I had eyes in the world, why have you raised me as blind?
Allah will say: it should be like this, you forgot when Our verses had come to you; likewise, you will be forgotten today.
And whoever transgressed and did not believe in his Lord's verses, then We will recompense him similarly, and punishment of the Hereafter is very severe and long lasting.
Did not that Lord tell inhabitants of Makkah that in whose dwellings these people go about, how many people He has destroyed before them; indeed, there are many signs in it for those who understand.
And (O Prophet), if Allah had not appointed the time earlier (for their punishment), immediate punishment was imperative because of their deeds.

(O Prophet), be patient on whatever they say to you, and praise with glorification to your Lord, before rising of the sun and before it is set; and glorify Him in the parts of the night and during the parts of the day so that you become well pleased.

And (O Prophet!) we have provided some with the splendor of this world, so that We test them, you do not stretch your eyes towards them, because sustenance given by your Lord is much better and lasting than this.
And enjoin to establish prayer to your household, and you also adhere to it, We do not ask for sustenance from you, but We bestow sustenance on you, and the consequence of piousness is good.
And they (inhabitants of Makkah) say why don't you bring a miracle (of our choice) to us, so the prophecies which are in the earlier books (Taurait and Injeel) did not reach them?

And if We would have destroyed them with punishment before (sending) this Prophet, then they would have said: O our Lord! why didn't You send (your) Prophet to us, we would have followed your verses before our disgrace and shame.

(O Prophet!) say: everyone is awaiting his consequences; so you also wait, then you will come to know soon that which are the people of straight path (and who is on crookedness), who is guided one (and who is misguided).
The reckoning of people came to them (at a time) and they are turning away their face in heedlessness state.
When any new commandment comes from their Lord, they just listen with an ear and then make mockery of it.

Their hearts are totally unaware (from the Day of the Judgement), and these unjust secretly whisper that this man (Mohammad [SAW]) is nothing but a mortal like you, then will you entangle in manifest magic knowingly.
On this Prophet said: My Lord knows whatever is spoken in the sky and on earth (then what whispering you do); and he is all Hearing and Knowing.

They did not stop here but said: this is (Quran) a compilation of anxious dreams, looks like he has forged it on his own; rather he is a poet. (if he is really a prophet) then let him bring the miracles (of our choice) like earlier prophets were sent.
We destroyed the earlier people. (but they did not believe) even after seeing the miracles, then what will these people believe?
And we sent earlier than you males as prophets on whom We used to send revelations, so if you do not know then ask the knowledgeable.
And We did not make their body like that they do not eat, and neither did they remain in this world forever.
Then We showed them our promise (of punishment) come true; and when punishment came then We delivered the prophets and to whoever We pleased, and destroyed the transgressors.
And We revealed that book (Quran) to you in which your good mention is also there; so don't you understand this much?
We destroyed many settlements whose dwellers were transgressors and created other people in their place.
And when they felt our punishment coming, they started running suddenly.
(We said) do not run (now), go back to your homes where you lived an easy life, so that something is enquired with you.
They said: Oh!, our misfortune, verily we were transgressors.
They continue to say this, until We pushed them, and made them like the field which has been harvested (and burnt), as heap of silent ash, which is drenched.
Whatever is in the skies and on earth and in between them, We have not created useless.
If We wanted to create any play then indeed, We would have done it with our proposition, if We pleased (but it was not suitable for our Stature).
And We hurl the Truth over the falsehood, which crushes the head of the falsehood, and it perishes there itself; woe unto you, what unjust things you describe.
Whereas. (Angels) who are in the skies and on earth are all His servants; (the angels) who are in His (very) Presence they neither feel proud about their prayers, nor do they ever get weary.
Day and night glorify Him and never show laziness.
And those who have made gods on the earth, will they bring them to life?
Even if there were gods besides Allah in the skies and on the earth, then both would have been perished long back, so Glory be to Him, He is much above than what they attribute to Him.
He cannot be questioned about whatever he does, but people will be questioned.

Or have they made other gods leaving Allah? O Prophet say: bring your argument, who are with me, their book (Quran) and who were before me, their books (Taurait and Injeel) are present, but most of them do not know the truth and they turn their face.
And before you, whichever prophet We sent, We continuously sent revelation that nobody is worthy of worship except Me, so worship Me (only).
And dwellers of Makkah say: Beneficent Allah has taken angels as His children, whereas He is much Higher than this, and angels are His noble servants.
They do not speak over His talk, and they act only on His command.

Whatever is in front of them and whatever is behind them, Allah knows everything, and they do not do intercession except for those with whom Allah is pleased, and they themselves tremble with His fear.
If somebody say that Allah does not exist, but I am the lord, then he is rejected one (from Allah) and We will give him punishment of Hell, and We give such punishment to the unjust.

And whoever have become infidels, don't they ponder that skies and the earth were closed, then We opened them up, and it is We Who created every living thing from water, so will they not then believe yet?
And only We created heavily loaded mountains so that the earth does not tilt on any side with them, and We created long and wide ways so that they may travel to their destinations.
And We made the sky their roof which is secure from all sides, and these people are turning their face away on the sky signs.
And That's That (predominantly powerful) who has created the night and the day, sun and the moon, they are all circumambulating in the celestial sphere.
O Prophet! (Even) before you We did not give everlasting life to any mortal, so when you die, will they live forever?
Every soul shall taste death (one day), and We test you with difficulty and ease, and (eventually) you have to return to Us only.
(O Prophet!) When infidels see you, they make fun of you and say: is it the person who remembers (badly) to your gods, whereas they themselves deny the remembrance of the Beneficent Allah.
Man is created of haste, soon We will show you signs of Our Power, then you will not do the haste.
And they say: when the promise of the Day of the Judgement will be fulfilled, if you are truthful?

And who have become infidels, wish they were aware of the condition of time when they will stand in the Hellfire and they will not be able to ward off fire from their faces and their backs, and they shall not be helped.
The Day of Judgement will not come with information but it will come suddenly and will make them astonished, then they cannot stop it nor they will be given any respite.
(O Prophet!) Not only you, but before you they have mocked the prophets; then those who mocked them were afflicted with the punishment of what they used to make fun of.
O Prophet! ask them who can keep you safe from punishment (of Allah) during the night, or during the day? Yet these people continue to turn their face away from remembrance of the Beneficent Allah.
Do they have other gods who can defend them against Us, these people cannot defend themselves nor they will be given any respite from Our punishment.

Whereas We have given their elders ease and comfort until they reached the advance age, then do not they see that We have dominated the earth from (all) four sides, and continue victory over it, so still do they think they are winning and prevailing?
O Prophet! Say: I warn you as per revelation. (and as if you are deaf, because) when deaf are warned, they do not listen to the calling.
And (O Prophet!) say: even if a little air of punishment of your Lord touches them, then suddenly they will say, woe to us, indeed we were unjust.

And on the Day of Judgement (to measure the good and the bad deeds of Our servants) we will establish Scale of the Justice, then no unjust will be done to anybody; and if anybody would have done anything (whether good or bad) even as a weight of mustard seed, we shall bring it forth, and We are sufficient to take account.
And Verily, We gave Moosa and Haroon the book (Taurait) so that they can differentiate (between truth and falsehood); and We bestowed upon pious people, advice and total light.
Who fear their Lord without seeing Him, and these people fear the Day of Judgement also.
This (Quran) is a greatly blissful word, which We have revealed, so do you not believe in it?
There is no doubt that We had given patience and understanding to Ibrahim earlier, and We were fully aware of his condition.
When he said to his people and his father that the idols which you worship, what is this (rubbish)?
They said: we (do not know anything else, but) had seen our elders worship them.
Ibrahim said: you and your elders were all in manifest misguidance.
They said: have you come to us with truth or you also doing amusement?
Ibrahim said (not joking) but these idols are not your lords, but your Lord is the Master of the skies and the earth, who created them, and I, myself, a witness of this in front of you.
Ibrahim said: after your turning away I will do plotting against these idols.
Ibrahim broke all idols into pieces except the big one, so that when they come back from festival, they should go to him.
(When infidels came to know) they said: whoever has done this misbehaviour with our gods has certainly done great unjust.
(Some of them said): we have seen a youth called Ibrahim who were ill-speaking about these idols.
They said: arrest and bring him in front of all, so whatever he will say, people might witness to his talk.
(When Ibrahim came), they said: O Ibrahim have you done this to our gods?
Ibrahim said: this has been done by the big idol, so ask them if they can speak.
Then they thought and said: (to each other) Verily only you yourselves are unjust.
Then their heads were caused to bow down (in the misguidance) and they could not do anything and said: you know that idols cannot speak.
So do you worship these things leaving Allah, which neither can benefit you nor they can cause any harm to you.
Curses on you, and on the things you worship, leaving Allah; so don't you understand this.
They said (to one to another): if you can do anything, burn Ibrahim in fire and help your gods.
(After all they threw Ibrahim in fire), so We said: O Fire! be cool and be a means of safety to Ibrahim.
And they wanted to plot against Ibrahim but We failed them all.
And it was We who delivered Ibrahim and Lut (from transgressors) towards safety and peace and reached them to this land (Bait al-Maqdas), where We kept different blessings for the entire world.
And We rewarded Ibrahim with (son) Ishaq and (grandson) Yaqoob; and We made them all good.

We made them all leaders (of the people), who used to guide them on Our Command; and We sent revelation on them for doing good work. (establishing) prayer and giving poor-rate, and they used to do Our worship only.

And to Lut also We gave patience and understanding and prophethood, and We delivered him from the town whose residents were wicked, and there is no doubt that those people were very evil and transgressors.
And We gave place to Lut in Our Mercy and there is no doubt that he was from the good people.
And (O Prophet! before Lut) We gave prophethood to Nooh, when he called Me then We heard his prayer, and delivered him and his companions from great distress (of typhoon).
And whoever has denied our verses We helped him against them, indeed they were bad people, and We drowned them all and killed them.

And (O Prophet!) remind them the tale of Dawood and Suleiman, when they both sat to decide about incident, when people's sheep intruded at night into the field and grazed it, and We were witnessing their judgement.

(When they disputed among) so We told the right judgement to Suleiman, and (like this) only We give wisdom and understanding and knowledge to all, and We directed mountains to obey Dawood, and they were used to glorify (Allah) with him, and We directed birds to obey him, and only We do such things.
And We taught him how to make iron armor, to save you from attack of one another, so now will you then be His grateful?

And We directed violent winds to obey Suleiman, and they were pursuing their course towards this land (Bait al-Maqdas) with his command, which We had blessed differently, and We are the knower of all the things.
And the Jinn who were diving to bring out gems, and were doing other works also; We directed them to obey Suleiman, and We were watching over them (so that they may not run away).
And O Prophet! remember the tale of Ayub, when he prayed to his Lord that ailment has afflicted me, and You are the most Merciful among the mercifuls.
