Then We accepted his prayer and warded off his pain and difficulties, and gave him his family and similarly much more from Our Grace; this is a reminder for worshippers.
And gave him Ismael and Idris and Zulkafal, remember! they were all among those who had patience.
And We had entered all of them in our Mercy; Verily, they were all Our good character servants.

And remember Yunus when he went in anger thinking We will not straiten his sustenance; then he went into darkness and called Us: O Lord there is no god except You, Glory be to You, the Self-Sufficient, and I was among those who were unjust on their own souls.
Then We accepted his prayer and delivered him from grief, and thus We deliver the believers.
And remember Zakaria, when he prayed to his Lord: O my Lord, leave me not alone (without a child); and you are the best heir among heirs.

So We heard his prayer, and We gave him a son such as Yahya, and We made good his wife for him, indeed they used to do haste in the good works, and used to call Us with utmost love and fear and used to implore before Us.
And (O Prophet!) remember the Lady, who saved her chastity, so We breathed Our Spirit into her womb, and made her and her son (Isa) signs of Our Power for the world.
Indeed, this your religion (Islam) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me (only).
And yet the people disputed it and divided it; and (eventually) they all have to return to Us (there it will be decided).
He who does good deeds and is also a believer, his endeavour will not go waste, and We are writing his deeds.
And the settlements which We destroyed. (they may go anywhere) but it is not possible that on the Day of Judgement they will not come back to Us.
When Gog and Magog will be let loose, and they will come out from every height of the land.

Then the promise of the Day of Judgement will draw near, then infidels' eyes will become like stone, and will say: Oh our misfortune, we were in state of negligence of this day, and in fact we were the unjust.
That day the sound will come and say: you and those (all) whom you had worshipped leaving Allah will be the fuel of Hellfire, you shall all go down this.
If they were true gods, they would not have to go to Hell. (now) they shall all abide in it forever.
They will shout and groan in Hell, and in the commotion, they shall not hear anything.
Yes, however, for whom good is already written in fate by Us, they will be kept away from Hell.
They will not hear even the slightest sound of it, and they will forever live in desires of their choice.
They shall not have the fear of the great fearful Day of the Judgement and angels will meet them happily and will give them glad tidings that this is that day of happiness which was promised to you.

That will be the day when We will roll up the skies, like a scroll of writings are rolled. (and) like We had made the creatures earlier, We shall reproduce them again, and this is the promise which was imperative on us (to complete), and We shall Verily bring it about.
And We had written an admonition in Zaboor after (Taurait) that Our inheritors on the land will be righteous people.
Indeed, in it there is a message (of the commandments of Allah) for the worshippers.
And (O Prophet!) We sent you as complete mercy for people of the world.
(O Prophet!) Say: I have received the revelation that your Lord is only One Allah, so are you becoming his obedient servants?
Still if they turn their faces, then say: I have told you all in fairness. (and) that I do not know whether the promise of punishment which is made to you, is near or yet it is still far.
There is no doubt that He knows the things which you say loudly or which you hide secretly, He knows that also.
And I also do not know whether this delay is a trial for you and for a period there may be ease for you.
Prophet prayed: O my Lord judge justly between me and the infidels, and our Lord is most Beneficent, and from Whom the help is sought, against what you describe (for Him).
O people! Keep fearing Allah, because the earthquake of the Day of Judgement is not ordinary but a very severe thing.

When you will see it that day, when all breastfeeding mothers shall forget her breastfed children, and (due to fright that day) all pregnant women will abort their children; in panic people will appear as intoxicated whereas they will not be drunk, but the punishment of Allah is most severe.
And there are some people who dispute (without knowledge) regarding Allah and follow every transgressor Satan.
It has been written for them that whoever will befriend him, Verily, he will misguide them and will Verily reach them to the punishment of Hell.

O People, if you have any doubt in raising again after (your) death, then indeed you were created earlier with dust, then sperm, then frozen blood, then lump of flesh (which came into shape), complete and incomplete to show you (Our Power). (then what is the difficulty in your re-production) and in the womb of women We keep sperm for an appointed period, then bring you out as babies. (then We nourish you) so you reach your youth, some of you die (before reaching old age), and some of you are brought to the worst part of life (old age); that in spite of having knowledge (due to your age) you don't understand anything; and you are seeing the barren land, when we send rain on it, it flourishes and rises (once) again, and beautiful things of all kinds are grown.
(These powers We show you that you should know) This is because indeed Allah is Truth, and then Verily, He brings to life again the dead ones, and He has power over everything.
And the Hour shall Verily come and there is no doubt in it, and who are in graves Allah will bring them to life again.
And there are some people who dispute about Allah without understanding and getting guidance from the enlightening Book.

(Unnecessarily) they are disputing about Allah that they may misguide people from the path of Allah, for such people there is disgrace in this world as well as on the Day of Judgement, We will make him taste the punishment of Hell.
At that time it will be said: this is the punishment for your deeds, which your hands had done earlier, and Verily Allah do not do injustice to his servants.

And there are some among the people who worship on an edge, and if any good reaches him he becomes satisfied, but if any difficulty touches him, he immediately turns his face (towards infidelity); he is in loss in this world as well as in the Hereafter, this is the manifest loss.
Whoever calls those things at the time of his desires besides Allah, which can neither can harm him nor it can cause any benefit, this is the utter misguidance.
And to whom he calls (for his desires) whose loss is nearer than benefit, Verily such master and friend (both) are evil.
Indeed, who believed and did good works, Allah will take them and enter them into lush-green gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing, Verily Allah does whatever he pleases.

(Due to anger) whoever has misconception that Allah would not help him in this world and in the Hereafter, he may ascend towards sky through a rope, then cut it off, then see that struggle can ward off that thing or not; on which he was enraged.
And We have sent the Quran like manifest argument and bright sign, indeed, Allah guides to whoever He pleases.

Indeed, whoever believed (Muslims) and (those who are) Jews, and Atheists and Christians and Fire Worshippers (Majoosi) and polytheists, Verily, Allah will judge between them on the Day of Judgement, and there is no doubt that Allah is seeing everything.

Did not you see that whoever is in the skies and whoever is on the earth, Sun, Moon and Stars, Mountains and Trees, and cattle (in fact all creatures) and many from among the human beings, they all prostrate before Allah; and there are many for whom punishment has become imperative due to their disobedience, whoever Allah disgraces then nobody can give honor to him, there is no doubt that Allah does whatever He pleases.

{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} These are two adversaries (Believers and Non-Believers), they dispute among them regarding Allah; whoever have become non-believer, for them garment of fire will be cut, which they will be made to wear, and boiling water will be poured over their heads.
(Because of its heat) whatever is in their bellies (intestine, etc.) will be melted.
And there will be iron mace to hit them.
Due to shock when they try to flee, they will be hit by mace and pushed inside (again), and they will be told: (now) taste the burning punishment.

Who believed and did the good works too, Allah will make them enter into (lush green Paradise's) Gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing; there they will be adorned therein with the gold bracelet and (garlands) of pearls, and they shall wear the silky dress over there.
(This is because) in the world they were guided towards good words (Monotheism) and they were shown the correct way to praise (Allah).

Verily, who have become infidels and stop people from the way of Allah and Sacred Mosque (Ka'aba), which We have made the place of worship, on which everyone has an equal share whether people of inland or visitors and who misguide them mischievously, We will make him taste the grievous punishment.

O Prophet! remember the time when We identified the place of Kaaba through a cloud, and told him not to associate anything with Me; and keep it neat and clean for those who perform circumambulation, stand, bow and prostrate.
And give the people news of the Hajj, who will come to you on foot in groups, and on the lean animals coming from far off areas.

So, they may see their benefits, then during some appointed days. (sacrifice) the animals which Allah has given you as sustenance and take Allah's name and eat from it, then feed the hungry and needy from it.
Then people should clean away the dirtiness of their bodies and complete their offerings and circumambulate the ancient House (Kaaba).

And this is a command of Allah, whoever will respect the sacred ordinances of Allah, for him there will be great reward with Allah, and all the animals are lawful for you except for those which have been described to you, so prevent yourself from unclean idols and avoid useless and nonsense talks such as singing etc.

Be purely for Allah, and do not make anyone His partner, whoever made (anyone) His partner (as if) he has fallen from the sky, and a bird of prey snatches him (in between) or strong wind throws him far away.
(Remember) whoever respects the signs of Allah, undoubtedly, it gets through the piousness of hearts.
And there is benefit in cattle for an appointed period then their place of sacrifice is Ancient House (Ka'aba) of worship.

We have told the ritual of slaughter to every Ummah, so the four-footed cattle which Allah has given them, mention the name of Allah at the time of slaughter, your Lord is only One Allah so become His obedient, and (O Prophet!) give glad tiding of Paradise to Our servants who humbly implore.

These are the people whose hearts get frightened when Allah's name is mentioned before them, they show patience when affliction befalls them, are continuous in prayer, and spend from the sustenance given by Us in the way of Allah.

And We have made the sacrificial camels as (one of) Our signs, there is benefit for you in it, so mention the name of Allah while they stand and when all parts fall down then eat from it, and give to the poor whether they show contentment or ask for it, we have made them subservient to you so that you become grateful servants.

In the Court of Allah neither flesh will reach nor their blood, only your piousness will reach his Court, and like this We made animals subservient to you, that you may proclaim His Greatness on the guidance given by Allah, and give glad tiding to those who do good deeds.
Verily, Allah defend those who are believers; and indeed, Allah never befriends those who betray or are ungrateful.
The people who are continuously under war, they have been given permission to defend themselves on account of getting oppressed, and Verily Allah is well able to defend them.

These are the people who have been unjustly expelled from their homes, except because they say that their Lord is only Allah, if Allah would not have stopped the people by some others, then all the synagogues of Jews, all fire temples of Majoosi and all mosques, all would have been demolished, and Allah Verily will aid His helpers (His cause), and He is indeed Powerful and Honourable.
And these are the people whom We gave power on earth that they established prayer and gave poor-rate, and enjoin good, and prohibit evil, and this is sure that Allah has the power to do everything.
(O Prophet!) there is no surprise if these (infidels) deny you; before that people of Nooh and Aad and Samood.
And people of Ibrahim and people of Lut.

And companions of Madyan, had denied their prophets; and Moosa was also rejected (by his people), then We gave some respite to infidels and caught hold of them, then everyone saw how (severe) Our punishment is.
So many settlements We destroyed because they were unjust, now they are lying upside down on their roofs, their wells dried, and their strong palaces are lying in a demolished state.

Have not they travelled in land so they would have such hearts which could understand, they would have such ears which could hear, in fact eyes that are not blind, but hearts are blind which are found in their breasts.
O Prophet! These people are asking for haste in punishment, whereas Allah could never do the opposite to His promise, and one day near Allah is equal to one thousand years to them.
And there were many settlements to which We gave respite even though they were unjust, then We seized them, after all everyone has to return to Us.
Say: O People! I am a manifest warner for you.
Then whoever believed, and did good works, there is forgiveness and best sustenance for him.
Whosoever tried to frustrate Us with regards to Our verses, they are the companions of hell.

And We did not send any messenger or prophet before you who desired something good and Satan created impediment in the way of his desire, then Allah removed that impediment created by Satan, then made (His) verses firm, and He is all knowing and having Wisdom.
So that He makes Satanic inspiration their trial whose hearts are sick, and whose hearts have become stiff; and unjust indeed are involved in the long-term disobedience.

And those who have been given knowledge should know that the revelation is truth from the Lord, and like this they believed, and then their hearts humbly implore in His Court, and Verily Allah is the Guide for the believers towards the straight path.
And those who adopted infidelity, they will always be in doubt until suddenly the Day of Judgment reaches them, or punishment of an inauspicious day befall them.

That day the Kingdom will be purely of Allah only, He will judge the dispute among the people, so those who have accepted the faith, and did good works, they will be living in the Gardens full of bliss.
And who adopted infidelity and denied our verses, these are the people for whom is the disgraceful punishment.

Who migrated from their cities for the cause of Allah then were martyred or died (naturally) Allah shall certainly give them best sustenance in the Hereafter, and He is the Best among the sustenance givers.
And certainly, He will reach them to such a place (Paradise) that they will be happy, and Verily Allah is all Knowing and Forbearing.

This is proper that a person should trouble him in retaliation to his enemy as much as he was troubled by him; if he is given more trouble, then Allah will Verily help him; Allah is One that erase sins and is Forgiving.
Because Allah is all Powerful; He cause to enter the night into the day, and He cause to enter the day into the night, and there is no doubt that Allah Knows everything.
And because Allah is certainly the Truth, and besides Him to whoever they call, they are all falsehood, and this is also sure that Allah is Most High, the Great.
Oh, did not you see this much that Allah sends the rain from the sky (clouds) so that land becomes lush green, certainly Allah is the most Beneficent on his servants and knows everything.
Whatever is in the skies and whatever in on earth, all is His, there is no doubt that Allah is most Self-Sufficient and worthy of Praise.

Didn't you notice that Allah has made subservient to you whatever is on the earth and also the ships sailing in the sea with His command, and He is holding the skies that they do not fall on the earth but when His command will be. (it will fall), there is no doubt that Allah is most Benignant and Merciful.
And He is having Absolute Power that in the beginning He brought you to life in the wombs, then He will cause you to die, and shall bring you to life again, indeed man is very ungrateful.

(O Prophet!) We have appointed a method for every Ummah to which they follow, therefore they should not dispute in this religion (Islam), you call people towards your Lord, indeed you are on the straight path.
Still if people quarrel with you then say: whatever I am doing, Allah is well aware of it.
In which you were disputing, on the Day of Judgment Allah will judge between you people.
(O Prophet!) Don't you know whatever is in the skies and on earth Allah Verily knows it, indeed it all is all secure in this Book, verily this is easy for Allah.
And these people worship other things leaving Allah, for which neither Allah has sent any argument, nor they have knowledge of their being true, on the Day of Judgement no one will help the unjust.

(O Prophet!) When Our manifest and bright verses are recited in front of them then you see unhappiness on faces of the infidels, almost that they may attack those who are reciting Our verses; (O Prophet!) Say: shall I tell you worse than this, listen, that is Hell, Allah has promised infidels to send them to Hell, and how evil is the place.

O People! When an example is described so listen to it attentively, to whom you call besides Allah, even if they come all together, they cannot create even a fly, and if a fly snatches something from them, they cannot even rescue it (what a fun) seeker and the giver both are weak.
They should appreciate Allah which they didn't; there is no doubt that Allah is all Powerful and Predominant.
Allah chose among the angels to reach His message; and likewise, among the men, Verily Allah Hear and See everything.
And whatever is in front of them and whatever has happened before them, Allah Knows Everything, and all the matters are turned to Allah only.
O Believers, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord, and do good works so you become successful.

{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} And do the struggle in the way of Allah as it should be, He chose and did not force you in any way for religious affairs, and made religion of your father Ibrahim, your religion, and that Allah named you Muslim (obedient servant) before, and strive hard in this Quran also so that Prophet become a witness for you, and you become the witness for all men, keep up prayer, continue to give poor-rate, and hold fast commands of Allah, He is your Guardian, and what a good Guardian and good Helper He is.
Indeed, believers became successful.
Who humbly implore in their prayers.
And who objects to the useless talks.
And who are givers of poor-rate.
And who protect their private parts.
Except for their wives and their lady-slaves, they Verily are not blamable.
Then if anybody will find another way (for his carnal desires), he shall commit excesses.
And those believers who keep their trusts and promises.
And those who keep up their prayer regularly.
Indeed, these are the inheritors of Paradise.
They shall inherit Firdaus, and they are going to abide in it forever.
And We created man with the wet clay.
Then we placed it as sperm at a secure place.

Then made sperm a clot, then We made clot into a lump of flesh, then We made lump of bones, then We covered the bones with flesh, then We made it another creature, so how Blessed is that Allah; Who is the Best of the Creators.
Then you are all going to die.
Then you will be raised once again on the Day of Judgement.
And We have created atop you, seven skies one upon another; and We are not oblivious from our Creatures.
And We have sent water from the sky in a fixed quantity, then We caused it to collect on the earth, whereas We were also capable of taking it back.
Then with this water We created the gardens of palms and grapes in which ample of fruits are found, and you eat also some from them.
And created that tree which is found on the Mount Tur (Sinai), oil is also extracted from it, that it is also a curry for the eaters.
And verily there is a lesson for you in the animals, and in their bellies, there is substance for your fulfilment, and there are many advantages in it and you also eat from it.
And on ships and animals you mount.
And We sent Nooh to his people, he said: O my people! worship Allah, that for it you do not have any other god, why you do not fear Him.

Infidel chiefs of his people said: this Nooh is just a mortal like you, who wish to take superiority on you, if Allah pleased, He could have sent down the angels, this we have not heard from our forefathers.
In fact, he is a mortal who has become insane, so wait for some days for his condition.
So, Nooh prayed: O my Lord! help me against their denial.

So We revealed to him: make an ark in front of my eyes according to my direction, when Our command comes and water start to gush out from the oven, take two from each pair, and take your family and go, except for those people against whom Our judgement has already come, and do not speak to me about the unjust - they all shall be drowned.
After this, when you board the Ark with your companions and be comfortably seated then say: thanks to the Lord who delivered us from the unjust people.
And say: O my Lord! cause us to disembark on a blessed place, because you are the Best who cause to disembark.
In this there are many of Our signs, We only take tests (from you).
Then We created other nations.
And We sent prophets among them so you all worship Allah that you do not have any god except Him, will not you become pious?

Chiefs of their tribes who have adopted infidelity and were denying the meeting of Allah in the Hereafter and We had given them life of ease, said: he is nothing but a mortal like you, he eats like you and drinks like you do.
And if you obey a mortal like you then Verily you will be at loss.
Does he promise to you that after you die and become dust and bones, you will be raised again?
Far, far away! What matter is being promised to you?
This is a worldly life where we will die and are not going to be raised again.
This is such a man who blames God, and we do not believe in him.
The Prophet said: O my Lord! help me, they are denying me.
Allah said: Shortly they will become remorseful.
Resultant, they were overtaken by a truthful mighty cry, and we made them rubbish, for there is death and destruction for the unjust people.
Then We created the new nations.
No nation can go ahead or lag from the appointed time.

Thereafter, we continuously sent the prophets, whenever any prophet came to them, they accused him of falsehood, and We also went on killing them (those people, one after another) and made them tales, because there is destruction for the nation who do not believe.
Then We sent Moosa and his brother Haroon with our manifest arguments.
Towards Firaun and his chiefs of the government, they also showed arrogance, and they were people of haughty type.
So they said: shall we believe in two men like us, when their people are worshipping us.
They denied them with this, and they became among the people who perished.
And We gave Moosa the Book, so that they may believe like this.
And We made the son of Maryam and his mother, our signs; We gave them a place to settle on the height, where a fountain was also there.
O my Prophets! eat pure things and do good work, We are well aware of your deeds.
And religion of all of you is one religion and I am the Lord of all, so fear Me only.
Then they divided the religion into sects, and every sect is happy and satisfied with whatever they have.
Now you leave them in this misguidance for a period.
Do they think that (because) We are giving them wealth and children?
We are hastening in their good work, never, they are unaware of the respite given to them.
Verily who keep shivering from the fear of their Lord.
And those who believe in the signs of their Lords.
And those who do not make anyone a partner of their Lord.
And those who keep giving in the way of Allah according to their capacity, and they keep fearing that they have to return to His Court.
These are the people who excel in doing good; and these are the people who are going to go ahead from the rest.
We do not burden any soul more than his capacity, and We have the book which speaks the truth, and no unjust will be done to them.
Whereas their hearts are drowned in total ignorance, and they have a different set of deeds which they follow.
Since We took their wealthy ones in Our punishment, now they are all pleading.
Now do whatever wailing (you want), today help will not come from Our side.
When Our verses were recited in front of you then you were running on your back foot.
Arrogantly, while talking uselessly and telling tales.
Did not they ponder over our talk; did they receive anything which their forefathers had not received?
Or it is because they did not recognize their prophet, that they deny.
Or their saying that there is madness in the prophet, whereas he has brought truth to them, and their majority does not like the truth.

If truth would have followed their desires, then whatever is in between skies and on earth and in between them would have been destroyed, whereas We have given them admonition, but they have turned away from the admonition.
Are you asking for expenses from them! Absolutely not, because expenses given by Allah are better for you, and He is the Best provider of sustenance.
And you are the inviter to the straight path for them.
And those who do not believe on the Hereafter, have gone astray.
And if We show Mercy on them and ward off their distress, still they will stay on their transgression, and will go in further misguidance.
We caught them with our punishment, but they neither bowed down before their Lord nor they humbly implored.
Until We opened the door of severe punishment (for them), but they sat disappointed in it.
And that is Allah Who made ears, eyes and hearts for you, but you are very less grateful.
And He spread you on the whole land, and you (all) will be collected in His Court.
That is He, Who gives life and death, and coming and going of the day and night is in His Power, then why do not you use wisdom?
But they said the same words which their earlier ones have said.
That if we die and become dust and bones, will we be raised again?
Certainly, the promise has been made to us also, and the promise has been made to earlier ones also, but this is the tale of the old ones.
So then you ask: this land and its creatures are for whom, if you have any knowledge?
They will immediately say: Allah's, then say: then why do you not understand?
Then further say: who is the owner of the seven skies and the Great Throne?
They will again say: Allah, say: then why do you not fear (Him)?
Then say: who has the Kingdom of Power over everything that he gives [you] refuge. (but) nobody is going to give refuge from his punishment, if you have any sort of knowledge.
So they will immediately reply: this is all for Allah, then say: then who is doing the magic on you (who is deceiving you).
Whereas I have brought the truth, and they are all liars.

Verily, Allah has not made anybody his son, and neither there is another god besides Him, otherwise every god would have separated along with his creations, and would think about superiority over other, and the universe would have been destroyedAllah, the Glorified, is Most High than all this.
He knows the unseen and the seen and He is Exalted than any kind of polytheism.
And say: O my Lord, if you have promised them any punishment, please show it to me.
So O Lord, do not place me along with the unjust nation.
And the promise of punishment which We are making with them, We have power to show you.
You prevent evil with good, We know these things very well.
And say: O my Lord I seek your refuge from the whispering of Satan.
And seek refuge from You that Satan should come near to me.
So much so when death came to any of them he says: O Lord send us back (to the world).
I may do some good deeds, ney, this is one thing which he is saying; and behind them there is a Barrier, which will remain until the Day of Judgement.
Then, when the trumpet will be blown, there will not be any relations nor will they enquire about each other.
Then whose good deeds' scale will be heavy they will be the one who will be delivered.
And whose scale of good deeds' will be light, those will be people who have put their souls into loss, they will abide in Hell forever.
Hellfire shall scorch their faces, and for them will be severe affliction.
Is it not so that when Our verses were recited before you, you denied them?
They will say: O my Lord, bad luck had dominated us and we had gone astray.
O Lord, take us out of Hell, if we sin again then Verily we are unjust.
Allah will say: now live with this disgrace and do not talk.
There was one group among our servants who were saying: O Lord! we have believed, so forgive our sins and have Mercy on us, you are the Best among Merciful ones.
So you people had made fun of them, so much so, that made you negligent from our remembrance, and you are still making fun of them.
Today We have rewarded them and they are clearly successful.
Then Allah will ask: how many years you stayed on the earth?
They will reply: One day or a part of it, You may ask those who keep account.
Allah will say: Verily you stayed for a short period, wish you had some understanding.
Do you think We have created you useless, and you will not be brought back to Us?
Allah is Most High and True King, and there is no god except Him, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
Whoever call anybody besides Allah without any argument, his accounting is with the Lord, and there is no deliverance for the infidels.
O Prophet! Say: O my Lord forgive me and have Mercy on me and you the Best of the Merciful.
This is a Surah that We have revealed and made obligatory, and in which We have revealed manifest signs, maybe you take some lesson (from it).

Man, who commit fornication, and woman who commit fornication should get 100 lashes each, beware and in this regard do not show any pity on them in the affairs of the religion of Allah; if you have faith on Allah and the Day of Judgement, then a party of believers should be present there to witness it.
A fornicator (man) can marry only an fornicatress (woman) or a polytheist, and a fornicatress (woman) can marry only a fornicator (man) or a polytheist; this is forbidden for the believers.

Those who falsely accuse a chaste woman of fornication, and cannot bring four witnesses, those should be given eighty lashes, then never accept them as witness because they are manifest transgressors.
Except for those who may repent and correct themselves, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
Those who accuse their wives and they do not have four witnesses, then they are equal to four witnesses provided they take oath four times and say they are the truthful ones.
Curses be upon him, if the fifth time he says he is a liar.
Then punishment can be averted from a woman, if she takes the oath four times that the man is among the liars.
And if the fifth time (she says) that he is from the truthful ones, then the wrath of Allah be upon me.
If Grace and Mercy of Allah would not be on you then He would not have been Wise who accept the repentance; and then recompense of this accusation would have been worse.

Verily those who are accused of falsehood were a group among you, do not think of them as evil in fact it is good for you, and for every man's sin is that much as much he has earned, and whoever has got a big part in it shall have the grievous punishment.
Why this did not happen that when you heard that accusation, then believer men and women should have thought good for themselves and should have said: this is a manifest accusation.
Then why did this not happen? they should have brought four witnesses, when they did not bring witnesses then they are the liars in front of Allah.
If Allah's Grace would not have been in the world and the Hereafter and Mercy was not there then grievous punishment would have afflicted you on account of discourse you describe.
When you were doing discourse, you uttered such a talk of which you had no knowledge, you were taking it as an easy matter whereas for Allah it was a grievous talk.
And why it didn't happen when you have heard it, you should have said: we have no right to say this, Allah is Glorified and Self-Sufficient and it is a grievous accusation.
Allah is advising you, if you are a believer, you should never repeat such an act again.
And Allah describes his signs manifestly and He is the master of Knowledge and master of Wisdom.
Who wishes to spread the evil discourse among the believers, for them there is painful punishment in the world and also in the Hereafter, and Allah Knows everything, only you do not know anything.
And if Allah's Grace and Beneficence had not come to you, he would not have been Compassionate and Merciful.

O Believers! do not follow the footsteps of Satan, whoever will follow his footsteps then he will command him for all the evil, if Allah's Grace and Mercy would not be on you than nobody would have been chaste among you, but Allah makes him chaste, with whoever He pleases, Allah hears everyone and is aware of everyone's heart's condition.

And beware, no one should take oath that he will not help his relatives, needy and those who migrate in the way of Allah, on whoever Allah has shown favors and given abundance; everyone should forgive (others), don't you want that Allah to forgive you? Certainly, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
Those who are chaste, and unknowingly accuse women, Verily, there are curses on them and great punishment for them.
On the Day of Judgement, their tongues, hands and legs will testify against them for what they were doing.
That day Allah will recompense them fully, and they will realize that Allah is Truth, and He is the revealer of the truth.

Evil things are for evil people, evil people are for evil talk, and pure talk is for pure people, and pure people are for pure talk, and pure people are free from the accusation of the evil people, and there is forgiveness and honorable sustenance for them.

O believers! beware, do not enter houses other than yours', unless you take permission from the owner of the house and unless you wish a salutation to him; this is good for you that maybe you take a lesson from it.
Then if there is no one in the house, do not enter unless you get the permission, and if you are told to go back. (then) go back, this is a purer act for you, and Allah is well aware of your acts.
You may enter the house which is not inhabited and (if) any of your luggage is there; and Allah knows whatever you say openly, and Allah also knows whatever you hide.
And, O Prophet! tell the believers, keep lowered your eyes and guard your private parts, this is the purer thing, and Allah is Verily aware of their affairs.

And say to the believing women to keep lowered the eyes guard their purity, and do not show your beauty, except that which are obvious, and hang the scarf in your neck, and do not show off your beauty except for husband, father, grandfather, father-in-law and your children, and children of your husband, your brother and children of your brother, children of your sisters, your women, slaves and lady-slaves, and such men who do not have any desire for women, and those children who do not know what is hidden of women, and beware do not walk by striking feet on the ground that the beauty you are hiding become obvious (by ornamental sound); and O believers! all of you keep seeking forgiveness in the Court of Allah, that in this way you might get prosperity and salvation.

Arrange for Nikah of eligible singles among your free and among your slaves and lady-slaves; if they are poor Allah will make them prosper with His Grace and Mercy, Allah is Ample-giving and All Knowing.

Who do not have the capacity for Nikah, they must also guard their purity until Allah make them rich with His Grace and Mercy, and slaves and lady-slaves who wish to make covenant, see if they are good, make covenant with them, then whatever riches Allah has given you, give them also something from it; and beware do not compel your lady-slaves into prostitution for your own benefit, and whoever will compel them (for prostitution) and they desire to keep their chastity, then Verily after their compulsion Allah is greatly Forgiving and Merciful with regards to women.
And We have sent Our manifest signs and examples of the earlier people who have passed before you, as the material of admonition for pious people.

Allah is the Light of the skies and the Earth, example of His light like a niche on which a lamp is kept and lamp is inside the glass lantern, and lantern is heightened as brightly shining star, which is lit up from the graceful tree of olive, which the neither eastern nor western, its oil is about to flare up, and fire does touch it also, this is Light upon Light, and Allah guides to His Light to whoever he pleases, like this He explains the examples, and He is Cognizant of everything.
This lamp is lit in those houses which Allah has commanded to be raised to honor, and therein His name is recited, in them He is Glorified in the mornings and in the evenings.

Men who are not negligent even while doing business, buying and selling from reciting the name of Allah, establishing prayer, and giving poor-rate, these are the people who are afraid of the Day's (Day of Judgement) fright when people's eyes and hearts will turn about.
So that Allah could reward for their best deeds and can also increase with His Grace, and Allah gives uncountable sustenance to whom Allah pleases.

Who adopted infidelity, there deeds are like mirage in desert, that thirsty man thinks it is water but when he reaches near, there is nothing. (but) he finds Allah who will do his accounting, and He is very quick in accounting.

This is an example of utter darkness in the deep sea which is covered by the waves upon waves, and atop that there are layers of clouds also, that when he raises his hand, he could not see anything due to darkness, for whom Allah does not give light, there is no light for him.

Did not you see that all the creatures of earth and the sky and all the birds in queue in the atmosphere are glorifying Him, and they are aware of their own prayer and glorifying, and Allah is also Cognizant of deeds.
Kingdom of the earth and the sky is only for Allah, and everyone has to return to Him only.

Did not you see that only Allah moves the clouds, then gather them together and make layers, you will see rain coming amidst it, and He rains it in between mountains of snow, then reaches it to whom He pleases and turns it to wherever He pleases, its lightning is so bright that man become near blind.
It is Allah only that flips the day and night, for the people who have insight there is a lesson in it.

And it is only Allah that has created every walking thing on the earth from water, out of them some of them walk on their bellies and some on two feet and some walk on all four hands and feet, and Allah creates what He pleases, and has Power over everything.
Verily We have revealed manifest verses, and Allah guides to the straight path to whoever He pleases.
And these people say that they believe in Allah and His Prophet and obeyed them, and then one sect turned away and they are in fact not the believers.
And when they are called towards Allah and His Prophet, that they decide between them, but one party gets aside.
However, if they were persistent on truthhood they would have come with their heads bowed down.
Is there ailment of infidelity in their hearts, or they are doubting, or they are afraid that Allah and His Prophet will be unjust to them, whereas in fact they themselves are unjust.
Believers are called towards Allah and His Prophet that if they will judge they will say: we heard and obeyed, in fact these are the people who will get prosperity.
And whoever will obey Allah and His Prophet, he will have fear of Allah and will adopt piety, so he will be called the successful.

And these people have sworn that if you will command, they will come out of their houses, so say: swearing is not necessary, as a general law, obeying is enough, certainly Allah is Cognizant of what you do.

Say: Obey Allah and His Prophet, and if you will deviate from it then responsibility of Prophet is on him and your responsibility on you, if you will obey you will get guidance; Prophet's responsibility is just to clearly preach.

Allah has promised that believers and who do good deeds to make them on the earth His vicegerents as he has made the earlier ones, and to make their religion dominant which he has chosen form them; and will replace their fear with security that they will all only worship Me and will not make anyone My partner, and even after that if anybody become infidel, then only these people are transgressors.
And establish prayer and give poor-rate and obey Prophet, perhaps in this way Allah may have Mercy on you.
Beware! Never think that people who adopt infidelity can make Us helpless on the earth, their abode is Hell, and that is the worst recompense.

O Believers! Your slaves and lady-slaves, and children who have not reached puberty, they should ask for your permission to meet you on three occasions: before morning prayer, in the afternoon when you take off cloth for rest and after the Isha prayer. (because) these are three times of privacy for you; apart from this there is no harm for you or them to go around to meet each other, like this, Allah describes His verses clearly and is all Knowing of your affairs and has Wisdom.

And when your children also attain puberty they should also take permission like this, as earlier people were taking permission. (your) Lord describes His verses clearly that Allah is Knowing and has Wisdom.

And due to old age the women who do not have any desire for marriage, there is no harm for them if they discard their outer garments (Hijab), provided they do not wear any makeup and guard their chastity; this is better for them, Allah is all Hearing and all Cognizant.

There is no blame on the people who are blind, lame, sick, and for yourself to eat from your houses, and the houses of your fathers and grandfathers, your maternal-grandfather, etc. or eat from houses of your mothers, paternal-grandmother or maternal-grandmothers, or eat from houses of your brothers, your sisters or your paternal uncles, or from houses oh your paternal-aunts, or maternal-uncles, or maternal-aunts, or from the houses whose keys are with you, or in the houses of your friends; and there is no harm if you eat all together or eat separately; when you enter houses at least give salutation to yourself, this is a pure gift for you from your Lord; and Allah describes His verses clearly like this that you may use your wisdom.

Believers are only those who believe on Allah and His Prophet, and those who are engaged in the community work should not go anywhere unless they take permission, and those who take permission from you have belief on Allah and His Prophet, if they seek permission from you, give permission to whomever you wish; and also seek forgiveness for them from Allah, Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

O Muslims! Beware, don't call upon the Prophet as you people call upon others among yourselves; Allah knows them very well who sneak away silently (from congregation), so whoever opposes command of Allah should be afraid of this matter, that any affliction catches them or painful punishment comes upon them.

And, remember all the universe of the sky and earth is His, and is cognizant of your condition, and that day when everyone will be returned to His Court, He will tell them about their deeds, and He is Knower of all things.
Blessed is that Allah, who has sent The Criterion on His servants, that he becomes the warner for the world from the punishment of Allah.
All the Kingdom of the sky and the earth is His, He does not have any son, nor does he have any partner in His Kingdom, He has created everything and has made everything perfectly in size.

And they have made gods leaving Allah, who have not created anything but they themselves have been created, and they are not able to cause any loss or benefit even to themselves, and neither they control death nor resurrection.
These infidels say that this Quran is a lie, which he has fabricated, and another nation has helped him in this matter, whereas they themselves have done unjust and forged.
These people say: these are the tales of the earlier people - which he has got them written and that he recites to them morning and evening.
Say: Quran is revealed by Who is aware of the secrets of skies and the earth, and indeed He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
And these people say: what has happened to Prophet who eats and goes about in market also, and why no angel was sent for him, which may prove as warner of the punishment of Allah.
Or some treasure should have been dropped on him, or he should have some garden from which could eat, then these unjust say that you are obeying a magician.
See how people have said examples for you, they have gone astray, now they cannot get the (right) way.

Blessed is He, Who, if pleases could provide for you much better material than this, and provide you such Paradise beneath which rivers will be flowing, then could make large palaces for you (people).
Reality is that they have denied the Day of Judgement, and We have provided Hell for the deniers of the Day of Judgement.
When the Hellfire will see them from afar then they will hear the rumbling and vehement roaring sounds.
And when they would be tied up in the chains and thrown in a strait place then they will ask for death.
Then it will be said to them: don't call out one death but call out too many deaths.
O Prophet! Ask them: punishment is better or everlasting Paradise? For which pious people have been promised, and that is their reward and their abode.
Every material of their desire is available there and they are going to abide there forever, this is an imperative promise on their Lord.
The day when He shall gather them and those at one place whom they had called besides Allah, and shall ask them whether you misguided my servants or they went astray by their own?

So they will all say: Glory to You; You are Self-Sufficient; who has given us the authority to make guardian of anybody else except You? Fact is that they became negligent of Your remembrance because of honor You gave to them and their elders in the world; for these people were going to be destroyed.

Did you see, they are denying you also whom you had made your gods, now you neither can avert the punishment nor you can help yourself; and whoever will be unjust We will make them taste the severe punishment.

And before you also, the prophets We had sent, they were also eating food and went about in the market; and We have made some of you trial for others; and O Muslims! Can you be patience, whereas your Lord is Master of Great Insight.
And those who do not hope to meet Us, they say: why not the angels come to us or why we cannot see Allah, in fact they have become very haughty, and they are doing the revolt of highest degree.
The day they will see angels, then there won't be any good news for the guilty ones, and angels will say: get away.
Then We will turn to their deeds; and will make them all like flying particles of dust.
That day only the people of Paradise will be there for whom will be best abode for resting.
That day the sky will burst apart because of clouds, and angels will come in groups (after groups).
That day the kingdom will be in the hands of the Lord, and that day will be very severe for the infidels.
That day unjust will cut their hand and say: Alas! I would have taken the path with the prophet.
Oh Alas! I would not have made that man a friend.
He misguided me even after the revelation of the verses, and Satan always brings disgrace to human beings.
That day the prophet will call out: O Lord! my people have neglected this Quran.
And like this We have made some enemies of every prophet among the guilty ones; and for your guidance and help your Lord is Sufficient.
And infidels also say this that why this Quran has not been revealed on them all at once, but We reveal it gradually so we can strengthen your hearts, and We have revealed it slowly.
They will not bring any example, but in their reply, We will describe the truth and better talk.
Those who will be brought to Hell dragging on their face, their abode is the worst, and they are strayed to a great extent.
And We gave Moosa the book and made his brother his minister with him.
Then We said both of you go towards the nation who are denying our verses, and We have destroyed them.
And to the people of Nooh also when they denied the messengers, then We drown them also and made them a sign for the people, and We have prepared very painful punishment for unjust.
And We have also destroyed nations of Aad and Samood and companion of Rass and many people between them.
And We explained examples for all of them, and We destroyed them all.
And they came towards the town on which We have rained the stones, so did not they saw them, fact is that they do not believe in the Day of Judgement.
And when they see you, they want to make fun of you that is the person whom Allah has sent as a prophet?
He has nearly deviated us from our gods, had We not been constant with them; "shortly they would know when they will see the punishment, that who has gone more astray".
Did you see the person who has made his desires, his god? Are you ready to take his responsibility also?
Do you think the majority of them listen and understand, no, never, they are like animals, and they are straying further off the path.
Didn't you see that how your Lord spread the shadow, if He pleased, He could have made it stagnant at one place, then We made sun its argument.
Then We pulled it slowly towards Us.
And that Allah Who made night your veil and made sleep for your rest, and made day time for standing you up.
And that is He Who sent wind with glad tidings of Mercy, and We rain pure water from the skies.
Through this make the dead city come to life again, and out of our creatures quench the thirst of humans and the animal.
And We divided the water differently among them so that they take admonition from this, but most men denied and accept nothing but disbelief or ingratitude.
We could have sent a warner in every town if we please.
So do not listen to infidels, and struggle hard with them till the last minute.
And that is Allah who has flown both the rivers whose water is tasty and sweet, and salty and bitter, and between the inviolable obstruction is made.
And that is He, Who created man from water, made his family and in-laws, and your Lord is the owner of Great Power.
And these people worship those besides Allah, who neither can benefit them nor can cause any loss, and infidels always support [those who are] against the Lord.
We have only sent you as a giver of glad tidings and as a warner.
Say: I do not want any recompense from you people, but whoever wants he can adopt the path of their Lord.
And believe in Allah, the Truth and Self-Existing One who is not going to die, and continue glorifying Him; and He is sufficient (as witness) for the sins of His servants.

He created the skies and the earth and all the creatures which are in between them within six days, then He established the Throne of His Kingdom, He is Beneficent and ask Him, Who knows about His creatures.
And when they are asked to prostrate before Beneficent Allah, they ask what is that Beneficent that we prostrate about whom you are commanding, like this their hatred increases.
{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} Blessed is He, who made a constellation in the sky and made a Lamp and bright Moon in it.
And that is He, Who made day and night to follow each other, for the man who wishes to take lessons or wishes to thank his Lord.
Servants of Allah are those who walk slowly on earth, and when ignorant speak to them they give a message of peace.
These people spend their night while prostrating or standing in the Court of their Lord.
And they say: O Lord! Avert the punishment of Hell from us because it is very severe and everlasting.
That is the worst place and abode.
These people when they spend, they neither over spend nor with stinginess, but take a middle way out of it.

And they do not call upon another god with Allah, and do not unjustly kill any soul whom Allah has forbidden, and they do not commit fornication, who will do such an act shall bear the punishment for the same.
Which will be doubled on the Day of Judgement, and they shall remain in it with disgrace forever.
Except for those who repent and believe and do good deeds also, Allah will change his bad deeds with good deeds, and Allah is very Forgiving.
And he who will repent and do good works and will really turn towards Allah.
And they do not go near lie and deception, and when they come across the useless work, they pass by in a sensible manner.
And when they are reminded of the verses of Allah they do not fall as deaf and blind.
And they continuously pray that, O Lord! give coolness in our eyes from our wives and children and make us the leader of the pious ones.
These are the people who will be granted the high places in the Paradise for their patience, and there they shall be offered greetings and salutations.
They will abide there forever because that is the best abode and most beautiful place of residence.
O Prophet! Say: My Lord would not have turned to you if it was not for your prayers, you have denied His prophet, then shortly you would have to bear the punishment for that.
Ta Seen Meem.
These are the verses of the manifest Book (Quran).
Will you put your soul in danger that these people are not believing?
If We pleased, we would have send a verse from the sky that their necks would have bend by humbleness.
But whenever any new verse comes from the Beneficent Allah, they object to it.
Indeed, they denied; shortly the news will come to them that they had been mocking at.
Did not they see towards the earth that how beautiful things We have grown.
There is Our sign in it, but majority of them is not going to believe.
And your Lord is Honorable and have Wisdom.
And remember the time when your Lord called out to Moosa saying: go to that unjust nation.
This is the nation of Firaun, will not they become pious?
Moosa said: O my Lord, I fear that they may not deny me.
My heart is becoming strait, my tongue is not fluent, send Haroon with this message.
There is a crime on me from them, I am afraid that they may not kill me.
Allah said: Never, both of you take Our signs and go, and We are also listening with you everything.
Go to Firaun and say: we both have been sent by the Lord of the Worlds.
Send Bani Israel with us.
He said: did not I brought you up and have not you spent some years of your life among us.
And you did what you did, are not you among the grateful.
Moosa said: when I killed, I was negligent of killing.
Then out of fear I went aside from you, now my Lord has sent me, He has made me among His messengers.
Favor that you are reminding for my upbringing, you did bad that you took Bani Israel as slaves.
Firaun said: what is this Lord of the Worlds?
Moosa said: He is the Lord of the skies and the earth and whatever is in between them, if you can believe.
Firaun said to his companions: are you listening something?
Moosa said: He is your Lord and also the Lord of your fathers.
Firaun said: this messenger which has been sent among you is mad.
Moosa said: He is the Lord of East and the West and whatever is in between them, if you have wisdom.
Firaun said: if you accept any other god than me, then I will send you among prisoners.
Moosa said: even if I show you manifest signs?
Firaun said: what is the argument, if you are truthful, present it.
Moosa put down his staff on the ground and it turned into a serpent and started moving.
And when he took out his hand it appeared white and bright.
Firaun told his companions: he seems to be an expert magician.
His aim is to drive you out of your land on the strength of his magic, now what is your opinion?
They said to stop him and his brother and send someone to gather the magicians from the city.
They brought the expert magicians.
And at the appointed time all magicians came together.
And they said: will you gather together on this issue?
We may follow the magicians, perhaps we may dominate.
When they got together, they asked Firaun: what will be our reward if we are victorious?
Firaun said: Verily you will be counted among my close ones.
Moosa said to them: whatever you wish to throw, throw.
So they threw ropes and sticks and said: by the honor and glory of Firaun we are going to be victorious.
Then Moosa also threw his staff, then suddenly they saw it is swallowing all the magic.
After seeing this all the magicians fell in prostration.
And they said we believe in the Lord of the Worlds.
Lord of Moosa and Haroon.

Firaun said: you believed before I gave you permission, he is greater magician than you who has taught you the magic; I will cut your hand and leg from opposite sides and will hang you on the gallows.
They said, no problem, we shall all return and reach to our Lord.
We only wish that our Lord may forgive our sins, that we are the first among those who believed.
We revealed to Moosa: take my servants and leave in the night that you will be pursued.
Then Firaun sent men to gather the armies from the different cities.
That these few people are a party.
And they have enraged us.
And we are with all ready with our equipment.
Resultant We drove them out of gardens and rivers.
From treasures and honourable places also.
And We punish like this, and We made Bani Israel to inherit the land.
And they pursued Moosa and his people early in the morning.
When both could see each other, people of Moosa said: now Verily we will be overtaken.
Moosa said: never, our Lord is with us, He will guide us.
Then We revealed to Moosa: strike the river with your staff, and river cracked up and every part seems like a mountain.
And We made nearer also to the second party.
And We delivered Moosa and all his companions.
Rest of them were drowned.
There is also Our sign in it, and majority among Bani Israel were not going to believe.
And your Lord is Honorable and Merciful.
And recite Ibrahim's news to them.
When he told his father (who brought him up) and the people, whose worship you are doing?
They said we are worshipping the idols and we are their keepers.
Ibrahim asked: when you call them, do they listen to you?
Do they give you any benefit or any harm?
They said: we have seen our forefathers do this.
Do you know whom you worship.
You and your elders of the clan.
They are all my enemies except Lord of the Worlds.
Who created me and then He guides me.
He gives food and He gives water.
When I fell sick, he cures me.
He gives death then He gives life.
And it is hoped from Him that He will forgive our sins on the Day of Accounting.
O Lord, give me knowledge and wisdom and count me among the righteous ones.
And ordain good tongue, and good mention in my forthcoming progeny.
Count me among the inheritors of the Paradise.
And forgive my father, who brought me up, he is among the misguided ones.
Do not disgrace me when everyone will be raised from their graves.
The day when mother and children would not be of any help (to you).
Only if he is present in the Court of Allah with pure heart.
The day when Paradise will be made nearer to the pious ones.
And Hell will be placed before the misguided ones.
And it will be said to the Hellish People where are those whom you used to worship?
Besides Allah, will they help you or will they help themselves?
Then they all with the misguided ones will be thrown in to Hell, with their faces down.
And all the soldiers of Iblis.
They will all be quarrelling in the Hell and say:
By god we were in manifest misguidance.
When they were paralleling you with the Lord of the worlds.
Nobody misguided us except the guilty ones.
Now there is no one who can do intercession for us.
And neither any friend.
Oh, Alas! If we could return, we will become believers.
Therein is one of our signs, whereas majority of them were not the believers.
And your lord is Predominant on all and Merciful.
And people of Nooh also denied the messengers.
When his brother Nooh said: why you do not adopt piety?
I am a trustworthy messenger of Lord for you.
So fear Allah, and obey me.
And I do not want any recompense of this preaching, my reward is with the Lord of the worlds.
So you fear Allah, and obey me.
They said, how can we believe in you when all your followers are lowest class of people.
Nooh said: what do I know what they do?
Their account is with my Lord, if you have wisdom of this.
And I am not going to drive away the believers.
I am only a manifest warner from the punishment of Allah.
They said: Nooh! If you do not desist from this talk, we will stone you.
Upon hearing this Nooh complaint, O Lord! my nation has denied me.
Now judge openly between me and them, and deliver me and my believing companions.
Then We delivered him and his companions in a laden Ark.
Thereafter, drowned all of them.
Verily, in it also there is Our sign; and their majority were not going to believe.
And your Lord is only Predominant on all and is Merciful (too).
And nation of Aad also have denied the messengers.
When their brother Hood said why you don't develop the fear Allah?
I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
So fear Allah, and obey me.
I do not want any reward from you for preaching, my recompense is with the Lord of the worlds.
Do you make the memorial at high place for play?
And you are making big palaces thinking that perhaps you will remain in this world forever.
And when you attack you attack with tyranny.
Now, fear Allah, and obey me.
And develop His fear, Who has assisted you with everything, which you know very well.
(He) helped you with animals and with (your) children.
And did help from gardens and rivers.
I am fearful for you, for a big day of severe punishment.
They said: it is the same for us whether you do admonition or you are not counted among those who admonished.
This fear and warning is the work of earlier people.
Punishment is not going to come on us.
Then nation denied and We destroyed them, in it there is one of Our signs, and majority of them were not the believers.
And your Lord is Predominant and also Merciful.
And nation of Samood also denied the prophets.
When his brother Saleh said: why don't you fear Allah?
I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
So fear Allah and obey me.
I do not want any reward from you for this work, my recompense is with the Lord of the worlds.
Will you be left in favors and rest (forever)?
In these gardens and rivers?
In these fields and amid the trees of palms, whose buds are soft and fragile?
And these houses which you are making by carving out the mountains for your rest.
It will never happen, so fear Allah, and obey me.
And do not follow who do the excesses.
Who create mischief in the land and do not amend.
They said: you had been cast a magic spell upon you, and that's it.
You are a human being like us, so if you are truthful then bring some sign or miracle.
Saleh said: this is a she-camel, one day's water is for her and one appointed day's water is for you.
And beware, do not harm her, otherwise the punishment of severe day will afflict you.
Then they cut her feet and later were ashamed.
And punishment afflicted them, and Verily there is our sign in it, and most of them were not going to believe.
And your Lord is Predominant on everyone and also very Merciful.
And nation of Lut also denied the messengers.
When his brother Lut said: why you do not fear Allah?
I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
Fear Allah, and obey me.
And I do not want any recompense from you for this, my reward is with my Allah, who is the Lord of the worlds.
Do you cohabit with men in the whole world.
And leave those wives whom your Lord has created for you, indeed you do very excesses.
They said: Lut, if you do not stop preaching, they you will be expel from the town.
Lut said: after all I abhor your act.
O my Lord! secure me and my family from the punishment of this act.
So, We delivered him and his family.
Except that old lady who stayed behind.
Then We destroyed them all.
And strongly rained stones on them, this is the worst rain for the people who are warned.
And in this also there is Our sign, and majority of them were not the believers.
And your Lord is most Mighty and most Merciful also.
And people of forest also denied the messengers.
When Shoaib told them: why you do not fear Allah?
I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
So, fear Allah, and obey me.
I do not want any recompense from you for this, my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.
And see, keep the measurement proper, and do not be those who give less to the people.
Weight should be proper, and on the true scale.
And do not give less (in measurement) to the people, and do not create mischief on the earth.
And fear that Lord who has created you and the people before you.
They said: you seem to be person who has been cast a spell upon him.
And you are a human being like us, and you seem to be a liar to us.
And if you are truthful then bring a piece upon us from the sky.
He said: my Lord is well aware of your deeds.
When they denied, they were afflicted by punishment on the day of shadow, and it was a punishment of a severe day.
Verily, there is a sign in this only, and majority of them were not going to believe.
You Lord is very Honorable and Merciful.
This Quran has been revealed from the Lord of the worlds.
This was revealed through trustworthy Gabriel.
This is revealed on your chest that you warn the people of punishment of Allah.
This is in manifest Arabic language.
It is mentioned in the previous books also.
Is this the sign is not enough that scholars of Bani Israel know it.
If we had revealed on a non-Arab.
And he would have recited, then they would not have believed.
And like this (as if) we made a way, to the hearts for denial for the guilty ones?
That they are not going to believe unless they see the painful punishment.
That punishment may fell upon them suddenly and they could not comprehend.
Then they will say: can we be given respite?
Are they hastening in Our punishment?
Don't you know We have given the respite for some years.
Then the punishment will come which they are promised.
Then the enjoyment given to them will not be of any use to them.
We did not destroy any town until We sent a warner to them.
This was a reminder and we never do unjust.
And this Quran was not brought by the Satans.
This is not suitable for them and they do not have any power of this.
They are even deprived of hearing revelation.
So do not call anyone god with Allah, otherwise you will be afflicted with punishment.
O Prophet! Warn your near relatives.
Put down your shoulders for the believers who obey you.
Later if they disobey, say: you are free from their deeds.
And trust in the Mighty and Merciful Allah.
Who sees you when you are standing.
Then He sees you mingling with the people who prostrate themselves before Allah.
He is all Hearing and all Seeing.
Shall We tell you, on whom Satans come?
They come on all liars and bad doers.
Who tries to hear the angels talk, and most of among them are liars.
Misguided people follow the poets.
Don’t you see that they roam in every valley of thought.
And whatever they say, do not follow.

Except those poets who are believers and did good works; and recite the name of Allah aplenty, and took revenge after tolerating the unjust, and shortly unjust will know where they are going to be returned.
Ta Seen, This is Quran and its manifest verses.
This is admonition and glad tidings for the believers.
Who keep up prayers, give poor-rate and believe on the Day of Judgement.
Verily, those who do not believe on the Day of Judgement, We have decorated their deeds and they are roaming in those deeds.
For them is the worst punishment, and they are losers on the Day of Judgement.
This Quran is being given to you from Knowing and Wise Allah.
Remember the time when Moosa said to his family: I have seen a fire and shortly I will bring the news of its way or bring an ember of it so that you can warm yourselves up.
When he came near the Fire, a sound came, blessed is the Lord who shows his miracle inside and around the fire, and Glory be to Allah who is nourisher of the worlds.
Moosa! I am the Lord, Predominant on all and Wise.
Now throw your staff on the ground, when Moosa saw it was moving serpent, he turned back footed and didn't saw back, came the sound, Moosa do not be afraid, messengers do not fear in My Court.
Yes, if anybody sins, then repent and exchange bad work with the good works, then I am all forgiving and Merciful.

Put your hand in collar and take out then you will see without any sickness it is white and bright, this is one of the miracles (out of many) which have been given for the nation of Firaun, they have become a very wicked nation.
Whenever manifest signs came to them, they said it is just open magic.
They denied because of haughtiness and unjustness whereas their hearts were believing, now see what will happen to the mischief-makers.
And We gave knowledge to Dawood and Suleiman, both thanked Allah and said He has excelled us upon many of his servants.
Then Suleiman inherited Dawood,and he said: I have been given the knowledge of the language of birds, and have been given a part of every excellence, this is manifest Mercy and Grace of Allah.
All the armies of jinns, men and birds were gathered for Suleiman, they were all collected in order.
When they reached the Valley of Naml, then an ant called: all the ants should get into their holes lest an army of Suleiman crush you and they do not even know.

Suleiman heard and smiled on this and said: O Lord, give me opportunity that I show gratefulness for your favours which You have granted me and my father; and I do such deeds that you are pleased with and that with You may count me with your Mercy among Your good servants.
And Suleiman searched for Hoopoe, when he could not see him, he said: what has happened to me; I do not see hoopoe, where has he gone?
I will give him severe punishment or will slay him, if he will (not) bring any reasonable argument.
After some time hoopoe came, he said I have come to know a thing which you also do not know, I have brought a definite news from Saba.
I have seen a lady who is governing on all and she has got everything of this world, and she also has got a magnificent throne.
I saw that she and her nation are worshipping the sun, and Satan has beautified it in their eyes and has hindered them from the right path; now they don't understand this also.
Why don't they prostrate before Allah who knows all the secrets of the skies and the earth, and He also knows whatever people are doing openly or secretly.
{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} That is Allah and there is no god except Him, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
Suleiman said I will see now, whatever you are saying is truth or you are also among the liars.
Take my letter and put it before them, then get aside and see what reply they give.
That lady said: O Chief of my Kingdom, I have been sent an honorable letter.
It is from Suleiman and its subject is that: I begin in the name of Allah, most Beneficent, most Merciful.
See, do not transgress against me, and come (to me) as an obedient.
O Chief! give us your opinion in this matter, without your opinion I cannot decisively decide.
They said: we are powerful and experts in warfare, but command is in your hands, you say: what is your command?
She said: when kings enter a town they destroy it and treat noblest people with disgrace (and make them low), this is their practice.
And I am sending a gift towards them, then will see what reply to my representative will bring back.
When a representative came to Suleiman, he said: you want to aid me with wealth, whereas whatever My Allah has given is much better, you take your gift and be happy with it yourself.
(Suleiman said:) Go, return, now I will come with the army which you cannot face, then I will expel you all from your town with disgrace and humiliation.
Then he said to his chiefs: who among you can bring that throne to me, before they come to me as obedient.
One audacious among the jinn said: I will bring in such a time that you will not move from your place, I am very powerful and trustworthy.

One person who was having part of knowledge of book said: I will bring before you can bat an eyelid, this is the Grace and Mercy of my Lord that He please to test me that I am thankful or ungrateful for His favours; and whoever will be thankful shall be for his own benefit, and whoever is ungrateful, my Lord is Self-Sufficient from him, and is Bountiful.
Suleiman said: that disguise the throne, I want to see whether she can understand, or she is not among the knowledgeable.
When she came, Suleiman asked: is it your throne; she said: it was like this, yes, perhaps this is it, I knew earlier, and I was obedient.
And she was held back by God; whom she had accepted as Lord besides Allah, and she was from an infidel nation.

Then she was told to enter the fort, when she saw it, she thought that it was deep water. (she rolled up her garment) and her shanks were exposed, Suleiman said this is a fort which has been covered with glass, and she (Bilqees) said: I did unjust to my soul, now with Suleiman I believed in God Who is Lord of the worlds.
And We sent towards nation of Samood his brother Saleh that you people worship Allah, then both the parties started quarrelling.
Saleh said: O people of nation, why you are hastening for evil before the good, why don't you repent with Allah, perhaps He might show Mercy on you.
These people said: we got bad omen from you and your people; he said: it is your bad luck, fate is with Allah, and this was in fact your trial.
In the city there were nine people who were creating mischief and was not amending.

They said: swear among yourselves, that you will attack Saleh and his family during the night, and afterward tell their inheritors that you were not present at the time of their killing, and we are truthful in our statement.
Then they plotted, and We also made arrangements, and they were (totally) unaware.
Now see, what was the result of their wickedness, we totally destroyed their chiefs along with their nation.
Now, their homes which are vacant because of their being unjust, there is a sign in it for the people who have knowledge.
And We delivered those who were believers and had adopted the piety of Allah.
And remember Lut, when he said to his nation: you are having eyes, still you are doing the bad deeds.
What, due to carnal desire you are mating with men and leaving the women? In fact, you people are totally ignorant.
Lut’s nation had a reply except that they said: expel Lut's followers, they are trying to be pure.
So We delivered Lut and his family except his wife, she was among those who stayed behind.
Then We sent upon them a strange rain from which they are warned, and this rain of punishment is very bad.
Say: All the Praises are for Allah, and salutations on His servants whom He has chosen; whether Allah is better or those whom they are making His partner?

Who is that Who has created the skies and the earth, and has rained water from sky (clouds), then We grew beautiful garden from it that you could not had grown those trees; there is no god except Allah; but these people are paralleling others with Allah on their own.

Who is He Who made the earth a place of stay, then flown rivers in between, and made mountains for it, and created barrier between the two rivers, is there any other god besides Allah, absolutely not; in fact, majority of them are ignorant.

Who is that who listens to the pleas in the distress when he calls to Him and removes the difficulty, and make you inherit the earth, is there anybody except Allah, then you take very little admonition and lesson.

Who is that who guides to the ways of land and the sea in the darkness, who is that who sends the winds of glad tidings before the rain, is there any god with Allah? (Absolutely not) Allah is much more exalted than what these people make partner with Him.

Or Who is there Who began the creation, and once again He will create, and who is that Who gives sustenance from the skies and the earth, is there and God besides Allah? Say: if you are truthful in your claim then bring your argument.
Say: there is no one in the skies and the earth who knows the unseen, except Allah, these people do not know when they will be raised again.
Whereas their knowledge about the Day of Judgement is incomplete; nay, they are in doubt about it, nay, they are blind.
And infidel say: when our forefathers will become dust, will they be raised again?
This promise has been made to us and to our forefathers for a very long time, these are tales of the earlier people.
You say: roam around on the land then see what the recompense of the guilty people was.
And do not be sad about their condition, they are plotting, and do not be strait hearted from them also.
They say: if you are truthful then when will this promise be completed?
Then say: for the punishment which you are hastening may be some part is already behind you.
There is no doubt that your Lord shows great Mercy on you, but many of them are not grateful.
And your Lord knows everything that they have hidden in their hearts or which they speak out.
And there is nothing hidden in the sky and the earth which is not mentioned in this manifest Book.
There is no doubt that this Quran declares to Bani Israel many things in which they differ.
This Quran is admonition and Mercy for the believers.
Your Lord judge between them with His Command, He is Predominant on all and Know everything.
Hence, trust that you are on the path of the clear truth.
You cannot make the dead and the deaf hear your voice, if they turn their face and run away.
And you cannot bring blinds to the right path; you can make hear your sound only to those who believe our verses and are Our obedient.
And when promise will be completed on them, then We will make stand a person walking on the land that he will talk (ask) to them that who is there who do not believe on Our verses.
And that day We will collect the army of every Ummah who were denying our verses, then they will be divided separately.
When everyone will come then Allah will say: had you denied Our verses, whereas you were unaware what you were doing.
And their talk will be proved by their unjust and they will not be able to speak.
