Didn't they see that We created night that they take rest, and made day the cause of light, in this there are big signs for the believers.
When the trumpet will be blown, whatever is in the earth and the skies will feel tremor, except those whom Allah pleases, and everyone will be presented in His Court, with their heads bowed down.
When you see you will think mountains are still, whereas they will be moving as clouds, this is the artistry of that Lord Who have made everything in perfect order and is aware of all your deeds.
Whoever will do the good deed will get the best reward, and they will be secured from the fear of the Day of Judgement.
And whoever will do bad deeds will be thrown into Hell with their faces down, can anything else be given to you except the recompense of your deeds?
I have been only commanded to worship the owner of this city who has made it honorable and everything is His property, and I have been commanded to be among his obedient.
And that I recite the Quran to you, after this whoever will get guidance will do it for his own benefit, and whoever will go astray tell him I am among the warners.
And say: all the Praise is only for Allah, and He will show his signs very soon, then you will understand that your Lord is not oblivious to your deeds.
Ta Seen Meem
These are the verses of the manifest Book.
We are telling you the true news of Moosa and Firaun, for those who are going to believe.

Firaun acquired the high place on the land, and he divided the dwellers of the earth on the many parts to weaken one another; he slayed their boys; and kept alive their women, he was Verily a mischief maker.
And We want to favor those who have been weakened and make them leaders of the people and make them inherit the land.
And give them the power of the land and show Firaun and Hamaan and their armies the scenes at the hands of those weak from which they were fearing.

And We revealed to mother of Moosa to feed the milk to her child and when fear comes put the child in the water, and do not have any fear or distress because We are going to turn him to you (again); and he shall be counted among the messengers.
Then family of Firaun picked him up, which after all resulted in the pain and grief for his enemies; indeed, Firaun, Hamaan and their armies were all evil.
And Firaun's wife said he is the coolness of our eyes, so don’t kill him, he may be beneficial for us, and we will make him our son; and they were not understanding anything.
And Moosa's mother's heart became empty, and she was about to reveal the secret if We would not have strengthened her heart; so that she be counted among the believers.
And she told his sister that you also follow him, so she saw Moosa from afar, when they were not even slightly aware of it.
And we had already forbidden the milk of foster mothers for Moosa, his sister said shall I tell you about a household who will nourish him and will be his well-wisher also.

Then (in this way) We returned Moosa to his mother so he could see the coolness of her eyes, and she was not upset (also), and she should know that Allah's promise is True, whereas the majority of people do not know this.
And when Moosa reached the strength of youth and became healthy, then We gave him knowledge and wisdom; and like this We recompense to the people who do good deeds.

And Moosa entered the city when people were negligently asleep, so he saw two people fighting, one of them was among his friends and other one from his enemies, so who was from among his friends, complaint about the unjust against him; so Moosa hit the man with his fist and he died, he (Moosa) said: Verily it was an act of Satan; Verily Satan is an enemy who openly misguide.
Moosa said: O my Lord, I have taken trouble for my soul, please forgive me, so the Lord forgave him; He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
Moosa said: O my Lord, You helped me, so I will never be among the guilty ones.

Then in the morning Moosa entered the city while he was fearful and worried and he saw that the person who had called him for help yesterday was again complaining, Moosa said: Verily you are manifest misguided one.

When Moosa tried to attack him, who is the enemy of both, he said Moosa you want to kill me as you have killed an innocent yesterday, you want to be a transgressed ruler on the land, and you do not want that you should be counted among those who warn.
And then from the end of the city a person came running and said: Moosa, elders of the city are planning to kill you so you leave the city, and I am an admonisher for you.
Moosa came out of the city in fear looking right and left and said: O my Lord save me from the unjust nation.
When Moosa turned towards Madyan, he said: shortly Allah will guide me towards the straight path.

When he reached a stream of Madyan, he saw a group watering their animals; on one side there were two females who were holding back their animals, Moosa asked them what is the matter? They both said: we cannot feed water to our animals unless they take away (their sheep), and our father is an old man.
Moosa watered the animal of both (ladies) then came and sat in a shadow, Verily I stand in need for the thing please send to me.

In that time one of those two girls came and said shyly: my father is calling you in order to reward you for watering the animals, when Moosa came to him and described his tale, he said do not fear you have been delivered from an unjust nation.
One of those girls said: father you hire him because he will be best among servants you would hire, he is strong man and trustworthy.

He said I desire to marry one of these my two daughters with you provided you serve me for eight years and if you will serve for ten years it will be from you, and I do not want to give any trouble to you; if Allah willing, you will find me among the good servants.
Moosa said: there is a covenant between me and you, whatever period I complete, then I will have no responsibility, and whatever I am saying, Allah is witness to it.

Then, when Moosa completed the period and took his family, he saw a fire from the direction of Mount Tur (Sinai), so he told his family: you stay here I have seen a fire, I may bring news or an ember from it that you may warm yourselves up.
When he came near the fire, on the right side of the valley from a blessed tree a sound came: I am the Lord of the worlds.

And you keep down your staff on the ground, and Moosa sees it is moving like a snake, seeing this Moosa turned away and did not look back, then again came the sound: Moosa come ahead, do not fear, you are fully safe.

Put your hand in the collar and take out, it will come out white and bright without any illness, fold your shoulder towards you with fear, from your Lord these are two arguments for Firaun and his chiefs, these are all transgressor and bad people.
Moosa said: I have killed one of their men, I fear that they might kill me and preaching work may stop.
My brother Haroon is more eloquent in language, so make him my helper so he can authenticate me, and I fear that those people may not deny me.

Allah said: We will strengthen your shoulders with your brother, and will create a domination for you that they will not be able to reach you, and with my signs you and your followers shall be the uppermost.
When Moosa came to them with Our manifest signs, they said it is just a fabricated magic, and we have not heard anything as such from our earlier elders.
And Moosa said: my Lord knows the best that who has brought guidance from Him, and abode is the Hereafter is for whom, Verily unjust will not be successful.

Firaun said: O my chiefs, in my knowledge there is no god for you, except me, O Hamaan, bake the clay and make a lofty tower for me so that I climb on it and bring the news of Moosa's God, and I think Moosa is a liar.
And Firaun and his army showed unnecessary haughtiness, and thought that they would not be returned to Our Court.
Then We caught hold of Firaun and his army, and threw everyone in the river, then see how is the recompense of the unjust.
And We have made them the leaders who invite people towards Hell, and they will not be helped on the Day of the Judgement.
And in this world also curses are behind them, and on the Day of Judgement also they will be counted among those whose faces will be disfigured.
We gave the book to Moosa after destroying the earlier generations, which was a source of insight, guidance and mercy for the people; perhaps they might get the admonition like this.
And at that time. you were not on the western side of Mount Tur (Sinai) when I sent my command to Moosa, and you were not even witness to this story.
But We created many nations, then a long time passed by, and you were not present in Madyan that you would have recited our verses to them, but we were the maker of messengers.

You were not on any side of Tur (Mount Sinai) when we called up Moosa, but this is the Mercy of your Lord that you warn this nation who was not sent any messenger earlier, maybe they take a lesson and admonition from this.

And if any affliction has befallen on them due to their earlier deeds, they would have said: O Lord why any messenger was not sent towards us that we would have followed your signs and we would be among the believers.

Then after this, when truth came from Us they said: why we have not been given that what people of Moosa were given, so have not they denied Moosa earlier, now they are saying that Taurait and Quran is a magic which authenticate each other and we are denying both.
Then say: Okay, you bring a book from the Lord which is more correct than this and I follow that, if you are truthful in your talk.

Then if they don't accept, understand that they are following their desires, and who have gone more strayed who is following their desires without receiving divine guidance, whereas Allah does not guide the unjust nation.
And we continuously conveyed Our communication to them, perhaps they take the admonition in this way.
To whoever I gave the book earlier than this they believe in this Quran.
When it is recited before them, they say we believe this is truthful from our Lord and we have already accepted it.
These are the people who will be given double the recompense that they showed patience, and they ward off evil with good deeds, and spend from the sustenance given by Us.
And when they hear useless talk they get aside by saying that for you is your deeds and for us is our deeds, our salutation (to you), we do not like to sit with the ignorant.
O Prophet! You cannot guide whoever you want, but Allah guides whomever He pleases, and He is well aware with those, who will get guidance.

These infidels say that if we follow you, we will be displaced from our land, have not we given them the control over the secured Holy Place (Haram), towards which fruits of every kind come because of our sustenance, but most among them do not understand.
We have destroyed many settlements because of their economy's pride, and these are their homes which were never populated, except a few, and in fact We are Heir and Master of everything.

Your Lord does not destroy any settlement unless We send the messenger to them who recite our communications in front of them, and We are not going to destroy any settlement unless people there are unjust.
Whatever We have given you is a few days' enjoyment and beauty of this world, and whatever is in the Court of Allah is good and everlasting, don't you even understand this.

Does the servant with whom We have promised the good and he also gets it, can be like the person whom We have given little enjoyment (of world) and on the Day of Judgement he will be dragged and presented in the Court of Allah.
That day Allah will call out: where are My partners, whose partnership you perceived.

So on whom sentencing of partnership with Allah would have been confirmed will say: O Lord these are the people whom we misguided, and like this we misguided them as we were misguided, but today we want to be free from them, they were not worshipping us.
So it will be said: now call out to your partners, they will call out, but there won't be any reply, but they will see the punishment only, alas! had they taken guidance in the world only.
And that day Allah will call out and say: what reply you had given to Our messengers?
So all the news will become darkness for them and they will not be able to speak among themselves.
But who repented and believed and did good works, he will Verily be counted among those who will prosper.
Your Lord creates and likes to whom He pleases, they have no right to choose, Allah is Pure, High and exalted from their polytheism.
And your Lord Knows the things which they have concealed in their breasts, and also Knows what they speak out openly.

That is Allah and there is no other god except Him, He is the First, He is the Last, and all the Praises are for Him only in this world and in the Hereafter, Judgement is His only; and you all shall have to return to Him only.
Say: What is your opinion if Allah continues and prolonged the night until the Day of Judgement so is there any other god besides Him who can bring the light for you, don't you listen to the talk?
And say: if He stretches the day and makes it permanent up to the Day of Judgement, then is there any other god besides Allah who can bring night for you where you can take rest, so don't you see.
This is part of His Mercy that he made night and day both for you so you can also take rest and even go in search of sustenance, and perhaps be grateful to Him too.
And on the Day of Judgement Allah will call out: where are my partners whose partnership you had perceived.

And We will bring out a witness from every nation, and will say to the deniers that you also bring your arguments, and when they will know that truth is for Allah, then those who were forging will all vanish away.

Verily, Qaroon was from the nation of Moosa, but he did unjust to his nation; and We had given him such treasures that a powerful party was also unable to lift their very keys; then his nation said do not show boastfulness because Allah does not like the boastful people.

And whatever Allah has given you, prepare a house in the Hereafter from it, and do not forget your part in this world, and do good as Allah has done good to you, and do not try to create mischief on the earth; Allah does not like mischief-makers.

Qaroon said it has all been given to me because of my knowledge, so does not he know that Allah has destroyed many generations before him who were more powerful and wealthier, and such guilty will not be even questioned about their sins.

Then Qaroon came out with all the decorations in front of his people, then those who had desire of this world said: we wish we would have such materials which have been given to Qaroon, he is master of mighty parts.
And whosoever was given the knowledge said: alas! on your condition; Allah's reward is much better for the believers and good doers, and reward is not given to anyone, but to the patient ones.
Then We made earth swallow him up and his house, and no group could save him, neither he was able to defend himself.

And those who have desired it yesterday began to say: Ah! Allah expands the sustenance of whoever He pleases and restrict of those whom He pleases; and if His Mercy was not on us, He would have caused the earth to swallow up us also; Ah! indeed infidels will never prosper.
This is the Hereafter which We have reserved for the people who do not desire high places and mischief in the world, and good-end is only for the pious people.
Whoever will do good work shall be rewarded the best, and whoever will do evil his recompense will be as much as his deeds.
Indeed who have made Quran imperative on you, He will definitely return you to your destination; say: Lord knows better who have brought the guidance and who is in the clear misguidance.
You were not hopeful that the book be revealed to you, this is Mercy of Allah, so beware, never side with the infidels.
Let them not stop you from preaching after revelation of a verse, and invite towards your Lord, and beware, do not be among the polytheists.
Do not call out to any other god with Allah, there is no god except Him, everything is going to be destroyed besides Him; Command is His, and (eventually) you will all be returned toward His Court.
Alif Laam Meem
Does the people think that they will be left just because of their saying that ‘we believe’, and they will not be put to trial?
Indeed, We also tested people earlier than them, and Allah definitely wish to know that who among those people are truthful and who are liars.
Does the evil doers think they will go ahead of Us, this is a wrong judgement.
Whoever hope to meet Allah, he should know that the term appointed is going to come, He is all Hearing and Knowing.
Whoever struggled, struggled for himself, Allah is Self-Sufficient from all the worlds.
Those who believed and did good works We Verily will cover up their sins, and We shall give them best recompense of their deeds.

And We have admonished human being to behave with good manners with parents and have told him: if they force you to make anyone My partner of which you do not know, then beware, do not obey them, and towards Me you shall all return, then I shall tell you what you were doing.
And those who adopted faith and did good works We will Verily count them among the good servants.

And there are some people who say we believe on Allah, after that when they are afflicted with any trouble in the way of Allah, then they consider that mischief as punishment of Allah, whereas if any help comes from the Lord they immediately say: we were with you; so is Allah not aware of the talk which are in the hearts of all creatures.
And He Verily knows who the believers are, and He also knows who the hypocrites are.

These infidels say to the believers: you follow our ways and we are responsible for your sins (on the day of Judgement), whereas they are not going to carry the burden of anyone's sins, they are plain liars.
And one day they have to carry their own burden; and also along with other's burden, and on the Day of Judgement they will be questioned for what they have blamed.
And We sent Nooh towards his nation, and he remained among them for nine hundred fifty years, then his nation was overtaken by the storm, because they were unjust.
Then We delivered Nooh and those who were in the Ark and made it a sign for the worlds.
And remember Ibrahim, when he said to his nation: Worship Allah and fear Him, this is better for you; if you know anything.

You worship only idols leaving Allah and forge lies on your own, remember, whomever you worship besides Allah are not the master of your sustenance, seek sustenance with Allah, worship Him, be grateful to Him, that you will all be taken to His Court.
And if you will deny, then many nations have done this before you, and the responsibility of the Prophet is only to reach you the message manifestly.
Did you not see that how Allah creates the creatures, and how he takes it back again, this is all very easy for Allah.
Say: roam on the land and see how Allah has begun the creation, and then He will raise them again in the Hereafter, indeed He has power over everything.
He punishes whom He pleases, He shows Mercy on whom He pleases, you will all be returned towards Him.
You cannot humble him in the earth and in the sky, and you do not have any other Guardian or Helper besides Him.
And those who deny Allah's signs and His meeting (in the Hereafter) are despaired of Our Mercy, and there is painful punishment for them.
So there was not any reply from his (Ibrahim's) nation, but they said: slay him or burn him; so Allah delivered him from the fire, indeed, in it also there are many signs for the believers.

And Ibrahim said: only for the love of life of this world you have adopted idols leaving Allah, and on the Day of Judgement you will deny each other and curse each other, then your abode will be Hell and no one will be your helper.
Then Lut believed in him (Ibrahim) and said: I am migrating towards Allah and He is the Honorable and Wise.

And then We gave him children like Ishaq and Yaqoob, then kept book and prophethood in their progeny, and in the world recompense them and in the Hereafter, they will be counted among the good character people.
Then remember Lut, when he said to his nation: you are doing such a bad act which nobody has done in the world before you.

You are establishing sexual relations with men and cutting off the way and doing bad acts in your gatherings; then their nation does not have any reply besides that if you are truthful bring divine punishment which you are promising.
So Lut said: O Lord help me against this mischief making nation.
And when Our representative angels came to Ibrahim with glad tiding and gave him the news that we want to destroy the people of that settlement (because) they are very unjust.
So Ibrahim said: Lut is also there, they said: we are aware of everybody, we will deliver him and his family except for his wife who is going to remain behind.

When Our angels came to Lut he got worried about the guests, they said don't fear and don't get worried we will save you and your family except your wife who will be among the people who will remain behind.
We are going to send punishment from the sky on this settlement; they are behaving very immorally.
And We left behind the manifest sign for the people of the settlement, who understand.
And We sent his brother Shoaib towards Madyan, so he said: worship Allah and be hopeful of the Day of Judgement, and do not make mischief in the land.
So they rejected him, resulting in the earthquake overtaking them, and in their homes they fell upside down on their knees.

And remember Aad and Samood. (after destruction) we made their dwelling appear to you clearly, and Satan had decorated their deeds for them and kept them apart from the path, however they were very intelligent.
And remind them of Qaroon, Firaun and Hamaan, to whom Moosa came with a manifest book, so they behaved proudly in the land; however, they were unable to go ahead of Us.

Then We arrested everyone in their sins; on some, stones rained from the sky, some were overtaken by Mighty Scream from the sky, some were sunk in the ground, some were drowned in water; and Allah is not unjust on anyone, but they are being unjust to their souls themselves.
And whoever made guardians other than Allah, their example is like a spider, she made the house, but the weakest house is that of the spider, if they have got knowledge and perception.
Indeed, Allah knows whom they are calling, besides Him, and He is very Honorable and has Wisdom.
These examples We are describing for the entire world of humanity, but nobody can understand them, except the knowledgeable.
Allah has created sky and the earth with the truth, and signs of Power are found in it for the believers.

Recite the Book which has been revealed to you, and establish prayer because it stops (you) from every bad deed and evil; and remembrance of Allah is a great thing, and Allah is well aware of your deeds.

And do not debate with the people of book but in a very decent manner, except with those who are unjust; and say: we believe in whatever is revealed towards us and towards them, and our God and your God is one, and we are all obedient to Him.

Like this We revealed the Book to you, so to whoever We gave the book earlier they believe in this book, and some of these people (Arabs) also believe in this (book), and Our verses are only denied by the infidels.
And O Prophet! Before the Quran you have not read any book and did not write anything with your hands otherwise people of falsehood would have doubted.
In fact, this Quran is the name of some open verses which are safe in their breasts to whom the knowledge is granted, and nobody deny our verses except the unjust.
And these people say why the verses of Quran are not revealed to them, say: verses are all with Allah, I am just a manifest warner from the punishment of Allah.
Is it not enough for them that We have revealed the Book on you which is recited before them, indeed in this is Mercy and reminder for the faithful nation.
You say to them: Allah is enough between me and you as a witness Who is aware of everything of sky and the earth, and those who believe in falsehood and deny Allah, are indeed losers.
And these people are hastening for the punishment, however if its term was not appointed then punishment would have come, and it will come suddenly, and they will not be able to understand.
They are hastening for the punishment, whereas Hell is certainly going to encompass infidels in it.
The day when punishment will cover them from atop, and the bottom and will say now taste the recompense of your deeds.
O Our believing servants! My land is very spacious; hence worship Me only.
Every soul is going to taste death, then you all shall be brought to Our Court.

Whoever believes and they did good work We will give them place in the lofty mansions of the Paradise beneath which rivers will be flowing and they will always abide in them, this is the best recompense for those who do good work.
Those who show patience and have trust in their Lord.
Many living creatures who walk on the earth cannot carry the burden of their sustenance, but Allah is giving the sustenance to them and to you, He Hears all and is aware of everyone's condition.
And if you ask them who has created sky and the earth and who brought about sun and the moon, they will immediately say: Allah did, then where they are deviating.
Allah create the expansion in whoever's sustenance He pleases of His servants, and straiten whoever's sustenance He pleases, He is well Cognizant of everything.

And if you ask them who rained the water from sky, and enlivened earth once again after being dead, they will say: Allah did, then say: all Praises are for Allah, and majority of them do not use their intelligence.
The life of this world is nothing but a play, and the abode of the Hereafter is the center for eternal life, if they would know and understand something.

When these people are on the ships, they call out to Allah with sincerity believing in Him and with dependence, but when He deliver them and reach them safely to the land, they immediately adopt polytheism.
Thus they deny to whatever We have given them and they enjoy in the world, shortly they will come to know of its result.
Did not these people see that We have made a secure house for them, and that men are being snatched away from all around it; so do they believe in falsehood, and deny the favour (of Allah)?
Who is the biggest unjust who attributes falsehood to Allah or denies the truth after its coming, so, is Hell not the abode of the infidels?
And whoever struggled hard in Our way, We will guide them to Our ways, and indeed Allah is with the people who do the best deeds.
Alif Laam Meem
Romans were defeated;
In the nearest area, but after getting defeated, shortly they will dominate again.
Within a few years, only Allah has the authority over the beginning and the end, and on that day believers shall rejoice.
With the help and aid of Allah, that He helps whom He pleases; and He is the Mighty and Merciful.
This is the promise of Allah, and He does not go back on His promise, but majority of humans are unaware of this reality.
These people know the obvious of this world, and they are totally oblivious from the Hereafter.

Did not they reflect within themselves, that Allah has created with truth whatever is in the skies and on earth and in between them; and with an appointed term, but most of them are deniers of the meeting with their Lord.

Did not they travelled in the earth that they see the recompense of their earlier ones who were stronger from them, and they had populated the land with farming more than them, and Our messengers had come to them with more manifest signs; Verily Allah is not unjust to His servants, but they are unjust on their own souls.
After that the recompense of evil people was bad, that they denied the signs of Allah, and they continue to make fun of them.
Allah only begins the creation, and then returns them also, then all of you will be taken to His Court.
When the Day of Judgment will be established, then all the guilty ones will be disappointed.
And there won't be any intercessor among their partners, and they will deny their own partners.
When the Day of Judgement will be established, they will be divided into groups among themselves.
Then the believers who had done good deeds, they will be happy and joyous in the gardens of Paradise.
And who adopted infidelity, and who denied Our verses and the Day of Judgement, they will Verily be entangled in the punishment.
Therefore, Glorify your Lord in the evening and in the morning.
All the Praise of the earth and the sky belong to Him, and at the time of evening and noon.
That Allah brings forth living out of the dead, and brings forth the dead from living; and brings to life again the dead earth, and like this you will also be raised one day.
And among His other signs one is that He created you from the dust, and then you expanded into a human being.

And among His signs is that He created the pair for you among yourselves that you may find rest in them, then He made love and compassion between you, there are many signs in this for the people who ponder.
And among His signs are creation of skies and the earth and difference between your languages and colour, there are many signs in this for the people who ponder.
Among His signs are that you take rest during the night and the day and then search for the Mercy (Sustenance) of Allah, in this also there are many signs for the nation who hears.

And He made lightning appear as a centre of fear and hope for you among His signs, and He rains water from the sky, and then through it brings to life the dead earth; indeed, in this also there are many signs for that nation who have intelligence.
And among His signs is that sky and the earth subsist through His command; and when He will call you, you all will come out of the earth at once.
Whatever is in sky and on the earth is his property, and everything is His obedient.

And that is He, who begins the creation, then brings to life again, and this is very easy for Him, and to Him belongs the loftiest example in the sky and the earth, and He is Predominant on all and has Wisdom.

He describes your example for you, that in the sustenance We have given you, you have partners with your slave and lady-slave who are your property, and you should fear them as you fear for your own souls; and Verily We relate Our signs distinctly for the nation who understand.
Fact is that unjust followed their desires without understanding, to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance who can guide him? And they do not have any helpers either.

Keep your face towards the religion, and get aside from the falsehood, this religion is that Divine Nature on which human beings have been created, and there can be no change in the Divine Creation, Verily this the straight and stable religion, but majority of the people are unaware of this.
You all keep your attention towards Allah, and keep fearing Him, establish prayer and beware, do not be among the polytheists.
Those who have created the division in the religion, and got divided into groups, then all the groups are rejoicing with whatever they had with them.
When any difficulty afflicts the people, they call upon their Lord with total attention; and thereafter when He makes them taste of His Mercy to them, one group among them shows polytheism.
That whatever We have given them they may deny, so you enjoy, afterwards you all shall come to know.
Did We send any argument to them that justify their polytheism?
When We make them taste Our Mercy, they become happy, and when any harm afflicts them due to their previous deeds, they are disappointed.

So did not these people see that Allah expands the sustenance to whoever He pleases, and straitens the sustenance to whoever He pleases, and in this also there are signs of Allah for the believing nation.
And give their share to the close relatives, poor, and needy-travelers, that this is good for them whoever desire Allah's pleasure, indeed they will be delivered.

Whatever you give as usury that may increase the people's wealth, but it does not increase anything with Allah, but whatever you give as poor-rate with the intention to please Allah, you shall be recompensed with double and quadruple.

That is Allah Who has created you, then gave you sustenance, then gives death, then shall bring to life again; is there anyone among your partners who can do this? Allah is much high, exalted and pure, then with whoever they make His partners.
Corruption has surfaced on the land and the sea because of the earning of the people, that Allah may give them taste of some of their deeds, and that people may come back on the (right) path.
Say: travel on the land to see what has happened to the people earlier than you, majority of them were polytheists.
Keep your face straight and on the stable religion, before that the day may come when there is no way for return, and the day when people will be upset and separated.
Who will not believe will be responsible for his own infidelity, and whoever is doing good deeds are making the way easy for themselves.
So that Allah may reward with his Mercy to the believers and to those who do good works, and He does not like the infidels.

And one of His signs is that He sends winds of glad tidings so that you may taste His Mercy, and ships sail on his command that you can get your sustenance, and perhaps you may become grateful like this.
And We sent many messengers before you towards their nations, who came to them with manifest signs, then We took revenge with the guilty ones, and it was imperative on Us to help the believers.

That is Allah who moves the winds that they fly the clouds, then He spreads the clouds in the sky wherever He pleases, and He breaks them into pieces, and rains water from amidst them, this water reaches those servants whom He pleases; then they become happy.
Although they were disappointed before the arrival of the rain.
Now see the signs of Allah's Mercy that how He brings to life the dead earth, Verily, He brings to life the dead ones, and He has Power over everything.
And if We would have blown the poisonous winds and they would have seen the yellow of autumn everywhere, then they would have completely adopted the infidelity.
You cannot make the dead to hear your voice, nor you can make the deaf to hear your voice, when they turn their face and walk away.
And you cannot guide from misguidance to the blind, you can only make them hear who believe Our verses, and are Muslims.

That is Allah who created you out of weakness, then after weakness gave you strength; and (again) after strength gave the weakness, and gave old age; and He creates whatever He pleases, He has Knowledge and Power.
When the Day of Judgement will be established, that day the guilty ones will swear and say we didn't stay in the world for more than an hour, in fact they were blaming such in the world also.
And who are given the knowledge and faith, they will say: according to the Book of Allah you stayed until the Day of Judgement, this is the Day of Judgement and you are unaware.
Then today no apology will work for them, nor will they be heard.
And we have described the examples of every kind in this Quran, even if you bring all the signs, these people will still say that you are the people of falsehood.
Verily Allah seals their hearts who do not have any knowledge.
Therefore, have patience, promise of Allah is Truth; and beware, those who do not believe in this may not shake your firmness.
Alif Laam Meem
These are verses of the Book full of wisdom.
Which is the guidance and mercy for the good character people.
Who establish prayer and give poor-rate, and believe in the Hereafter.
These people are on the guidance from their Lord and are going to prosper.

There is a person among the people who purchase idle talk to misguide people without knowledge, from the path of Allah and make fun of divine verses, in fact for such people is the painful punishment.

And when divine verses are recited before him, he turns his face with pride, as if he has not heard anything, and as there is deafness in his ears; Give good news of painful punishment to such a person.
Verily who believed and did righteous deeds, for them is the Paradise of bliss.
They will abide in it forever, this is the truthful promise of Allah, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.

He has created the skies without the pillars, you can see; He set upon earth huge mountains lest it move with you from its place, and has spread all types of animals, and We rained water from the sky, and through it made all types of fine creatures (vegetation), in pairs.
This is the creation of Allah, so O infidels! Now show, what else can your gods create? Fact is that unjust are in clear misguidance.

And We bestowed wisdom upon Luqman ;that be grateful to Allah, whoever is grateful (to Allah) is for his own benefit, and whoever is ungrateful, he should know that Allah is Self-Sufficient and is worthy of praises also.
And remember the time when Luqman enlightened his son, O son! Do not make any partner with Allah, polytheism is great unjust.

And We have instructed humans about parents that mother has taken trouble over trouble and kept in the womb; and took two years of weaning from breastfeeding; be grateful to Me and your parents, that your return is towards Me only.

And if your parents compel you to make something My partner of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them; but be kind to them in the world, and follow the path of him which reminds Me, then thereafter return of all of you are towards Me only; then I will inform you what you have done.

Son, good or evil, even if it is like a mustard-seed and beneath the stone or on the skies or in the depth of earth, Allah will Verily bring it forth on the Day of Judgement; He is Subtlest and well-aware.
O my Son! establish prayer, enjoin good and despise what is wrong, if any trouble afflicts you in the way of Allah, be patient, indeed that it is the matter of courage.
And do not turn your face away from people with disrespect, and do not walk with proud on earth, because Allah does not like haughty and boasters.
And pursue the middle course in your behavior, and keep your voice low, the worst sound is that of donkey.

Did not you saw that Allah has made subservient you all the things of sky and the earth, and completed seen and unseen favors for you, and there are some among the people who argue about Allah without knowledge, guidance and the bright book.
And when they are told to follow what is revealed by Allah, they say: we follow whatever our forefathers had followed, even if they are invited by Satan towards Hell.
And who turns his life wholly towards Allah and also has good character, then he has held the rope of guidance firmly, and on Allah is the end of all affairs.
(O prophet!) You should not be sad if someone adopts infidelity, that everyone has to return to Us only; then We will inform them what they have done, indeed Allah knows the secrets of hearts also.
We will give them rest for some days, then shall drag and bring them towards the severest punishment.
If you ask them who has created the sky and the earth, they will say: Allah did, then say all the Praises are for Allah; and majority of them are totally ignorant.
Everything on the earth and in the sky is for Allah only, and He is Self-Sufficient and worthy of praise.

If all the trees on the earth turn to pens, and to support seven more seas may come to assist the (seven) seas, even then words of Allah are not going to end, Verily Allah is Honorable and has Wisdom.
Creation of all of you and coming to life once again, is like one man, and Verily Allah is all-Hearing and all-Seeing.

Did you not see that it is Allah Who makes night to enter into the day; and makes day enter into the night; He made moon and the sun that they will continue to move until the appointed day, and Allah is Cognizant of your affairs.
This is all because Allah is the truthful Lord, and to whomever they call besides Him are falsehood, Allah is Exalted, High and Great.
Did you not see that ships are moving in the sea with Allah's Mercy, that He may show you His signs, there are big signs in this for the people who are patient and thankful.

When any wave covers them like a shade they call out to Allah with total religious sincerity, and when he delivers them and reach them to the land, then only some of them remain on moderation, and only traitors and ungrateful people only deny Our verses.

O People! Fear your Lord, fear the day when father will not be useful to son nor son will be useful to father, Verily, Allah's promise is truth, therefore worldly life should not deceive you; and beware, let no deceiver deceive you.

Verily, knowledge of the Day of Judgement is with Allah only, and He rains the water, and He knows the condition inside of womb, and nobody know what he will earn tomorrow, and nobody know on which land he will die, Verily, Allah is Cognizant and is Aware.
Alif Laam Meem
Indeed, revelation of this Book (Quran) is from the Lord of the Worlds.

What, are they saying this is all the forging of the prophet, absolutely not; this is the truth from your Lord, that you may warn the nation because no warner prophet has come to them earlier than you, perhaps they may take the guidance.

That is Allah who created skies and the earth and everything in between them within six days, then established His Power on the Throne, and for you there is no guardian and intercessor other than Him; are not you understanding this thing.
That Allah regulates the affairs from sky to the earth, then this plan will be presented in His Court on the day which according to your calculation is equivalent to a thousand years.
That is Allah, the knower of all things; present and the unseen, and He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
He has made everything beautiful, and He has begun the creation of man with clay.
After that made his progeny come into existence, from despicable water.
Thereafter made him in due proportion and blew His spirit in it; and made for you ear, eye and heart, but you pay very less thanks.
And they say: if we are lost in the land, will we be raised again as a new creation? Thing is that they are the deniers of meeting with their Lord.
Say: Angel of death will reach you to the end of your life, who is deployed for you, thereafter you will all be presented in the Court of the Lord.
Wish you see how guilty ones will be standing with their head bow down: Our Lord we saw and heard (now) send us back we will do the good work, Verily we are from the believers.
And if We pleases We would have guide every soul forcibly, but it has already been decided from Us that We will fill Hell with jinns and all misguided humans.
Now you taste the thing that you had forgotten, Our today's meeting, then we have also neglected you, now taste the permanent punishment because of your past deeds.
Believers of our verses are only those, when they are reminded of Our verses they fall down in prostration, and glorify Allah with praises and are not proud.
{Prostrate, Obligatory} Their backs are drawn away from their beds and they call out to their Lord out of fear and greed; and they spend in Our way out of what We have given them.
And not any soul knows what is hidden for them to comfort their eyes, as a reward for their (good) deeds.
What, that person who is a believer can be like a transgressor, absolutely not, both cannot be the same.
Those who believed and did the good works, for their comfort are Paradises which are in reward to their deeds.
Who adopted transgression, their abode is Hell, when they will try to come out, they will be pushed inside again and will be said: now taste the fire which you had denied (in the world).
And before bigger punishment Verily We will make them taste the lesser punishment, perhaps like this they might come on the straight path.
And who can be bigger unjust than he who is reminded of Divine Verses but he objects; Verily We will take revenge from the guilty ones.
And We gave book to Moosa also, therefore you should not doubt that the Quran is from Allah, and We made book of Moosa a guidance for Bani Israel.
And among them We made some leaders and chiefs, to guide them by Our command, and because they were patient and they believed in our verses.
Verily, your Lord will decide between them on the Day of Judgement, in the matter they had disputed among them.
Is it not enough for their guidance that We destroyed many nations before them, in the settlements they are moving around, and there are many signs in this, so do not they listen?
Do they not see that We move the water to the open fields and therewith produce agriculture through it, which they eat themselves and also feed their animals, so are not they seeing it.
And these people say: when that day of victory will come, if you people are truthful?
Say: those who adopt infidelity, neither their faith will benefit them on the day of victory, nor they will be given any respite.
Therefore, turn away from them, and wait for the time, they are also waiting.
O Prophet! Keep fearing Allah and beware, do not obey infidels and hypocrites, Verily Allah is Cognizant of everything and has Wisdom.
And follow whatever is being revealed to you from your Lord, Allah is well aware of your deeds.
And rely on Allah, He is enough for your worries.

Allah has not given two hearts in any man's breast, nor He made your wives as your real mothers, whose back you liken to your mothers, nor He has made your adopted son your son, these are words of your mouth; and Allah says the truth, and guide to the straight path.

Call those children with their father's name, this is nearest to justice in the sight of Allah; if you do not know their father then in religion, they are your brothers and friends; there is no harm for you if you have committed any mistake, but you are responsible for whatever you have done knowingly, and Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.

Verily, prophet has much more right over the souls of the believers, and his wives are mothers to all; and among believers and migrants their close relatives are more important, but if you want to do good to friends then there is no harm, this is written and present in the book of Allah.
And remember the time when We took covenant from all prophets, especially with you and Nooh, Ibrahim, Moosa and Isa son of Maryam; and took very strong covenant from all.
That He may question the truthfulness of their truth about sincerity of preaching; and Allah has made available very painful punishment for infidels.
O believers! Remember the favor of Allah when army of infidelity confronted you, and We sent strong winds and such forces for your help which you could not see, and Allah is well aware of your deeds.
When infidels came from above and from below you, and eyes were expanded with terror, and hearts rose up to the throats, and you began thinking diversely about Allah.
That time believers were tested and they were given strong jerks.
And infidels who had sickness in their hearts said: Allah and His prophet had only made deceptive promises with us.

When one group said O people of Madina there is no place here, we should flee, among them one group asked for permission from the Prophet that their houses are empty, whereas they were not empty, but they were only trying to flee.

And if such forces would have come from all points from around Madina, and they were asked for mischief, they immediately would have come, and they would have stayed in their houses just for little while.
And Verily they have made a strong covenant with Allah that they will not turn their backs; and they will be enquired of their covenant with Allah.
Say: your fleeing out of fear of slaying or death will not work for you, you will be able to rest a little in the world.
Say: if Allah intends to do evil or good for you, then who can save you from Him, and these people cannot find any guardian or helper other than Him.
Allah knows those also who hinder people from war and say to their brothers come to us and they themselves come to the battlefield very less.

They are reluctant from you, when fear will come in front of them, they will see you as if their eyes are turning just as their death is near, when fear will wane away they will attack on you with sharp language, and they will be greedy of war-spoils, they have not believed from the beginning, hence, Allah has negated their deeds, and for Allah this is very easy.

They are still thinking that the coalition forces of infidels have not gone away, and if the army come again, they will think, wish, they would have settled in the desert with villagers, and would get your news from there; and even if they were with you, yet they would have come to fight alongside you only for a little while.
O Muslims! Life of the Prophet is an excellent example for those who are hopeful of Allah and the Day of Judgement and remember Allah a lot.

And the condition of the believers is such that when they saw the armies of infidelity they called out: this is the thing which Allah and His Prophet had promised, and the promise of Allah and His Prophet is truth; and this mob increased their faith and passion in them.

There are many fighters among the believers who have completed the covenant made with Allah, and some of them have completed their time, and some of them are waiting, they have not made any change in their words.
So that Allah recompense the truthful for their truth, and as for hypocrites either He may punish them or may accept their repentance, Verily, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
And Allah returned infidels along with their rage and they could not benefit any, and Allah saved the believers from the war, and Allah is very Powerful and Mighty.
And he made people of book who were backing the infidels climb down their forts, and casted such a fear in their hearts that you killed some and took some as prisoners.
And then made you inherit their land, their rivers and their wealth and made you inherit all the lands also in which you had not trodden, and Verily Allah has power over everything.
O Prophet! Tell your wives: if you are desirous of beauty of this world, then come I will bid you goodbye with decency and wealth of the world.
And if you are desirous of Allah, Prophet and the Hereafter; then for women of good characters among you Allah has preserved the great reward.
O wives of the Prophet! Whoever will commit the manifest evil among you, punishment for them will be double, and this is very easy for Allah.
And whoever among you will obey Allah and His Prophet and will do good deeds, We will give him double the reward, and We have provided the best sustenance for him.

O wives of the Prophet! If you are pious, then your status is not like other women, don't be soft in talk with any man, that if he has sickness in his heart he will yearn; and always speak good words.

And stay in your houses and do not wear make-up like ignorant period, establish prayer and give poor-rate, and obey Allah and His Prophet, Allah intends, O people of household, to keep every uncleanness away from you, and purify you in such a way as it should be purified.
And O Prophet's wives! Remember the Divine Verses and words of wisdom which are recited in your houses, because Allah is a very Meticulous Knower and Cognizant of everything.

Verily, Muslim men and Muslim women, believing men and believing women, and men who obey and women who obey, and truthful men and truthful women, and patient men and patient women, and men who are humble and women who are humble; and men who give charity and women who give charity; and men who fast and women who fast, and men and women who guard their chastity, and men and women who profusely thank Allah; Allah has made available for them forgiveness and great reward for them.

It is not allowed for any believing man and woman that when Allah and His Prophet have judged in any matter, they should have their own choice, and whoever will be disobedient he/she will be in manifest misguidance.

And remember the time when you will telling him, upon whom Allah has shown the favor and you also have done favor and were telling him to retain your wife to yourself and keep fearing Allah, you are concealing in your heart which Allah wants to bring to light, but you were afraid of people's taunting, whereas Allah has greater right that He should be feared, and when Zaid had accomplished of his want of her, We married that lady to you, that for the believers there is no harm to marry (ex) wives of their adopted sons, when they have accomplished want of them; and Allah's command will however be implemented.
There is no harm for the prophet for Allah's duties which He has ordained for him, this Divine tradition of earlier prophets, and command of Allah is a decree that is made absolute.
They reach the messages of Allah to the people, and keep His fear in their hearts, and do not fear anybody except Him; and Allah is sufficient for accounting.
Mohammad is not the father for any of your men, he is prophet of Allah, and last in the series of the prophets (seal of the prophets), and Allah is well-aware of everything.
O believers, mention the name of Allah very frequently.
Glorify Him morning and evening.
That is He who reveals the Mercy and all the angels also, that He bring you from darkness towards the light, and is very Merciful on the believers.
The day when they will meet their Lord, their hospitality will be with salutations; and He has made available the best reward for them.
O Prophet! We have made you witness, giver of glad tidings, and warner from the Divine punishment;
And has sent you as inviter with the permission of Allah, and as bright lamp.
Give glad tidings to the believers that there is great Grace and Mercy for them.
And beware! Do not obey infidel and hypocrites, and do not think about their trouble, and rely on Allah that He is sufficient for guardianship.
O Believers, when you marry believing women and divorce them without touching them, then you cannot demand the 'iddat' duration, give some gift to them and bid them good-bye nicely.

O Prophet! We have made to you lawful your wives whose dower you have paid, and lady-slaves whom Allah has given you without war, and daughters of your uncles, and daughters of your paternal-aunts, and daughters of your maternal-uncles; and daughters of your maternal-aunts who migrated with you, and believing women who gift their soul to the Prophet, if prophet wish to marry them, it is made lawful, but this is specially only for you and not for other believers; and We know what duty we have ordained for these people's wives and lady-slaves that there is no difficulty and trouble for you; and Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.

Among them, from whoever you separate or you give refuge to some, if you like them whom you have separated there is no harm; this is because their eyes should be comforted and may not get sad, they should be happy with whatever you give them, and Allah knows the condition of your hearts, and is Cognizant of everything and has Wisdom.

After that other women are not lawful for you, nor is it allowed that you exchange wives however beautiful they may be and you like them, except for those women who are your property (lady-slaves); and Allah is Watchful over everything.

O Believers! Do not enter the Prophet's house unless permission is given to you for meal, and even then do not keep an eye on the utensils, when you are invited then you can enter, and after food disperse immediately, and do not get busy in talking; because this troubles the Prophet; but he bears with you; however, although Allah is not shy from anything about the right of anybody, and when ask for anything from wives of the Prophet, ask them from behind the curtains; this is purer for you and them both, and you have no right to trouble the Prophet, and you should not marry his wives after him; this is a great talk in the sight of Allah.
You show anything, or conceal anything, eventually Allah knows everything.

For women there is no harm if they come without a veil in front of their father and grandfather, their sons, their brothers, brother's sons, or sister's sons, or in front of their women or female slaves, but you keep fearing Allah, He is Watchful over everything.
Indeed Allah and His angels send blessings on the Prophet, so O believers, you should also send blessings and salutations on him.
Curses are upon them in the world and the Hereafter who trouble Allah and His Prophet, Allah has made available disgraceful punishment for them.
And those who trouble believing men and believing women, for something other than what they have done, they are carrying the burden of false accusation and manifest sins on them.

O Prophet! Say to your wives, daughters and believing women to cast their outer garments over them, this is nearer to their identity and decency, and in this way they will not be given trouble, Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.

And if hypocrites and those who have sickness in their heart and who spread rumors in Madina, do not desist, then We will impose you upon them, and then these your neighbors will live only for few days.
These people will be cursed, they will be seized wherever they are found, and they will be cut into pieces.
This is a divine tradition which has remained among the people who have gone by, and there cannot be any change in the divine tradition.
O Prophet! They ask you about the Day of Judgement; say: its knowledge with Allah, and what do you know, it may be near.
Verily Allah has cursed the infidels and has arranged Hell for them.
They will remain in it forever, and they will not find guardian and helper.
That day their face will be turned towards Hell, and they will say: wish we would have obeyed Allah and His Prophet.
And will say: we obeyed our chiefs and elders, and they strayed us.
O Lord! Give them double the punishment and curse them greatly.
O Believers! do not be like them who troubled Moosa, but Allah cleared him from their saying, and he was a very dignified person near Allah.
O Believers! Fear Allah and talk straight.
So that He put your deeds to the right state and forgive your sins, and whoever will obey Allah and His Prophet will get the status of great success.
Verily, We presented trust to the sky, earth and the mountains, but everyone refused to carry it and expressed fear, it was humans who took it, that human is ignorant and unjust for his soul.

So that Allah send the punishment on hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and polytheist men and polytheist women; and accept the repentance of believing men and believing women; Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.
All the Praises are for Allah who is controlling everything of sky and the earth, for Him is the Praise in the Hereafter, and He has Wisdom, and Cognizant of everything.
He knows what things goes inside the earth and what comes out of it, and what things come from the sky and what things are ascended, He is Merciful and Forgiving.

Infidels say the Day of Judgment is not going to come, say: by Allah, it will Verily come, He has knowledge of the unseen, and no particle of sky and the earth is away from Him; nothing small or bigger than this but everything is present in this manifest Book.
So that He may reward those who believe and did good work, and for them is forgiveness and honorable sustenance.
And whoever strives against our verses, for them We there is painful punishment.
And whoever is given the knowledge they know that whatever is revealed on you is absolutely truth, and guide towards Allah, who is Predominant and worthy of Praise.

And whoever adopted infidelity say: we will tell you about a person who gives the news that after your death when you will be scattered in parts, then you will be brought to life again as new creation.
He is forging on Allah or madness is found in him, no, those who do not believe in the Hereafter, they are suffering from punishment and misguidance.

Did not they see the skies and the earth, and things of their front and their back? If We wish we can sink them in the earth or make the sky fall on them in pieces, and in these signs of Power of Allah are found for those who ponder.
And We have done favour to Dawood that you do glorify with the mountains, and we made the iron soft for him.
That you may make spacious and complete iron coats (armor) and be careful while joining the rings; and all of you do good deeds, and I am seeing your deeds.

And We made winds subservient to Soleiman that in the morning he travels the distance of one month and in the evening, he travels the distance of one month; and We made fountain of copper to flow out for him, and there were those among the jinns who worked for him with the command of Allah; and whoever deviated from our command, We will make him taste the Hellfire.

They make whatever Suleiman wishes, like arcs, pictures; bowls as big as ponds; big pots that are firmly in the ground (and would not move); Dawood! be grateful; among Our servants there are very few who are grateful.

Then when We decided for his death, nobody informed this to jinn except termite which were eating his staff, when he fell on the ground then jinns came to know (of his death); if they were aware of the unseen, they would not be suffering the disgraceful punishment.

And for the nation of Saba there were Our signs in their city, there were gardens left and right on both sides; you people eat the sustenance given by Him and be thankful to Him, pure city (for you) and Forgiving Lord.
But they deviated, and We sent a strong flood, then their two gardens turned such that their fruits were tasteless, some tamarix trees and some ber (jujube) plants were there.
This punishment was because of their ungratefulness, and to whom We give punishment, except the ungrateful.
And when We placed between them and the settlements which We had blessed, and appointed for the journey therein, now whenever you wish travel through them securely during the nights and days.

On this they said: O Lord, make our journey far away and like this they were unjust on their souls; so We left them as tales and broke them into pieces; and Verily signs are found in them for those who are patient and grateful.
And Iblis made and showed his doubt as truth to them, so all the believers, except one group, obeyed him.
And Satan would not have dominated them, but We wanted to know who has belief in the Hereafter, and who is in doubt about it, and your Lord is the Guardian of everything.

Say: call upon them whom you fancy except Allah, then you will see that they do not have power of even a particle in the skies and the earth, and neither they do have any part in the skies and the earth and nor they have any backer among them.

No intercession will be accepted in front of Him, except to those whom He will allow, when fear shall be removed from their hearts they will be asked: what your Lord has said; they will reply: whatever He has said is the Truth, He is Most High and Great.
Say: who gives you sustenance from the sky and the earth, then tell them, Allah gives, then say: we or you are on a right path or in manifest misguidance?
Tell them: you will not be questioned about our faults; neither will we be questioned about what you do.
Say: one day Allah will gather us all, then will judge among us with the Truth, and He is the best decider.
Say to them: just show us the partners whom you associate with Allah, they will never be able to show, because Lord is only Allah, Mighty and Wise.
And O Prophet! We have sent you to all people as a giver of glad tidings and as a warner, this is another matter that most of them are not aware of reality.
And they say if you are truthful then when this promise of the Day of Judgement will be completed?
Say: for you one day's promise is appointed, you can neither retreat even for one hour from it nor you can go ahead.

And these infidels say: they will not have belief on this Quran and neither on the earlier books, wish you would see when these unjust will be made to stand before the Lord, and everyone will return the talk to another, and those who are considered weak, they will say to the proud-ones that if you had not come in between we would have been believers.
Then proud-ones will say to the weaker ones: after coming of the guidance did we stop you from accepting, never, you yourselves are the guilty.

And weaker will say to the proud-ones that this is the result of your planning by night and you told us to deny the Lord, and to make similitude for Him; and after seeing the punishment they will be ashamed in their hearts; and We will put the shackles in the necks of the infidels, will they be given any other recompense for the deeds they had done.
We did not send any warner in the settlements but the proud-ones said we are the deniers of your message.
And they also said that we are better off with regards to wealth and children, and punishment is not going to come on us.
Say: My Lord increases or decreases the sustenance of whoever he pleases and, but many people do not know it.

There is nothing in your wealth and children which can bring you near in My Presence, except that they believe and did good work, so for them is double the reward for their deeds, and they will be sitting in the high places with peace.
And whoever strives in opposing our signs, they will be thrown in the punishment of Hell.

Verily our Lord expands the means of sustenance among His servants He pleases; and straitens the sustenance of whom He pleases, and whatever you will spend in His way Verily He will reward you for that; and He is the Best giver of sustenance.
The day Allah will collect them all and say to the angels: were they worshipping you?
They will say: You are Pure, Self-Sufficient and our Master, they are nothing to us, they were worshipping jinns, and their majority were believers of them.
So today nobody will be the master of anybody's benefit or loss, and We will say to the unjust now taste punishment of Hell of which you had denied.

When Our clear verses were recited before them, they used to say that this person wants to desist you from worshipping to whom your forefathers had worshipped; this is a forged tale; and infidels always say whenever Truth comes in front of them that this is a manifest magic.
And We did not send them any book which they recited, nor did We sent any warner to them before you.

And before them also people had denied messengers, however they did not even have one tenth of it which We had given to them, but they also denied the messengers, then you saw how dangerous was Our punishment.

O Prophet, say: I admonish you only for one thing that rises in groups of ones and twos then ponder that your companion does not have any madness, he is only a warner about oncoming of the severest punishment.
Say: the reward I am asking is for you only, my real reward is with the Lord, and He is witness to everything.
Say: my Lord puts the truth in hearts regularly and He is the knower of the unseen.
Say: Truth has come, and falsehood neither can create anything, nor it can return again (anything).
Say: if I go astray, it will affect me only, and if I will get guidance, it will be because of revelation, He listens to all and is nearer than anybody else.
Wish you could see they will be frightened, and they could not be saved, and they will be caught hold of shortly.
They will say they believe, but how could they receive (Faith) from a position so far off.
They have denied earlier (the faith), and they speculate regarding the unseen from far off place.
And now curtains have been drawn between them and the things they desired, as was done with the earlier ones: that they are in a state of disquieting doubt.

All the Praises are for Allah, the creator of the skies and the earth, who makes angels his messengers, the angels who have two-two, three-three, and four-four wings, and increases the creation as much He pleases; indeed, He has power over everything.
If Allah opens the doors of Mercy no one can stop Him, and to whoever He stops no one can send him, He is Predominant on everything, and Wise.
O People! Remember the Blessings of Allah, no one is Creator except Him, only He give you sustenance from the skies and the earth, there is no Lord except Him, so where you are deviating.
And if they deny you, before you also, they have denied many prophets and return of all the affairs is to the Lord only.
O People! Promise of the Lord is Truth, so do not allow the life of the world to deceive you, and no deceiver should deceive you.
Verily, Satan is your enemy, so consider him enemy, he invites them to his group that they all become people of Hell.
Whoever adopted infidelity there is severe punishment for them, and those who believe and did good work, there is forgiveness and big reward for them.

So can that person whose deeds have been decorated, and he thinks them good, can be same as a believer; to whoever Allah pleases leaves him in misguidance, and to whoever pleases He guides, do not grieve in their concern, Allah is well aware of their deeds.
That is Allah who sent winds to scatter the clouds, and We take them to the dead cities, and bring the dead land to the life again, and like this people would be raised to life (once again).

Whoever is desirous of honor, should understand that all Honor belongs to the Lord, pure words rise towards Him; and good deeds lift them up, there is severe punishment for those who strive for evil; and their planning is after all going to perish.

And Allah has created you from dust, then made sperm, then made pair, and whatever a woman carries in her womb, or gives birth, is aware of all, then whoever is given long life or short life; everything is mentioned in the Divine Book, and for Allah it is all very easy.

And two seas cannot be the same, one with sweet and pleasant water and other with salty and bitter water; and yet from both of them you eat fresh meat and take out the jewelry which you wear; you see the ships which swiftly move on the water that you may search for the bounties of Allah (sustenance); perhaps you become thankful in this way.

And Allah makes to enter the night into the day, and makes to enter day into the night, Allah made subservient to sun and the moon, and they are moving (in the orbit) according to the appointed time, that is your Lord and He is the master of the universe, and besides Him whom you call out, they don't have even the control of the peel of the seed of the palm-date.

You will call them but they will not be able to listen to you, and if they hear, they will not be able to reply to you, and on the Day of Judgement they will deny your association, and nobody can say all this, except that Who Knows.
O People, you are all needy in the presence of Allah, and Allah is master of wealth and worthy of Praise.
If He pleases, He may take you all away and bring another creation in your place.
And this is not a difficult task for Allah.

And no one will carry the burden of another's sins, and if somebody will be called to carry this, he will not be able to lift anything, even if they are the kins, you can only warn those people, who fear Allah from the unseen, and who establishes prayer, and whoever will adopt purity will be for his benefit, and all of them have to return to Allah only.
And blinds and seeing ones cannot be the same.
And darkness and light both cannot be equal.
And shadow and sunlight cannot be the same.
And alive and dead cannot be the same, and to whoever Allah pleases makes him hear to His words, you cannot make those hear who are living in the graves.
You are just the warner.
We have sent as giver of glad tidings with the Truth, and there is no nation which was not sent a warner.
And if they deny you, people earlier than them also have done this, when messengers came to them with miracles, scriptures, clear book.
Then We caught hold of the infidels, then how dangerous was Our punishment.
Didn't you see that Allah sent the water from the sky, then We made fruits of different colors, and made ways in the mountains, white and red, and some of them were of black in color.

And different color of creatures are found among humans, cattle and animals, and among the people who fear Allah are those who have knowledge and wisdom, Verily, Allah is Honorable and very Forgiving.

Verily, those who recite the Book (Quran), and they establish prayer, and spend (in the way of Allah) openly and secretly from whatever sustenance We have given them, they do such a business that will never be destroyed.
So that Allah give them their reward fully and may increase some with His Mercy and Blessings, indeed, Allah is very Forgiving and Appreciator.
The Book which We have revealed towards you is the Truth, and confirms its earlier books; indeed, Allah is aware of the condition of His servants; and Seeing.

Then We made to inherit this book to those whom We have chosen, some of them are unjust to their souls, some are moderate, and some of them goes ahead in doing the good work with the permission of Allah; and indeed, this is biggest blessing and excellence.
These people shall enter the ever-lasting Paradise, they will be given gold bracelet and pearl ornaments to wear, and their dress in the Paradise will be that of silk.
And they will say: thank Allah, He took us away from sadness, Verily, Allah is very Forgiving and Appreciator.
With His Blessings and Mercy, He has made us reach to a place where there is no tiredness and no trouble can touch us.
There is Hellfire for those who adopted infidelity, and there neither death will come to them nor there would be any concession in their punishment, and We give punishment like this to the infidels.

There they will plead: O Lord get us out of here we will do good works, as opposed to what we had been doing; so have not We given you the age, who wanted to take lesson could have taken; and a warner also had come to you; now taste the punishment, there is no help for the unjust.
Verily, Allah knows the unseen of the skies and the earth, and knows the secrets hidden in the hearts.

That is Allah who made you successors of the earlier ones, and whoever will be infidel he will be responsible for himself, and infidelity in the sight of Allah does not increase anything except the divine wrath and loss.

Say: have you seen those whom you associate with Allah; show them to me also, that what they have created on earth, or do they have any association in the skies, or We have given them any book through which they can establish any argument; this is nothing, but unjust are deceiving among themselves and making false promises.
Verily, Allah upholds skies and the earth from getting perish, apart from Allah if anybody else would have upheld them, they would have been perished, and He is very Forbearing and Forgiving.
And these people have sworn strongest that if any warner come to us then we will be the most guided among all the Ummah, but when warner came, so nothing increased but hate.

This is the result of proud and evil planning, however big evil plotters will be affected with their own plotting, now what they are awaiting about the method of Allah with regards to the earlier ones, and method of Allah is also not going to be changed, nor can there be any changes.

So did not they travel in the land to see what had happened to the earlier ones, whereas they were more powerful compared to them; nothing of the earth and the skies can humble Allah, verily, He knows everything and has power over them.

And were Allah to punish them all for they have done, then no living being would have been left on the earth, but He gives respite up to an appointed and fixed time, when that time will come then Allah has great insight for His servants.
Ya Seen
Swear by the Quran, full of wisdom.
You are from the messengers.
Verily, you are on the straight path.
This Quran is revealed by the Mighty and Merciful Allah.
So that you warn this nation whose forefathers were not warned by any messengers, and they all remained negligent.
Indeed, on their majority Our punishment is confirmed, they are not going to believe.
We have put shackles in their necks which are up to their chins, and they have raised their heads.
And We have made one wall in front of them and one wall on their back, and then have covered them with punishment, they are unable to see anything.
Whether you warn them or not it is the same for them, they are not going to believe it.
You can warn only those people who follow your admonition, and without seeing keep fearing the unseen Allah; you give glad tidings to those people for forgiveness and honorable reward.
Indeed, only We bring alive to the dead, and write down their deeds and impressions, and We have recorded everything in an explicit leader.
And O Prophet! You mention to the people of the town to whom Our prophets had come.
Like this we sent two prophets but people denied them, so to help them We sent the third prophet, and all of them together announced that we have been sent to you (from Allah).
They said: you are all mortals like us, Beneficent (Allah) has not sent anybody, you are telling lies.
They said: Our Lord knows that we have been sent towards you.
And our responsibility is to reach you with the message explicitly.
Those people said: you seem to be ill-omened, if you do not desist from your talk we will stone you, and we will give you severe punishment.
They replied: your evil fortune is with you; is this reminder any ill-omen, fact is that you are all people who do excesses.
From the corner of city a man came running and said: O people follow the prophets.
Follow them, they do not ask any reward from you and are the guided ones.
And what has happened to me, that I do not worship Him who has created me, and you will all be returned to His Presence.
Shall I adopt any other god besides Him, that if He wish to afflict me with any harm then nobody recommendation will be of any use, and nobody can save.
I will be in open misguidance.
I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.
Resultant, that servant was told to enter Paradise, he said: I wish my nation also would have known this.
As to how my Lord has forgiven and has counted me among the honorable people.
And thereafter on those people We did not send any army, nor did We are going to send any army.
That was a mighty blast, and then the light of life was extinguished.
How sad is the condition of those servants that when any prophet comes to them, they mock him.
Did these people not see how many nations we destroyed before them, which are not going to return to them.
Then one day, all of them will be presented to Us.
For them one of Our signs is that dead earth, which We brought to life again, and grow seeds in them which they are eating.
In this land We created gardens of Palms and grapes and gushing springs.
So they eat the fruits, whereas it is not the work of their hands, then why do not they thank Us.
Pure and Self-Sufficient is that Lord who created all the pairs which grow on earth; and from their souls and from the things of which they do not have any knowledge.
And for them night is a sign from which We pull out the day and they all go in darkness.
