And the sun is running on its center point, this movement is established by the Mighty and Knowledgeable Allah.
And for the moon also We have appointed stages, so much so that at the end it becomes like a dry branch of a Palm tree.
It is not possible for the sun to catch the moon, neither is it possible for the night to go beyond the day, and they are all floating in the sky and in orbit.
And for them this is also a sign that we carried their elders in the laden ship.
Like ship created many things on which they mount.
If We wish We may drown them all, there will not be any helper for them nor they can be rescued.
But only with our Mercy, and We allow them to take rest for a period.
And when they are told to fear this punishment, which can come from front or from behind, perhaps Mercy be shown on you.
So for them no signs come from the signs of Allah that they get aside from it.

And when it is told to spend in His way from whatever sustenance is given by your Lord, then infidels say as a taunt that why we should feed them, if Allah pleased, He would have fed them Himself, you are in manifest misguidance.
Then they say: when this promise of the Day of Judgement will be completed; if you are truthful in your promise.
In fact they are just waiting for a mighty blast which will seize them; and they will be quarrelling among themselves.
Then no one will be able to make a will; nor shall they be able to return to their families.
And when the trumpet will be blown then everyone will rise from their graves and move towards their Lord.
Will say: who raised us from our sleeping place, Verily this is the thing which Allah has promised, and His messengers had said the truth.
Day of the Judgement is a mighty blast, thereafter everyone will be brought in Our Presence.
Then on this day no unjust will be done to any soul, and you will be given the reward as you had done the deeds.
Verily, people of Paradise shall be enjoying in the different activities.
They and their wives shall be sitting in the shade of the Paradise, reclining with cushions on thrones.
There will be fresh fruits for them and any other things which they would wish.
The only word from their Merciful Lord will be: Peace.
And O guilty! Get separated from them.
And O children of Adam, had not we taken covenant from you that not to worship Satan, he is your manifest enemy.
And worship Me only, this is the straight path.
This Satan has misguided many of your generations, so will you also not use wisdom?
This is Hell which was being promised to you in the world.
Go in it today, you have been practicing infidelity.
Today We will seal their mouth, their hands will speak, and their legs will testify, that what deeds they had been doing.
And if We please, We would put out their eyes, then they will run about but how would they see?
And if we please, We distort them totally, after that they neither be able to move ahead nor retreat.
And to whoever We give long life, in creation we reduce him to an abject state of childhood, so don't these people understand?
And We have not taught our Prophet the poetry, and neither poetry is suitable for him, this is an admonition, open and bright Quran.
That you warn the living persons from the punishment of Allah, and argument is completed on the infidels.
Did not they see that for their benefit We created cattle with power of Our Hand, now they are called their masters.
Then We made the animals submissive to them, so they use some of them for riding and eat some of them.
And there are many advantages in the animals for them and things for drinking also, then why don't they thank Allah?
These people left Allah and made other gods, perhaps they may be helped.
However, they do not have the power to help them, and they are such an army that they themselves will also be presented before the Lord.
Therefore, O Prophet! Don't be sad with their talk, We know whatever they are expressing.
Didn't the humans see that We created them with sperm, and suddenly they become Our manifest enemies.
And describes likeness for Us, and has forgotten his creation and they say: who can bring to life again these decayed bones.
Say: who has created you for the first time, He will bring to life again, and He knows better all the creations.
He made fire from a green tree for you, so you have been lighting the fire.
So does not He Who created the skies and the earth be able to create the like of them; Verily, He can, he is the Best creator and the Knower.
And his command is only that when he intends to do anything He just say: Be and it becomes.
So, pure and Self-Sufficient is that Allah whose Hands possess all the power, and you all will be returned and taken to His Presence.
By those who range themselves in ranks.
Then by those who warn them from evil.
Then by those who recite the Quran.
Verily, your Lord is One.
He is Lord of everything, whatever is between the skies and the earth, and master of every East.
Verily We adorned the sky of earth with stars.
And made them secure against every transgressor Satan.
Now Satans cannot try to hear anything from the higher world, and they will be killed from everywhere.
To drive them off; and perpetual punishment for them.
Except if anybody snatches off something, then an amber of flaring fire follows them.
Now ask them that they are the difficult creatures whom We have created, We have created them from sticky clay.
Whereas you are surprised, and they mock you.
And when admonition is done (they) do not accept.
And when they see any sign, make a mockery of it.
And they say this is an open magic.
When we die and become dust and bones, will we be raised again?
Will our forefathers also be brought to life?
Say: Verily you shall be humiliated.
This Day of Judgement is just a challenge, after they shall all see.
And they will say: Alas! This is the Day of Judgement.
This is that result which you had been denying.
Angels! Gather the unjust and their companions and to those whom they had been worshipping leaving Allah.
And to all their gods and (also) to them, show the way to Hell.
And stop them, they shall be questioned.
Now what has happened to you, why don't you help each other?
Whereas, today everyone has bowed down his head.
And they are questioning looking at each other.
Saying: you used to come from our right side.
They will say: you were not going to believe.
And we did not had any command over you, you yourselves were a transgressing nation.
Now Allah's punishment has proved on us, and will have to taste it.
What! we misguided you; you were misguided yourselves.
So they shall equally share the punishment today.
And we deal like this with the guilty ones.
They used to behave proudly, when it is said there is no god but Allah.
And used to say, shall we leave our gods because of a mad poet?
However, he had brought the Truth, and was confirming all the messengers.
Verily, you are going to taste the painful punishment.
And you will be given the recompense according to your deeds.
Except sincere servants of Allah.
For them is the certain sustenance.
There are fruits and they will live in a dignified manner.
in the Paradises full of blessings.
They will be sitting on the thrones facing each other.
There will be neat and clean beverages around them.
Beverage of white color which the drinkers will enjoy.
From it there won't be any headache or loss of consciousness.
With them will be big-eyed Hooris restraining their glances.
Their color will be like hidden eggs.
Then they will ask while facing each other.
Then one of them will say there was a companion in the world.
He used to say: do you also confirm the Day of Judgement?
When we will die and become dust and bones, will we be recompensed for our deeds?
Will you also see this?
After saying this when they saw, they saw him in the middle of Hell.
By God, it was near that you destroyed us.
If it was not the favour of Allah then I would also be present there.
Is it not true that we are not going to die now.
Except for the first death, there is no punishment for us now.
Verily this is a big success.
For this day the acts should be done by the act doers.
Just say, for hospitality it is better or the Zaqqum tree?
Which I have made certain for testing of the unjust.
This is a tree which comes out from the bottom of Hell.
Its produce is as ugly as heads of Satans.
But people of Hell will eat and fill their bellies with it.
Then there is hot water to drink, which will be mixed with pus, etc.
Then their final outcome will be Hell.
They had found their forefathers misguided.
So they followed their footsteps.
And Verily, earlier a big group of their elders have gone strayed.
And We have sent messengers who warned them.
Now see- what happens to those who are warned but they do not obey.
Except those who are sincere servants of Allah.
And Verily, Nooh called upon us, and We are the best Acceptor.
We delivered him and his family from a great difficulty.
And We made their children the survivors.
And We let remain their mention, in the coming generations.
Our salutation to Nooh in all divinity.
Like this We recompense the good doers.
He was from our believing servants.
Then We drowned them all.
And Verily Ibrahim was also the follower of Nooh.
When he came to the Presence of Allah with courteous heart.
When he told his father and his nation to worship Allah.
Are you seeking self-made gods leaving Allah?
Then what is your opinion about the Lord of the Worlds?
Then Ibrahim gave a glance to the stars.
And said, I am sick.
So they turned their faces and left.
And Ibrahim turned to their gods and said why don't you eat something?
What has happened to you, why don't you speak?
Then he started breaking them.
Then they come running to Ibrahim.
So Ibrahim said, do you worship the idols crafted by your own hands?
Whereas Allah has created you all.
They said, make a house, light the fire and throw him in the fire.
They wanted to do plotting, but We degraded and disgraced them.
Ibrahim said, I am going towards my Lord, he will send guidance to me.
O Lord, give me a righteous son.
Then We gave him glad tidings of a righteous son.

When the son reached the age and was able to run about, he told him, son I saw a dream that I am slaughtering you, now say what is your opinion, he said O father, follow, whatever you are commanded; Allah willing, you will find me among the patient ones.
When both of them accepted; then the father made the son lie down upon his forehead.
We called out: O Ibrahim!
You made your dream come true, We reward like this for the good doers.
Verily, it is a very big manifest trial.
And We have changed it with the Great Sacrifice.
And reminder of this will remain till the last era.
Salutation to Ibrahim.
Like this We reward doers of the good deeds.
Verily, Ibrahim was among our believing servants.
And We gave him glad tidings of Ishaq, who was a prophet and was among good servants.
And We sent blessing on him and on Is’haq, and among his children some of them are of good character, and some are those who are openly unjust to their souls.
And We showed favours on Moosa and Haroon also.
And delivered them and their nations from great difficulty.
And helped them, so they became among those who gained dominance.
We gave them the book of manifest meanings.
And have guided both of them towards the straight path.
And kept their remembrance also in their forthcoming generations.
Salutations to Moosa and Haroon.
Like this We reward the people who do good deeds.
Verily, those two were among our believing servants.
And Verily Ilyas was also among the messengers.
When he said to his nation, why do you not fear Allah?
Do you call out to Baol, leaving the best Creator?
Whereas Allah is your and your forefathers' Lord.
Then they denied prophets, so they will all be overtaken by Hell.
Except for sincere servants of Allah.
And We also kept their remembrance in the future generations.
Salutation on Children of Yaseen (Aal-e-Yaseen).
Like this we reward the doers of the good deeds.
Verily they were among Our believing servants.
And Lut were Verily was among the messengers.
Then We delivered him and his household.
Except for his wife who remained among the people who stayed behind.
Then We destroyed them all.
You regularly pass by them during the morning.
And at the night time also, so don’t you understand.
And Verily Yunus was also among the messengers.
When he ran towards a loaded ship.
And people of the ship drew his name and he was embarrassed.
Then fish swallowed him, when he was blaming on his own soul.
If he would not be among the glorifying.
Then he would have remained in the belly (of fish) till the Day of Judgement.
Then We put him on ground when he was sick also.
And caused to grow a pumpkin tree for him.
And sent him as messenger towards over a lakh or more people.
They believed and We also gave him rest till a certain period.
Then O Prophet, ask these infidels: do your Lord have girls and you have boys?
Or We have created angels as girls and are they witness to it?
Be aware, this is their own forging.
That son has born to Allah, they are all liars.
That He has selected daughters in place of sons.
What has happened you, what you are deciding?
Don't you ponder over it?
Or you have more explicit argument?
Then bring your book, if you are truthful.
They have made a relation between Allah and the jinns, whereas jinns know that they will also be presented before Allah.
Allah is higher and purer than all these talks.
Except for the sincere servants of Allah.
Then you and whom you worship.
All of them together cannot misguide (anyone) against Him.
Except those who eventually have to go to Hell.
And for every one of us a place is certain.
And We are all going to be lined up in His Presence.
And we are all those who glorify Him.
Whereas these people used to say this.
Had we a reminder from those of earlier ones.
Then we also would have been good and sincere servants.
They adopted infidelity, shortly they will come to know of its result.
And we had already decided with our servants, the prophets.
Their will Verily be helped.
And Our army is Verily going to dominate.
Therefore, you turn your face aside from them for some days.
Keep looking at them, soon they will see their result themselves.
Are they hastening for Our punishment?
When the punishment will come in their courtyard, that will be the worst morning for the nation which was warned.
You turn your face aside from them for some days.
And keep looking, shortly they will see themselves.
Your Lord is honourable, and is purer than this talk.
Our salutations to the messengers.
All praises be to Allah, for the Lord of the Worlds.
Saad, by the Quran, full of admonition.
Fact is that infidels are in proud and in disagreement.
We have destroyed many generations before them, then they pleaded but no respite was possible.
And they are surprised, how a warner has come among them; and infidels clearly said this is a magician and a liar.
Has he merged many gods and made one god, this is very surprising.
And one group said this and walked away: be on your own gods, some other thing is found in it.
We did not hear this among earlier generations, it looks as if it has been forged.
Among us only the book has been revealed to him; fact is that they have doubt in Our book, or rather they have not tasted Our punishment yet.
Do they have any treasure from your honorable Allah, the Mighty, the Great Giver.
Or they have an option between sky and the earth that they climb the sky with a ladder.
Of all the groups, one group is going to be defeated here also.
The people of Nuh and Aad, and Firaun, the lord of spikes, have all passed by.
And Samood, people of Lut and people of forest, they have all passed by.
All of them denied the prophets, so Our punishment was proven on them.
They are just waiting for a mighty blast and they shall not be given even a little respite.
And they say: O Lord whatever you have written in our fate give us before the day of accounting.
Be patient in their talk, and remember Our servant Dawood, who was very powerful and was oft-returning in Our Presence.
We made mountains subservient to him, that they may glorify Allah with him in the morning and in the evening.
We made to gather birds around him, they were all his subservient.
And We made his kingdom stronger, and gave him wisdom, and knowledge to make clear judgement.
Did you get the news of those who were quarrelling, who entered by jumping the wall of arch.

When they came in front of Dawood, he felt frightened, they said do not be frightened we are two litigants, one has been unjust towards the other, you decide with truth and do not do injustice, and guide us to the straight path.
This is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one; he is saying give that also to me, and he is being difficult in it.

Dawood said: he has been unjust to you by demanding your ewe; and there are many partners who are unjust to each other, except those who are believers and do good deeds, and such people are few; Dawood thought that Allah had tested him, so he repented from Allah and fell in prostration, and turn his attention totally towards Us.
{Prostrate Non-Obligatory} So we forgive him, he has nearness to Us and an excellent return.

O Dawood! We made you Our vicegerent on the earth, so you do justice among people with truth, and do not follow the desires which deviate you from the path of Allah; Verily those who deviate from the path of Allah, there is severe punishment for them that they have underestimated the Day of Account totally.
We have not created skies and the earth and things between them worthless, this is the thinking of infidels, then woe to the infidels on account of the fire.
Shall We declare those who believed and did good work and those who create mischief on earth as one; or (shall We) declare the pious people as mischief makers and transgressors?
This is a blessed book which We have revealed towards you, so that people ponder over its verses and knowledgeable persons may take admonition from it.
And We gave to Dawood a son like Suleiman, who is the best servant, and who turns to Us.
When in the evening horses of the highest breed were presented to him.
So, he said: I prefer the good remembrance of Allah, and horses vanished from his eyes while running.
He said: bring them back to me, and he started pressing his hand over their calves and necks.
Then We tested Suleiman, We put a lifeless body on his throne, then he turned to Allah.
And said: O Lord forgive me, and grant me a kingdom which no one else is worthy of after me, and you are the best giver.
Then We made winds subservient to him, and made it his command to run gently wherever he desired.
And all the masons and divers among Satans were made subservient to him.
And to Satans also were tied up in chains due to their transgression.
This is Our bestowing, either give it to people or keep it with you.
And for him is the nearness in Our Presence, and the best recompense.
And remember Our servant Ayub, when he called out to his Lord that Satan has troubled him a lot.
So We said: rub the legs on the ground, then you will see cold water for bathing and drinking.
Then We bestowed him his family and similarly gave him more, this is Our Mercy for the people who take lesson and admonition.
And, O Ayub, take little grass and strike it, and do not do contrary to the oath; We found Ayub full of patience and best of the servants, who turns to Us.
And O Prophet! Mention Our servants Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqoob, who were strong and had insight.
We distinguished him for his attribute of remembrance of the Day of Judgement.
He was chosen one near Us; and among the good servants.
And remember Ismail, Al-Yasa and Zulkafil, they were all Our good servants.
This is an admonition and the best return for the pious ones.
Paradises of Eternity, doors will be open for them.
They will be resting there with cushions, and they will demand different fruits and beverages.
There shall be wives beside them with the equal age with restrained eyes.
These are things which are promised to you for the Day of Judgement.
This is Our sustenance which will never end.
This on one side, and for transgressors there is worst return.
Hell, where they will enter, and this the worst abode.
This is the punishment which they will taste, hot water and pus.
And many other such things also.
This is your army which will be pushed into Hell with you, Allah may not do any good to them, they are all going to burn in Hell.
Then their followers will say to their leaders: may no good be done to you, you made available this punishment for us, therefore, this is the worst abode.
Then will say more: O Lord, who have propped us ahead, make their punishment double in Hell.
Then they will say to themselves: what is the matter with us, we don't see them whom we had counted among the mischievous ones.
We had unjustly mocked at them, or our eyes have turned away from them.
This quarrelling among the Hellish people is a sure thing.
(O Prophet) Say: I am just a warner, and there is no god except Allah, the One, the Dominant.
He is the Lord of the skies and the earth and all the creatures in between them, and He is Honorable and very Forgiving.
Say: This Quran is an great news.
From which you have turned away.
What do I know what matter is discussed in High Place.
Only revelation comes to me; I am a man who explicitly warns you from the punishment of Allah.
Remind them that when your Lord said to the angels: I am going to create a mortal from the wet clay.
When it is completed and I breathe my spirit in it then you all fall down in prostration.
Then all angels prostrated.
Except Iblis; he showed proud and become among the infidels.
So Allah said: O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating before him, I have made him from the power of my hands, you showed haughtiness, you Verily are from the higher ones.
He said: I am better than him, you created me out of fire and created him from dust.
Said Allah: Get out from here, you are rejected.
And Verily you are accursed by Me, until the Day of Judgement.
He said: my Lord give me respite until the Day of Judgement.
Said Allah: you are given respite.
But until a certain time.
He said: by your Honor, I will misguide everyone.
Except those of Your servants whom you have made pure.
Said Allah: So this is the Truth, and I always say the Truth.
That I will fill Hell with you and your followers.
And O Prophet! Say: I do not want reward for my preaching, nor am I a pretender or a false teller.
This Quran is an admonition for the worlds.
And after some days you will all know its reality.
This Book has been revealed by Allah, the Honorable, the Wise.
We have revealed this Book towards you with the Truth, and you worship Allah with all sincerity.

Be aware that sincere worshipping is for Allah only; who have made other guardians by saying that their worship will bring us closer to Allah; Allah will decide between them in case of dispute; that Allah does not guide liar and thankless people.
If He wanted to make His sons, then He could have chosen anyone among His creatures; He is Pure and Self-Sufficient, He is the Only One Allah, the Subduer.

He has created skies and the earth with the Truth, He makes the night wrap over the day and makes the day wrap over the night, and He has made subservient to Sun and Moon, they will all keep moving until an appointed period, be aware that He is Predominant on all and very Forgiving.

He has created you from one soul, then made pairs from it, and sent eight types of cattle; He takes you through different stages in the womb of your mothers, this is all done in triple darkness, that Allah is your Lord who has power over the Kingdom, there is no god but Him, then where you are turning away.

Even if you become infidel, Allah is Self-Sufficient from you, and He does not like infidelity for His servants, He likes if you are thankful to Him, and no one will carry the burden of sins of others; thereafter you will all be returned to your Lord; then He will inform you what you had been doing in the world; He is also aware of the secrets hidden in the hearts.

And when man is afflicted then he calls out to the Lord with full attention, and when He gives any blessings, then he totally forgets for what he has called upon Him, and makes associates for Allah that he may cause them to deviate from the path, then say: enjoy for some days in infidelity, thereafter you Verily are among the Hellish people.

What! that person who prostrates during the night, and worships Allah while standing, and has fear for the Hereafter, and is hopeful of Mercy of his Lord; say: those who know, and those who do not know can be same? Only knowledgeable persons take the admonition from this.
Say: O my believing servants! Fear your Lord; there is good (in the Hereafter) for them who do good in this world, and Allah's land is very vast; the uncountable reward is only for the patient ones.
Say: I have been commanded that I should be sincere to Allah and worship him with total sincerity.
And I have been commanded that I shall be the first obedient.
Say: if I indulge in sin then I fear the punishment of the difficult day.
Say: I only worship Allah, and I am sincere in my worshipping.
Now worship whoever you want, say: The losers Verily are those who shall have kept themselves and their families in loss on the Day of Judgement; be aware this is the clear loss.
Upon them will be the covering of Hellfire and below the bedding of fire, these are the talks by which Allah warns His servants, so O My servants, fear Me.
Whoever separated from the unjust that they don't worship and turned to Allah, for them is glad tidings from Us, therefore, O Prophet! Give glad tidings to my servants.
Whoever listens to the talk and follows the good talk, these are the people whom Allah has guided, and these are the people who have knowledge.
What! on whom punishment is proven, and whoever has gone to Hell, can you take him out.

Those who created fear of their Lord, for them are (spacious) rooms in the Paradise, and there are more rooms beneath which rivers will be flowing, this is the promise of Allah, and Allah does not go back on His promise.

Did not you see that Allah sent the water from sky, then flown it into the different rivers, then made colourful farming from it, then it withers and becomes yellow, He makes it into husk; most Verily there is admonition in this for those who understand.

What! A person whose heart Allah has made spacious for Islam, and he has light from his Lord, can be same as the misguided ones, alas, on the condition of those heart have become hardened for remembrance of Allah, so they are in open misguidance.

Allah has revealed the best words in the form of a Book, whose verses are similar to each other, and have been repeated, that their hairs are raised who have fear of Allah, then their bodies and hearts become soft for remembrance of Allah, this is the real guidance of Allah, He gives to whoever He pleases; and to whoever He leaves in misguidance, nobody can guide him.

What! the person who will try to save severe punishment from his face on the day of judgement, can be alike to who has been delivered, and it will be said to the unjust to taste the punishment of your own deeds.
People earlier than these infidels have also denied the prophets, so punishment came to them in such a way that they couldn't understood.
Then Allah made them taste the disgrace in the world, and punishment of the Hereafter is very severe; if they can understand.
And We have described all types of examples for the people in this Quran, perhaps they might get lessons or admonition from this.
This Quran is in Arabic language, in which there is no crookedness, perhaps they might become pious like this.

Allah sets an example: There is a slave in whom there are several partners differing with one another; and there is another slave wholly owned by one man. Are conditions of the two alike? All praise is due to Allah but most of them do not know.
O Prophet! Death will come to you also, all of them are going to die.
Thereafter you will all present your dispute in the Presence of Allah on the Day of Judgement.
Who can be more unjust than who slander on Allah and after advent of truth deny it, so is Hell not the abode of infidels?
Who has brought the message of truth, and who confirms it, in fact they are pious people who guard against evil.
For them everything is there with the Lord whatever they wish, this is the recompense of the good deeds.
That Allah will do away with the evil which they have done, and give them the reward in a better way then what they have done.
Is Allah not enough for His servants? And these people frighten you from others than Him, although, nobody can guide him to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance.
And to whoever Allah guides, there is no one who can misguide him, is Allah not all Mighty and an Avenger?

And if you will ask them who have created skies and the earth, they will reply: Allah, so say: have you seen their condition whom you worship, that if Allah wish to cause harm, can they stop that harm, or if He desire to show Mercy, who can withhold Him; say: my Allah is sufficient for me; and those who are reliant, rely on Him.
And say: O nation you do your deeds accordingly, I am doing my deeds, after that you will come to know the condition of all.
And that onto whom will come the disgraceful punishment and on whom the everlasting punishment comes.

We have revealed this Book to you with the Truth for guidance of the people, whoever will take guidance will be for his own benefit, and who will go astray will harm himself; and you are not responsible for them.

That is Allah who calls towards Him the spirits at the time of death, and those who do not die also calls their spirits to Him when they are asleep, and then if He decides anybody's death He withheld that spirit with Him, and releases all other spirits until a certain period, there are many signs in this for the people who ponder.
Have they found the intercessors besides Allah, Say: even though they did not ever have control over anything, nor do they understand.
Say: authority of intercession is in Allah's hands only, He has the kingdom of the earth and the skies, and after that you all will be returned to His Presence.
When the remembrance of One and Only Allah comes before them, those who do not believe in the Hereafter their hearts are disgusted, and if anybody else is remembered they become happy.
Now say: O Lord, Creator of the earth and the skies, knower of the seen and unseen, You only can judge the matter among them in which they dispute.

And if these unjust get all the wealth of the world, and they get similarly this much more, and they give all this in lieu of punishment on the Day of Judgement, but whatever is from Allah for them will Verily come true; which they do not even think of.
All their bad deeds will become clear on them, and that very thing will encircle them of which they had been making fun of.

And when any difficulty afflicts humans he calls to Us, and when We give any blessing to him, he says it has been given to me because of my knowledge, whereas this is only a trial; and most of them are unaware of this.
People earlier than them also had said the same thing; it was not of any use to them which they were acquiring.
Whereas the effects of their bad deeds have reached them; and among infidels also who are unjust their effect will verily reach them, and they cannot humble Allah.
Do they not know that it is Allah who expands the sustenance of whoever He pleases, and straitens the sustenance of whoever He pleases, in these affairs many signs are found for the believers.

O Prophet! Reach the message that O my servants, those who have done excesses on their souls should not be disappointed from the Mercy of Allah; Allah is Forgiver of all the sins, and indeed He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
You all turn towards your Lord, and be entirely submissive to Him, before any punishment comes to you, then you cannot be helped.
And follow the best system which has been revealed from your Lord, before that any punishment comes to you suddenly, and you could not understand.
Then among you any soul says, alas! I showed laziness towards Allah, and I was among those who made fun of it.
Or he may say if Allah has guided me he would also have been pious.
Or after seeing the punishment he may say, if I get a chance to go back again, I would also be among the good character ones.
Yes, yes My verses come to you but you denied them, and behaved with pride, and became infidel.
And you will see on the Day of Judgement, whoever slander Allah, their faces will be black, and is Hell not the abode of those who show pride?
And Allah will deliver the pious people because of their success that no evil will touch them, and neither they will have any kind of sadness.
Allah is the Creator of everything, and He is the guardian of everything.
With Him are all the keys of earth and skies, and whoever denies His verses are going to be in loss.
Say: O ignorant, are you commanding me to worship others than Allah.
And Verily, We sent revelation to you and to the people earlier than you that if you will adopt polytheism all your deeds will go waste, and your counting will be among those who are the losers.
Worship only Allah, and become His thankful servant.

Verily, they did not value Allah, on the Day of Judgement all the earth will be in His fist, and skies will be wrapped upon His hands; He is Pure and Self-Sufficient, He is much higher than what they associate with Him.

And when trumpet will be blown then all the creatures of earth and the skies will fell unconscious, except to those whom Allah will save, after that when trumpet will be blown once again everyone will stand up and start looking.

And earth will shine with the Light of Allah, and records of deeds will be kept, and messengers and martyrs will be brought; and judgement will be made among them with the Truth, and no unjust will be done on anyone.
Then every soul will be recompensed fully for their deeds, and He is completely aware of everyone's deeds.

Those who had adopted infidelity will be driven away in groups towards Hell until they reach in front of it, then its doors will be opened, its custodian will say did not any prophet came to you who would recite the divine verses to you and warn you from the meeting of today, so all of them will say Verily prophets have come, but sentence of punishment has been proven for the infidels.
Then it will be said: enter into Hell from the gate and remain there forever that this is the worst abode for the proud people.

And those who adopted piousness of Allah, they will be taken towards Paradise in groups, when they will reach near it, its doors will be opened, its custodians will say: Salutations, you are pure, so enter the everlasting Paradise.

And will say: thanks to Allah that he has made his promise come true, and made us inherit His land, that we can rest in Paradise wherever we wish, and Verily this is the best reward for those who have done (good) deeds.

And you will see that angels have surrounded the Throne of Allah and they are glorifying Him; and judgement will be done justly among the people, and verdict shall be given between them with justice, and everywhere there will be one sound: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Ha Meem
This Book has been revealed by Mighty and Knowledgeable Allah.
He is Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repentance, giver of severe punishment, and owner of Mercy and Blessings, there is no god except Him; everyone must return towards Him.
Only those who dispute the signs of Allah are infidels, hence, their roaming in the towns may not deceive you.

Before them, the nation of Nooh and the groups after them denied the prophets; and every nation thought about the prophets to arrest them; and took the help of falsehood and wanted to uproot the Truth, then We also arrested them; and you saw how Our punishment was.
Like this the punishment of your Lord has been proven for the infidels that they are going to Hell.

Those angels who are holding the Divine Throne and those who are surrounding them are all glorifying Allah, and believe on Him only, and are seeking forgiveness for the believers; O Lord, Your Mercy and Knowledge have encompassed all things, therefore forgive them who seek repentance and follow Your path, and save them from punishment of Hell.
O Lord! make them enter the everlasting Gardens which You have promised to them and to their fathers and their wives and their offspring those who do good, Verily You are Predominant and Wise.
And save them from evil deeds, and whom You save from evil deeds this day, indeed You did (shower) Mercy on them, and that is the big achievement.

Verily those who adopted infidelity they shall be called on the Day of Judgement and told: the way you are disgusted from your souls Allah's displeasure is greater than that; you had been invited towards faith, but you adopted infidelity.
They will say O Lord you gave us death two times and life two times, now we have accepted our sins, now is there any way to get rid of it?

This is because when the One and Only Allah's name was mentioned you adopted infidelity, when polytheism was mentioned, you accepted it immediately, now the judgement is in the Hands of Allah, the Great.
That is He, Who shows you His signs, and sends sustenance to you from the sky, only he takes the admonition from this who turns to Him.
Therefore, you call out to Allah with pure worshipping no matter how distasteful infidels may feel.
That Allah is the owner of Lofty Place and the Throne and sends revelation on whoever He pleases among his servants, that he may warn the people from Day of the Meeting.
When everyone will come forth and nothing will be hidden from Allah, today's kingdom is whose? Kingdom is of Allah, the One, the Subduer.
Every soul will be given his recompense, today there won't be any unjust done on anyone; Verily, Allah is the one who takes the account swiftly.
And O Prophet, warn them about oncoming of the punishment, when heart will come to the mouth due to suffocation, and for unjust there won't be any friend or intercessor who will be heard.
Allah also knows the betrayal of eyes, and also knows the secrets hidden in the hearts.
He judges with the Truth, and they cannot even judge whom they worship leaving Allah, indeed Allah hears and sees everything.

Did not they travel in the land that they could see what had happened to the earlier people who were more powerful and influential than them, then Allah overtook them due to their sins, and there was no one who could save them against Allah.
This happened because prophets have come to them with explicit signs but they denied them, then Allah also overtook them; He is very powerful and giver of severe punishment.
We have sent Moosa with Our signs and clear arguments.
Towards Firaun, Hamaan and Qaroon, they all said he is a magician and a liar.
So when they come from Us with the truth, they said whoever follow them, kill their boys and keep their girls alive; and planning of the infidels are Verily going to be strayed.
Firaun said leave me I will kill Moosa and he call his Lord, I am afraid that he may not change your religion and may not create mischief on the land.
Moosa said: I am seeking refuge from your Lord and my Lord against all the proud people who do not have faith on the Day of Accounting.

And one person who was hiding his faith among the people of Firaun said: you are killing somebody just because he is saying his Lord is Allah and have also brought clear arguments from your Lord, and if he is a liar, he is responsible for it, and if what he is saying is truth then from what he is warning that difficulties may afflict you, Verily Allah does not guide anyone who do excesses and is a liar.

O my nation Verily today you have kingdom and domination in the land, but if punishment of Allah comes, I am telling you the things which I understand and I am not guiding you to any other way except the way of wisdom.
And the person who was the believer said: I fear the day of punishment for you which was the day of punishment for other nations.
Nation of Nooh, nation of Aad, nation of Samood and condition of later ones, indeed Allah does not want to be unjust on His servants.
And O my people, I fear for you for the Day of Judgement.
That day when all of you will turn and run away, no one will be there to save you against Allah; to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance no one can guide him.

And before this Yusuf also came to you, and you were in doubt about his message, and when he left the world, you said Allah did not send any prophet after him; like this Allah leaves in misguidance to those who do excesses and doubt.

Those who argue in verses of Allah without having any proof from Him, they are worthy of hate near Allah and the believers; and like this Allah seals the hearts of every person who does excesses and is proud.
And Firaun said: O Hamaan build for me a fort that I may attain the means of access.

From the ways in the sky I may see the Lord of Moosa, I think Moosa is a liar and there is no Allah, and like this Firaun's bad deeds were decorated and he was stopped from his way, and result of plotting of Firaun was nothing but destruction.
And that person who had believed said: O my people follow me, I will show you the way of guidance.
O people of the nation, remember the enjoyment of the worldly life is for some days, and everlasting abode is the Hereafter.

Whoever will commit evil will be recompensed, and whoever will do good deeds whether men or women provided they are believing, shall be entered into Paradise, and there they will get the unaccountable sustenance.
O people of my nation, what has happened to you, I am inviting you towards deliverance and you are inviting me towards Hell.
Your invitation is that I may deny Allah, and I make His associates whom I do not know; and I am inviting you towards the Allah who is Mighty and very Forgiving.
Verily you are inviting me towards that who is neither worthy of calling upon in the world nor in the Hereafter, our return is all towards Allah, and who do excesses are Hellish people.
Then shortly you will remember that what I am telling you, I am referring all my affairs to Allah, indeed He is aware of the condition of all his servants.
So, Allah delivered that believing persons from the harm of plotting of the people; and severe punishment overtook the people of Firaun.
They are presented before the Hell every morning and evening, when Day of Judgement will be established then angels will be commanded to put them in the worst stage of punishment in Hell.

And think of the time when they will fight in Hell, and weak people will say to the haughty people that we were following you, so can you save us from some part of Hell, and can you be of any use to us.
So haughty people will say now abode of all of us is this only, Allah has already decided among His servants.
Thereafter Hellish people will say to its custodians: pray to the Lord that even for a day Allah may lighten our punishment.

They will reply: did not prophets come to you with the manifest signs; they will say: Verily, they came; then they will get the reply: so call upon (them) yourselves; whereas calling and pleading of the infidels will go waste.
Verily, We do help the prophets and the believers in the world, and that day also will help them when all the witnesses will be gathered.
That day when no excuse will be of any use for the unjust, and there will be curse and worst abode for them.
And Verily, we did guide Moosa, and made Bani Israel inherit the book.
That book is entirely guidance, and a matter of admonition for the wise people.
Therefore, be patient, the promise of Allah is the Truth, and seek forgiveness for yourself, and keep praising your Lord morning and evening.

And Verily those who dispute in the signs of Allah without any argument that have come to them, there is naught in their breasts but a desire to become great which they shall never attain; therefore, seek refuge in Allah, Verily, He is all Hearing and Seeing.
Verily, creating the earth and the skies is a bigger task than creating human beings, but the majority of people do not know this.
And remember, blind and the seeing ones cannot be the same; those who believed and did good works cannot be like wicked people; but you people take very less admonition.
Verily, Day of Judgement is going to come, and there is no doubt that majority of people do not believe on it.
And your Lord says: supplicate from Me and I will accept it, and Verily those who are arrogant from Our worship, shortly they will enter Hell with disgrace.

That is Allah who has created night for you so you take rest, and made day a source of light, indeed He shows lots of grace and blessings on His servants, but majority of them are not thankful to Him.
That is your Lord who has created everything, there is no god except Him, then where are you turning away?
Like this they are misguided who deny Allah's signs.
That is Allah who established the earth for you and the sky a canopy and created you with the best face, and gave you pure sustenance, that is your blessed Allah who is the Lord of the worlds.
He is Ever Living, there is no god but He, therefore worship Him with sincere religion, and all the praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
Say: I have been barred from worshipping to those whom you worship leaving Allah; whereas I have received the manifest signs, and I have been commanded that I remain an obedient servant of Allah.

That is Allah who created you from dust, then with sperm, then from the frozen blood, then made you a child and brought you out, then keeps you alive that you reach the strength, then become old; some of you are called back (even) before that, and keeps you alive that you reach the appointed period; and that you might understand.
That is He; Who gives life and also death, when He decides to do something, He says: Be, and it becomes.
Did not you see those who quarrel about the verses of Allah, after that to where they are straying?
Those who denied the Book and other things which We have sent through the Prophet, shortly they will come to know of its result.
When shackles and chains will be put in their necks and they will be dragged.
In the hot water, after that they will be thrown in to Hell.
Then it will be said: where are those whom you had made associate (with Allah).
Besides Allah; so they will reply: they have vanished leaving us (here), but we were not calling upon anyone, and like this Allah leaves infidels in misguidance.
This is the result of because on the earth you were happy with the falsehood and walked about with pride.
Now enter from the gates of Hell, and always live there, the abode of arrogant people is very bad.

Now you have patience, the promise of Allah is truthful, so We will show you some of the things of which we are threatening, or will call you back before that, even then they will be brought back here only.

And We have sent many prophets before you of which some of them were mentioned to you, and some of them were not even mentioned to you; and no prophet has the ability that he can bring the miracle without the permission of Allah; when the time came then it was decided with the Truth, and then people of falsehood were in loss.
That is Allah who has created cattle for you, of which some of them you ride upon and some of them you use for eating.
For you there are many benefits in it, that you may get your desires through them, and you ride upon these animals and (also on) ships.
And Allah shows you his signs, so which of His signs will you deny?

Did not they travel in the land that they see what We have done to the earlier people who were more in numbers in their comparison and more powerful and also had influence in the land, but whatever they earned did not benefit them and they suffered the punishment.
When the prophets brought the miracles, they showed arrogance because of their knowledge, and as a result they were beset by what they were mocking at.
Then, when they saw Our punishment, they said: we believe in the One Allah, and are denying what we used to associate with Him.
So believing after seeing the punishment will not help, this is the constant method of Allah, which has passed by with regards to His servants, and at that time infidels suffer the loss.
Ha Meem
This is the revelation of Allah, the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
Verses of this Book have been described in detail; in Arabic language for the people who understand.
This Quran has been revealed as to give glad tidings and to warn the people, but the majority of people object to it and they are not ready to listen to anything.

And they say: our hearts are under the veil from the message which you are giving, there is deafness in our ears, and there is a veil between us and you, so you do your work and we are doing our work.
Say: I am also a mortal like you, but revelation comes to me on regularly that your Lord is One, therefore be persistent in the right path and seek forgiveness from Him, and woe to the polytheists.
Those who do not give poor-rate are the deniers of the Hereafter.
Verily those who believe and did good works for them is the recompense which will never be discontinued.
Say: are you denying the Lord which has created the earth in two days, and make associates for him Who is Lord of the worlds.
And established mountains on the earth, and has kept blessing, and made therein all provisions of livelihood in four days, which has equal share for all the seekers.
Then He turned towards the sky which was like smoke, and He commanded to earth whether willingly or unwillingly come to Us, so both said: we come obediently.

Then made seven skies among the skies in two days, and revealed to each sky about its affairs, and decorated sky of the world with the lamps, and made it secure, this is the decree of Mighty and Knowing Allah.
Still if they object then say, We warned you from the punishment of lightning as We have sent on the nations of Aad and Samood.
When Our messengers came from front and from behind that do not worship anyone except Allah, they said: if our Lord pleased, He could have sent angels, we are not going to accept your message.

Then nation of Aad unjustly showed proud in the land and said who is more powerful than us, so did not they see that Who has created everything is more powerful than them, but these people were denying the signs.
Then We sent strong winds on them on unlucky days, to taste them the disgraceful punishment in the world and punishment of the Hereafter is more disgraceful, and there they will not be helped also.

And We gave guidance to the nation of Samood also, but they preferred misguidance over guidance; so disgraceful punishment of lightning overtook them; as recompense of the deeds which they were doing.
We delivered them who believed and were pious.
The day when enemies of Allah will be sent to Hell that day they will be tortured and reprimanded.
When they will all come near Hell, then their ears, their eyes, and their skin will testify against their deeds.

They will say to their body parts how you have testified against us, they will say: Allah made us speak Who have given speaking power to everyone, and on the first day He has created you, and now also you will return to his Presence.
And you have not drawn any curtain that your ears, your eyes, your flesh, and skin does not testify against you, and you thought that they are not aware about many of your deeds.
And these your (evil) thought which you have made about Allah has destroyed you; and you are among the losers.
Now even if they tolerate their abode is Hell, and if they want to excuse, their excuse will not be accepted.

And We have provided them companions who had decorated their earlier deeds in their eyes, and on them also the punishment was proven as it had been proven on their earlier humans and jinns; they are all among the losers.
And infidels say do not listen to the Quran at all, and when it is recited make commotion, we might dominate them like this.
So now We will taste severe punishment to those who indulged in polytheism and shall give punishment to them for their deeds.
This Hell is the right punishment for the enemies of Allah in which their abode is forever, this is the punishment for they had denied the verses of Allah.
And the infidels will plead O Lord, who among the humans and jinns who had misguided us, so that we trample them beneath our feet, so that they are despised.

Verily, those who said Allah is our Lord and were steadfast on it, on them angels come with the message that do not fear and do not be sad, and be happy with this Paradise which is being promised to you.
We are with you; in life of this world and we are with you in the Hereafter, and in Paradise everything is available which your heart desires and which you will demand.
From the very Forgiving and Merciful Lord these are the provisions for your hospitality.
What else can be better that he invites towards Allah, and do good works also and say that I am from the obedient.
Good and evil cannot be the same, therefore do reply to the evil with good talk, in this way even those who have enmity can become warm friends.
And none can have this ability except those who are patient, and they get this thing who are very lucky.
Seek refuge from Allah if you get any whispering from Satan, He is all Hearing and Knowing.

And these signs of Allah are night and day, sun and the moon, therefore do not prostrate before sun and the Moon but prostrate before Allah who have created all this, if you are really worshipping Him.
{Prostrate, Obligatory} So let them show arrogance if they wish, who are in the presence of Allah glorify Him day and night and they never get tired.

This is among His signs that you see the earth plain and dead and when We send water it flourishes again, then you see growth in it. Verily, who brought earth to life, will bring alive the dead (humans) also, indeed He has power over everything.

Verily, those who make changes in our verses cannot hide from Us, think who is better, one who will be put into Hell or the one who will be fearless on the Day of Judgement; you do whatever you wish, Allah is watcher of all your deeds.
Verily, those who denied the Quran after its revelation their recompense is bad, this is Book of highest status.
Falsehood cannot come near it, in front or behind it, this Book has been revealed by the Wise and Praiseworthy Allah.
O Prophet, whatever is being said to you has been told to the prophets earlier than you (also), and your Lord is Forgiving and also the owner of the painful punishment.

And if We would have revealed Quran in non-Arabic language then they would have said why its verses are not clear, and what is the connection of non-Arabic book with the Arabs; say: this book is healing and guidance for the believers, and those who do not believe have deafness in their ears and they are not seeing also, and they will be called out from very far-off place.
And Verily, We gave the book to Moosa but they created a quarrel in it, and if it was not decided earlier, it would have been decided among them, they were in a very uneasy doubt.
Whoever will do good work will do it for oneself, and whoever will do evil will be responsible for it, and your Lord is not unjust on His servants.

To Him is the knowledge of the Day of Judgement; and fruits which come out of the covering or women who get pregnant or the children they bear, this is all according to His Knowledge, that day when He will call out: where are My partners? Polytheists will forcibly say: we have already said that we do not know them.
They will all vanish whom they used to call earlier, now they will realize that there is no escaping.
Man does not tire of praying for good, and when any trouble touches him he gets dejected and hopeless.

And after trouble if We taste him Our Mercy, he says it was my right, and I do not think that the Day of Judgement will ever establish, and if I am returned to the Lord there is good for me over there; then We shall tell infidels what they did, and will taste them severe punishment.
When We show favour to humans, they get aside from Us and get away by turning his side, and when any difficulty afflict them they makes lengthy supplications.
Say: do you think if this Quran is from Allah, and you deny it, then who will be more misguided than who is in a prolonged opposition?

We shortly will show our signs all around the world and in their own souls, that it is proven on them that He is the Truth, and is it not enough for the Lord that He is witness to everything, and all seeing.
Be aware that they are in doubt from meeting with Allah, and be aware that Allah has encompassed everything.
Ha Meem
Ain Seen Qaaf
Likewise, Mighty and Wise Allah send the revelation to you and people earlier than you.
Whatever is on earth and in the sky is His property; and that He is most Great and Most High.

It is near that sky is rend from above with His awe, and angels are also glorifying their Lord and are seeking forgiveness for people of the earth; and be aware that is Allah who is all Forgiving and Merciful.
And whoever have made the guardians other than Him, Allah is watching their condition, and O Prophet, you are not responsible for anyone.

And like this We revealed to you Quran in Arabic language, so you warn people of Makkah and its vicinity, and warn them from the day when everyone will be gathered, and there is not any doubt in it, that day one group will be in Paradise and another group will be in Hell.
And if Allah pleased, He would have made everyone one nation, but to whoever He pleases enters into His Mercy; and for unjust there is no guardian or helper.
Have these people made guardians besides Him, whereas He is the guardian of everyone, and He gives life to the dead ones, and He has Power over everything.
And in matters you will disagree, the decision of it is in the Hands of Allah, He is my Lord and I rely on Him, and I turn to Him only.

He is the Creator of the skies and the earth, He created the pairs from your souls and also made pairs among the animals, He is spreading you in the world with the pairs, nobody is like Him, He hears to all and sees everything.
All the keys of the sky and the earth are in His possession, He expands the sustenance of whoever He pleases, and straitens of whoever He pleases, He is well aware of everything.

He made the path for you in your religion whose admonition He did to Nooh, and whose revelation sent towards you also, O Prophet; and whose admonition did to Ibrahim, Moosa and Isa also, that establish the religion and no differences should come up in it; and for polytheists it is very difficult to talk that you invite to them, Allah chooses for His Presence to whomever He pleases, and He guides to whoever turns towards Him.

And these people disagreed among themselves, at the time when they had received the knowledge, this was because of enmity among them, and if the Lord had not decided thing for an appointed period, then it would have been decided among them; and Verily those who have been made to inherit the book, they are in severe doubt about it.

Therefore, you invite for this, and act with perseverance as you have been commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say: I believe on the Book which has been revealed from Allah and I have been commanded to do justice among you, Allah is Lord of both - mine and yours, my deeds for myself and your deeds for yourselves, there is no wrangling between us, Allah will gather us all one day, and everybody has to return to Him.
Those who quarrel about Allah after accepting Him, their arguments are null and waste, and there is wrath of Allah on them, and for them punishment is of severe type.
That is Allah who revealed with Truth the Book and the balance; and what do you know, may be the Day of Judgement is near.

Those who hasten in it (in the Day of Judgement) do not believe in it, but those who believe are always fearful of it, and know that after all it is the truth, beware! those who doubt in the Day of Judgement, they are in misguidance and have gone far away.
Allah is Merciful on His servants, He gives sustenance to whoever He pleases, and He is Powerful and the Honorable.
Whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter, We increase (reward) for him, and who desires the reward in the world, We give him here only, then he will not have any share in the Hereafter.

Do they have any partners who have made the paths for which Allah have not given the permission, and if promise of the day was not there, then the matter would have been decided among them, and verily there is painful punishment for the unjust.

You will see, that the unjust are fearful for punishment of their deeds that will Verily come upon them, and those who have believed, and have done good deeds, they will live in the gardens of Paradise; and for them there is everything in the presence of Allah for which they will desire, and this is a great Mercy of the Lord.

This is greatest Mercy of the Lord for which He has given glad tidings to his servants who have adopted faith and have done good deeds; say: I do not want any recompense for preaching of this prophethood except that you love my near ones; and whoever will earn good, We will give more therein, and Verily Allah is very Forgiving and Appreciator.

Do they say that Prophet falsely slanders on Allah, whereas if Allah pleases, He can seal your hearts also, and Allah erases the falsehood, and make Truth steadfast and sustainable through His words, Verily He knows the secrets of the hearts.
And that is He who accepts the repentance of His servants, and forgives their evils, and is well aware of your deeds.
And those who believe and did good works they accept the Divine Invitation, Allah increases their recompense with His Mercy and Blessings, and infidels shall have the severest punishment.

And if Allah would have expanded the sustenance of all His servants they would have revolted, but according to His Will, He sends down in a fixed quantity, He is well aware of His servants and watches their conditions.
That is He who sends down the rain after they are disappointed, and spreads His Mercy, and He is worthy of praise - Master and Guardian.
And among His signs are creation of earth and the sky and all the living beings walking on it, and whenever He pleases, He has the power to collect them all.
And if any difficulty afflicts you that is of your own doing, and He also forgives many things.
And you cannot humble Allah in the land, and for you there is no guardian or helper other than Him.
And among his signs are sailing ships in the seas which are as high as mountains.
And if He pleases, He causes the wind to become still and all of them will be motionless on the surface, Verily in this reality many signs are found for those who are patient and thankful.
Or He may cause them to perish because of their deeds, and He also forgives many things.
Those who quarrel in Our verses should know that there is no way to escape for them.
Then whatever has been given to you is for your comfort in this world, and whatever is in His Presence is (more) good and everlasting for those who believe and rely on their Lord.
And (they) desist from big sins and indecencies and when they get angry, they forgive.
And those who accept the talk of their Lord, and establish prayer and discuss their affairs among them, and spend in Our way from whatever sustenance We have given them.
And they take revenge when any unjust is done to them (defend themselves).
And recompense of every evil is alike, but if he forgives and makes amends then his reward is with Allah, and Verily, He does not like the unjust.
If any unjust is done to him and he takes the revenge there is no blame on him.
Blame is on those who do unjust on people and unnecessarily spread excesses, painful punishment is for them only.
And Verily who have patience and forgive then this act is certainly very encouraging.
And to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance then there is no friend and guardian for him, you will see that the unjust will say after seeing the punishment: is there any way to return.

You will see that when they will be brought before the Hell their heads will be bowed down in disgrace, and they will be seeing with their eyes, and the believers will say: Verily the losers are they who have lost themselves and their followers on the Day of Judgement. Now Verily the unjust shall remain in lasting punishment.
And there will not be any guardian for them who can help them besides Allah, and to whoever Allah leaves in misguidance, there is no way for him.
Accept the words of Allah before the day comes which cannot be averted, and that day there will be no refuge for you, and you will not have the strength to deny the punishment.

Now, if they object, We have not sent you as their guardians, your mission was just to reach the message to them, that's it, and when We taste Our Mercy to humans they show arrogance, and when any evil reaches them because of their deeds, then he becomes very ungrateful.
Verily authority of sky and the earth is in the hands of Allah only, whatever He pleases He creates, to whoever He pleases gives daughters, to whoever He pleases gives sons.
Then He gathers sons and daughters both and makes barren to whom He pleases, Verily, He has Knowledge, Power and Authority.

It is not for any human that Allah should speak to them, but that He send revelation, or talk from behind the curtain, and send an angel as representative, and then with His permission he reaches the message whatever He pleases, He is most High and Wise.

And thus, We revealed spirit (Quran) to you by Our Command, and you didn't know what the book was, and what the faith was, but We made it a light, through which We guide to Our servants to whoever We please, and Verily We are guiding you to the straight path.
Path of Allah in whose authority is all things of the earth and the sky, and Verily like this all affairs will return (to Him).
Ha Meem
By this enlightened Book.
Verily, We have made this Arabic Quran so that you understand.
This book is mentioned on "Laoh-e-Mahfooz" with Us, truly elevated and full of wisdom.
Shall We desist from admonishing you altogether just because you are doing excesses.
And We sent many messengers to the nations before you.
And there came no prophet to them but they mocked them.
So We destroyed the people more powerful than them, and an example began.
You ask them: who has created the earth and the skies, they will say: the Mighty and the Knowing one has created them.
That, Who made earth the cradle for you, and made ways in it, that you might find the path in it.
And Who sent water from the sky in a fixed quantity, and then We enliven the dead earths through it, and like this you will also be taken out of the earth.
And Who created all the pairs, and made provision for travelling for you in ships and on the animals.

That you sit with comfort on their backs, and when you sit with comfort then remember the blessings of Allah, and say: pure and Self-Sufficient is that Lord who made this subservient for our riding, otherwise we could not have controlled it.
And after all we are going to return to the Presence of our Lord.
And these people assigned a part (son) from His servants for the Lord, Verily humans are very ungrateful.
Say the truth, of all the creatures has the Lord taken for Himself daughters, and liked sons for you?
And when they are given the good news of a daughter, like they have described the example of the Beneficent Lord, then their faces turn black and they start to swallow the anger.
What! Who are raised in ornaments can they not talk properly at the time of quarreling?
And those people declared Angels as females who are servants of the Beneficent Allah, are they witness to their creation, shortly their testimony will be written and they will be questioned about it.
And they say if Allah pleased, we would not have worshipped them, they have no knowledge of it, they are just guessing.
What! Have We given any book to them previously to which they are adhering?
No. But their saying is that they found their forefathers in this tradition, and we are following in their footsteps.
And thus, We did not send before you any warner in a settlement, but those who led easy lives in it said: Verily we found our forefathers on a course, and Verily we are followers of their footsteps.
So the prophet said, even if I bring a better message on which your forefathers were, they replied we are not going to listen to your message.
Then We took revenge from them, so now see what was the end of the deniers.
And when Ibrahim told his (step) father and his nation that I am free from all your gods.
Except that Lord who created me, He will shortly guide me.
And he made his message a permanent word in his progeny, that perhaps they might return to the Lord.
Whereas We gave comfort to them and their elders regularly, so much so that the Truth and Prophet came to them.
And when the Truth came, they said: this is magic and we deny it.
And they started saying: why did this Quran not come on a wealthy person of the two towns (Makkah and Madina)?

So are they distributing the blessings of Allah? We distribute among them their livelihood in the life of this world, and We have exalted some of them above others, that some of them may take work from one another, and blessings of Allah is much better than the wealth they have collected.

And were it not that all people would become a single nation, then to those who deny Beneficent Allah We would have certainly made their roofs and stairs of their houses of silver, by which they climb.
And doors of their houses and their throne on which they sit with cushions.
And from gold also, but it is the material for enjoyment of life of the world only, and the Hereafter near Allah is only for the pious people.
And whoever will be blind from the remembrance of Allah, We will appoint one Satan for him who will be his companion and live with him.
And these Satans prevent them from the path, and they think they are the guided ones.
So much so, when they will come to us, they will say: Alas! there would have been distance of east and west between us and them, this comes out to be a bad companion.
All this talk will be of no use today for you, you are all partners in the punishment, and you have been unjust also.
O Prophet! Can you make deaf to listen, or can you show the path to the blind who is in clear error?
Then We shall take you from the world, after all We have to take revenge from them.
Or We will show the punishment to you and send it, that We have power to do this also.
Therefore, hold this command firmly which has been revealed, that this is totally the straight path.
This Quran is a provision of admonition for your nation, and shortly you will all be questioned.
And you ask the prophets who had been sent before you, had We appointed other gods to be worshipped besides the Beneficent Allah?
And We sent Moosa with our signs towards Firaun and chiefs of his nation, he said: I am the messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.
But when he presented our signs, they all started making fun of it.
And the sign which We show is greater than the earlier one, and then We took them in punishment, that perhaps they might return on the path like this.
And they said: O magician (Moosa)! talk to your Lord for us, as He has made the covenant with you, then We would Verily come on the right path.
But when we averted the punishment, they broke the covenant.
And Firaun called out to his nation and said: O nation, is this country Egypt is not mine, and all these rivers which are beneath my feet are not mine, then why you are not seeing?
Am I not better than the person who is contemptible; and who cannot even speak properly.
Then why the gold bracelets were not sent on him, and why did not angels come with him?
Thus, Firaun made fools of his people, and they obeyed him, they were evil and transgressing people.
When they brought me to wrath then We took recompense from them, then drowned them all together.
Then We made them useless and as examples, for generations to come.
When the son of Maryam was presented as an example, then your nation raised a commotion.
And said: are our gods better, or is He? And they set the example because of stubbornness; they were contentious people.
Otherwise, Isa was a servant upon whom We have sent blessings, and We made him an example of Our power for Bani Israel.
And if We pleased, We would have settled angels on the earth.
And verily this is a clear example of the Day of Judgement, therefore do not doubt in it and follow me that this is the straight path.
And beware, Satan may not stop you from the path of Truth, and he is your open enemy.
And when Isa came to them with the miracles, then he said: I have come to you with wisdom, and that I may explain to you in the part of what you differ in; hence fear Allah and obey me.
Allah is mine and your Lord, and worship Him only that this is the straight path.
Then nations started disputing among themselves, alas! on their condition who did unjust, for them is the punishment of the painful day.
Are they waiting only for this that the Day of Judgement comes suddenly, and they do not realize it.
Today except for the pious people, all friends will turn into enemies against each other.
O My servants, there is no fear for you today, neither will you have any sadness or grief.
These are the people who accepted faith in Our signs, and became obedient.
Now all of you with your wives enter respectfully in Paradise.

Around them there shall be golden trays and drinking cups around them, and that there will be everything which their hearts will desire and which shall be pleasant to their eyes, and you will all be living here forever.
And this is the Paradise which you are given as inheritance on account of your deeds.
There are lots of fruits in it which you will eat.
Verily, guilty ones are going to abide forever in the punishment of Hell.
Punishment shall not be abated from them; they will be living in a state of despair there.
And We have not done any unjust to them, but they were unjust unto themselves.
And they will call out: O Malik, it will be better if your Lord give us death; they will get the reply: now you are going to abide here only.
Verily We come to you with the Truth, but majority of you dislike the Truth.
Have they decided firmly something, then We also know this work.
Or they think We cannot hear their planning and secret talks, What We, Our representatives are writing everything.
Say: if the Beneficent Allah was having son; I am the first worshipper.
He is master of the skies and the earth and the throne, is pure and aloof from all these talks.
Leave them on their own terms, they are talking and playing, so much so that they face the Day which has been promised to them.
And that is He who is Allah in the skies and Allah on the earth, and is Wise, and knower of all things.
Blessed is He who is Owner of the skies and the earth and everything in between them, and He has the knowledge of the Day of Judgement, and towards Whom you shall all be returned.
And besides Him whom they call, they do not even have the authority of intercession, but those who testify the truth knowingly.
If you will ask them that who is their creator, they will say: Allah, then where they are deviating.
And He is also aware of the saying that O Lord, this is the nation who is not going to believe.
Therefore, turn your face from them, and give a message of peace, then shortly they all will come to know.
Ha Meem
I swear by the manifest book.
We have revealed this book on a blessed night; Verily We were the one who gave warning from the punishment.
On this night all the affairs of wisdom and expediency are decided.
This is commanded from Us and We send the prophets.
This is the Mercy of your Lord, and Verily He is all Listening and Knowing.
Whatever is between skies and the earth and between them belong to the Lord, if you are believing.
There is no god but Him, He gives life and He gives death, He is your Lord and the Lord of your earlier elders also.
But these people are playing in doubt.
Hence, you wait for that day when sky shall bring the evident smoke.
Which will engulf everybody, and this is the painful punishment.
Then everyone will say: O Lord, drive away this punishment from us, we are believers.
Where they have admonition now in their fate, when the prophet with explicit message had come to them.
And they turn their face from him saying he is a taught insane.
Well, We will remove the punishment for some time, but you will do the same again what you are doing.
One day will come when We shall strictly catch you because Verily We are the Requiter.
And We, before them, tested the nation of Firaun when a respected messenger came to them.
That deliver me the servants of Allah, I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
And do not feel yourself high before Allah, I have brought very explicit argument for you.
I seek refuge from my Lord and your Lord that you may stone me.
And if you are not going to believe, then get aside from me.
Then he prayed to his Lord that this nation is a very criminal nation.
Then We said: take my servants and leave by night, that you will be pursued.
And go away, leaving the sea on its condition, this army is going to be drowned.
These people left behind many a garden and rivers.
And left behind many a farm and the best houses.
And blessings that they were enjoying.
That is the consequence; and We made other nation to inherit this.
Then neither skies nor earth wept on them; and nor they were given the respite.
And We saved Bani Israel from disgraceful punishment.
From the evil of Firaun, who was the highest among the people doing excesses.
And We chose Bani Israel thoughtfully among all the nations.
And have given them such signs in which clear tests are found.
Verily, they say this.
That this is the first death, after that we will not be raised again.
And if you are truthful bring our forefathers from the graves.
Are they better or the nation of Tab’e and people earlier than them, whom We destroyed because they were all criminals.
We have not created earth and the skies and all the creatures between them for play.
We have created them only with the Truth, but most of them are unaware of this.
Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the appointed time for all of them to be raised.
The day when no friend will benefit a friend, and neither will they be helped.
Except he to whom Allah shows mercy, Verily, He is all Forgiving and Merciful.
Verily, in the Hereafter there is the tree of Thor.
Which is food for the sinners
That shall boil in their bellies like molten copper.
Like the water boils.
Angels will be commanded to catch them and take them to the middle of Hell.
Then pour the boiling water on their heads.
Tell them to taste whatever they have done, that you were called very honourable and respectful.
This is the punishment in which you were creating doubt.
Verily, those pious people will be in a secure place.
Amidst the gardens and rivers.
They will be sitting face to face wearing thick and fine silk clothes.
Thus shall it be; and We shall make their pairs with the big-eyed Hoories.
They shall ask calmly for all types of fruits.
And there they will not taste any death after the first one, and Allah will secure them from the punishment of Hell.
