This is all Grace and Mercy of your Lord; this is the biggest success for the human.
Then We made this Quran easy in your language; that perhaps you may take admonition.
Then you wait; and these people are already waiting.
Ha Meem
Revelation of this Book is from Allah Who is Honorable and has Wisdom.
Verily, in the skies and the earth many signs are found for the believers.
And even in your creation; and the animals which he spread are many signs for the believers.

And in alternation of the day and night; and in the sustenance which Allah sends down from the sky, through which dead earth is brought to life, and in the moving of breeze, signs are found for that nation which have wisdom.
These are verses of Allah which are being recited; then after Allah and His verses, on which thing they are going to believe.
Verily, Alas! On the condition of every liar sinner.
Who listens to the recitation of verses then shows arrogance as if he has not heard, so give him the glad tiding of painful punishment.
And whenever he comes to know any of Our signs, he makes fun of it; Verily, these are the people for whom there is disgraceful punishment.
Hell is behind them, and whatever they have earned and to whom they have made their guardians leaving Allah will not be of any use, and for them is the big punishment.
This Quran is guidance, and there is a grievous type of painful punishment for those who deny the verses of Allah.
Allah has made seas subservient to you that ships may sail from His command and you may search the Blessings and Mercy of Allah, and perhaps may be thankful to Him.
And only He made subservient everything of earth and skies for you; Verily in these, signs are found for that nation which ponder.
Say to those who believe that forgive those who do not fear the divine days so Allah may recompense the nation fully for their deeds.
Whoever will do good work will do it for his own benefit, and whoever will do bad deeds will do it for his own loss, thereafter you will all be returned to your Lord.
And Verily We gave book, wisdom and prophethood to Bani Israel, and gave them pure sustenance, and made them excel over the worlds.

And gave them explicit signs of Our affairs, then after advent of knowledge they disputed among themselves due to stubbornness, so Verily your Lord will judge between them in all the matters on the Day of Judgement, in which they were disputing.
Then We appointed you on the clear course of Our affairs, that you follow it; and beware do not follow the desires of the ignorant.
These people are not of slightest useful against Allah, these oppressors are friends of each other, so then Allah is Guardian of the pious people.
This is the collection of light for the people, and guidance and mercy for the believing nation.
Are the bad-doers thinking that We will hold them equal with those who believe and do good deeds, that their life and death will be the same, they have judged very badly.
And Allah created the sky and the earth with the Truth, and also because every soul can be recompensed for his deeds, and no unjust shall be done on anyone.

Have you seen the person who has taken his desires as God, and Allah has left him in misguidance seeing his condition, and has sealed his ears and heart and there are veils on his eyes; and who can guide him after Allah, don't you even ponder this much?
And these people say that this is worldly life only in which we die and live and time destroys us; they have no knowledge of this, that this is their thinking only, and that's it.
And when Our clear verses are recited before them, their argument is no other than that if you are truthful bring alive our fathers.

Say: Allah has also kept you alive, then one day He will cause death to you, in the end He will gather everybody on the Day of Judgement; and there is no doubt in it, but most of the people even do not understand this.
And the Kingdom of the earth and the sky is of Allah, and when the Day of Judgement will be established Verily that day people of falsehood will be at a loss.
You will see all the nations kneeling, and everyone shall be called towards their book of deeds that today you will be recompensed for your deeds.
This is Our book which speaks with the truth, and We are continuously recording your deeds.
Now, those who believed and did good deeds, Allah will make them enter into His Mercy, this is obvious success.
And those who adopted infidelity, so were not Our verses being recited in front of you? but you showed arrogance and you were a criminal nation.

And when it was said that the promise of Allah is true and there is not any doubt in the Day of Judgement, then you said: we do not know the Day of Judgement and we consider it an imagination and we are not going to believe on this.
And for them evil of their deeds were proven; and that punishment encircled them of which they had made fun of.
And they were told that today We will overlook you the way you had forgotten the meeting of today; and Hell is consequence of all of you, and you do not have any helper.

This is all because you had mocked at the Divine Verses, and worldly life had kept you in deception, today they will not be taken out of punishment, and they will not be even given chance to seek the forgiveness.
All the praise is for Allah only who is Lord and Master of the skies and the earth and all the worlds.
Greatness is His in the skies and the earth, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
Ha Meem
This is the Book revealed by Allah, the Honorable and Wise.
We have created skies and the earth and all creatures in between with the Truth and with an appointed term, and those who have adopted infidelity have turned aside from which they have been warned.

So you say to them: have you seen them to whom you call besides Allah, if yes, then show me also that what they have created on earth or what partnership they have in the skies, then if you are truthful show me any earlier book or traces of the knowledge.
Who can be more misguided who call upon others besides Allah who cannot reply to their calls (even) till the Day of Judgement, and they are oblivious of the sound of their calls.
When all the people will gather on the Day of Judgement these gods will become their enemies and will deny of their worshipping.
And when Our bright verses are recited in front of them, so infidels after coming of the Truth say in this regard that this is clear magic.

Do they say that the prophet has slandered, so you say: if I have slandered then you are not going to be of any use to me, and Allah knows well what you utter about Him, and He is sufficient as witness between me and you, and He is very Forgiving and Merciful.
Say: that I am not the prophet of any new kind and I do not know what will be done to me and to you, I only follow the Divine Revelation and I am a plain warner of the Allah's punishment.

Say: do you think if this Quran is from Allah and you have denied it, whereas a person of Bani Israel had testified about it and he has also become a believer; even then you showed arrogance, Verily, Allah's guidance is not for the unjust people. ​

And these infidels say to the believers that if this religion was better then they would not have gone ahead of us; and when they did not get the guidance themselves now they say that it is a very old lie.

Before this, it was the Book of Moosa which was guidance and mercy; and this Book is in Arabic which verifies all that it may warn the unjust from the punishment of Allah, and for the good doers it is complete good news.
Verily, those who called Allah their Lord and are steadfast on it, there is no fear or grief for them.
These are in fact the people of Paradise and shall abide in it forever, and this is the real recompense for their deeds.

And We gave admonition to the man to be good with his parents that his mother had kept him with lots of difficulty in her womb and then with difficulty gave birth, and period from the pregnancy till weaning is thirty months; when he gained maturity and reached forty years then he prayed: O Lord, give me opportunity that I may thank You for Your blessings which You have bestowed upon me and my parents, I may do good that You are pleased with me; and give admonition and piety in my descendants, my attention is towards You only and I may be Your obedient servant.
These are the people whose good deeds We accept and forgive their bad deeds, they are among the people of Paradise, and this is the promise of Allah which they are being promised continuously.

And who said to his parents: woe unto you that you are scaring me from being raised again from the grave whereas many nations have passed before me; and they were crying: O Son, this is very sad, become a believer, Verily promise of Allah is true, but he said: these are the fictions of the ancient people.
These are the people on whom punishment has proved; in the Ummah of humans and jinns who have passed by, Verily, they will be among the losers.
For everyone there will be ranks according to their deeds and that Allah will recompense completely for their deeds, and not any kind of unjust will be done on them.

And the day when infidels will be brought before Hell, that you have enjoyed the life in the world and have rested there, so today (you) will be given disgraceful punishment that you were arrogant on the earth and were disobeying the commands of the Lord.

And remember brother of Aad, Hud that he warned his nation in the sandy plains, that before him and after him many messengers have passed (saying) do not worship anyone except Allah, I am fearful for you from the punishment of a hard day.
Those people said: you have come to us that you may deviate us from our gods; so bring the punishment from which you are warning us, if you are truthful in your talk.
He said knowledge is only with Allah and I deliver to you His message which is given to me, however, I think you are an ignorant nation.

Thereafter when they saw the cloud which was coming towards their valleys, they said this cloud is going to rain upon us, whereas, this is the same punishment for which you have hastened for, this is the wind in which there is painful punishment.
It will destroy everything by the command of Allah; result was that nothing was seen except the houses, and like this We punish the criminal nation.

And certainly, We had given them the authorities which (We) have not given to you, and We had given them ears, eyes and hearts, but neither ears benefitted them nor eyes and hearts, that they were deniers of the Divine verses; and they were encompassed by the punishment, which they used to mocked at.
Verily, We destroyed many a settlement around you, and showed Our signs repeatedly that perhaps they may come back towards the Truth.

So why they did not benefitted them whom they have adopted as gods besides Allah to draw near to Him, but instead they disappeared; and this was their lie and slander which they used to fabricate regularly.

When We made a group of jinn attentive towards you to listen to Quran; when they came, they said among themselves to listen silently, when recitation ended, they returned immediately to their nation as warners.
(They) said: O people of the nation we have heard the Book which has been revealed after Moosa, it verifies the books before it and guides towards the truth, justice, and the straight path.
O people of the nation say yes to him who is inviting you towards Allah and become a believer so that Allah forgives your sins and gives you refuge from the painful punishment.
And whoever will not say yes to the Divine Caller, cannot humble Allah, and for him there is no guardian other than Allah; verily they are in explicit misguidance.
Did not they observed that Allah, Who created the skies and the earth was not helpless from their creation, he also has the power to bring to life the dead, and verily He has power over everything.

When these infidels will be presented before Hell, they will all say; is that not the Truth?; by Lord this is all Truth, then (Allah) will say: now taste the punishment because earlier you were denying it.

O Prophet! Be patient, as the Arch-Prophets were patient, and do not seek haste for the punishment, that day when they will see the punishment from which they are being warned, they will think that they have stayed in the world for one day or only one hour, this Quran is the last argument for them, is any nation will be destroyed other than the transgressors?
Whoever adopted infidelity and hindered people from the path of Allah, He shall destroy their deeds.

And whoever adopted faith and did good deeds and believed on whatever was revealed on Mohammad and which is Truth from the Lord, so Allah will remove their bad deeds and shall improve their condition.
This is because infidels did follow the falsehood and people of faith did follow the Truth which came from their Lord, and like this Allah describes the examples for the people.

When the infidels come to confront you, smite their necks until they are injured with wounds do tie their arms, thereafter either leave them as a favour or take ransom (and leave them) until they lay down their weapons, remember, if Allah pleased He would have taken the recompense Himself but He wish to test one through another, those who have been slain in His way Allah cannot waste their deeds.
Shortly, He will cause to reach them to their destinations and shall improve their condition.
He will cause them to enter Paradise which He has identified to them earlier.
O people of faith, if you will help Allah, Allah will help you, and shall make you steadfast.
And those who adopt infidelity there is unsteadiness for them and their deeds are a waste.
This is because they thought evil about the commands revealed by Allah, so Allah also rendered their deeds null.
So did not they travelled in the land to see that what has happened to their earlier ones, Verily Allah has ruined them, and for infidels such punishment is fixed.
This is all because Allah is the Guardian of the people of the faith and there is no guardian for the infidels.

Verily, those adopted faith and they did good deeds Allah will cause them to enter such gardens beneath which the rivers will be flowing and those who adopted infidelity they are enjoying, they eat as the animals eat; and in the end their abode is Hell.
There were many a settlement which were more powerful than this settlement from which you were driven out, when We destroyed them there was no helper for them.
So, can the one who has received the clear argument from Allah be like him whose evil deeds are decorated for him; and then they followed their desires.

An example of the Paradise which has been promised to the pious people is this that there are rivers of water which does not have smell of any kind, there are also some rivers of milk whose taste never changes, and some rivers are of wine - a joy for those who drink, some rivers are of clear honey, and for them there are also fruits of every kind, and there is forgiveness from the Lord; so can these pious people be like those who will forever abide in Hell, there they will be given boiling water to drink which will break their bowels into pieces.

And among them are some people who seem to listen to you attentively, and when they go away from you (they) ask those who have been given the knowledge that what was it that he said just now; these are the people whose hearts have been sealed, and they are following their desires.
Those who took the guidance, Allah increased their guidance, and blessed them with more piety.
Then, are they awaiting the Day of Judgement that it come suddenly to them, whereas its signs have become obvious, even if it come to them, then what admonition they will obtain?
So understand that there is no god except Allah, and keep seeking forgiveness for you and your men and women who are people of faith; Allah is well aware of your movement and stillness.

Those who adopted faith say why no Chapter (in Quran) has been revealed about (fighting), and when the Chapter was revealed in which fighting was categorically mentioned; then did you see that whose hearts were having sickness were looking at you as if they have fainted because of death, so woe unto them.
Only obedience and good talk is good for them, so when the affair of war gets settled and they remain on their promise to Allah, then it is much better for them.
Is it far from you that you become ruler and create mischief in the land and sever ties with relatives?
These are the people whom Allah has cursed and have made their ears deaf and have made their eyes blind.
So do they not ponder even a little in the Quran, or their hearts have locks.
Verily (as for) those who return on their backs after the guidance has become manifest to them, the Satan has decorated their desires for them; and they have been given ample of respite.
This is because, they said to those who did not like the things revealed by Allah that in some matters we would obey you, and Allah is well aware from their secret talks.
Then what will happen when death will come, and angels will continuously hit their faces and their backs.
This is because they followed the things which are displeasing to Allah, and (they) disliked His Will, so Allah also made their deeds null.
Those in whose hearts sickness are found think that Allah will not bring out the malice of their hearts.

And if We pleased, We would have shown them to you, and you would have recognized them from the expression of their faces, and you would certainly guess by their speech; and Allah is well aware of the deeds of all of you.
And certainly, We will try all of you to know that who among you can struggle hard (in the way of Allah) and who can be patient; and like this (We) shall test your condition thoroughly.

Verily, who adopted infidelity and hindered people from the way of Allah, and even after guidance becoming manifest, they did quarrel with the Prophet, they cannot cause any harm to Allah, shortly Allah will ruin their deeds.
O believers, obey Allah and obey Prophet and beware don't ruin your deeds.
Verily, who adopted infidelity and creates hindrance in the way of Allah and died in infidelity, so Allah will never forgive them.
Hence, do not give up, do not propose peace to the enemy, you have upper hand and Allah is with you, He will never lessen the reward of your deeds.
This worldly life is just idle sport and play and if you have adopted faith and piety then Allah will give you full reward and would not ask your possessions from you.
Even if He will ask and insist, you will only show your stinginess, and Allah will bring forth your malice.

Yes, you are those people that when they are called upon to spend in the way of Allah, some of you show stinginess, and those who are stingy are stingy for themselves, and Allah is Self-Sufficient; you are poor and needy in front of Him, and if you turn your face, Allah will bring another nation in your place who will not be like you.
Verily, We have given you a clear victory.
So that Allah removes all your past and future blames and complete His favor on you and guide you to the straight path.
And help you in a magnificent way.
That is Allah who has sent down calm in the hearts of the believers that they might have more faith, all the armies of the earth and skies are of Him and He is all-Knowing and has Wisdom.

That He may cause believing men and believing women to enter into Paradise beneath which rivers are flowing that they always abide in it and shall remove their evil from them, this is the grand success near Allah.

May the punishment of Allah be on hypocrite men and hypocrite women and polytheist men and women who have evil thinking about Allah, punishment is circling over their heads and wrath of Allah is on them, Allah has cursed them, and Hell has been provided for them; this is the worst result.
And all the forces of the earth and skies are only for Allah, He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
O Prophet, We have sent you as a witness, giver of glad tidings and as warner from the punishment of Allah.
So that you may believe in Allah and His Prophet and help and respect him; and glorify Allah morning and evening.

Verily those pay allegiance to you in fact they pay allegiance to Allah, and Allah's Hand is upon their hands, and now whoever breaks the allegiance, he acts against himself; and whoever will fulfil the Divine Promise, Allah will shortly bestow upon him the grand reward.

Shortly these villagers who stayed behind will say to you: our property and children had kept us busy, so ask forgiveness for us, they are saying this from their tongue which is not in their hearts, so say to them: if Allah intends to harm you or intends to do good then who has the control against Him with regards to your affairs, fact is that Allah is well aware about your deeds.

In fact, you were thinking that Prophet and the believers cannot ever return to their abodes and that thing was decorated in your hearts and you acted distrustfully; and you are a nation doomed to perish.
And whoever will not believe on Allah and (His) Prophet, We have prepared the Hell for such infidels.
And Kingdom of the earth and the skies is only of Allah's, He forgives whom He pleases and punishes whom He pleases, and Allah is very forgiving and Merciful.

Shortly these who stayed behind will say: allow us to accompany you when you go for war booty, they want to change the word of Allah; so say: you cannot come with us, Allah has decided this earlier; then they will say: you are envious of us, whereas in fact they understand very little.

Say to these who stayed behind, shortly you will be called towards a hard fighting nation that you continue fighting or they become Muslims, so if you obey Allah, He will give you the best reward; and if you will turn back as you had done earlier then you will be punished through the painful punishment.

There is no blame on the blind, and for lame also there is no blame, there is no responsibility for the sick (if they do not join fighting); and those who obey Allah and His Prophet, Allah will cause them to enter such Paradises beneath which rivers will be flowing; and those who will turn back they will be punished with the grievous punishment.

Verily Allah was pleased with the believers when they gathered below the tree and were swearing allegiance to you, then He saw everything that was in their hearts and sent calm on them, and in exchange rewarded them the close victory.
And gave many benefits which they will receive, Allah is Predominant on everyone and Wise.

He has promised you many benefits which you will receive, then hastened in giving the war booty (of Khaiber) and held back hands of people from you that it may become a sign of power for the people of faith; and He may guide you towards the straight path.
And other booties on which you could not access, Allah is dominant over them also, and Allah has the power over everything.
And if these infidels have fought with you they would have turned their faces and run away, and then they would not have found any guardian and helper.
This is a tradition of Allah which has passed, and you can never find a change in the method of Allah.
That is Allah Who held back infidels' hands from you, and your hands from them, at the border of Makkah even after your victory; and Allah is well aware of your deeds.

These are the people who adopted infidelity and barred you from entering the Sacred Mosque, and barred the animals of sacrifice from reaching their destinations, and if believing men and believing women were not there whom you didn't know and there was fear of unknowingly trampling upon them, and in this way you may have unintentionally incurred the loss which would not have been stopped, it was stopped because with whomever Allah pleases causes him to enter into His Mercy; if they would have been separated, We would have encompassed infidels into the painful punishment.

This is of that time when infidels who harboured in their hearts the feelings of disdain of the days of ignorance (that they will not allow you to enter Makkah), so Allah sent down tranquility on the Prophet and the people of faith and kept them steady on piety, and they were deserving of this, and Allah is Knower of everything.

Verily Allah had shown the true dream to His Prophet, Allah pleases, you enter the Sacred Mosque after shaving off the head or trimming your hair and you shall not have any fear; and He knew what you do not know; so He gave you a close victory before the victory of Makkah.
That is Allah Who sent His Prophet with the guidance and the true religion that it dominates all the (previous) religions; and Allah is sufficient for a Witness.

Mohammad is the Prophet of Allah, and the people with him are very firm against infidels and very soft hearted among themselves; so you will see that they are bowing down in prostration in His Presence, and are seeking from their Lord Grace and Mercy and His Pleasure; marks of prostration are found on their faces due to frequent prostration, thus is their example in Taurait and thus their virtue in Injeel; as in farming first seed produce then it give out sprouts then strengthen it and becomes thick then it stands on its own stem that make the sowers happy and it becomes a source of envy for infidels; Allah has promised the people of faith and good-doers for forgiveness and grand reward.
O People of Faith beware, do not precede your words to Allah and His Prophet, and fear Allah, He is all Hearing and Knowing.

O People of Faith beware, do not raise your voice over the voice of the Prophet and do not speak loudly to him as you call out to one another among yourselves; lest your deeds may go waste, and you are not even aware of it.
Verily those who keep down the tone of their voice in front of the Prophet, these are the people whose hearts Allah has tested for piety, and for them is forgiveness and grand reward.
Verily those who call out to you from behind the chambers, majority of them do not understand anything.
And if they had been patient till you come out, it would have been better for them, and Allah is all Forgiving and Merciful.
O people of faith if any transgressor brings any news, then carefully investigate it, lest you reach a nation unknowingly, and then be ashamed of your action.

And remember Prophet of Allah is present amidst you, if he listens to you in many of the matters you would have been in trouble, but Allah made the faith beloved for you and adorned it into your hearts; and disliked infidelity, transgression, and disobedience for you, and in fact these people are the guided ones.
This is Allah's Grace and His Blessings, and Allah is Knower of everything and (He) also has Wisdom.

And if two groups of the believers quarrel then you make peace between them, thereafter if they are unjust on one another then fight unitedly with the group which are doing excesses until they return to submit to the command of Allah; then if they return, make the peace with them, and do justice with them because Allah likes those who do justice.
Believers are brothers among themselves, so make things right between brothers, keep fearing Allah, so that perhaps you may receive Mercy.

O believers, beware, no nation should mock at other nation, because they may be better than they; and group of women should not laugh at the other group, those women may be better than them and do not taunt one another and do not call one another with bad titles; even the name of evil is bad after faith; and know that those who do not repent, they are in fact the unjust people.

O people of faith avoid most of suspicions, because some suspicions are like sin, and beware, do not find faults in one another and do not backbite others; does anyone among you would like to eat the flesh of your dead brother, definitely you would consider it bad, so fear Allah, verily Allah is acceptor of repentance and Merciful.

O people, We have created you from a man and a woman, then made families and tribes among you so that you might identify one another among you, verily most dear among you near Allah is, who is most pious; and Allah is Knowing and Aware.

These Arabs of desert say we believe, so you say to them: you have not believed but say you just accepted Islam, and faith has not entered into your hearts yet, and if you will obey Allah and His Prophet then He would not lessen your deeds, and He is very Forgiving and Merciful.

People of Faith are only those who believe on Allah and His Prophet and then never doubted and struggled hard in His way with their wealth and lives; and in fact, these are the people who are truthful in their claim of faith.
You tell them: are you teaching your religion to Allah, whereas He is Aware of everything in the skies and the earth, and He is Knower of everything of the universe.

They show you as a favor that they have accepted faith, so you say to them: do not show the favor of your faith to me; this is the favor of Allah that He guided you to adopt faith - if you are truthful in claim of faith.
Indeed, Allah is aware of every unseen of the skies and the earth, and He is seeing all your deeds.
Qaaf, By the Glorious Quran.
But these infidels wonder that a man from among themselves has come as a Prophet; they say it is very strange.
What, when we will die and become dust, will we return again, it does not seem so.
We know how earth diminishes their bodies, and we have a Secured Book.
Fact is that, after the advent of the Truth, they denied it; now they are suffering from anxiety.
Didn't they see towards the sky above them; that - how We have made it and decorated it also, and there is no gap in it.
And made earth the flooring and put mountains on it and grew beautiful things everywhere.
This is the matter of admonition and insight for every servant of Allah who turns towards Him.
And We sent down blessed water from the sky, then grew gardens, and grains in the fields.
And grew long palm-trees, whose branches of fruits are arranged in layers together.
This is all for the sustenance of Our servants, and We brought to life the dead lands from this water, like this We will bring you forth from the earth.
Before them the nation of Nuh, and the people of Rass and even Samood had denied.
And also, the nation of Aad, Firaun and brothers of Lut.
And also did companions of grove, and nation of Tab’e, they all denied prophets, so Our promise was fulfilled.
So were We helpless from earlier creation, never, so fact is that they are doubting the future creation.
We have created the man, We know what whisperings his conscience creates, and We are nearer to his jugular vein.
When two writers write his deeds who are sitting on the right and left.
He does not utter any word, but a watcher is present with him.
And the unconsciousness of death will certainly come; this is the thing from which you were running away.
And then the trumpet shall be blown, this is the day when punishment was promised.
And every self shall come in such a way that there will be angels to drive them and bear witness.
Verily you were neglectful from this, so We removed your veils, and now your sight has become sharp.
And his companion angel will say: his deed is ready with me.
Command shall come: both of you throw every ungrateful transgressor into Hell.
Who was preventing (others) from good; transgressing and was creating doubts.
Who had created gods besides Allah; both of you, throw him into severe punishment.
Then his companion Satan will say: O Lord, I have not misguided him, he himself had gone far in great error.
(Lord) will say: do not quarrel in My presence, I have warned you beforehand about the punishment.
My words do not change, nor am I unjust to the servants.
The day We will say to Hell: are you filled up? It will say: can I have more?
And Paradise will be brought nearer to the pious people.
This is the place which is promised with everyone who turns to Allah and who guards his self.
Whoever fears the Beneficent (Allah) in secret; and comes to His Presence with the heart that turns to Him.
All of you enter Paradise with peace, this is the day of forever.
Everything of their desire is present there, and We have more also.
And how many nations did We destroy before them who were more powerful than they; so they went about and about all the towns; but where is the escape from death.
There is admonition in this event for the man who has heart or who listens attentively.
And We created skies and the earth and what is in between them within six days, and exhaustion even did not touch Us.
Hence, be patient on their talk, and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset.
And glorify Him during part of the night and also glorify Him after prostrations.
And listen on the day attentively when the Divine Caller (Israfil) shall call out from the near place.
The day; when they all shall hear the sound of the sky, and that is the day of coming forth from the graves.
Verily, We give life and death and everyone has to return to Us.
And that day the earth will be ruptured from their side, and they will come out hastening, saying the Resurrection is easy for us.
We know well what these people are saying, and you are not going to force them, continue admonishing people through the Quran, who fear Our punishment.
By the winds that scatter the clouds.
Then carries the weight of the clouds.
Then it blows gently.
Then it is the distributor of an order.
Whatever has been promised to you is true.
The reward and the punishment are verily going to happen.
And by the sky which has different paths.
That you people are involved in different affairs.
Who have already gone astray, only they can be misguided from the truth.
Verily speculators will be killed.
Who are lying in their own negligence.
They ask: after all, when the Day of Judgement will come.
So this is the day when they shall be heated in the fire of Hell.
Now taste your punishment, this is the punishment for which you hastened.
Verily pious people will be amidst gardens and fountains.
Whatever their Lord is going to give, they will receive it, these are the people who earlier did good.
They sleep very less during the night.
And used to seek forgiveness in His Presence at dawn.
And in their wealth there was a portion for those who ask, and for deprived who do not ask.
And many signs are found in the earth for those who accept.
And within yourself also, are not you seeing.
And your sustenance is in the sky, and whatever is promised to you everything is present.
By the Master of the skies and the earth, Quran is most verily the Truth, just as you speak among yourselves.
Has the mention of honourable guests of Ibrahim reached you.
When they entered with him and said salutation, he replied with a salutation and said: you seem to be from an unknown nation.
Then he went home, prepared and brought a fat (roasted) calf.
Then offered it to them and asked: don't you eat?
Then he felt fear in his soul, so they said: do not fear, and then gave him the good news of a wise son.
Hearing this, his wife came shouting and struck her face (and said) I am an old and barren.
They said: so will it be, this is the command of your Lord, He is Wise, and Knower of everything.
Ibrahim said: O angels, what is your mission.
They said: we have been sent towards a guilty nation.
That we rain upon them the stones of clay.
Who have been marked as transgressors by the Lord.
Then We took out all the believers from that settlement.
We found there nobody except one house of the Muslims.
And We left therein a sign of painful punishment for those who fear.
And in the story of Moosa Our signs are there when We sent him towards Firaun with the explicit argument.
So on the strength of his army he turned his face away that he is magician or insane.
Then We caught him and his army and threw them into the sea; and he was reprehensible.
And nation of Aad is also a sign, when We sent towards them the barren wind.
That wherever it passes it reduced everything to ruin like rotten bone.
And in the nation of Samood also there is a sign, when it was said to them: enjoy for few days.
They disobeyed the command of Allah, so lightning overtook them, while they just saw.
Then they were not able to stand, nor could they seek help.
And before them was nation of Nooh that they were all transgressor and evil.
And We made skies with Our prowess, and We expanded it.
And We made earth as floor, and how well We have spread it out.
And We created a pair from everything that perhaps you might get admonition.
Therefore, run towards Allah now that I am plain warner.
And beware, do not make anyone god besides Him that I am a clear warner to you.
Like this, no prophet came to this nation before but these people said: he is magician or insane.
Have they made their will to one another for this, no, rather they are all rebellious.
Therefore, turn your face from them, then there is no blame on you.
And continue to remind them that reminder is useful for the believers.
And I have created jinn and men just for My worshipping.
I do not want any sustenance from them, nor do I want that they should feed Me.
Verily the one who gives sustenance is Allah only; the Lord of Power, the Strong.
Then for those unjust is also the same rewards as were for their companions, so they should not hasten.
Then woe and punishment for infidels on that day, for the day that is being promised with them.
By the mountain (Toor).
And by the book that is written.
Which is in the outstretched pages.
And by the frequently visited House.
And by the elevated ceiling (sky).
And by the raging sea.
Verily, the punishment of Your Lord shall happen.
​And no one can avert it.
The day when skies shall revolve completely.
And mountains shall come in movement.
Then there will be punishment and destruction for the deniers.
Those who are playing in the wasteful discourse.
The day when they will forcefully pushed into Hell.
This is the fire of Hell which you were denying.
Is it magic, or do you not see.
Now enter into it, whether be patient or don't be patient, it is the same (to you); this is the punishment of those deeds, which you have done.
Indeed, pious people shall be amidst gardens and bliss.
They will be happy with what Allah will bestow upon them, and Allah will keep them safe from the punishment of Hell.
Now eat and drink here with ease on the basis of your deeds which you have done.
They will be reclining on the thrones set up in lines, and We will pair them with big-eyed Hoories.

Those who believed and their children also obeyed them in faith, then We will cause them to unite with their descendants also, and We will not lessen anybody's deeds even for a particle, and everyone is responsible for his deeds.
And whatever fruit or meat they would desire, We will help them in much better way.
They will pass on the cups (of pure wine) (one to another); but there shall not be any nonsense nor any sin.
And young boys will wander around them, who will be like carefully hidden pearls, beautiful and elegant.
And then they will turn towards one another and engage in question and answer.
Shall say: we were very fearful of Allah in our houses.
So Allah has done favour to us, and saved us from the poisonous air of Hell.
Earlier also we had been supplicating to Him; certainly, He does favours and is Benevolent.
Therefore, continue admonishing people, by the grace of Allah you are neither a magician nor a madman.
Do these people say he is a poet, for this we are waiting for the accidents of time to come.
So you say: Verily you wait, along with you I am also among the awaiters.
Do their intellect say these things; or they are really rebellious.
Or they say the prophet has fabricated the Quran; and the fact is that they are not going to believe.
Then let them bring the similar writing, if they are truthful in their talk.
Have they come into existence on their own without anything, or are they themselves creators.
Or they have created the skies and the earth; fact is that they will not believe.
Or treasures of the Lord are with them, or they are the masters?
Or they have any such ladder by which they listen from the sky, so those who listen should bring any clear proof.
Or daughters are for Allah and sons are for you.
Or do you ask for any reward of prophethood from them that they are burdened with its load.
Or they have knowledge of the Unseen that they are writing about.
Or do they wish to do any deceit, so remember, infidels shall get entangled in their own deceit.
Or for them there is another god besides Allah, whereas Allah is clean and pure from their polytheism.
And even if they will see the pieces of sky falling, they will say: these are the layers of the clouds.
So leave them on their condition, till they encounter the day when they shall become unconscious.
The day when no trick will work, nor will there be any helper for them.
And those who did unjust, for them there is also other punishment than this; but most of them are unaware about this.
Now wait in patience for the command of your Lord, you are before Our sight; and while standing always glorify your Lord.
And continue to glorify the Lord during the part of night and at the setting of the stars.
By the star when it broke.
Your companion neither got misguided nor deviated.
And he does not even speak out of his own desire.
His words are nothing but revelation, which is constantly revealed.
He has been taught by the Mighty Power.
Who has beauty and elegance, who stands straight.
When he was on the highest of the horizon.
Then he drew near and came forward.
So much so that the distance was of two bows, or even closer.
Then Allah revealed to his servant, whatever secret He meant to reveal.
Heart has not rejected what he saw.
Are you quarreling regarding the matter of what he is seeing?
And he has seen it once more.
Near the Lote-Tree (beyond which no one can pass).
Near which there is also have Paradise of Mawa'.
When it was spreading over the lote-tree, whatever was spreading.
At that time neither his eye strayed, nor did it cross the limit.
He saw the greatest signs of his Lord.
Have you people seen Laat and Uzza?
Have you seen Manaat, which is their third?
What! Are males for you; and females for Him?
This is a very unjust division.

These are the names which you and your fathers have named, and Allah has not revealed any argument for them, in fact these people just follow their speculation and desires of their heart, Verily guidance has come to them from their Lord.
Can man get everything he desires?
The world and The Hereafter, everything is only for Allah.
And how many angels are there in the skies whose intercession cannot benefit anyone; except that Allah allows to whom He pleases and chooses.
Verily those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels after female names.
Although, they do not have any knowledge in this regard, they only follow the conjecture; and conjecture can give no benefit with regards to the truth.
Therefore, who turns his face from Our mention and does not desire anything except this world, you also turn aside from him.
This is the limit of their knowledge, and certainly your Lord knows who has gone astray from His path and who is on the path of guidance.
And to Allah belongs the authority of the skies and the earth, that He may punish those who do evil deeds; and reward those who do good deeds with what is the best.

And those who desist from the major sins and indecencies (and) falls only into the small sins; Verily your Lord is very vast forgiver, He was aware of your condition when He created you from the dust, and when you were in the wombs of your mothers nearing birth, therefore do not attribute purity to your souls; He is well aware of the pious people.
Have you seen him also who has turn his face?
And withheld after giving little in the way of Allah.
Does he have the knowledge of the unseen through which he is seeing.
Or he is not even aware from what was written in the scripture of Musa.
Or in the scriptures of Ibrahim, who fulfilled his engagements truthfully.
And no man is going to carry the burden of others.
And man shall have that much for which he has strived.
And that (the fruit of) his striving shall shortly be presented to him.
Thereafter he shall be recompensed to the fullest.
And Verily, the final destination is the Presence of the Lord.
And that He causes (us) to laugh and makes us cry.
And that He causes death and gives life.
And only He created pair of the male and the female.
From that sperm which is put in the womb.
And He is responsible for the second life as well.
And He made wealthy and gave capital.
And He is the Lord of the Sirius.
And that is He who earlier destroyed the nation of Aad.
And also to the nation of Samood, then (He) spared nobody.
And nation of Nooh and people earlier than them were all very unjust and transgressors.
And He destroyed the overturn town of the nation of Lut.
Then it covered them; that which covered.
Now on which of the favor of your Lord are you doubting.
Indeed, this prophet is also one of the warner like earlier warners.
Look! the Day of Judgement is near.
Except Allah, no one can avert it.
Are you wondering at this?
And then you laugh, and do not cry?
You are totally negligent.
So, prostrate for Allah and worship Him.
The Day of Judgement has come near, and moon is split into two.
And if they see any sign, they turn their face and say: it is continuous magic.
And they denied it and followed their desires; and every affair has its appointed term.
Verily much communication has come to them which contain the warnings.
Far-reaching wisdom, but warnings do not benefit them.
Therefore, turn your face from them, the day when a caller (Israfeel) shall call them towards an unpleasant task.
Looking downward they shall as come out from their graves as if locusts have spread.
They shall all be running towards the caller with their heads raised, and infidels will be saying: today is a very hard day.
Before them nation of Nooh also denied, so they denied Our servant, saying he is mad and even he was scolded.
So, he prayed to his Lord, I have been defeated, help me.
So, We opened the doors of the sky with the torrential rain.
And We made water gushed from rivers in land also, then both the waters gathered for the special purpose.
And We carried him on an Ark made of planks and nails.
Sailing before Our eyes, this was a recompense for Our servant who was denied.
And We have left it as Our sign, is there anyone who get admonition.
Then how our punishment and warning was proven.
And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition?
And nation of Aad also denied, then how was Our punishment and warning?
Then We sent sharp storm on them on a bitter ill-fortune day.
Which uprooted people from their places as if they were dry stems of the palm-tree.
Then see! How my punishment and warning was proven.
And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition.
And (Nation of) Samood also denied the prophets.
And said: shall we follow a person from among ourselves, in that case we shall be in misguidance and will be in madness.
What! Among us has the message revealed on him only, in fact he is a liar and seeker of glory.
So they will come to know tomorrow who is the liar and proud.
We are going to send a she-camel as a trial for them, therefore you wait and have patience. ​
And inform them that the water will be divided between them, and each one's right to drink shall be established by turn.
So, they called their companion and they caught the she-camel and killed her.
Then everyone saw how Our punishment and warning was proven.
We sent upon them a mighty blast, so they all became like the dry stubble used in the cattle enclosure.
And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition.
And nation of Lut also denied the prophets.
So We rained upon them the stones, except for the family of Lut, that We saved them in the morning itself.
This was one of Our favors, and like this We reward Our thankful servants.
And Lut warned them of Our violent seizure, but they doubted the warner.
And when they demanded illegitimately about the guests, then We made their eyes blind, that now taste the punishment and warning.
And the punishment which cannot be averted overtook them in the morning.
Now taste Our punishment and warning.
And We made Quran easy for admonition, is there anyone to get admonition.
And messengers came to the Firaun's people also.
They rejected all Our signs, so We also seized them in the manner of a Mighty Powerful One.
Are your infidels better than they or any Note of Pardon has been written for them in the books.
Or their saying that they have a big party which helps one another.
Shortly this party will face defeat, and they all will turn their backs and run away.
Rather their promise is of the Hereafter, and the Hereafter is a very hard and bitter reality.
Verily, guilty (people) are suffering from misguidance and insanity.
On the Day of Judgement when they shall be dragged upon their faces into fire; Taste Hell now.
Verily We have created everything according to a fixed measure.
And Our command is but one, like batting an eyelid.
And We have already destroyed your companions, so is there anyone to get the admonition.
And whatever these people have done everything is secured in the Book of Deeds.
And every small and big deed has been noted in it.
Verily pious people shall be amidst the gardens and rivers.
At a pure place; in the presence of the Mighty Powerful King.
Most Gracious.
He taught the Quran.
Created the man.
And taught him speech.
Sun and the moon are following the course appointed by Him.
And stars and trees are all prostrating.
He raised the sky, and established the Balance (of Justice).
That you may not transgress in balance.
And establish the weight with justice and do not weigh less while weighing.
And He has spread earth for the people.
Therein are fruits and date-palms whose bunches are covered with skin.
Seeds are with husk, and fragrant flowers are also there.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
He created the man from sounding clay like pottery.
And created the Jinn with flames of fire.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Lord of the two Easts and Lord the two Wests.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
He has flowed two seas which meet together.
There is a barrier between them that they cannot exceed upon each other.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Pearls and corals come out of these seas.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
And His are the ships that stand like mountains in the sea.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Whatever is on earth everything shall perish.
And only forever shall remain the Face of your Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honor.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Whoever is in the sky and on earth beg of Him, and every day He has new glory.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
O both groups, shortly We shall turn towards you.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
O groups of Jinn and Man if you have power then go beyond the boundaries of skies and the earth; but remember, you cannot pass through without strength and authority (which you do not have).
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Flame of green fire, and black smoke shall be set loose upon you, then both of you cannot avert it anyhow.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
And when the sky will rend and become red like oil.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Then on that day no Jinn and Man will be questioned about his sin.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Guilty people shall be recognized by their marks, then they shall be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
This is the Hell which the guilty had denied.
Now go round about between this and the boiling water.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
And for him who fears to stand in the Presence of his Lord, there are two gardens.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
And branches of both the gardens will be laden with the fresh fruits.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
In both of them two fountains shall be flowing.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
In both of them every fruit will be in pairs.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
They shall be reclining on the carpets whose lining shall be of satin and fruits of both the gardens shall be very near.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
In those Paradises there will be Hoories, limiting their glances; whom neither man nor jinn would have touched them before.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Those Hoories will be like Rubies and coral.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Can the recompense of favor be anything else but favor?
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
And there will be two more gardens other than these two.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Both of them will be extraordinarily green and blooming.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
These two gardens will also have two fountains which will be gushing with water.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
In both the gardens will be fruits, date-palms and pomegranates.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
In these Paradises there will be pure and beautiful women.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Hoories will be sitting in the tents.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Whom no man or jinn would have touched them before.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
They shall be reclining on green cushions and fine carpets.
Then which of the favors of your Lord both of you will deny?
Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honor.
When the Day of Judgement will be established.
There is no lie in its establishment.
It will make everything topsy-turvy.
When the earth will shake violently.
And the mountains will completely crumble.
Then will scattered into particles.
Then you will become three groups.
Then people of right hand, and what to say about right-handers.
And people of the left hand, and what to ask about left-handers.
And the foremost ones (in faith), shall be the foremost ones (in the Hereafter).
And they will be nearest in the presence of Allah.
(They) shall be in the Paradises of full of Bliss.
Many people will be from the earlier ones (who first embraced Islam).
And some of them will be from the last period.
On the large thrones (of pearls and rubies).
They will be reclining on them, in front of each other.
Youths, who will always remain young, will go roundabout (to serve) them.
Shall be carrying goblets, jugs and cups of pure wine.
From which there will not be any headache nor there will be any loss of consciousness.
And shall be carrying fruits of their choice.
And meat of those birds which they will desire.
And there will be wide-eyed Hoories.
Like well-guarded pearls.
In fact all this will be as recompense and reward for their deeds.
There they will not hear any vain talk or sinful-speech.
There only will be peace and greetings everywhere.
And what to say about the companions of right hand; those companions of Right-Hand!
(There will be) bores without thorns;
Loaded bananas, one over another.
Spreaded shades.
Water falling from the Falls.
They will be amidst the plentiful fruits.
Whose continuance will never end and there won't be any hindrance.
And there will be high quality mattresses.
Indeed, We have created these Hoories.
We have created them all new.
These virgins will be companions among themselves.
These are all for right handers.
Whose one group will be of earlier people.
And one group will be of later people.
And companions of the left-hand; what to ask about the left-handers.
Hot air and boiling water.
Shade of black smoke.
Which will not be cool and nor feel good.
These are the people who were living a very (lavish) luxurious life.
They were persistent on the great sins.
They said: when we die and become dust and bones, shall then we be raised up again.
Will our fathers be raised again?
Say: earlier ones and later ones, all.
They will all be collected on an appointed day at a promised place.
After that, O you who have gone astray and deniers.
They shall eat the Thor tree.
Then you shall fill your bellies with it.
Then shall drink boiling water on top of it.
Then shall drink like thirsty camels drink.
This shall be their hospitality on the Day of Judgement.
We have created you, then why don't you affirm the re-creation.
Have you seen that sperm which you put in the womb.
Do you create that, or We are the Creator?
We have ordained death among you, and We are not unable to do this.
That We may create other people like you; and transform you in such a form which even you do not know.
You know the first form of creation, so why don't you ponder over it.
You have seen that seed also which you sow in the ground.
Do you make it grow or We make it grow?
Had We pleased, We would have turned it into bits and you would have kept thinking.
That we remain in great loss.
Rather we remained deprived.
Did you see the water which you drink?
Did you rain it from the clouds, or is it We who sent down the rain?
Had We pleased, We would have made it saline, then why don't you give thanks to Us?
Did you see the fire which you kindle from wood?
Did you grow that tree, or We are its Creator.
We made it a source of a reminder; and a profitable object for the travelers.
Now you glorify the name of your Greatest Lord.
And I swear by the phases of the stars.
And it is a great oath; if you know.
This is the most honorable Quran.
This has been kept in the hidden book.
No one can touch it except those who are purified.
This is revealed by the Lord of the Worlds.
So do you people deny this talk (Quran).
And you have made it your profession to deny it.
Then why does it not happen, when your soul reaches your throat.
And then you shall just keep looking on.
We are nearer to the dying person than you, but you cannot see.
Then if you are not under pressure from anyone and are totally free.
Then why do you not return that soul, if you are truthful.
Then if the dying person is from the nearest one to Allah.
Then for him is comfort, fragrant flowers, and gardens of bliss.
And if those are the right-hand people.
Then salutations are for you, from the companions of right-handers.
And if he is of those who deny and have gone astray.
Then (for him) is hospitality of boiling water.
And the punishment of being thrown into Hell.
This is that talk which is the Truth and certainty.
Then continue to glorify the name of your Greatest Lord.
Everything which is in the sky and on the earth is busy in glorifying the Lord, and that Lord is Honorable and Wise.
All the authority of the sky and the earth is with Him, and it is He who gives life and death, and He has Power over everything.
He is The First, He is The Last, He is Outward, He is Inward, and He is Knower of everything.

It is He who has created the skies and the earth in six days, then established His power on the Throne, He knows all things which enters the earth and what comes out of it, and whatever comes down from the sky and raises towards it, He is with you - wherever you may be, and He sees all your deeds.
Kingdom of the skies and the earth is for Him, and all the affairs return to Allah only.
He enters night into the day and the day into the night, and he has the knowledge of secrets of the chests too.

Believe in Allah and His prophet and spend from the wealth (in His way) in which Allah has made you His deputy, among you those who believe and spend in the way of Allah, there is great reward for them.

And what has happened to you; that you do not believe in Allah, even while the prophet is inviting you to believe in your Lord, and Allah has already taken a covenant from you about this; if you would trust.
That is He who sends the explicit signs on His servant, to bring you out of darkness towards the light, and verily Allah is kind on your condition and is Merciful.

And what has happened to you that you do not spend in the cause of Allah? Whereas all the heritage of skies and the earth is His, and among you he cannot be equal to (the persons) who spent and fought before the victory, to those who spent and fought after the victory; those are higher in rank who fought before, however Allah has promised good to everyone, and Allah is well cognizant of what you do. ​
Who is there who will give goodly loan (qarz-e-hasna) to Allah, and He will increase it two-fold, and besides that he will have respectful reward too.

On that day you will see to the believing men and the believing women - their light of faith is walking ahead of them and on their right side, and it is being said to them that today good news to you is that of gardens beneath which rivers are flowing, and you shall abide forever therein, and this is the grand success.

On that day hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to the believers: look at us so we may borrow a light from your light, so they will be told: return to your rear and request for light from your demons; and thereafter separation will be brought between them by a wall - inside of which will be the Mercy, and outside of which will be the punishment.

Hypocrites will call out to the believers and say: were not we with you, they will say: indeed, but you afflicted yourselves in calamity and awaited adversity for us, and you doubted prophethood; and your desires kept you in deception, till the command of Allah came; and you were deceived by the deceptive Satan.
So today no ransom will be accepted either from you or from the infidels, abode of all of you is Hell, He has the authority over all of you, and worst is your consequence.

Has the time not come for the believers that their hearts are softened from the mention of Allah and about the Truth revealed from Him; and they should not be like those People of the Book who were given the book and their hearts were hardened after the passage of a period of time, and their majority became wicked.
Remember, that it is Allah who gives life to the dead earth, and We have described all (Our) signs in detail, so that you may use your wisdom.
Verily, men who do charity and women who do charity and those who give goodly loan to Allah with sincerity, their recompense will be doubled and (besides it) for them is honorable great reward.

And the people who believed in Allah and His prophet, their rank near Allah is that of a truthful and a martyr and for them is their reward and the light; and those who adopted infidelity and denied Our signs, they are in fact companions of Hell.

Remember, life of the world is play, entertainment, adornment and mutual boasting, and competition about abundance of wealth and children; an example is of rain that its power of growth make the farmers happy, and later their farms withers and you see it grow yellow, and then it becomes dry and crumbles; and in the Hereafter there is severe Punishment and Forgiveness and Pleasure of Allah is also there, and life of this world is nothing but means of deception.

Hasten towards the forgiveness of your Lord and His Paradise - width of which is equal to the earth and the skies, that has been provided for the people who believe on Allah and His prophet, this is in fact the Grace of Allah which He bestows upon whom He pleases; and Allah is the Master of abounding Grace.
If any calamity befalls on earth or befalls on yourself; so this has already been written in the Divine Book before the creation of yourself, and this is a very easy thing for Allah.
This fate is there so that you do not grieve if anything goes out of your hands, and if you get something do not be proud of it; that Allah does not like prideful and arrogant people.
Those who are stingy themselves and enjoin others also to do stinginess and whoever will turn away from Allah should know that Allah is Self-Sufficient and worthy of all Praise.

Verily, We have sent Our prophets with the clear signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that the people may stand forth in justice; and We have also sent down the iron in which there is material of mighty war and other benefits too; so that Allah may test who help Him and His prophet without seeing, and verily Allah is very Powerful and Honorable.
And We sent Nooh and Ibrahim and kept book and the prophethood among their descendants; so some of them were on guidance and many of them were transgressors and wicked ones.

Then on their footsteps We sent other prophets, and after them sent Isa son of Maryam and bestowed upon him Injeel, and We ordained in the hearts of his followers love and compassion; and Monasticism, which they had invented for themselves to seek the pleasure of Allah, We did not prescribed for them, and even they themselves didn't followed it (as they should have done), so among them We rewarded those who really believed; but many of them were transgressors and wicked ones.

O believers! fear Allah and believe in His prophet in reality, so that Allah bestow upon you double His Mercy on you, and establish a light for you with which you can walk (on the straight path), and forgive you, for Allah is Most-Forgiving and Most Merciful.

That People of Book should know that they do not have any authority over the Grace of Allah, and all the Grace is in Allah's Hand only and He bestows upon whomever He pleases, and He is the Owner of the mighty Grace.
Verily, Allah heard the talk of that lady who was talking to you regarding her husband and was pleading with Allah, and Allah was hearing the talk of both of you; Allah is all Hearing and all Seeing.

Those people who do Zihaar with their wives, their wives cannot be their mothers, mothers are only those who gave birth to them, and they say very evil and false talk, and Allah is all Pardoning and all Forgiving.

Among you, those who pronounce Zihaar to their wives and wish to go back on their words they uttered, so they should free a slave before touching the wife, this is an admonition for you from Allah, and Allah is very cognizant with your deeds.

Then if it is not possible for him to free a slave, he should keep the fast for two months consecutively before touching each other, if this is also not possible then he should feed sixty destitute; this is because you should keep faith on Allah and His prophet correctly, these are the limits set by Allah, and for the infidels there is very painful punishment.

Verily, those who keep enmity with Allah and His prophet will be as humiliated as people before them were humiliated, and We have revealed the Clear Signs, and for the infidels is humiliating punishment.
On the Day when Allah will bring everyone to life (again) and shall inform them about their deeds, which He has recorded and people themselves have forgotten, and Allah is Witness over everything.

Don't you see that Allah is aware of everything of the skies and the earth, there is not a secret talk between three persons but that He is their fourth, and where there are five secret talk holders He is their sixth; whether less or more if there is a secret talk He is surely with them - wherever they may be; thereafter on the Day of Judgement He will inform them what they had done; verily He is Knower of all things.

Didn't you see those people who were forbidden from secret talk yet they talk like this and indulge in secret talk with iniquity, injustice and in disobedience to the prophet; when they come to you they address you in such a way which Allah has not taught them, and they say in their hearts if we are wrong why don't Allah send punishment on us; although for Hell is enough for them, in which they will burn, and that is the worst end.

O you who believe! Whenever you talk in secret, beware, do not talk with iniquity, aggression and in disobedience to the prophet, but instead talk righteousness and with piousness, keep fearing Allah, after all your return is towards Him.
These secret talks are from Satan to trouble the believers, although he cannot harm them until Allah gives permission, and believers' trust is only on Allah.

O you who believe! When you are asked to make room in the assemblies give place to other so that Allah expand your place in the Paradise; and when you are asked to rise up, get up, that Allah pleases to raise the ranks of those who believe and who have been granted knowledge; and Allah is well aware of your deeds.

O you who believe! whenever you talk confidentially to the prophet give something in charity beforehand, it is better and purity for you; if charity is not possible then Allah is very Forgiving and Merciful.

Have you become fearful that you have to give charity before your confidential talk with the prophet, now that you have not done this then Allah has accepted your repentance; now establish prayer and give poor-rate and obey Allah and His prophet; Allah is well aware of your deeds.

Didn't you see those people who befriended the nation on whom Allah has sent punishment, they are neither from you nor from them, and they swear falsely and they are themselves aware of their own falsehood.
Allah has prepared severe punishment for them that they were doing very evil deeds.
They have made their oaths their shields and are creating hurdles in the path of Allah, so for them is humiliating punishment.
Their wealth and their children are of no avail against Allah, they are all Hellish people and they shall abide in it forever.
On the Day Allah will raise them again, then they will swear with Him also as they swear with you; they will think that they have something to say, whereas they are totally liars.
Satan has overpowered them and he has made them oblivious from the remembrance of Allah; be aware, this is group of Satan, and at last group of Satan is loser.
Verily, those who are hostile to Allah and His prophet, they are among the most humiliating people.
Allah has written that I and My prophet are going to prevail, Verily, Allah is Owner of Strength and Honorable.

You will never see that the nation who believe on Allah and the Day of Judgement is befriending to the people who are inimical to Allah and His prophet even if they are their fathers, children, brothers or of their clan and tribe; Allah has written faith in the hearts of the believers, and has endorsed them with exclusive Spirit from Himself, and He will admit them into those Paradises beneath which rivers will be flowing, and they shall abide in them forever, Allah will be pleased with them, and they will be pleased with Allah, they are the Party of Allah and be aware that deliverance is only for Allah's Party.
Whatever is in the skies and on the earth, everything is busy glorifying Allah, and He is Honorable and Owner of Wisdom.

It is He who got out unbelievers among the People of the Book from their homes at the first gathering and you were not even imagining that they can be exiled, and they were also of the opinion that their forts will saved them from Allah, but Allah behaved in such a way that they could not had envisage about it, and cast terror in their hearts that they started to destroy their houses from their own hands and from the hands of the believers; so that people with the vision may take the lesson.
If Allah would not have written exile in their fate, then He would have sent punishment on them in the world, and in the Hereafter punishment of Hell is certain.
This is because they disputed with Allah and His prophet, and those who dispute with Allah, then Allah is severe in punishment.
O Muslims! Whether you cut the palm-tree branches or left them on their roots, this was all with the permission of Allah, that Allah may disgrace the transgressors.

And whatever war booty Allah has made available from them to the Prophet, for that you made no expedition either through your horses or camels, but Allah gave domination to His prophet and Allah has power over everything.

Whatever Allah has made available from the people of the towns, all belong to Allah, to His prophet, relatives of the prophet, orphans, destitute and to poor-travelers; that all the wealth may not circulate and may not remain among the wealthy people only; and take whatever prophet give you, and refrain from whatever he prohibits you, and fear Allah; for Allah is strict in punishment.

This wealth belongs to the poor migrants also who have been expelled from their homes and property and they only desire the Grace and Pleasure of Allah and help Allah and His prophet, these are the people who are true to their claim in believing.

And those who earlier had their homes (in Madina) and adopted faith before them and show affection to those who came to them after migration; and had no desire in their hearts for whatever was given to them and prefers others over themselves no matter how needful they themselves may be, and those who are saved from the greed of their Selves, they shall achieve the desires of their hearts.

And those who came after them say: O Lord forgive us and also our brethren who accepted faith before us and do not let the malice take place in our hearts for the believers, O Lord, You are very Kind and Merciful.

Did not you see the condition of the hypocrites that they say to their unbelieving brothers among the people of the book that if you are expelled, we will also go with you and will not obey anyone concerning you, and if you are attacked, we will help you; and Allah is witness that they are totally liars.

If they are expelled, they will not go with them; if they are attacked, they will never help them, and even if they help - they will turn their backs and run away, then no one will be there to help them.
O Muslims! You arouse greater fear in their hearts than Allah, this is because this nation is devoid of understanding.

They will never fight collectively with you except when they are in secured towns or from behind the walls, strong is their fighting spirit among them, you think they are united, never, there is severe discord in their hearts; and this is because this nation has no wisdom.
Like recently what has happened to the earlier people, they tasted the result of their conduct, and there is also painful punishment for them.
Their example is like Satan that he says to man: "adopt infidelity" and when he becomes infidel Satan says: I am free from you, I fear the Lord of the Worlds.
So consequence of both of them is that both shall abide in the Hell forever; and this is really the punishment of the unjust.
O you who believe! Fear Allah, and every person should see what he has sent for tomorrow (the Hereafter) and keep fearing Allah, He is indeed well aware of your deeds.
And beware! do not be like those who have forgotten Allah; so Allah Himself have also forgotten their Selves, and indeed they are all transgressors.
Companions of Paradise and Companions of Hell cannot be alike, Companions of Paradise are those who will achieve success.
Had We revealed this Quran on a mountain then you would have seen it tremble and become pieces with the Fear of Allah, and We describe these examples for man that perhaps they may ponder about it.
That is Allah, there is no god but He, He is the knower of the Unseen and the seen; He is the Most Gracious, the All-compassionate.

That is Allah, there is no god but He. He is the King, Having Holy Attributes, Flawless, Giver of the Refuge, Guardian, Exalted in Honor, Greatest, Owner of Pride; He is above all the talk which polytheists do.
That is Allah who creates, invents, and makes faces; to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names, every particle of the earth and the skies is busy glorifying him, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.

O you who believe, beware! Never befriend with My enemy and your enemy, you will offer them friendship whereas they have denied the Truth that has come to you; and they are expelling the prophet and you, just because you believe in Allah - your Lord; if in reality you have left your homes to strive in Our way and to seek Our Pleasure, then how you are making secret friendship with them, whereas I know fully well all that you conceal and that you reveal; and whoever will act in this way verily he has deviated from the straight path.
And if they find you, they will prove to be your enemies, they will work against you with their hands and their tongues, and they will desire you become infidels.
Verily your relatives and your children will be of no use to you on the Day of Judgement, that day Allah will decide between you, and He is well aware of your deeds.

The best example for your is in Ibrahim and his companions when they said to their nation that we are free from you and your gods, we have rejected you, and enmity and hatred between us and you is clear unless you believe in One Allah - who has no partner; except for the word of Ibrahim which he said to his father that Verily I will seek forgiveness for you though I do not have any authority from Allah (in this regard); O Allah, I have trusted you, and have turned towards You, and towards you is the return.
O Lord, do not make us a temptation to the infidels, and forgive us, O Lord, You are all-Honorable and all-Wise.
Verily for you is a best example in these people - for him who is hopeful of Allah and the Hereafter, but if anyone deviate then Allah is Self-Sufficient from him and worthy of all-Praise.
It is near that Allah may establish friendship between you and those with whom you have enmity that He is Owner of Power, and All-Forgiving and All-Merciful.

And He did not forbid you from doing kindness and justice with those who have not fought with you in religious matters and have not expelled you from your homes, that Allah likes those who do justice.

He only prohibits you from being friend with those who fought with you in religion's cause and who expelled you from your habitats and help the enemies in your expulsion; whoever will befriend with them is indeed unjust.

O you who believe, when the migrant believing women come to you, first test them that Allah is well aware of their faith, if you ascertain that they are believers then beware do not send them back to the infidels, that they are not lawful for them, nor these (women) are lawful for them (for infidels); but pay them (to infidels) whatever they have spent on dowers; there is no blame on you if you marry them after paying their dowers; and do not hold unto the infidel women, ask back for what you have spent on them (for their dower), and infidels may also ask for what they have spent; this is the command of Allah by which Allah has judged between you, and He is All-Knowing and All-Wise.

And if any of your wives have deserted you for the infidels, so punish them; whose wife has gone, pay him the dower (what he had paid to the woman) from the war-booty; and anyhow fear Allah, in Whom you believe.
