O Prophet, if believing women come to you and wish to give you oath of allegiance that they will not make any partner with Allah, and will not steal, and they will not commit fornication, and will not kill their children; and they will not forge a slander from their hands and their feet, and will not oppose you in any good, then accept their allegiance and ask forgiveness for them from Allah, that Allah is Most Forgiving and Most Merciful.
O you who believe, never befriend with the nation on whom Allah has sent His wrath; that they are in despair from the Hereafter just as the infidels are in despair about those buried in graves.
Every particle which is on the earth and in the skies is busy glorifying Allah, and He is Honorable and Wise.
O you who believe, why do you say that which you do not do.
It is a matter of strong displeasure near Allah, that you say that you do not follow.
Verily, Allah likes those who fight in battle in His way by forming rows like a wall filled with lead.

And remember the time when Moosa said to his nation: O my people why you are vexing me, although you are aware that I am a messenger of Allah to you, so when those people turned crooked then Allah let their hearts go crooked; that Allah do not guide transgressing nation.

And remember the time when Isa son of Maryam said: O Bani Israel I am a messenger of Allah to you; and I am confirming the earlier book Taurait, and giving glad-tidings of a Prophet after me, whose name is Ahmed; but even then when he came with the miracles, the people said: "this is open magic".
Who can be the bigger unjust who blames Allah, whereas he is being invited towards Islam, and Allah never guides the unjust nation.
Intention of these people is to extinguish the Light of Allah (by blowing) with their mouth and Allah shall complete His Light, even if the infidels may not like it.
That is Allah who has sent His Prophet with guidance and religion of truth, that He makes it dominate over all the religions, no matter how much the polytheists dislike it.
O you who believe, shall I guide you towards such a trade which will save you from the painful punishment?
Believe in Allah and His Prophet, and struggle hard in the way of Allah with your life and wealth, that this is the best for you; if you know.

He will also forgive your sins and will enter you in that Paradises beneath which the rivers will be flowing, and there will be pure houses in this forever-remaining Paradise, and this the greater success.
And one more thing which you like - help from Allah and close victory; and you may give glad tidings to the believers.

O you who believe, become helpers of Allah, like Isa ibn Maryam said to his disciples: who is my helper in the way of Allah? So his disciples said: we are the helpers of Allah; but then one group of Bani Israel believed, and one group disbelieved, so We helped the believers against their enemy, so eventually they dominated.
Every particle of the earth and the sky is glorifying Allah, who is the King, having Pure Attributes, Honorable and has Wisdom.

That is Allah who sent a prophet to the people of Makkah which was from among them to recite the verses in front of them, to purify themselves and may educate them in book and wisdom, although they were afflicted with the open misguidance.
And from among them towards those people also, who have not joined them yet, and He is Honorable and has Wisdom.
It is the Grace of Allah, He bestows upon whomever He pleases, and He is the Owner of the Mighty Grace.

The example of the people who were given a load of Taurait and they could not bear it; its load are similar to a donkey who is carrying a load of books; this worst example is of those people who denied the Divine Verses, and Allah does not guide the unjust nation.
(O Prophet) Say: O you Jews! if you consider that only you are friends of Allah among all the people, so if you are true in your claim, then desire for death.
And they will never desire for death because of the deeds their hands have already done, and Allah is well aware of the conditions of the unjust.

Say: the death from which you are escaping is going to meet you itself, thereafter you will be returned to His Presence, Who is aware of all, the unseen and the seen and He will tell you what you had been doing in the world.
O believers, when on Friday you are called for the prayer, hasten towards the remembrance of Allah and close your business, that this is best for you; if you know.
When the prayer gets over, scatter in the land and search for the bounty of Allah (sustenance) and remember Allah in abundance, perhaps like this you may get deliverance.

And O prophet, when these people see the trade and games then they run towards and leave you standing alone; Say: whatever is with Allah is much better than this game and trade, and He is the best provider of the sustenance.

O prophet, these hypocrites come to you and say: we bear witness that you are the prophet of Allah, Yes, Allah Knows that you are His prophet and Allah bears witness that these hypocrites are liars in their claim.
They have made their oaths their shields and they are obstructing people from the way of Allah, and these are their worst deeds which they are doing.
This is because they believed first and then they became infidels, so their hearts have been sealed, now they are not understanding anything.

And when you will look at them, their bodies will seem very good to you, and when they speak, you will listen to their words, but in reality they are like dry woods leaning against the wall, and they think every scream is against them, in fact they are enemies, beware of them, may Allah destroy them; where are they going astray.
And when it is said to them: come, Prophet of Allah will pray for your forgiveness, they turn aside their heads; and you will see them turning their faces in arrogance.
It is the same for them whether you pray for their forgiveness or not, Allah is not going to forgive them that Allah does not give guidance to the evil doing nation.

These are the people who say: do not spend anything on the companions of the Prophet of Allah so they may get scattered, although all the treasures of skies and the earth belong to Allah only, and these hypocrites do not understand this.

These people say that if we come back to Madina, then we, the honorable people will drive out these mean people; although all the Honor belongs to Allah, His Prophet and to the believers and these hypocrites even do not know this.
O you who believe! beware, your wealth and your children may not make you oblivious from the remembrance of Allah, and Verily whoever will do this will be counted among the losers.

And spend in Our way from the sustenance what We have bestowed upon you, before death come to any of you and he may say, "O Lord! Why don't you give us the respite for some days so that we give charity and be counted among the good servants".
And when the appointed time (of death) comes, Allah does not grant respite to any soul, and He is well aware of your deeds.
Every particle on the earth and in the skies is glorifying Allah, to Him belongs the Kingdom and to Him belongs the Praise and He has the power over all things.
He has created you all, then some of you are believers and some of you are disbelievers, and He is well watching your deeds.
Only He has created the skies and the earth with the Truth, and has given you face and made your faces very beautiful, and then everyone has to return to Him.
He is aware of everything of the earth and the skies; and He knows all those things which you express or which you conceal and He is also aware of the secrets of your breasts.
Did not the news of those who adopted infidelity earlier come to you that they tasted the disaster of their deeds; aur for them is the painful punishment.

That was because prophets came to them with clear signs so they said clearly, 'will a human being give us guidance', and by saying this they rejected and turned the face, Allah is also needless from them; and He is Praiseworthy and free of all wants.
These infidels think that they will not be raised again, say: by my Lord, you shall be brought to life again, then (you) shall be told of all that you did, and this is very easy for Allah.
Therefore, believe on Allah and His Prophet and that Light which We have sent down that Allah is well aware of your deeds.

He will gather you all on the Day of Judgement and that will be the day of loss and gain, and the one who believes in Allah and will perform good deeds; Allah will remove his evil deeds and will admit him in those gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, and they will abide in it forever, and this is the biggest achievement.
And those who adopted infidelity and rejected Our signs, they are the people of Hell, and shall abide therein forever; and this is their worst recompense.
No calamity comes, but with the command of Allah and he who is a believer, Allah guides his heart; and Allah knows all things.
And you people obey Allah and obey His Prophet and if you will deviate then the duty of the prophet is nothing but to reach you the message clearly.
That is Allah and besides Him there is no god, and all the believers should have trust in Him only.

O you who believe! among your wives and children some of them are your enemies, therefore be careful of them, and if you forgive them and overlook them, and pardon them, then Allah is also All-Forgiving and Merciful.
Your wealth and your children are source of trial for you, and Great Reward is only with Allah.

Therefore, fear Allah as much as you can and listen to Him and obey and spend in the way of Allah that there is good in it for you; and those who are saved from stinginess of their own souls are those who will prosper and get deliverance.
If you will give Goodly loan to Allah, He will make it double (to your credit) and will also forgive you; and He is very Appreciative and very Forbearing.
He is the Knower of the seen and unseen and is Honorable and Wise.

O Prophet! When you people divorce women, divorce them according to their prescribed periods, then count their prescribed period and keep fearing Allah for He is your Lord, and do not turn them out of homes, nor they should leave themselves, unless they commit some open lewdness, these are limits of Allah and whoever will transgress limits of Allah, will be unjust to his own soul; you are not aware that perhaps Allah thereafter may bring about some new situation.

When they complete their prescribed periods, either hold them back with goodness, or bid them farewell with goodness, and for divorce make two just witnesses from among yourselves, and bear witness only for the sake of Allah; this admonition is for those who believe in Allah and on the Last Day, and for those who fears Allah, He makes the way for his deliverance.

And (He) provide the sustenance from such places you cannot imagine, and if anyone trust in Allah, Allah is sufficient for him, verily, Allah reaches His command, and He has specified a quantity for everything.

And among your women who have passed the age of menstrual course and if you have any doubt then their prescribed period is three months, and likewise for the women who do not menstruate; and prescribed period for pregnant is till the delivery of child, and who fear Allah, Allah makes easy their affairs.
This is the command of Allah which He has sent down towards you, and who fear Allah, Allah removes his evils, and increases his reward.

And provide residence to the divorcee (during the prescribed period) as per your capacity and do not torment them so as to make them suffer; and if they are pregnant provide them the expenses until the delivery of child; and if they suckle your children then give them wages and decide it with mutual understanding that is just and reasonable, and if there is discord among you then give chance to other woman for suckling.

Let the rich man spend according to his capacity, and the man whose sustenance is strait, let him spend according to what Allah has given him; Allah does not trouble any Self beyond what he can bear; Allah will shortly grant vastness after straitness.
And how many settlements are there who disobeyed the Command of Allah and His Prophet, so We took severe account of them and afflicted them in the worst punishment.
Then did they taste the evil result of their conduct, and the final recompense is loss only.
Allah has prepared the severest type of punishment for them; therefore, O you who believe and O you men of understanding, fear Allah that He has sent down His remembrance towards you.

That Prophet who recites the explicit verses of Allah to bring out the believers and good doers from the darkness towards the light; and who will have faith on Allah and will do good deeds, Allah will enter him into the gardens beneath which rivers will be flowing, they shall abide in it forever, and Allah has bestowed upon them this, the excellent sustenance.

That is Allah who created the seven skies, and likewise created earths within the earth in same numbers, His commands descend between them that you must know He has power over all things, and that His Knowledge has encircled everything.
O Prophet! Why are you withholding yourself from what Allah has made lawful for you, are you desirous of pleasing your wives; Allah is All-Forgiving and Most Merciful.
Allah has obliged that you end your oaths by giving expiation, and Allah is your Master, and He is the Knower of all things and has Wisdom.

When Prophet disclosed a matter to one of his wives in confidence and she divulged it to the other (wife) and Allah made this known to the Prophet, so Prophet told some matters to her and withheld some; then when he told her, she asked: who told you this, so prophet said: Allah is all Knower and all Aware.

Now both of you seek repentance, crookedness has developed in your hearts, otherwise if you will back up each other against him, then remember, Allah is his Guardian and Gabriel, and righteous believers and angels all are his helpers.
Even if he divorces you (all), Allah will provide him better wives in your place, submissive, believers, obedient, repentant, worshipper, fasting ones, virgin and non-virgin, all.

O you who believe, save yourselves and your families from this fire whose fuel will be human and stones, over which those angels will be appointed who are stern and harsh in temperament, and who do not oppose the command of Allah; and they obey the command that is given to them.
And O you who adopted infidelity, today do not present any excuse, today you will be punished for your deeds.

O you who believe, repent sincerely, shortly your Lord will remove your evil and will admit you in such Paradises beneath which rivers will be flowing; that Day Allah will not allow His prophet and the believers to be disgraced, their light shall be walking ahead of them and on their right side; and they will say: O Allah, complete our light for us and forgive us that verily You have Power over all things.
O Prophet, struggle hard against infidels and hypocrites and be stern with them, and their abode is Hell and that is the worst consequence.

Those who adopted infidelity, Allah has described the example of wife of Nooh and wife of Lut for they both were under the marriage of our righteous servants, but they betrayed them (their husbands); therefore, their marriage (with the prophets) did not benefit them in the Presence of Allah, and they were told: you also enter the Hell along with other Hellish people.

And Allah has narrated the example of Firaun's wife for the believers, that she prayed: O Lord, build for me a house in the Paradise and deliver me from the doings of Firaun and deliver me from this entire unjust nation.

And the instance of Maryam, daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity, so We blew Our Spirit in her, and she testified the words of her Lord, and confirmed the books, and she was among Our obedient servants.
Blessed is He in whose hands is the entire Kingdom; and He has power over all things.
He has created death and life so that He may try you that who is better among you with regards to the deed, and He is also Honorable and Forgiving.
He has created seven skies one over another, and you will not see any difference in creation of the Beneficent, then look up again do you see any crack?
Thereafter, look again and again, your sight will return to you tiredly, but you will not see any flaw.
And We have beautified the world's sky with the lamps, and made them the source for stoning the satans, and have also prepared punishment of Hell separately for them.
And those who deny their Lord there is punishment of Hell for them and that is the worst result.
When they will be cast therein (they) will listen to its cries, and it will be blazing forth.
Rather, it will be nearing that with intensity of flaring it may burst up; whenever any group will be cast into it, its wardens will ask them: had no warner come to you?
So they will say, he did come to us, but we denied him and said: Allah never sent down anything; you people are yourselves in great misguidance.
And then they will say: if we would have heard and understood, today we would not have been among the Hellish people.
So they have confessed to their sins, now people of Hell are far away from the Mercy of Allah.
Verily, as for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, there is forgiveness and great reward for them.
Whether you talk slowly or talk loudly, Allah is even aware of the secrets of your breasts.
And did the Creator not know? While He is also Subtle and also All-Aware.
It is He who made the earth soft for you, that you walk on its sides and search for the sustenance of Allah; then rising from the graves have to return towards Him.
Have you become complacent from the One who Rule the sky, that He will cause the earth to swallow you up, and it keep you rotating.
Or do you feel secure from it that He will not send shower of stones on you; then you will very shortly know how is My warning.
And people before them have also denied, then see how terrifying their result was.
Did not they observe the birds over themselves, who spread and wind up their wings, no one can uphold them in the atmosphere except Allah; and He is the Guardian over all things.
Is this who is made up like your army can help you against Allah? Indeed, infidels are in delusion.
Or can he give you sustenance if Allah withhold His provisions, fact is that they are drowned in utter disobedience and hate.
Does the person who walks on his face is more guided; or the person who walks upright on the straight path?
Say: "It is Allah Who has created you and He has given you ears, eyes and heart, but you are very less grateful".
Say: "That He is the one who has spread you in the earth, and you will be gathered and taken towards Him".
And these people say if you are truthful then when will this promise be perfected?
Say: "Knowledge is with Allah and I am only a clear warner."
